abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Recent literature on the lack of efficiency and acceptability of publicly provided health services has led to an interest in the use of partnerships with the private sector to deliver public services. OBJECTIVES: To assess the effectiveness of contracting out healthcare services in improving access to care in low and middle-income countries and, where possible, health outcomes. SEARCH STRATEGY: We searched a wide range of international databases, including the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), MEDLINE and EMBASE, in addition to development studies and economic databases. We also searched the websites and online resources of numerous international agencies, organisations and universities to find relevant grey literature. The original searches were conducted between November 2005 and April 2006. An updated search in MEDLINE was carried out in May 2009. SELECTION CRITERIA: Contracting out health services is defined as the provision of healthcare services on behalf of the government by non-state providers. Studies had to include an objective measure of at least one of the following outcomes: health care utilisation, health expenditure, health outcomes or equity outcomes. Studies also needed to use one of the following study designs: randomised controlled trial, non-randomised controlled trial, interrupted time series analysis or controlled before and after study. DATA COLLECTION AND ANALYSIS: We made an attempt to present results from the different studies in a systematic way, however due to the diversity of sources, contexts and methods used, we undertook a narrative synthesis. MAIN RESULTS: Three studies met our inclusion criteria (one after re-analysis of data). These studies suggest that contracting out services to non-state providers can increase access and utilisation of health services. One study found a reduction in out-of-pocket expenditures and improvement in some health outcomes. However, methodological weaknesses and particularities of the reported programme settings limit the strength and generalisability of their conclusions. AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: Three studies suggest that contracting out may be an appropriate response to scale up service delivery in particular settings, such as post-conflict or fragile states. Evidence was not presented on whether this approach was more effective than making a similar investment in the public sector, as there was not an exact control available in any of the settings. In addition, the introduction of non-state providers into some settings and not others also brings many potentially confounding variables, such as the presence of additional management expertise or expatriate doctors, which may improve drug supply or increase utilisation.

10.1002/14651858.cd008133.abstractZh: 背景：近期关于公共医疗服务效率低下和接受度不足的研究，引发了对与私营部门合作以提供公共服务的兴趣。目的：评估将医疗服务外包在提高低收入和中等收入国家医疗服务可及性方面的效果，并在可能的情况下评估其健康结果。检索策略：我们检索了多种国际数据库，包括Cochrane中央对照试验注册库（CENTRAL）、MEDLINE和EMBASE，以及发展研究和经济数据库。我们还检索了众多国际机构、组织和大学的网站和在线资源，以寻找相关的灰色文献。最初的检索工作在2005年11月至2006年4月期间进行。2009年5月对MEDLINE进行了更新检索。选择标准：将医疗服务外包定义为由政府以外的提供者代表政府提供医疗服务。研究必须至少包含以下结果之一的客观衡量指标：医疗服务利用情况、医疗支出、健康结果或公平结果。研究还需要采用以下一种研究设计：随机对照试验、非随机对照试验、中断时间序列分析或对照前后研究。数据收集与分析：我们尝试以系统化的方式呈现不同研究的结果，但由于来源、背景和方法的多样性，我们采用了叙述性综合方法。主要结果：有三项研究符合我们的纳入标准（其中一项是在重新分析数据后发现的）。这些研究表明，将服务外包给非国家提供者可以提高医疗服务的获取率和利用率。一项研究发现，患者的自付费用有所减少，某些健康指标也有所改善。然而，研究方法上的不足以及报告中的项目特殊性限制了这些结论的可靠性和普遍性。作者的结论：三项研究表明，在特定情况下，如冲突后或脆弱国家，将服务外包可能是一种有效的服务提供扩展方式。不过，这些研究并未提供关于这种方法是否比在公共部门进行类似投资更为有效的证据，因为在这些项目中缺乏精确的控制措施。此外，将非国家提供者引入某些项目而另一些项目则没有，这引入了许多潜在的混淆变量，例如额外的管理专业知识或外籍医生的存在，这些因素可能会改善药品供应或提高服务利用率。

abstract.text: About 30% of Americans are currently obese, which is roughly a 100% increase from 25 years ago. Public health officials have consequently become alarmed because recent research indicates that societal costs of obesity now exceed those of cigarette smoking and alcoholism. Cigarette taxes may have exacerbated the prevalence of obesity. In 1964, the US Surgeon General issued its first report relating smoking and health, and since that time, federal and state governments have increased cigarette taxes in a successful effort to reduce cigarette smoking. However, because cigarette smoking and obesity seem inversely related, cigarette taxes may have simultaneously increased obesity. This paper examines the effects of cigarette costs on BMI and obesity and finds that they have significant positive effects. This paper attempts to reconcile conflicting evidence in the literature by controlling more carefully for correlation with state-specific time trends using panel data. Results indicate that the net benefit to society of increasing cigarette taxes may not be as large as previously thought, though this research in no way concludes that they should be decreased to prompt weight loss.

10.1002/hec.1340.abstractZh: 目前，约30%的美国人患有肥胖症，这一比例比25年前增加了大约100%。公共卫生官员因此感到担忧，因为最近的研究表明，肥胖带来的社会成本已经超过了吸烟和酗酒。香烟税的增加可能加剧了肥胖的流行。1964年，美国卫生局局长发布了关于吸烟与健康的首次报告，此后，联邦和州政府通过提高香烟税来减少吸烟现象。然而，由于吸烟和肥胖似乎呈负相关关系，香烟税的增加可能同时导致了肥胖的上升。本文研究了香烟成本对体重指数和肥胖的影响，发现它们具有显著的积极效果。本文试图通过使用面板数据更仔细地控制各州的时间趋势，来调和文献中的矛盾证据。结果表明，提高香烟税对社会的净收益可能并不如之前认为的那么大，尽管这项研究并不建议降低香烟税以促进体重减轻。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the relationship between job satisfaction and measures of health of workers using the German Socio-Economic Panel. Methodologically, it addresses two important design problems encountered frequently in the literature: (a) cross-sectional causality problems and (b) the absence of objective measures of physical health that complement self-reported measures of health status. Not only does using the panel structure with individual fixed effects mitigate the bias from omitting unobservable personal psycho-social characteristics, but employing more objective health measures such as health-system contacts and disability addresses such measurement problems relating to self-report assessments of health status.We find a positive link between job satisfaction (and changes over time therein) and subjective health measures (and changes therein); that is, employees with higher or improved job satisfaction levels feel healthier and are more satisfied with their health. This observation also holds true for more objective measures of health. Particularly, improvements in job satisfaction over time appear to prevent workers from (further) health deterioration.

10.1002/hec.1341.abstractZh: 本文利用德国社会经济面板数据，评估了工作满意度与工人健康状况之间的关系。在方法论上，本文解决了文献中常见的两个重要设计问题：(a)横截面因果关系问题；(b)缺乏能够补充自我报告健康状况的客观健康指标。采用带有个体固定效应的面板结构不仅可以减少因忽略不可观测的个人心理社会特征而产生的偏差，而且通过使用如医疗系统接触次数和残疾状况等更客观的健康指标，可以解决与自我报告健康状况评估相关的测量问题。我们发现，工作满意度（及其随时间的变化）与主观健康指标之间存在正相关关系；也就是说，工作满意度较高或有所改善的员工感觉更健康，并且对自己的健康状况更为满意。这一观察结果在更客观的健康指标上同样成立。特别是，随着时间推移工作满意度的提升似乎能够防止工人健康状况进一步恶化。

abstract.text: We examine the distributional characteristics of Hong Kong's mixed public-private health system to identify the net redistribution achieved through public spending on health care, compare the income-related inequality and inequity of public and private care and measure horizontal inequity in health-care delivery overall. Payments for public care are highly concentrated on the better-off whereas benefits are pro-poor. As a consequence, public health care effects significant net redistribution from the rich to the poor. Public care is skewed towards the poor in part not only because of allocation according to need but also because the rich opt out of the public sector and consume most of the private care. Overall, there is horizontal inequity favouring the rich in general outpatient care and (very marginally) inpatient care. Pro-rich bias in the distribution of private care outweighs the pro-poor bias of public care. A lesser role for private finance may improve horizontal equity of utilisation but would also reduce the degree of net redistribution through the public sector.

10.1002/hec.1342.abstractZh: 我们研究了香港混合公私卫生系统的分配特征，以识别通过公共支出在医疗保健方面实现的净再分配效果，比较公共和私人医疗服务的收入相关不平等性，并衡量整体医疗服务中的横向不平等性。公共医疗服务的支付高度集中在较富裕的人群身上，而福利则倾向于帮助贫困人口。因此，公共医疗保健从富人向穷人的显著净再分配效果显著。公共医疗服务的分配偏向于贫困人口，这不仅是因为根据需求进行分配，还因为富人选择不参与公共部门服务，而大部分私人医疗服务则由富人消费。总体而言，在门诊服务中，横向不平等性有利于富人，在住院服务中则存在非常轻微的不平等性。私人医疗服务分配中的富人偏向性超过了公共医疗服务中的穷人偏向性。减少私人金融的作用可能会改善使用的横向公平性，但也会降低通过公共部门实现的净再分配程度。

abstract.text: In response to rising health care costs, many have called for more effective regional health policy coordination. In this paper, we address the issue by examining the degree of convergence in per capita health care expenditure and its nine components across the US states from 1980 to 2004. The major finding is the moderate evidence of convergence in total health care expenditure and the diverse performance of the expenditure components regarding convergence. We also find hospital care to be responsible for the bulk of cross-state convergence in total expenditure. The expenditure on prescription drugs is the most important diverging factor. Policy implications of these empirical results are discussed.

10.1002/hec.1343.abstractZh: 为应对不断上升的医疗保健成本，许多人呼吁加强区域卫生政策的协调。本文通过研究1980年至2004年间美国各州人均医疗保健支出及其九个组成部分的趋同程度，来探讨这一问题。主要发现是，总体医疗保健支出存在适度的趋同趋势，而各组成部分在趋同方面的表现则存在差异。我们还发现，医院护理在州际总支出的趋同中起着重要作用，而处方药支出则是导致差异最大的因素。本文还讨论了这些实证结果的政策意义。

abstract.text: We propose a method for calculating the production costs of an intervention in a manner that accounts for differences in productive 'effort.' This method could be used within a cost-effectiveness analysis framework in the evaluation of new medical technologies, pharmaceuticals, treatment programs, or public health interventions. We apply it to show evidence in favor of implementing a newborn screening program to detect congenital hearing impairment.

10.1002/hec.1345.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种计算干预措施成本的方法，该方法考虑了生产“努力”的差异。这种方法可以用于成本效益分析框架中，以评估新的医疗技术、药品、治疗计划或公共卫生干预措施。我们应用该方法来证明实施新生儿筛查计划以检测先天性听力障碍的合理性。

abstract.text: Objective To measure the impact of China's New Cooperative Medical Scheme (NCMS) on catastrophic medical payments of rural households in Linyi County, Shandong Province. Method In 2005, from a stratified cluster sample of 3101 rural households, we identified 375 households that might be at risk of catastrophic payments by searching through NCMS claims and interviewing key informants. We interviewed these 375 households and confirmed that 231 had had catastrophic payments (> or = 40% of the households' capacity to pay; CTP) during 2004. A validity test of our screening method found another eight cases among immediate neighbours of these 375 households; by extrapolation, we obtained an adjusted total of 289 catastrophic households in the sample of 3101. We measured the impact of the NCMS on hardship alleviation by counterfactual analysis, comparing catastrophic payments before and after NCMS reimbursements. Result The effect was twofold. Before NCMS intervention 8.98% of Linyi population had had catastrophic out-of-pocket payments compared with 8.25% after reimbursements. Catastrophic severity for households remaining in catastrophe after reimbursement dropped by 18.7% to an average of 6.34 times the household's CTP. Conclusion Out-of-pocket medical payments remain a burden for rural households. Financial protection from the NCMS, with an average reimbursement of 17.8%, was modest and should be restructured to provide better benefits that are targeted to those in most need.

10.1002/hec.1346.abstractZh:
目的：研究中国新型农村合作医疗制度对山东省临邑县农村家庭灾难性医疗支出的影响。  
方法：2005年，从3101户农村家庭中进行分层抽样，通过查阅新型农村合作医疗的报销记录并访谈关键信息来源，筛选出375户可能存在灾难性医疗支出的家庭。对这375户家庭进行访谈后确认，2004年有231户发生了灾难性医疗支出（超过或等于家庭支付能力的40%）。对筛选方法的有效性测试发现，这375户家庭的直接邻居中还有8户出现灾难性医疗支出；通过推断，在3101户家庭中共有289户发生了灾难性医疗支出。我们通过反事实分析来衡量新型农村合作医疗对减轻贫困的影响，比较了实施新型农村合作医疗前后的灾难性医疗支出情况。  
结果：新型农村合作医疗的干预效果显著。在实施新型农村合作医疗之前，临邑县8.98%的人口曾发生灾难性医疗支出，而在实施报销政策后这一比例降至8.25%。对于在报销后仍处于灾难状态的家庭来说，灾难性医疗支出的严重程度平均下降了18.7%，降至家庭支付能力的6.34倍。  
结论：农村家庭仍然面临着高昂的医疗费用负担。新型农村合作医疗提供的平均报销金额为17.8%，但这一措施的效果有限，需要进一步调整，以提供更有效的福利，真正惠及最需要帮助的人群。

abstract.text: A post hoc analysis of data from a prospective cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) conducted alongside a randomized controlled trial (National Emphysema Treatment Trial - NETT) was used to assess the impact of using different imputation methods for missing quality of life data on the estimation of the incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER). The NETT compared lung-volume-reduction surgery plus medical therapy with medical therapy alone in patients with severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease due to emphysema. One thousand sixty-six patients were followed for up to 3 years after randomization. The cost per quality-adjusted life-year gained was obtained, computing costs from a societal perspective and using the self-administered Quality of Well Being questionnaire to measure quality of life. Different methods of imputation resulted in substantial differences in ICERs as well as differences in estimates of the uncertainty in the point estimates as reflected in the CEA acceptability curves. Paradoxically, the use of a conservative single imputation method resulted in relatively less uncertainty (anticonservative) about the ICER. Owing to the effects of different imputation methods for missing quality of life data on the estimation of the ICER, we recommend use of a minimum of two imputation methods that always include multiple imputation.

10.1002/hec.1347.abstractZh: 对一项前瞻性成本效益分析（CEA）的数据进行了后验分析，该分析与一项随机对照试验（国家肺气肿治疗试验 - NETT）同时进行。分析的目的是评估使用不同的缺失生活质量数据填补方法对增量成本效益比（ICER）估算的影响。NETT比较了肺容积减少手术加药物治疗与单独药物治疗在因肺气肿导致的严重慢性阻塞性肺病患者中的效果。一千六十六名患者在随机分组后接受了长达3年的随访。通过社会视角计算成本，并使用自我管理的生活质量问卷来衡量生活质量，从而获得了每质量调整生命年所获得的成本。不同的填补方法导致ICER存在显著差异，同时CEA可接受性曲线也反映出点估计的不确定性存在差异。具有讽刺意味的是，使用较为保守的单一填补方法反而使得ICER的不确定性相对较小。由于不同填补方法对缺失生活质量数据的影响，我们建议至少使用两种填补方法，并且始终采用多重填补方法。

abstract.text: The literature to date on the effect of demand uncertainty on public hospital costs and excess capacity has not taken into account the role of expense preference behaviour. Similarly, the research on expense preference behaviour has not taken demand uncertainty into account. In this paper, we argue that both demand uncertainty and expense preference behaviour may affect public hospital costs and excess capacity and that ignoring either of these effects may lead to biased parameter estimates and misleading inference. To show this, we extend the analysis of Rodríguez-Alvarez and Lovell (Health Econ. 2004; 13: 157-169) by incorporating demand uncertainty into the technology to account for the hospital activity of providing standby capacity or insurance against the unexpected demand. We find that demand uncertainty in Spanish public hospitals affects hospital production decisions and increases costs. Our results also show that overcapitalization in these hospitals can be explained by hospitals providing insurance demand when faced with demand uncertainty. We also find evidence of expense preference behaviour. We conclude that both stochastic demand and expense preference behaviour should be taken into account when analysing hospital costs and production.

10.1002/hec.1352.abstractZh: 迄今为止，关于需求不确定性对公立医院成本和过剩产能影响的文献并未考虑费用偏好行为的作用。同样，关于费用偏好行为的研究也未考虑需求不确定性。在本文中，我们认为需求不确定性和费用偏好行为都可能影响公立医院的成本和过剩产能，忽视其中任何一个效应都可能导致参数估计偏差和误导性结论。为了证明这一点，我们扩展了Rodríguez-Alvarez和Lovell（Health Econ. 2004; 13: 157-169）的分析，将需求不确定性纳入技术分析中，以解释医院提供备用产能或应对意外需求保险的行为。我们发现，西班牙公立医院的需求不确定性会影响医院的生产决策并增加成本。我们的结果还表明，这些医院的过度投资可以通过在面临需求不确定性时提供需求保险来解释。我们还发现了费用偏好行为的证据。我们得出结论，在分析医院成本和生产决策时，应同时考虑随机需求和费用偏好行为。

abstract.text: Value of information methods allows decision makers to identify efficient trial design following a principle of maximizing the expected value to decision makers of information from potential trial designs relative to their expected cost. However, in health technology assessment (HTA) the restrictive assumption has been made that, prospectively, there is only expected value of sample information from research commissioned within jurisdiction. This paper extends the framework for optimal trial design and decision making within jurisdiction to allow for optimal trial design across jurisdictions. This is illustrated in identifying an optimal trial design for decision making across the US, the UK and Australia for early versus late external cephalic version for pregnant women presenting in the breech position. The expected net gain from locally optimal trial designs of US$0.72M is shown to increase to US$1.14M with a globally optimal trial design. In general, the proposed method of globally optimal trial design improves on optimal trial design within jurisdictions by: (i) reflecting the global value of non-rival information; (ii) allowing optimal allocation of trial sample across jurisdictions; (iii) avoiding market failure associated with free-rider effects, sub-optimal spreading of fixed costs and heterogeneity of trial information with multiple trials.

10.1002/hec.1353.abstractZh: 信息方法的价值在于帮助决策者根据最大化决策者从潜在试验设计中获得的信息的预期价值与预期成本之间的关系来识别高效的试验设计。然而，在健康技术评估中，人们通常假设只有来自所在司法管辖区的研究样本信息的预期价值是可行的。本文扩展了在所在司法管辖区内进行最优试验设计和决策制定的框架，以允许跨司法管辖区进行最优试验设计。以美国、英国和澳大利亚为例，本文确定了针对臀位分娩孕妇早期与晚期外部头位转位手术的最优试验设计。研究表明，本地最优试验设计的预期净收益为72万美元，而全球最优试验设计的预期净收益则增加到114万美元。总体而言，所提出的全球最优试验设计方法优于所在司法管辖区内的最优试验设计，因为它能够：(i) 反映非竞争性信息的全球价值；(ii) 允许在跨司法管辖区之间最优分配试验样本；(iii) 避免与搭便车效应、固定成本分配不当以及多试验情况下试验信息的异质性相关的市场失灵问题。

abstract.text: We test the relative income hypothesis that an individual's health depends on the distribution of income in a reference group, as well as on the income of the individual. We use data on 231 208 individuals in Great Britain from 19 rounds of the General Household Survey between 1979 and 2000. Results are insensitive to the measure of self-assessed health used but the sign and significance of the effect of relative income depend on the reference group (national or regional) and the measure of relative income (Gini coefficient, absolute or proportional difference from the reference group mean, Yitzhaki absolute and proportional relative deprivation and affluence). Only one model (relative deprivation measured as income proportional to regional mean income) performs better than the model without relative income and has a positive estimated effect of absolute income on health. In this model the increase in the probability of good health from a ceteris paribus reduction in relative deprivation from the upper quartile to zero is 0.010, whereas an increase in income from the lower to the upper quartile increases the probability by 0.056. While our results provide only very weak support for the relative deprivation hypothesis, the inevitable correlation of measures of individual income and relative deprivation measured by comparing income and incomes in a reference group makes identification of the separate effects of income and relative deprivation problematic.

10.1002/hec.1354.abstractZh: 我们检验了相对收入假说，即个人的健康状况取决于参考群体的收入分布以及个人的收入。我们使用了1979年至2000年间英国《综合家庭调查》19轮调查中的231,208名个体的数据。研究结果对用于自我评估健康状况的度量方式并不敏感，但相对收入效应的符号和显著性取决于参考群体（国家或地区）以及相对收入的度量方式（基尼系数、与参考群体平均值的绝对或比例差异、Yitzhaki绝对和比例相对剥夺以及富裕程度）。只有一个模型（将相对剥夺表示为与地区平均收入的比例）的表现优于没有相对收入的模型，并且绝对收入对健康的估计效应为正。在这个模型中，从其他条件不变的情况下，相对剥夺从上四分位数降至零，健康概率增加0.010；而收入从下四分位数上升到上四分位数，健康概率增加0.056。虽然我们的结果仅对相对剥夺假说提供了非常弱的支持，但由于个人收入与通过比较参考群体中的收入和收入所测量的相对剥夺之间存在必然的相关性，因此难以区分收入和相对剥夺的单独效应。

abstract.text: When deciding how to weigh benefits to different groups, standard economic models assume that people focus on the final distribution of utility, health or whatever. Thus, an egalitarian is assumed to be an egalitarian in the outcome space. But what about egalitarianism in the gains space, such that people focus instead on how equally benefits are distributed? This paper reports on a study in which members of the public were asked to rank a number of health programmes that differed in the distribution of benefits and final outcomes in ways that enabled us to distinguish between different types of egalitarianism. The results suggest that outcome egalitarianism dominates, particularly for differences in health by social class, but a sizeable minority of respondents appear to be gain egalitarians, especially when the health differences are by sex. These results have important implications for how we think about outcome-based social welfare functions in economics.

10.1002/hec.1355.abstractZh: 在决定如何权衡不同群体的利益时，标准的经济模型假设人们关注的是最终的利益分配，无论是健康还是其他方面。因此，平等主义者被假定是在结果空间中的平等主义者。但是，如果平等主义是在收益空间中的，即人们关注的是利益分配的平等性呢？本文报道了一项研究，参与者被要求对一系列健康项目进行排名，这些项目在利益分配和最终结果方面存在差异，从而我们能够区分不同类型的平等主义。研究结果表明，结果平等主义占主导地位，尤其是在不同社会阶层之间的健康差异方面。不过，有相当一部分受访者似乎属于收益平等主义者，尤其是在健康差异与性别相关的情况下。这些结果对于我们如何看待经济学中基于结果的福利函数具有重要意义。

abstract.text: The value of a health state may depend on how long an individual has had to endure the health state (i.e. hedonic load). In this paper, we test the constant proportionality (CP) assumption and determine the sign of relationship between duration and health state value for 42 health states using the nationally representative data from the United Kingdom Measurement and Valuation of Health study. The results reject the CP assumption and suggest that the relationship is negative for optimal health (i.e. fair innings argument) and that the relationship is positive for poorer health states (i.e. adaptation). We find no evidence of the maximum endurable time hypothesis using these data. This evidence on the duration effect has important implications for outcomes research and the economic evaluation of interventions.

10.1002/hec.1356.abstractZh: 健康状态的价值可能取决于个体需要忍受该健康状态的时间长短（即享乐负担）。在本文中，我们检验了恒定比例假设，并使用英国健康测量与评估研究的全国代表性数据，确定了42种健康状态中持续时间与健康状态价值之间的关系的符号。研究结果否定了恒定比例假设，并表明对于最佳健康状态而言，这种关系是负的（即“公平游戏”理论）；而对于较差的健康状态而言，这种关系是正的（即适应性）。我们没有发现使用这些数据时支持“可忍受时间最大化”假设的证据。关于持续时间效应的这些研究结果对结果研究和干预措施的经济评估具有重要意义。

abstract.text: In the United States, inpatient medical care increasingly encompasses the use of expensive medical technology and, at the same time, is coordinated and supervised more and more by a rapidly growing number of inpatient-dedicated physicians (hospitalists). In the production of inpatient care services, Hospitalist services can be viewed as complementary to sophisticated and expensive medical equipment in the provision of inpatient medical care. We investigate the causal relationship between a hospital's access to three types of sophisticated diagnostic and therapeutic medical equipment - intensity-modulated radiation therapy, gamma knife, and multi-slice computed tomography - and its likelihood of using hospitalists. To rule out omitted variables bias and reverse causality, we use technology-specific Certificate of Need regulation to predict technology use. We find a strong positive association, yet no causal link between access to medical technology and hospitalist use. We also study the choice of employment modality among hospitals that use hospitalists, and find that access to expensive medical technology reduces the hospital's propensity to employ hospitalists directly.

10.1002/hec.1360.abstractZh: 在美国，住院医疗护理越来越包含使用昂贵的医疗技术，同时，这些护理工作也越来越多地由数量迅速增长的住院医师来协调和监督。在住院护理服务的提供过程中，住院医师服务可以被视为对复杂且昂贵的医疗设备的补充。我们研究了医院获取三种复杂诊断和治疗医疗设备——调强放射治疗、伽马刀和多层螺旋CT——与是否使用住院医师之间的因果关系。为了排除遗漏变量偏差和反向因果关系的影响，我们使用了特定技术的需求许可制度来预测技术使用情况。我们发现，尽管在获取医疗技术方面与住院医师的使用之间存在强烈的正相关关系，但并没有直接的因果关系。我们还研究了使用住院医师的医院在选择就业模式方面的差异，发现获取昂贵的医疗技术会降低医院直接雇佣住院医师的倾向。

abstract.text: We examine the relationship between unemployment and self-assessed health using the European Community Household Panel for Finland over the period 1996-2001. Our results show that the event of becoming unemployed does not matter as such for self-assessed health. The health status of those that end up being unemployed is lower than that of the continually employed. Therefore, persons who have poor health are being selected for the pool of the unemployed. This explains why, in a cross-section, unemployment is associated with poor self-assessed health. All in all, the cross-sectional negative relationship between unemployment and self-assessed health is not found longitudinally.

10.1002/hec.1361.abstractZh: 我们利用芬兰欧洲共同体家庭面板数据，在1996-2001年期间研究了失业与自我评估健康状况之间的关系。研究结果表明，失业本身对自我评估的健康状况并无显著影响。最终失业者的健康状况低于持续就业者的健康状况。因此，健康状况较差的人会被选入失业人群。这解释了为什么在横截面上，失业与自我评估的不良健康状况之间存在关联。总体而言，失业与自我评估健康状况之间的负相关关系在纵向研究中并未得到证实。

abstract.text: This paper examines the differences in health state evaluations given by patients when they are asked to value their own current states, and those given by members of the general population who were asked to value hypothetical health states. Patient data consist of 4137 observations on EQ-5D profiles and Visual Analogue Scale (VAS) obtained from 3376 patients, covering eight different conditions. General population data are taken from the EQ-5D valuation set. Two analyses were carried out. In the first, the patient self-rated VAS was compared with population VAS values for the same health states. In the second, the patient self-rated VAS values were modelled, and the regression coefficients were compared with the corresponding coefficients from the general population study. The first analysis resulted in a statistically significant mean difference of -0.012 (0.647 for patient VAS, 0.659 from the population value set). The second analysis found statistically significant differences between the coefficients for the EQ-5D health dimensions Pain/Discomfort, Mobility and Anxiety/Depression. Anxiety/Depression had the largest impact on the patient model compared with Pain/Discomfort in the general population model. A further regression analysis suggests that the magnitude of disagreement between patient self-rated VAS model and the population VAS model depends on the patients' condition.

10.1002/hec.1362.abstractZh: 本文探讨了当患者被要求评估自身当前健康状况时，与一般人群被要求评估假设健康状况时，他们对健康状况的评估差异。患者数据包括来自3376名患者的4137个EQ-5D评估报告和视觉类比量表（VAS）数据，涵盖八种不同的健康状况。一般人群数据则来自EQ-5D评估数据集。进行了两项分析：第一项是将患者自我评估的VAS值与相同健康状况的一般人群VAS值进行比较；第二项是对患者自我评估的VAS值进行建模，并将回归系数与一般人群研究中的相应系数进行比较。第一项分析结果显示，患者自我评估的VAS值与一般人群评估值之间存在统计学上的显著差异，平均差异为-0.012（患者评估值为0.647，一般人群评估值为0.659）。第二项分析发现，EQ-5D健康维度中的疼痛/不适、活动能力和焦虑/抑郁方面的系数存在统计学上的显著差异。在一般人群模型中，疼痛/不适的影响较小，而焦虑/抑郁对患者的评估模型影响更大。进一步的回归分析表明，患者自我评估的VAS模型与一般人群VAS模型之间的分歧程度取决于患者的健康状况。

abstract.text: Background Published guidelines on the conduct of economic evaluations provide little guidance regarding the use and potential bias of the different costing methods. Objectives Using microcosting and two gross-costing methods, we (1) compared the cost estimates within and across subjects, and (2) determined the impact on the results of an economic evaluation. Methods Microcosting estimates were obtained from the local health region and gross-costing estimates were obtained from two government bodies (one provincial and one national). Total inpatient costs were described for each method. Using an economic evaluation of sirolimus-eluting stents, we compared the incremental cost-utility ratios that resulted from applying each method. Results Microcosting, Case-Mix-Grouper (CMG) gross-costing, and Refined-Diagnosis-Related grouper (rDRG) gross-costing resulted in 4-year mean cost estimates of $16,684, $16,232, and $10,474, respectively. Using Monte Carlo simulation, the cost per QALY gained was $41,764 (95% CI: $41,182-$42 346), $42,538 (95% CI: $42 167-$42 907), and $36,566 (95% CI: $36,172-$36,960) for microcosting, rDRG-derived and CMG-derived estimates, respectively (P<0.001). Conclusions Within subject, the three costing methods produced markedly different cost estimates. The difference in cost-utility values produced by each method is modest but of a magnitude that could influence a decision to fund a new intervention.

10.1002/hec.1363.abstractZh:
背景：现有的经济评估实施指南对于不同成本计算方法的运用及其潜在偏差提供了较少的指导。  
目的：通过使用微观成本计算法和两种总体成本计算方法，我们（1）比较了不同受试对象之间的成本估算结果，以及（2）确定了这些方法对经济评估结果的影响。  
方法：微观成本计算法的估算数据来自当地卫生区域，而总体成本计算法的估算数据来自两个政府机构（一个省级机构和一个国家级机构）。每种方法下的总住院成本均被详细描述。通过对西罗莫司洗脱支架的经济评估，我们比较了采用每种方法得出的增量成本-效用比。  
结果：微观成本计算法、病例组合法（CMG）总体成本计算法和精细化诊断相关病例组合法（rDRG）总体成本计算法分别得出的4年平均成本估算分别为16,684美元、16,232美元和10,474美元。通过蒙特卡洛模拟分析，每种方法每获得一个质量调整生命年（QALY）的成本分别为41,764美元（95%置信区间：41,182美元至42,346美元）、42,538美元（95%置信区间：42,167美元至42,907美元）和36,566美元（95%置信区间：36,172美元至36,960美元）（P<0.001）。  
结论：在单个受试对象内部，这三种成本计算方法得出的成本估算结果存在显著差异。每种方法产生的成本-效用值差异虽不大，但这一差异可能对是否资助新的干预措施的决定产生影响。

abstract.text: This study presents the first comparison of willingness to pay estimates derived from the payment card (PC) contingent valuation and discrete choice experiment (DCE) methods. A within-sample experiment was used to elicit women's preferences for Chlamydia screening. The willingness to pay estimate derived from the DCE was larger than that derived from the PC. To investigate why the willingness to pay estimates were different, a range of validity tests were conducted. Both methods produced theoretically valid results, and there was no difference in the reported difficulty of completing the tasks. Evidence of a prominence effect was found in the PC responses. Responses to the DCE satisfied tests of non-satiation. Responses to both methods were compared with revealed preference data. There were significant differences between stated screening intention in both methods and actual screening uptake. Future work should address the external validity of stated preference methods.

10.1002/hec.1364.abstractZh: 本研究首次比较了通过支付卡条件估值法和离散选择实验法得出的支付意愿估计值。实验采用样本内实验方法，以了解女性对衣原体筛查的偏好。结果显示，通过离散选择实验得出的支付意愿估计值高于通过支付卡方法得出的结果。为了探究支付意愿估计值差异的原因，研究人员进行了一系列有效性测试。两种方法均产生了理论上的有效结果，且完成任务的难度也没有差异。在支付卡响应中发现了显著性效应的证据。离散选择实验的响应符合非饱和性检验的结果。两种方法得出的响应与揭示偏好数据进行了比较，发现两种方法下表达的筛查意向与实际筛查实施之间存在显著差异。未来的研究应进一步探讨揭示偏好方法的外部有效性。

abstract.text: The valuation of changes in consumption of addictive goods resulting from policy interventions presents a challenge for cost-benefit analysts. Consumer surplus losses from reduced consumption of addictive goods that are measured relative to market demand schedules overestimate the social cost of cessation interventions. This article seeks to show that consumer surplus losses measured using a non-addicted demand schedule provide a better assessment of social cost. Specifically, (1) it develops an addiction model that permits an estimate of the smoker's compensating variation for the elimination of addiction; (2) it employs a contingent valuation survey of current smokers to estimate their willingness-to-pay (WTP) for a treatment that would eliminate addiction; (3) it uses the estimate of WTP from the survey to calculate the fraction of consumer surplus that should be viewed as consumer value; and (4) it provides an estimate of this fraction. The exercise suggests that, as a tentative first and rough rule-of-thumb, only about 75% of the loss of the conventionally measured consumer surplus should be counted as social cost for policies that reduce the consumption of cigarettes. Additional research to estimate this important rule-of-thumb is desirable to address the various caveats relevant to this study.

10.1002/hec.1365.abstractZh: 对于成本效益分析师来说，评估政策干预导致的成瘾性商品消费变化的价值是一个挑战。通过减少成瘾性商品消费而导致的消费者剩余损失，如果以市场需求表为基准进行测量，会高估停止干预措施的社会成本。本文旨在证明，使用非成瘾性需求表来测量消费者剩余损失能够更好地评估社会成本。具体来说：(1) 本文建立了一个成瘾模型，可以估算吸烟者因消除成瘾而产生的补偿变化；(2) 通过对当前吸烟者进行条件价值评估调查，估算他们愿意为消除成瘾的治疗支付的价格；(3) 利用调查得出的支付意愿估算值，计算应被视为消费者价值的消费者剩余比例；(4) 本文还提供了这一比例的估算值。研究表明，作为初步的粗略规则，只有大约75%的常规测量消费者剩余损失应被视为减少香烟消费政策的社会成本。为了应对本研究中的各种限制因素，有必要进行更多的研究以验证这一重要规则。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of health maintenance organizations (HMOs) and for-profit HMO share on the survival of safety net services in hospitals between 1990 and 2004. The primary data sources are the American Hospital Association Annual Surveys, the Medicare hospital cost reports, and the HMO enrollment and ownership data from Interstudy. I analyze the risks of shutting down each safety net service separately using the proportional hazard models. I find that the risks of shutting down hospital safety net services do not vary by different levels of overall HMO penetration. However, conditional on the overall HMO penetration level, increasing for-profit presence of HMO does increase the risks of shutting down several safety net services. Policies evaluating the for-profit expansion or ownership conversion of health plans should take this potential adverse effect into consideration.

10.1002/hec.1366.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了1990年至2004年间，健康维护组织（HMOs）及其营利性HMO股份对医院安全网服务存续情况的影响。主要数据来源包括美国医院协会年度调查、医疗保险医院成本报告，以及Interstudy提供的HMO注册和所有权数据。我使用比例风险模型分别分析了关闭每项安全网服务的风险。研究发现，关闭医院安全网服务的风险并不因HMO的整体渗透率不同而有所变化。然而，在总体HMO渗透率既定的情况下，HMO的营利性增强确实会增加关闭多项安全网服务的风险。评估健康计划营利性扩张或所有权转换的政策应考虑到这一潜在的负面影响。

abstract.text: Individuals with dual enrollment in Medicare and Medicaid have become the focus of heightened US federal and state policy interest in recent years. These beneficiaries are among the most vulnerable and costly persons served by either program. This analysis uses a reduced-form econometric model and a unique survey of community-resident dual enrollees to take a critical step toward understanding the relationships and combinations of state long-term care (LTC) policies and their relative effectiveness in achieving their intended effects: increasing access to care, improving activities of daily living/instrumental activities of daily living (ADL/IADL) assistance, and reducing unmet needs. We then simulate the effects of alternative policies to determine the most effective combination.The combination of policies that was most effective in reducing the percentage of individuals receiving low levels of assistance was high spending in the community relative to nursing home and low community LTC spending per recipient; that is, spending more on community care and spreading it across more people. Overall, this analysis confirms that Medicaid LTC policy decisions by states, and the combinations of policies that are implemented, result in important variations in levels of assistance to elderly persons with disabilities.

10.1002/hec.1367.abstractZh: 近年来，同时参加医疗保险和医疗补助计划的个体成为美国联邦和州政府政策关注的重点。这些受益者属于任一计划服务中最脆弱且费用最高的群体。本研究采用简化形式的计量经济模型，并结合对社区居民的独特调查，以深入理解各州长期护理政策之间的关系与组合，以及它们在实现预期效果方面的相对有效性：提高护理可及性、改善日常生活活动/工具性日常生活活动辅助能力，以及减少未满足的需求。随后，我们模拟了不同政策组合的效果，以确定最有效的政策组合。结果显示，在减少接受低水平辅助服务的个体比例方面，最有效的政策组合是：在社区中投入更多的资金，以相对较低的护理院支出和较低的每人社区长期护理支出；也就是说，在社区护理上投入更多资金，并将资金分配给更多人群。总体而言，这项分析证实，各州对医疗补助长期护理政策的决策，以及所实施的政策组合，确实会导致对残疾老年人援助水平的显著差异。

abstract.text: I study factors associated with prevalence of obesity among immigrants as the length of their stay in the US becomes longer. Using the National Health Interview Surveys for 1990-2004, I create 'synthetic cohorts' of immigrants that allow controlling for two important determinants of obesity: age at arrival and period of arrival in the US. I find that immigrants with a BA degree did not experience any change in obesity as their stay in the US advanced. Obesity among those without a BA degree, however, increased with duration of stay. Similarly, while some ethnic groups experienced increase in obesity with duration, others did not. For those who experienced increase in obesity with duration, the rise was higher during the first five years of residence than later and greater for those who arrived at a relatively young age.

10.1002/hec.1368.abstractZh: 我研究了随着移民在美国停留时间延长，肥胖患病率的相关因素。利用1990-2004年的全国健康访谈调查数据，我创建了“合成队列”，以控制两个重要的肥胖决定因素：抵达年龄和抵达美国的时间。我发现，拥有学士学位的移民在在美国停留期间，肥胖率没有变化。然而，没有学士学位的移民的肥胖率则随着停留时间的延长而增加。同样，一些族裔群体的肥胖率随着停留时间的延长而增加，而另一些则没有。对于那些肥胖率随着停留时间延长而增加的群体来说，前五年的肥胖率上升幅度大于后期，且那些在相对年轻的时候抵达的移民的肥胖率上升幅度更大。

abstract.text: Stated preference methods assume respondents' preferences are consistent with utility theory, but many empirical studies report evidence of preferences that violate utility theory. This evidence is often derived from quantitative tests that occur naturally within, or are added to, stated preference tasks. In this study, we use qualitative methods to explore three axioms of utility theory: completeness, monotonicity, and continuity. We take a novel approach, adopting a 'think aloud' technique to identify violations of the axioms of utility theory and to consider how well the quantitative tests incorporated within a discrete choice experiment are able to detect these. Results indicate that quantitative tests classify respondents as being 'irrational' when qualitative statements would indicate they are 'rational'. In particular, 'non-monotonic' responses can often be explained by respondents inferring additional information beyond what is presented in the task, and individuals who appear to adopt non-compensatory decision-making strategies do so because they rate particular attributes very highly (they are not attempting to simplify the task). The results also provide evidence of 'cost-based responses': respondents assumed tests with higher costs would be of higher quality. The value of including in-depth qualitative validation techniques in the development of stated preference tasks is shown.

10.1002/hec.1369.abstractZh: 陈述偏好方法假设受访者的偏好与效用理论一致，但许多实证研究发现了违反效用理论的偏好情况。这些证据通常来自在陈述偏好任务中自然发生的定量测试，或者是在这些测试基础上进行的额外分析。本研究采用定性方法来探讨效用理论的三个公理：完备性、单调性和连续性。我们采用了一种新颖的方法，通过“思维记录”技术来识别效用理论公理的违反情况，并评估定量测试在离散选择实验中的表现如何能够检测到这些违反情况。研究结果表明，当定性陈述表明受访者是“理性”的时，定量测试却将受访者分类为“非理性”的。具体来说，“非单调”的回应通常是由于受访者推断出了任务中未呈现的额外信息，而那些似乎采用非补偿性决策策略的受访者，是因为他们非常看重某些属性（他们并非试图简化任务）。研究结果还提供了“基于成本的反应”的证据：受访者认为成本较高的测试质量更高。研究强调了在开发陈述偏好任务时加入深入定性验证技术的价值。

abstract.text: The potential of preventive health-care services to save costs is intensely debated. On the one hand, a longer life span increases the probability that new and costly diseases occur. On the other hand, a higher life expectancy postpones the expensive last year of life (LYOL), which becomes cheaper with age. Using US expenditure data on survivors and decedents the paper shows that prevention in the general population causes expenditures for additional diseases that are larger than the savings from postponing the LYOL. This result may also hold for prevention in diseased individuals.

10.1002/hec.1370.abstractZh: 关于预防性医疗保健服务在节省成本方面的潜力，目前存在激烈的争论。一方面，更长的寿命会增加出现新的、昂贵的疾病的概率；另一方面，更高的预期寿命会推迟昂贵的晚年生活，而晚年生活的成本会随着年龄的增长而降低。通过利用美国关于幸存者和逝者的支出数据，本文表明，对普通人群进行预防性医疗干预所引发的额外疾病支出，超过了推迟晚年生活所带来的节省成本。这一结果同样适用于对患病个体的预防性医疗干预。

abstract.text: The participation rate in medical screening programmes is typically below 100%, which means that not all potential health benefits are fully exploited. In this paper, the prospect of pecuniary compensation is tested as a method of increasing the participation rate. We propose a model explaining the individual's probability of participating in screening for colorectal cancer when he is offered pecuniary compensation, given that he did not participate when first invited. The participant's decision is based on both known and uncertain factors. The estimation is conducted in two steps, where a binary probit model is used in each. We find that pecuniary compensation increases the probability of participation, and that an individual's participation probability systematically varies with variables such as travel expenses, income, age, education level, expected benefit from the screening, use of health-care services, genetic predisposition and subjective health status. Using the results from the estimation, we predict changes in the participation rate for different levels of compensation and estimate the cost per additional individual screened. The cost per additional individual screened is 808, including 25 in compensation; this cost increases with the level of compensation.

10.1002/hec.1371.abstractZh: 医疗筛查项目的参与率通常低于100%，这意味着并非所有的潜在健康益处都能得到充分利用。本文探讨了通过金钱补偿来提高参与率的可能性。我们提出了一个模型，用于解释当个体在首次被邀请时未参与筛查后，在获得金钱补偿的情况下参与结直肠癌筛查的概率。个体的决策基于已知和未知因素。估计过程分为两步，每一步都使用二元Probit模型。研究发现，金钱补偿确实增加了参与的概率，而个体参与概率会随着诸如旅行费用、收入、年龄、教育水平、筛查预期收益、医疗服务使用、遗传倾向和主观健康状况等变量的变化而发生变化。根据估计结果，我们预测了不同补偿水平下参与率的变化，并估算了每增加一个被筛查个体的成本。每增加一个被筛查个体的成本约为808，其中25元用于补偿；这一成本会随着补偿水平的提高而增加。

abstract.text: Families in developing countries face enormous financial risks from major illness both in terms of the cost of medical care and the loss in income associated with reduced labor supply and productivity. We test whether access to microfinancial savings and lending institutions helps Indonesian families smooth consumption after declines in adult health. In general, results support the importance of these institutions in helping families to self-insure consumption against health shocks.

10.1002/hec.1372.abstractZh: 发展中国家的家庭面临着重大疾病的巨大财务风险，这不仅涉及医疗费用的支出，还涉及因劳动力供应和生产力下降而导致的收入损失。我们研究了获得小额金融储蓄和贷款机构服务是否有助于印度尼西亚家庭在成人健康状况下降后平稳消费。总体而言，研究结果支持了这些机构在帮助家庭应对健康冲击时提供自我保险服务的重要性。

abstract.text: Direct elicitation of utilities for joint health (JS) states may pose substantial interview burden, while traditional models to predict these utilities from utilities of component single states (SS) are inconsistent with the data. Using individual-level data on utilities for health states associated with prostate cancer, we report the performance of a new model that encompasses three traditional models - additive, multiplicative, and minimum - previously used for predicting utilities for joint health states. Describing utilities in terms of utility losses l(.) relative to prefect health, our final estimated linear index for predicting joint health-state utilities is El(JS)=0.05+0.72 x max l(SS1),l(SS2)+0.33.min x l(SS1),l(SS2)-0.18 x l(SS1) x l(SS2). Based on out-of-sample predictions, this model produces up to 50% reduction in mean-square error compared with traditional models and consistent prediction across different ranges of joint-state utilities, which the traditional models do not. Parameter estimates of the new model proposed here provide direct evidence on the inconsistencies of the traditional models, are grounded in psychological theory by emphasizing the more severe component of a joint health state, and provide a simple linear index to generate consistent predictions of utilities for joint health states. Further validation of this function for joint health states in other clinical scenarios is warranted.

10.1002/hec.1373.abstractZh: 直接估算联合健康状态的效用可能会带来巨大的访谈负担，而传统模型从单个状态的效用来预测联合健康的效用则与数据不符。我们利用与前列腺癌相关的健康状态的个体级效用数据，报告了一个新模型的性能，该模型结合了三种传统模型——加法模型、乘法模型和最小模型，这些模型以前被用于预测联合健康的效用。通过以相对于最佳健康的效用损失来表示效用，我们最终得到的线性指数用于预测联合健康状态的效用为：El(JS)=0.05+0.72 x max l(SS1),l(SS2)+0.33.min x l(SS1),l(SS2)-0.18 x l(SS1) x l(SS2)。基于样本外预测，该模型与传统模型相比，平均平方误差降低了50%，并且在不同的联合状态效用范围内都能提供一致的预测结果，这是传统模型所无法实现的。这里提出的新模型的参数估计直接证明了传统模型的不一致性，这些估计基于心理学理论，强调了联合健康状态中更为严重的因素，并提供了一个简单的线性指数，以生成一致性的联合健康状态效用预测。进一步验证该函数在其他临床场景中对联合健康状态的适用性是有必要的。

abstract.text: This note investigates the sources of international differences in the levels of per capita health-care expenditure, using data on the OECD countries between 1975 and 2003. To that end, we use Theil's second measure of inequality for decomposing cross-country disparities in per capita health-care expenditure into the contributions of various factors: health-care expenditure expressed as a share of GDP, labour productivity, employment rate, activity rate and the ratio of working-age population to total population. Our results show that cross-country differences in the share of GDP devoted to health-care expenditure and labour productivity are the main determinants of the level of dispersion in per capita health-care expenditure. On the contrary, existing disparities in the remaining explanatory factors considered play a less relevant role in this context. In any event, the analysis performed reveals that the overall inequality in per capita health-care expenditure decreased throughout the study period. This was due to the process of international convergence observed in most of the factors used to break down the level of per capita health-care expenditure.

10.1002/hec.1374.abstractZh: 本文研究了1975年至2003年间经合组织国家之间人均医疗保健支出水平的国际差异来源。为此，我们采用了Theil的第二衡量不平等指标，将各国人均医疗保健支出的差异分解为多种因素的贡献：以GDP比例表示的医疗保健支出、劳动生产率、就业率、活动率以及劳动年龄人口与总人口的比例。研究结果表明，用于医疗保健支出的GDP比例和劳动生产率的差异是人均医疗保健支出差异程度的主要决定因素。相反，其他解释因素的差异在这一背景下作用较小。无论如何，分析显示，在研究期间，人均医疗保健支出的整体不平等程度有所下降。这一变化是由于用于分解人均医疗保健支出水平的多数因素都经历了国际趋同的过程。

abstract.text: Perinatal interventions delivered during the prenatal period have the potential to directly impact prenatal life. The decision on when to begin 'counting' the life of an infant in the calculus has received little attention in previous economic evaluations of perinatal interventions. We illustrate, using data from a recent trial-based economic evaluation of magnesium sulphate given to women with pre-eclampsia to prevent eclampsia, how different definitions of when human life commences can have a significant impact upon cost-effectiveness estimates based on composite outcome measures such as life years or quality-adjusted life years gained or disability-adjusted life years averted. Further, we suggest ways in which methods in this area can be improved.

10.1002/hec.1375.abstractZh: 在产前阶段进行的围产期干预措施有可能直接影响胎儿的生命。在以往对围产期干预措施的经济评估中，关于何时开始“计算”婴儿生命的长度这一决策并未受到足够关注。我们通过一项基于试验的经济评估数据来说明，对于何时开始计算人类生命的长度有不同的定义，这些差异会对基于复合结局指标（如生命年数、质量调整生命年数或避免的残疾调整生命年数）的成本效益评估产生显著影响。此外，我们提出了改进该领域研究方法的方向。

abstract.text: This paper examines effects of the German social health insurance system's reference drug program (RDP) for prescription drugs on ex-factory prices. Moreover, we analyze whether manufacturers adapt prices of their products that are not subject to reference pricing as a consequence of changes in reference prices of their products that are subject to reference pricing. We use econometric panel data methods based on a large panel data set of nearly all German prescription drugs on a monthly basis between October 1994 and July 2005. They provide information on ex-factory prices, reference prices, manufacturers, type of prescription drug, and market entries and exits. Our results show that there is no full price adjustment: A 1%-change in reference prices leads to a 0.3%-change in market prices. Price adjustment, however, is fast - it mostly happens in the first month. Furthermore, the first introduction of a reference price reduces market prices of the affected products by approximately 7%. Finally, we observe a significant time effect that is positive in the market without reference prices and negative in the market with reference prices.

10.1002/hec.1376.abstractZh: 本文研究了德国社会健康保险系统中的参考药品计划对处方药出厂价格的影响。此外，我们还分析了由于参考价格的变动，那些不受参考价格影响的产品的制造商是否会调整其产品价格。我们采用了基于大量德国处方药月度数据的计量经济学面板数据方法，数据时间跨度从1994年10月到2005年7月。这些数据包含了出厂价格、参考价格、制造商信息、处方药类型以及市场进入和退出情况等信息。研究结果表明，并不存在完全的价格调整：参考价格每变动1%，市场价格会相应变动0.3%。不过，价格调整是迅速发生的，通常会在第一个月内完成。此外，首次引入参考价格会使受影响产品的市场价格下降约7%。最后，我们观察到一种显著的时间效应：在没有参考价格的市场中，这种效应是积极的；而在有参考价格的市场中，这种效应则是消极的。

abstract.text: The number of specialists within dental health services has increased over the last few years. This raises the issue of how the services should be organized and funded. We describe the effect of one way of organizing the services, which is by relying on competition. In Norway, some oral specialists face real competition with general dental practitioners for the same patients (prosthetists, periodontists and endodontists), while other specialists do not (orthodontists and oral surgeons). The latter specialists have skills that give them exclusive possibilities to practice their profession. We find that competition can be effective for the specialists who experience real competition with general dental practitioners for patients. In situations where real competition does not exist, specialists can obtain market power and raise their fees. Our results are based on an analysis of a representative set of data from general dental practitioners and specialists in Norway. The specialities in which practitioners can exercise market power raise challenges related to the type of public policy that can reduce this market power in an appropriate way, and without involving too large costs for the authorities.

10.1002/hec.1377.abstractZh: 近年来，牙科健康服务领域的专家数量有所增加。这引发了关于如何组织和服务以及如何为其提供资金的问题。我们探讨了一种组织服务的方式，即依靠竞争。在挪威，一些口腔专家需要与普通牙科医生竞争相同的患者（如修复牙医、牙周病医生和根管治疗医生），而其他专家则不需要（如正牙医生和口腔外科医生）。后者拥有独特的技能，使他们能够独自执业。我们发现，对于那些需要与普通牙科医生竞争患者的专家来说，竞争是有效的。而在不存在真正竞争的情况下，专家可以获得市场力量并提高收费。我们的研究结果基于对挪威普通牙科医生和专家数据的分析。那些能够行使市场力量的专业领域，带来了与公共政策相关的挑战，这些政策需要以适当的方式减少这种市场力量，同时避免给当局带来过大的成本。

abstract.text: This paper employs a cohort analysis to examine the relative importance of different factors in explaining changes in the number of hours spent in direct patient care by Canadian general/family practitioners (GPs) over the period 1982-2003. Cohorts are defined by year of graduation from medical school. The results for male GPs indicate that there is little age effect on hours of direct patient care, especially among physicians aged 35-55, there is no strong cohort effect on hours of direct patient care, but there is a secular decline in hours of direct patient care over the period. The results for female GPs indicate that female physicians on average work fewer hours than male physicians, there is a clear age effect on hours of direct patient care, there is no strong cohort effect, and there has been little secular change in average hours of direct patient care. The changing behaviour of male GPs accounted for a greater proportion of the overall decline in hours of direct patient care from the 1980s through the mid-1990 s than did the growing proportion of female GPs in the physician stock.

10.1002/hec.1378.abstractZh: 本文采用队列分析方法来研究1982年至2003年间加拿大全科医生/家庭医生在直接患者护理时间上的变化，不同因素的相对重要性。队列的划分依据为从医学院毕业的年份。对于男性全科医生而言，年龄对直接患者护理时间的影响较小，尤其是35-55岁的医生，队列效应并不明显，但整个时期直接患者护理时间呈现了持续下降的趋势。对于女性全科医生而言，女性医生平均工作时间少于男性医生，年龄对直接患者护理时间有明显的影响，但队列效应并不显著，平均直接患者护理时间也几乎没有变化。男性全科医生的行为变化在1980年代至1990年代中期导致直接患者护理时间总体下降的幅度中占据了更大的比例，而女性全科医生在医生群体中的比例增长对这一变化的贡献则相对较小。

abstract.text: Prioritizing candidates for health-care expenditure using cost per Quality-Adjusted Life Year (QALY) is a helpful but insufficient means of ranking alternative uses for scarce health-care funds at the local level. This is because QALYs do not by themselves capture all criteria decision makers need to take into account. Other criteria such as reducing inequalities, meeting national and local priorities and public acceptability also feature in the decision maker's utility function. Programme budgeting and marginal analysis (PBMA) is an established framework for systematic priority setting in which a 'weighted benefit score' for each option is calculated based on all relevant decision-making criteria. Ranking options as a ratio of cost to benefit is desirable and necessary to ensure efficiency. In this paper we review a number of approaches to scoring costs and benefits of options in a PBMA context. Several approaches rank by benefit score alone, rather than efficiency (cost per unit of benefit). Of those that do rank by efficiency, we discuss the benefits and drawbacks. The optimal approach is far from clear, with each technique having its own strengths and weaknesses. A deliberative approach using summaries of costs and benefits of options as a basis for discussion may be preferable.

10.1002/hec.1380.abstractZh: 使用每质量调整生命年（QALY）的成本来优先选择医疗保健支出，是一种有帮助但不够充分的方法，用于在地方层面对稀缺的医疗保健资金进行优先排序。这是因为QALY本身并不能涵盖决策者需要考虑的所有标准。其他标准，如减少不平等、满足国家和地方的优先事项以及公众接受度，也包含在决策者的效用函数中。项目预算编制和边际分析（PBMA）是一种用于系统优先排序的成熟框架，其中基于所有相关的决策标准计算每个选项的“加权收益得分”。将选项按成本与收益的比率进行排序是必要且有益的，以确保效率。在本文中，我们回顾了在PBMA背景下对选项的成本和收益进行评分的几种方法。有些方法仅根据收益得分进行排序，而不是效率（每单位收益的花费）。对于那些按效率进行排序的方法，我们讨论了其优缺点。最优方法尚不清楚，每种技术都有其自身的优势和劣势。使用选项的成本和收益摘要作为讨论基础，可能更为合适。

abstract.text: Enterobacter sakazakii, a pathogen that can be found in powdered infant milk formula, can cause adverse health effects on infants. Using Vickrey auction, this study examines parents' willingness to pay (WTP) for a quality assurance label on powdered infant milk formula. The influence of ambiguity with the incidence rate information and provision of safe-handling information on WTP are also evaluated using three experimental treatments. Our findings generally imply that parents significantly value a quality assurance label. The mean price premium parents are willing to pay for the safer and quality assurance labelled powdered infant milk formula ranges from 61 to 133 Eurocents per 100 grams (53-116% of the base price per 100 grams) depending on the treatment. While no ambiguity effects are generally found, provision of safe-handling information significantly reduced WTP to 39-69 Eurocents per 100 grams depending on the treatment.

10.1002/hec.1381.abstractZh: 阪崎肠杆菌是一种存在于婴儿奶粉中的病原体，可能对婴儿健康造成不良影响。本研究采用Vickrey拍卖法，考察了父母对婴儿奶粉上质量保证标签的支付意愿。同时，通过三种实验处理，评估了发病率信息不明确以及提供安全处理信息对支付意愿的影响。研究结果表明，父母非常重视质量保证标签。对于标有安全与质量保证标签的婴儿奶粉，父母愿意支付的平均价格溢价在每100克61至133欧分之间（占基础价格的53%-116%），具体取决于实验处理方式。虽然总体上未发现信息不明确的效应，但提供安全处理信息后，父母对婴儿奶粉的支付意愿显著下降至每100克39至69欧分。

abstract.text: This study examines the effect of changes in the vintage distribution of cardiovascular system drugs on hospitalization and mortality due to cardiovascular disease using longitudinal country-level data. The vintage of a drug is the first year in which it was marketed anywhere in the world. We use annual data on the utilization of over 1100 cardiovascular drugs (active ingredients) in 20 OECD countries during the period 1995-2003. Countries with larger increases in the share of cardiovascular drug doses that contained post-1995 ingredients had smaller increases in the cardiovascular disease hospital discharge rate, controlling for the quantity of cardiovascular medications consumed per person, the use of other medical innovations (computed tomography scanners and magnetic resonance imaging units), potential risk factors (average consumption of calories, tobacco, and alcohol), and demographic variables (population size and age structure, income, and educational attainment). The estimates also indicate that the use of newer cardiovascular drugs has reduced the average length of stay and the age-adjusted cardiovascular mortality rate, but not the number of potential years of life lost due to cardiovascular disease before age 70 per 100,000 population. The estimates indicate that if drug vintage had not increased during 1995-2004, hospitalization and mortality would have been higher in 2004. We estimate that per capita expenditure on cardiovascular hospital stays would have been 70% ($89) higher in 2004 had drug vintage not increased during 1995-2004. Per capita expenditure on cardiovascular drugs would have been lower in 2004 had drug vintage not increased during 1995-2004. However, our estimate of the increase in expenditure on cardiovascular hospital stays is about 3.7 times as large as our estimate of the reduction in per capita expenditure for cardiovascular drugs that would have occurred ($24).

10.1002/hec.1382.abstractZh: 本研究利用纵向国家级数据，探讨了心血管系统药物上市年份分布的变化对心血管疾病住院率和死亡率的影响。药物的上市年份是指该药物在全球范围内首次上市的那一年。我们使用了1995年至2003年间20个经合组织国家1100种心血管药物（活性成分）的年度使用数据。在控制人均心血管药物使用量、其他医疗创新技术（如计算机断层扫描仪和磁共振成像设备）的使用、潜在风险因素（如平均热量、烟草和酒精消费）以及人口统计变量（如人口规模和年龄结构、收入和教育水平）的情况下，那些在1995年后才开始使用新成分的心血管药物的国家，其心血管疾病住院率的增长幅度较小。估计结果还表明，使用较新的心血管药物可以减少平均住院时间和年龄调整后的心血管死亡率，但并不会减少每10万人因心血管疾病在70岁之前失去的潜在寿命年数。估计结果显示，如果1995年至2004年期间药物的上市年份没有增加，那么2004年的住院率和死亡率将会更高。我们估计，如果1995年至2004年期间药物的上市年份没有增加，那么2004年人均心血管住院费用将高出70%（即89美元）。如果1995年至2004年期间药物的上市年份没有增加，那么2004年人均心血管药物支出将会更低。然而，我们对心血管疾病住院费用增加的估计，大约是我们对心血管药物人均支出减少估计的3.7倍。

abstract.text: Aim To investigate if subjective life expectancy (SLE) impacts the willingness to trade-off (WTT) and the number of years traded-off in a 10-years time trade-off (TTO) exercise to obtain health state valuations. Methods An Internet-based questionnaire was administered in a sample representative for the Dutch general public. Next to basic demographic characteristics and SLE, respondents were asked to perform three TTO exercises. The following EQ-5D health states were included 21211 (TTO1), 22221 (TTO2) and 33312 (TTO3). The WTT was studied using a probit regression model. The number of years traded-off was investigated using a generalized negative binomial regression model. The independent variables used in both models were age, gender, quality of life, education, the difference between age and expected age of death (SLE), and a variable indicating whether the SLE was less than 10 years (SLE<10). Results Three hundred and thirty nine respondents completed the questionnaire. The mean utility scores were 0.96 (TTO1), 0.94 (TTO2) and 0.79 (TTO3). The probit model showed that SLE was the only variable with a significant influence on WTT. The gnbreg showed that the number of years traded-off was also significantly influenced by SLE. In addition, age and education significantly influenced the number of years traded-off. Conclusion The WTT years and the number of years traded-off were both influenced by SLE in 10-years TTO exercises. Reducing remaining life expectancy to 10 years in a TTO may thus increase loss aversion and, especially in respondents losing relatively many expected life years, diminish WTT and the amount of time traded off.

10.1002/hec.1385.abstractZh: 目的：研究主观预期寿命是否会影响人们为获得健康状态估值而进行的10年权衡中愿意做出的权衡年限。方法：在代表荷兰普通公众的样本中，通过互联网问卷进行调查。除了基本的人口统计特征和主观预期寿命外，受访者还需完成三项10年权衡练习。涉及的健康状态包括21211（TTO1）、22221（TTO2）和33312（TTO3）。通过概率回归模型研究愿意做出的权衡年限，并使用广义负二项回归模型研究权衡年限。两个模型中使用的独立变量包括年龄、性别、生活质量、教育水平、预期寿命与实际寿命的差异（主观预期寿命），以及主观预期寿命小于10年的变量（SLE<10）。结果：共有339名受访者完成了问卷。平均效用得分分别为0.96（TTO1）、0.94（TTO2）和0.79（TTO3）。概率回归模型显示，主观预期寿命是影响愿意做出权衡年限的唯一变量。广义负二项回归模型显示，权衡年限也受到主观预期寿命的显著影响。此外，年龄和教育水平对权衡年限也有显著影响。结论：在10年权衡练习中，愿意做出的权衡年限和权衡年限都受到主观预期寿命的影响。因此，将剩余预期寿命缩短至10年可能会增加损失厌恶感，尤其是在那些预期寿命减少较多的受访者中，这将降低愿意做出的权衡年限。

abstract.text: Past empirical work has shown a negative relationship between the body mass index (BMI) and wages in most cases. We improve on this work by allowing the marginal effect of non-linear BMI groups to vary by gender, age, and type of interpersonal relationships required in each occupation. We use the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 (1982-1998). We find that the often-reported negative relationship between the BMI and wages is larger in occupations requiring interpersonal skills with presumably more social interactions. Also, the wage penalty increases as the respondents get older beyond their mid-twenties. We show that being overweight and obese penalizes the probability of employment across all race-gender subgroups except black women and men. Our results for the obesity-wage association can be explained by either consumers or employers having distaste for obese workers.

10.1002/hec.1386.abstractZh: 以往的研究表明，在大多数情况下，体重指数与工资之间存在负相关关系。我们通过允许非线性体重指数组对边际效应的性别、年龄以及每个职业所需的人际关系类型的影响来改进这一研究。我们采用了1979年青年纵向调查的数据（1982-1998年）。研究发现，在需要人际交往能力的职业中，BMI与工资之间的负相关关系更为明显，这些职业通常涉及更多的社会互动。此外，随着受访者年龄超过二十五岁，工资损失会进一步增加。我们的研究还发现，超重和肥胖会降低所有种族和性别群体的就业可能性，但黑人和黑人的情况除外。关于肥胖与工资关系的结论可以解释为，消费者和雇主都可能对肥胖工人持有负面态度。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the determinants of the perceived stress level of workers with a special focus on the effects of commuting, while controlling for personal and work-related characteristics. Using ordered logistic regression we find that several dimensions of the commuting situation, such as impedance, control and predictability of commuting, significantly influence the perceived stress level. Therefore, stress and stress-related health problems should be taken into consideration when analyzing the economic costs of commuting.

10.1002/hec.1389.abstractZh: 本文分析了工人感知压力水平的决定因素，特别关注通勤对压力的影响，同时控制了个人和工作相关的特征。通过有序逻辑回归分析发现，通勤状况的多个维度，如通勤的阻碍程度、控制能力和可预测性，对感知压力水平有显著影响。因此，在分析通勤的经济成本时，应考虑到压力及其相关的健康问题。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of diabetes on the employment of Canadian males and females ages 15-64. Using data from the National Population Health Survey (1998), it utilizes a recursive bivariate probit approach to take into account the potential endogeneity of diabetes in employment outcomes. The results suggest that treating diabetes as exogenous yields an over-estimation of its impact on male employment. The study finds that diabetes has a significant negative impact on female employment probability, but has no significant impact on that of non-white Canadians. An implication thus is that policy-makers should take endogeneity into account in estimating labor market costs of chronic diseases such as diabetes.

10.1002/hec.1390.abstractZh: 本文探讨了糖尿病对加拿大15-64岁男女就业的影响。研究基于1998年全国人口健康调查的数据，采用递归双变量Probit模型来考虑糖尿病对就业结果的潜在内生性。研究结果表明，将糖尿病视为外生变量时，其对男性就业的负面影响被高估了。研究发现，糖尿病对女性就业概率有显著的负面影响，但对非白人加拿大人的就业概率没有显著影响。因此，政策制定者在估算糖尿病等慢性疾病的劳动力市场成本时，应考虑内生性因素。

abstract.text: The objective of this paper is to provide two-stage game models explaining the 'Generic Competition Paradox' that demonstrates an increase of brand-name drug price in response to generic entry. Under the assumption that there are two groups of consumers who are segmented by their insurance status, high insurance coverage and low insurance coverage consumers, the models indicate that the decisive factor is the market share of the high insurance coverage consumer and the size of cross-substitute factor relative to certain characteristics of market demand. The paper analyses both the case of only true generic entry and the case of pseudo-generic and true generic entry. The models prove that a brand-name price will increase when both the market share of high insurance coverage consumer and the factor of cross-substitute are small. Also, the 'Generic Competition Paradox' more likely occurs in the market where less pseudo-generic products are produced.

10.1002/hec.1392.abstractZh: 本文旨在提供两阶段博弈模型，以解释“通用竞争悖论”——即品牌药品价格因通用药品进入市场而上涨的现象。在假设存在两类消费者（根据保险状况分为高保险覆盖消费者和低保险覆盖消费者）的情况下，模型表明，决定因素是高保险覆盖消费者的市场份额以及替代因素相对于市场需求特定特征的大小。本文分析了仅出现真正通用药品进入市场的情况，以及伪通用药品和真正通用药品同时进入市场的情况。模型证明，当高保险覆盖消费者的市场份额和替代因素都很小时，品牌药品价格会上涨。此外，“通用竞争悖论”更可能出现在伪通用药品产量较少的市场中。

abstract.text: Background Research on self-care for chronic disease has not examined time requirements. Translating Research into Action for Diabetes (TRIAD), a multi-site study of managed care patients with diabetes, is among the first to assess self-care time. Objective To examine associations between socioeconomic position and extra time patients spend on foot care, shopping/cooking, and exercise due to diabetes. Data Eleven thousand nine hundred and twenty-seven patient surveys from 2000 to 2001. Methods Bayesian two-part models were used to estimate associations of self-reported extra time spent on self-care with race/ethnicity, education, and income, controlling for demographic and clinical characteristics. Results Proportions of patients spending no extra time on foot care, shopping/cooking, and exercise were, respectively, 37, 52, and 31%. Extra time spent on foot care and shopping/cooking was greater among racial/ethnic minorities, less-educated and lower-income patients. For example, African-Americans were about 10 percentage points more likely to report spending extra time on foot care than whites and extra time spent was about 3 min more per day. Discussion Extra time spent on self-care was greater for socioeconomically disadvantaged patients than for advantaged patients, perhaps because their perceived opportunity cost of time is lower or they cannot afford substitutes. Our findings suggest that poorly controlled diabetes risk factors among disadvantaged populations may not be attributable to self-care practices.

10.1002/hec.1394.abstractZh: 关于慢性病自我护理的背景研究尚未考察时间需求。将“糖尿病行动研究”（TRIAD）这一针对糖尿病管理患者的多中心研究转化为实际行动，是首批评估自我护理时间的研究之一。研究目的：探讨社会经济地位与患者因糖尿病而花费在足部护理、购物/烹饪和锻炼上的额外时间之间的关联。数据来源：2000至2001年间收集到的1万9千2百27份患者调查数据。研究方法：采用贝叶斯双部分模型，在控制人口统计学和临床特征的基础上，估算自我报告在自我护理上花费的额外时间与种族/民族、教育程度和收入的关系。研究结果：分别有37%、52%和31%的患者在足部护理、购物/烹饪和锻炼上不花费额外时间。在种族/民族少数群体、教育程度较低和收入较低的患者中，花费在足部护理和购物/烹饪上的额外时间更多。例如，非裔美国人报告在足部护理上花费额外时间的可能性比白人高出约10个百分点，每天额外花费的时间约多出3分钟。讨论：社会经济地位较低的患者在自我护理上花费的额外时间比社会经济地位较高的患者更多，这可能是因为他们认为时间的机会成本较低，或者他们无法负担替代方案。我们的研究结果表明，在不利群体中存在的不受控制的糖尿病风险因素可能并非由自我护理行为引起。

abstract.text: This paper studies the relationship between technology and productivity in Dutch hospitals. In most studies technical change is measured by a proxy, namely a time trend. In practice however, innovations slowly spread over all hospitals and so different hospitals are operating under different technologies at the same point in time. In this study we explicitly inventory specific and well-known innovations in the Dutch hospital industry in the past ten years. These innovations are aggregated into a limited number of homogenous innovation clusters, which are measured by a set of technology index numbers. The index numbers are included in the cost function specification and estimation. The results indicate that technical change is non-neutral and output- biased and that some technologies affect cost in beneficial ways.

10.1002/hec.1395.abstractZh: 本文研究了荷兰医院中技术与发展生产力之间的关系。在大多数研究中，技术变革是通过一个代理指标来衡量的，即时间趋势。然而，实际上，创新会在各医院之间缓慢传播，因此不同医院在同一时期可能使用不同的技术。本研究明确列出了过去十年荷兰医院行业中的特定且知名的创新成果。这些创新被汇总为若干同质化的创新集群，并通过一系列技术指数来衡量。这些指数被纳入成本函数的设定与估计过程中。研究结果表明，技术变革并非中性，而是对产出有偏向性，并且某些技术以有益的方式影响成本。

abstract.text: The aim of this paper is to undertake a discrete choice experiment using a 'blocked attribute' design. To date in the health economics literature, most discrete choice experiments have used only a relatively small number of attributes due to concerns about task complexity, non-compensatory decision rules, simplicity of experimental designs, and the costs of surveys. This may lead to omitted variable bias and reduced explanatory power when attributes have been pre-selected from a longer list. There may be situations where it is desirable to include a longer list of attributes, such as attaching weights to quality-of-life instruments to obtain single index scores. We examine this issue in the context of attaching weights to a disease-specific quality-of-life instrument used to prioritise patients on orthopaedic waiting lists in Victorian hospitals. Eleven attributes are allocated across three separate experimental designs and the data pooled for analysis. Pooling is justified given the specific context of the study, including attempts to minimise the effect of unobserved heterogeneity across the three models when designing the study and collecting data. Blocked attribute designs may offer flexibility to researchers when it is not possible or desirable to reduce the number of attributes.

10.1002/hec.1396.abstractZh: 本文的目的是采用“分组属性”设计进行离散选择实验。在健康经济学文献中，由于对任务复杂性的担忧、非补偿性决策规则、实验设计的简单性以及调查成本等因素，大多数离散选择实验仅使用了相对较少的属性。这可能导致遗漏变量偏差，并在属性从较长的列表中被预先选择时降低解释力。在某些情况下，包含更长的属性列表可能是可取的，例如为生活质量指标分配权重以获得单一指数分数。本文在将权重附加到用于优先处理维多利亚医院骨科等候名单患者的疾病特异性生活质量指标的背景下，探讨了这一问题。在三个独立的实验设计中分配了十一个属性，数据被汇总用于分析。鉴于研究的特定背景，这种汇总是合理的，包括在设计研究和收集数据时尽量减少三个模型之间未观测到的异质性影响。当无法或不宜减少属性数量时，分组属性设计可能为研究人员提供了灵活性。

abstract.text: In this paper, we have elaborated an index in two phases to measure the degree of transferability of the results of the economic evaluation of health technologies. In the first phase, we have considered the objective factors (critical and non-critical) to derive a general transferability index, which can be used to measure this internal property of the studies of economic evaluation applied to health technologies. In the second phase, with a more specific index, we have measured the degree of applicability of the results of a given study to a different setting. Both indices have been combined (arithmetic and geometric mean) to obtain a global transferability index. We have applied the global index to a sample of 27 Spanish studies on infectious diseases. We have obtained an average value for the index of 0.54, quite far from the maximum theoretical value of 1. We also found that 11 studies lacked some critical factor and were directly deemed as not transferable.

10.1002/hec.1397.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种分两个阶段构建的指标，用于衡量经济评估结果的可转移性。在第一阶段，我们考虑了客观因素（关键与非关键因素），以得出一个通用的可转移性指数，该指数可用于评估应用于健康技术领域的经济评估研究的内在特性。在第二阶段，我们通过一个更具体的指标来衡量特定研究结果在不同情境下的适用性。这两个指标通过算术平均数和几何平均数相结合的方式，得到了综合的可转移性指数。我们将这一综合指数应用于27项关于传染病的西班牙研究样本，得出的指数平均值为0.54，这一数值远低于理论上的最大值1。我们还发现，有11项研究缺乏某些关键因素，因此直接被判定为不可转移性。

abstract.text: Self-reported disability status is often relied upon in labour force participation models, but this may be reported with error for economic or psychological reasons and can lead to a bias in the effect of disability on participation. In this paper, we explore the possibility that reported limitations in daily activities are mis-reported, in particular for those who define their labour force status as disabled/ill, and assess if economic incentives influence this group to mis-report. The main questions we wish to address therefore are: (1) was there state-dependent reporting error and did economic incentives play a role, and (2) did this change over the years 1995-2001? Using a generalised ordered response model, we compute cleansed measures of disability that correspond to predicted responses individuals would have made if employed. Unobserved differences between the employed and non-employed may exist; therefore, we control for this via correlated random effects. The results indicate that the disabled/ill group did over-report and the difference between actual and predicted probabilities only marginally changed between 1995 and 2001. The extent of this measurement error is lower once we control for unobserved heterogeneity.

10.1002/hec.1399.abstractZh: 自我报告的残疾状况在劳动力参与模型中经常被依赖，但由于经济或心理原因，这种报告可能存在误差，从而导致残疾对参与率的影响出现偏差。本文探讨了日常活动限制的报告可能存在误报的情况，尤其是对于那些将自身劳动力状况定义为残疾/疾病的人，并评估经济激励是否会影响这一群体的误报行为。我们主要想解答的问题是：(1)是否存在状态依赖性的报告误差，经济激励是否起到了作用；(2)这种情况在1995年至2001年期间是否发生了变化？通过使用广义有序响应模型，我们计算了与个体在就业状态下可能做出的预测反应相对应的净化残疾度量。在就业者和非就业者之间可能存在未观察到的差异；因此，我们通过相关随机效应来控制这一差异。结果表明，残疾/疾病群体确实过度报告了情况，实际概率与预测概率之间的差异在1995年至2001年间仅略有变化。在控制了未观察到的异质性后，这种测量误差的程度有所降低。

abstract.text: This paper sets out an empirical model of learning with forgetting and uses it to estimate how much hospital quality improves with experience. The size of the learning effect and the depreciation rate are estimated for two cardiac procedures in Maryland and Arizona. Models are estimated using patient survival as the outcome of interest. The results show that learning does not appear to be a factor in hospital quality for either procedure or for surgery generally. From a policy standpoint, based on these results, regulations in Maryland that seek to concentrate these two procedures among a small number of providers could not be justified on the grounds that higher volume would increase the quality of care.

10.1002/hec.1400.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个关于学习与遗忘的实证模型，并利用该模型来估算经验对医院质量提升的影响程度。研究对马里兰州和亚利桑那州两种心脏手术的效果进行了分析，分别估算了学习效应的大小和折旧率。模型以患者生存率为研究目标。结果表明，无论是哪种手术，学习似乎都不是影响医院质量的因素。从政策角度来看，基于这些结果，马里兰州试图将这两种手术集中由少数医生执行的规定，并不能以更高的手术量会提升护理质量为由来证明其合理性。

abstract.text: Using data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, we compare immigrants' use of preventive care with that of natives. We employ a multinomial switching regression framework that accounts for non-random selection into continuous private insurance, temporary private insurance, public insurance, and no insurance. Our results indicate that among the populations with continuous private coverage and without coverage (uninsured), immigrants, especially non-citizens, are less likely to use preventive care than natives. We find that the longer immigrants stay in the US the more their use of care approximates to that of natives. However, for most types of care, immigrants' use of care never fully converges to that of natives. Among the publicly insured population, immigrants' use of care is similar to natives, but non-citizen immigrants are significantly less likely to use preventive measures. We find that the ability to speak English does not have a significant effect on the use of preventive care among publicly insured persons.

10.1002/hec.1401.abstractZh: 通过《医疗支出面板调查》的数据，我们比较了移民与本地人在使用预防性护理方面的差异。我们采用了多项选择回归框架，考虑了非随机选择进入连续私人保险、临时私人保险、公共保险以及无保险的情况。研究结果表明，在有连续私人保险且无保险的人群中，移民，尤其是非公民，使用预防性护理的可能性低于本地人。我们发现，移民在美国停留的时间越长，其使用预防性护理的比例就越接近本地人。然而，对于大多数类型的护理，移民的使用比例从未完全达到本地人的水平。在公共保险覆盖的人群中，移民的使用情况与本地人相似，但非公民移民使用预防性措施的可能性明显较低。我们还发现，英语能力对公共保险覆盖人群使用预防性护理的影响并不显著。

abstract.text: We examine the extent to which infant health production functions are sensitive to model specification and measurement error. We focus on the importance of typically unobserved but theoretically important variables (typically unobserved variables, TUVs), other non-standard covariates (NSCs), input reporting, and characterization of infant health. The TUVs represent wantedness, taste for risky behavior, and maternal health endowment. The NSCs include father characteristics. We estimate the effects of prenatal drug use, prenatal cigarette smoking, and first trimester prenatal care on birth weight, low birth weight, and a measure of abnormal infant health conditions. We compare estimates using self-reported inputs versus input measures that combine information from medical records and self-reports. We find that TUVs and NSCs are significantly associated with both inputs and outcomes, but that excluding them from infant health production functions does not appreciably affect the input estimates. However, using self-reported inputs leads to overestimated effects of inputs, particularly prenatal care, on outcomes, and using a direct measure of infant health does not always yield input estimates similar to those when using birth weight outcomes. The findings have implications for research, data collection, and public health policy.

10.1002/hec.1402.abstractZh: 我们研究了婴儿健康生产函数对模型设定和测量误差的敏感性。我们重点关注那些通常未被观察到但在理论上具有重要意义的变量（通常未被观察到的变量，TUVs）、其他非标准协变量（NSCs）、输入数据的报告方式以及婴儿健康的特征描述。这些TUVs包括需求、对风险行为的偏好以及母亲的健康状况。NSCs则包括父亲的特征。我们估计了产前药物使用、产前吸烟以及孕早期产前护理对出生体重、低出生体重以及婴儿健康异常状况的影响。我们比较了使用自我报告的数据与结合医疗记录和自我报告的数据得出的估计结果。我们发现，TUVs和NSCs与输入数据和结果都有显著关联，但将它们排除在婴儿健康生产函数之外并不会显著影响输入数据的估计结果。然而，使用自我报告的数据会导致对输入数据（尤其是产前护理）的影响估计过高，而使用直接的婴儿健康指标并不总是能得到与使用出生体重指标相似的输入数据估计结果。这些发现对研究、数据收集以及公共卫生政策具有启示意义。

abstract.text: This paper uses supermarket scanner data to estimate brand- and packaging-specific own- and cross-price elasticities for beer. We find that brand- and packaging-specific beer sales are highly price elastic. Cross-price elasticity estimates suggest that individuals are more likely to buy a higher-volume package of the same brand of beer than they are to switch brands. Policy simulations suggest that regulation of volume-based price discounts is potentially more effective than a tax increase at reducing beer consumption. Our results suggest that volume-based price discounting induces people to buy larger-volume packages of beer and may lead to an increased overall beer consumption.

10.1002/hec.1403.abstractZh: 本文利用超市扫描仪数据，估算了啤酒在品牌和包装方面的自身价格弹性及交叉价格弹性。研究发现，啤酒在品牌和包装方面的销售对价格具有高度弹性。交叉价格弹性的估计表明，消费者更可能购买同一品牌更高容量包装的啤酒，而不是更换品牌。政策模拟分析表明，与增税相比，对基于容量的价格折扣进行监管可能更有效地减少啤酒消费。我们的研究结果表明，基于容量的价格折扣会促使人们购买更大容量的啤酒包装，并可能导致整体啤酒消费量的增加。

abstract.text: We consider the problem of assessing new and existing technologies for their cost-effectiveness in the case where data on both costs and effects are available from a clinical trial, and we address it by means of the cost-effectiveness acceptability curve. The main difficulty in these analyses is that cost data usually exhibit highly skew and heavy-tailed distributions so that it can be extremely difficult to produce realistic probabilistic models for the underlying population distribution, and in particular to model accurately the tail of the distribution, which is highly influential in estimating the population mean. Here, in order to integrate the uncertainty about the model into the analysis of cost data and into cost-effectiveness analyses, we consider an approach based on Bayesian model averaging: instead of choosing a single parametric model, we specify a set of plausible models for costs and estimate the mean cost with a weighted mean of its posterior expectations under each model, with weights given by the posterior model probabilities. The results are compared with those obtained with a semi-parametric approach that does not require any assumption about the distribution of costs.

10.1002/hec.1404.abstractZh: 我们研究了在临床试验中同时拥有成本和效果数据的情况下，如何评估新技术和新技术的成本效益问题，并通过成本效益可接受曲线来解决这个问题。这些分析的主要难点在于，成本数据通常呈现高度偏斜和重尾分布，因此很难构建出真实的概率模型来描述底层人群的分布，尤其是难以准确模拟分布的尾部，而分布的尾部对估计总体均值具有很大影响。为了将模型的不确定性纳入成本数据的分析和成本效益评估中，我们采用了基于贝叶斯模型平均的方法：不是选择一个单一的参数模型，而是指定一组合理的成本模型，并通过每个模型下的后验期望值的加权平均值来估计平均成本，权重由后验模型概率决定。这些结果与采用半参数方法获得的结果进行了比较，后者不需要对成本分布做任何假设。

abstract.text: A central assumption in health utility measurement is that preferences are invariant to the elicitation method used. This assumption is challenged by preference reversals. Previous studies have observed preference reversals between choice and matching tasks and between choice and ranking tasks. We present a preference reversal that is entirely derived from choices, the basic primitive of economics and utility theory. The preference reversal was observed in two studies regarding health states after stroke. Both studies involved large representative samples from the Spanish population, interviewed professionally, and face-to-face. Possible explanations for the preference reversal are the anticipation of disappointment and elation in risky choice and the impact of ethical considerations about the value of life.

10.1002/hec.1405.abstractZh: 在健康效用测量中的一个核心假设是，偏好不受所采用的引出方法的影响。这一假设受到了偏好反转现象的挑战。先前的研究观察到在选择任务和匹配任务之间，以及选择任务和排序任务之间存在偏好反转现象。我们提出了一种完全源自选择的偏好反转现象，这是经济学和效用理论的基本出发点。在两项关于中风后健康状态的研究中观察到了这种偏好反转现象。这两项研究都涉及了来自西班牙人口的大规模代表性样本，采用专业方式进行访谈，并且访谈是面对面的。偏好反转现象的可能解释包括对风险选择中可能出现的失望和兴奋的预期，以及关于生命价值的伦理考量。

abstract.text: Given that wealthier people are healthier, the increase in income inequality over the past two decades has led to fears that inequalities in health have also increased. Indeed, some papers have found that health disparities have become more salient among some adult populations. Using the US Vital Statistics 1983-2000, this paper presents a new stylized fact: the infant health disparity, as measured by Apgar score, neonatal mortality and infant mortality, has been narrowing over the past two decades. This is in sharp contrast to the increasing disparities in health among adults of different educational backgrounds. Using a decomposition method, I find that the most important factor in explaining the closing gap is an increase in access to medical care. All else being equal, access to proper medical care is the most important factor in explaining the narrowing infant health gap. Demographic shifts and maternal behavior changes are also significant factors, together explaining 42.2% of the closing gap in low Apgar score, 41.4% of the closing gap in neonatal death, and 45.6% of the closing gap in infant death.

10.1002/hec.1407.abstractZh: 鉴于富裕人群更健康，过去二十年收入不平等的加剧引发了人们对健康不平等也增加的担忧。事实上，一些研究指出，某些成年人群中的健康差异变得更加明显。本文利用1983-2000年的美国生命统计数据，提出了一个新的现象：以Apgar评分、新生儿死亡率和婴儿死亡率衡量的婴儿健康差异在过去二十年里有所缩小。这与不同教育背景的成年人之间健康差异的加剧形成了鲜明对比。通过分解分析，我发现解释这一差距缩小的最重要因素是医疗服务的可及性提高。在其他条件相同的情况下，获得适当的医疗服务是缩小婴儿健康差异的关键因素。人口结构变化和母亲行为的变化也是重要因素，它们共同解释了低Apgar评分差距的42.2%、新生儿死亡差距的41.4%以及婴儿死亡差距的45.6%。

abstract.text: Physically inactive people are expected to use more healthcare services than active people. This inactivity imposes costs on the collectively funded health insurance programs. In this paper, excess utilization of healthcare services due to physical inactivity is examined using count data models and the Canadian Community Health Survey. The aim of the paper is to estimate utilization of healthcare services associated with inactivity and to estimate its impact on the Canadian healthcare system. The results suggest that physical inactivity increases hospital stays, and use of physician and nurse services. On average, an inactive person spends 38% more days in hospital than an active person. S/he also uses 5.5% more family physician visits, 13% more specialist services, and 12% more nurse visits than an active individual. The subsequent social cost of inactivity for the healthcare system is substantial.

10.1002/hec.1408.abstractZh: 身体不活跃的人预计会比活跃的人使用更多的医疗服务。这种不活跃状态给集体资助的医疗保险计划带来了负担。本文利用计数数据模型和加拿大社区健康调查数据，研究了由于身体不活跃而导致的医疗服务过度使用问题。研究旨在估算与身体不活跃相关的医疗服务使用情况，并评估其对加拿大医疗系统的影响。研究结果表明，身体不活跃会增加住院时间，以及医生和服务员服务的使用量。平均而言，不活跃的人住院天数比活跃的人多出38%，家庭医生的就诊次数多出5.5%，专科服务的使用量多出13%，服务员的就诊次数多出12%。因此，身体不活跃对医疗系统的社会成本相当可观。

abstract.text: The extent to which increasing longevity increases per capita demand for long-term care depends on the degree to which utilization is concentrated at the end of life. We estimate the marginal effect of proximity to death, measured by being within 2 years of death, on the probabilities of nursing home and formal home care use, and we determine whether this effect differs by availability of informal care--i.e. marital status and co-residence with an adult child.
