The analysis uses a sample of elderly aged 70+ from the 1993-2002 Health and Retirement Study. Simultaneous probit models address the joint decisions to use long-term care and co-reside with an adult child. Overall, proximity to death significantly increases the probability of nursing home use by 50.0% and of formal home care use by 12.4%. Availability of informal support significantly reduces the effect of proximity to death. Among married elderly, proximity to death has no effect on institutionalization. In conclusion, proximity to death is one of the main drivers of long-term care use, but changes in sources of informal support, such as an increase in the proportion of married elderly, may lessen its importance in shaping the demand for long-term care.

10.1002/hec.1409.abstractZh: 寿命延长对人均长期护理需求的影响程度，取决于在生命末期对护理服务的利用程度。我们估算了与死亡距离近这一因素对使用养老院和正式家庭护理概率的边际影响，并探讨了这种影响是否因非正式护理的可用性而有所不同——即婚姻状况和与成年子女同住的情况。分析采用了1993-2002年健康与退休研究中的70岁以上老年人样本。同时使用的Probit模型则探讨了使用长期护理与与成年子女同住之间的联合决策。总体而言，与死亡距离近显著增加了使用养老院的概率50.0%，使用正式家庭护理的概率增加了12.4%。非正式支持的可用性显著降低了与死亡距离近的影响。在已婚老年人中，与死亡距离近对入住养老院没有影响。总之，与死亡距离近是长期护理使用的主要驱动因素之一，但非正式支持来源的变化，例如已婚老年人比例的增加，可能会降低其在塑造长期护理需求中的重要性。

abstract.text: This study considers variables related to health-care expenditures associated with aging and long-term hospitalization in Japan. We focused on daily per capita inpatient health-care expenditures, and examined the impact of inpatient characteristics such as sex, age, survived or deceased, length of stay, adult disease, and type of medical care received during the duration of each stay. We analyzed data from the Survey of Medical-Care Activities in Public Health Insurance by multinomial logistic regression analyses. Age of patient had little impact on per capita inpatient health-care expenditures per day. As regards length of stay, inpatient stays of 8-14 days had a little impact on health-care expenditures. This study suggested that these results might be due to the kind of medical care received. More research is needed to determine the appropriate medical services to reduce long-term hospitalization. In the last month of care for patients who died, medical examinations had a great influence on health-care expenditures. This study showed that increasing medical examinations in the end-of-life care needs further investigation.

10.1002/hec.1410.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了与日本老龄化及长期住院相关的医疗支出相关变量。我们重点关注了人均住院医疗支出，并考察了住院患者的性别、年龄、生死状态、住院时长、成人疾病类型以及住院期间接受的医疗护理类型等因素对医疗支出的影响。我们通过多项逻辑回归分析，对《公共医疗保险医疗活动调查》的数据进行了分析。患者的年龄对人均每日住院医疗支出的影响较小。就住院时长而言，8-14天的住院对医疗支出的影响也不大。研究结果表明，这些结果可能与患者接受的医疗护理类型有关。需要进一步研究以确定哪些医疗服务有助于减少长期住院。对于已故患者的最后一个月护理，体检对医疗支出有显著影响。研究表明，在临终护理中增加体检的必要性需要进一步研究。

abstract.text: This paper describes an application of hierarchical information integration (HII) discrete choice experiments. We assessed theoretical and construct validity, as well as internal consistency, to investigate whether HII can be used to investigate complex multi-faceted health-care decisions (objective 1). In addition, we incorporated recent advances in mixed logit modelling (objective 2). Finally, we determined the response rate and predictive ability to study the feasibility of HII to support health-care management (objective 3). The clinical subject was the implementation of the guideline for breast cancer surgery in day care, which is a complex process that involves changes at the organizational and management levels, as well as the level of health-care professionals and that of patients.We found good theoretical and construct validity and satisfactory internal consistency. The proposed mixed logit model, which included repeated measures corrections and subexperiment error scale variations, also performed well. We found a poor response, but the model had satisfactory predictive ability. Therefore, we conclude that HII can be used successfully to study complex multi-faceted health-care decisions (objectives 1 and 2), but that the feasibility of HII to support health-care management, in particular in challenging implementation projects, seems less favourable (objective 3).

10.1002/hec.1411.abstractZh: 本文描述了层次信息整合（HII）离散选择实验的应用。我们评估了理论效度和结构效度以及内部一致性，以研究HII是否可用于研究复杂的多维度医疗决策（目标1）。此外，我们结合了混合逻辑模型的最新进展（目标2）。最后，我们通过确定响应率和预测能力，研究了HII在支持医疗管理中的可行性（目标3）。临床研究对象是日间护理中乳腺癌手术指南的实施，这是一个涉及组织和管理层面变化，以及医疗专业人员和患者层面的复杂过程。我们发现理论效度和结构效度良好，内部一致性令人满意。所提出的混合逻辑模型，包括重复测量校正和子实验误差尺度变化，表现也很好。虽然响应率较低，但模型的预测能力令人满意。因此，我们得出结论，HII可以成功用于研究复杂的多维度医疗决策（目标1和2），但在具有挑战性的实施项目中，HII在支持医疗管理方面的可行性似乎不太理想（目标3）。

abstract.text: Volume-outcome relationships are of clear importance for most participants in the health-care industry; research and appropriate policy implications are of critical importance. In this letter we critique the prevailing 'learning-by-doing' view in cardiac surgery. We illustrate the very wide disparity in empirical findings on volume-outcome relationships there, in the context of broader open issues in 'learning curves' in general. Potential complementary mechanisms, e.g. 'social learning by knowledge spillovers' are introduced; these cast into doubt the prevailing policy recommendations of simple regionalization and volume smoothing.

10.1002/hec.1412.abstractZh: 销量与收益之间的关系对医疗保健行业的大多数参与者来说都至关重要；相关研究及相应的政策建议具有极其重要的意义。在本文中，我们对心脏外科手术中普遍存在的“边做边学”的观点进行了批判。我们展示了在该领域关于销量与收益关系的实证研究结果存在巨大差异，这进一步凸显了“学习曲线”这一更广泛问题的重要性。我们提出了一些潜在的互补机制，例如“通过知识溢出实现的社会学习”；这些机制使得简单采用区域化管理和销量平滑化的政策建议变得值得怀疑。

abstract.text: We compare estimated lifetime out-of-pocket prescription drug expenditures on outpatient prescription drugs, premiums and late enrollment penalties for healthy 65-year-old Medicare beneficiaries if they (a) purchase Part D as soon as they are eligible versus (b) waiting until they contract a drug-intensive condition. Using data from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey, a representative sample of the Medicare population, we estimate the annual probability that a healthy 65-year-old will transition to a drug-intensive health state or death. We then use Monte Carlo simulations to estimate expected lifetime prescription drug spending with and without drug insurance. We find that for the statutory minimum benefit policy with a $30 per month premium, lifetime expected expenditures are about 10% higher for women and 6.5% higher for men if healthy beneficiaries postpone enrollment in Part D. Eliminating the late enrollment penalty would create a significant cost advantage for postponed enrollment, particularly for men. Under current rules, the financial advantage of early enrollment coupled with the reduction in risk associated with purchasing Part D plans and potential utility gains from insurance-induced drug consumption, suggests that immediate purchase of Part D is the optimal choice for Medicare beneficiaries.

10.1002/hec.1413.abstractZh: 我们比较了65岁健康医疗保险受益人购买D部分保险时的实际支出、保费以及延迟投保的惩罚措施。如果他们在符合条件时立即购买D部分保险，与等待直到患上需要药物治疗的疾病后再购买相比，实际支出会有差异。通过《医疗保险当前受益人调查》的数据，我们对65岁健康受益人转变为需要药物治疗的健康状态或死亡的概率进行了估算。随后，我们使用蒙特卡洛模拟方法估算了有无药物保险情况下的预期终身处方药支出。研究发现，对于每月保费为30美元的法定最低保险政策，如果健康受益人推迟购买D部分保险，女性患者的终身预期支出将增加约10%，男性患者则增加6.5%。如果取消延迟投保的惩罚措施，推迟投保将带来显著的成本优势，尤其是对男性而言。根据现行规定，提前投保的财务优势，加上购买D部分保险带来的风险降低以及保险可能促进的用药行为带来的潜在效用提升，表明立即购买D部分保险是医疗保险受益人的最佳选择。

abstract.text: Much of the literature on distributive preferences covers specific considerations in isolation, and recent reviews have suggested that research is required to inform on the relative importance of various key considerations. Responding to this research recommendation, we explore the distributive preferences of the general public using a set of generic social value judgments. We report on a discrete choice experiment (DCE) survey, using face-to-face interviews, in a sample of the general population (n=259). The context for the survey was resource allocation decisions in the UK National Health Service, using the process of health technology appraisal as an example. The attributes used covered health improvement, value for money, severity of health, and availability of other treatments, and it is the first such survey to use cost-effectiveness in scenarios described to the general public. Results support the feasibility and acceptability of the DCE approach for the elicitation of public preferences. Choice data are used to consider the relative importance of changes across attribute levels, and to model utility scores and relative probabilities for the full set of combinations of attributes and levels in the experimental design used (n=64). Results allow the relative social value of health technology scenarios to be explored. Findings add to a sparse literature on 'social' preferences, and show that DCE data can be used to consider the strength of preference over alternative scenarios in a priority-setting context.

10.1002/hec.1414.abstractZh: 关于分配偏好的大量文献通常只关注特定的考虑因素，而最近的综述指出，需要研究来明确各种关键考虑因素的相对重要性。为了响应这一研究需求，我们采用一套通用的社会价值判断来探讨普通公众的分配偏好。我们开展了一项离散选择实验调查，通过面对面访谈的方式，在普通人群样本中进行了调查（样本量n=259）。该调查的背景是英国国家卫生服务系统中的资源分配决策，以健康技术评估过程为例。所使用的属性包括健康改善、性价比、健康问题的严重程度以及其他治疗方法的可用性。这是首次在向公众描述的场景中运用成本效益分析的方法。研究结果支持了离散选择实验方法在获取公众偏好方面的可行性和可接受性。选择数据被用来评估不同属性水平变化的重要性，并用于建模实验设计中所有属性和水平组合下的效用得分和相对概率（样本量n=64）。研究结果有助于探索健康技术场景的相对社会价值。这些发现为关于“社会”偏好的研究提供了补充，并表明离散选择实验数据可以用来在优先级设定背景下比较不同场景的偏好强度。

abstract.text: Debate about the monetary value of a quality-adjusted life year (QALY) has existed in the health economics literature for some time. More recently, concern about such a value has arisen in UK health policy. This paper reports on an attempt to 'model' a willingness-to-pay-based value of a QALY from the existing value of preventing a statistical fatality (VPF) currently used in UK public sector decision making. Two methods of deriving the value of a QALY from the existing UK VPF are outlined: one conventional and one new. The advantages and disadvantages of each of the approaches are discussed as well as the implications of the results for policy and health economic evaluation methodology.

10.1002/hec.1416.abstractZh: 关于质量调整生命年（QALY）的货币价值问题，在健康经济学文献中已经存在一段时间了。最近，英国卫生政策中也出现了对这类价值的关注。本文报告了一次尝试，试图从目前用于英国公共部门决策中的预防统计性死亡的价值（VPF）出发，来“建模”一个基于支付意愿的QALY价值。文中概述了两种从现有英国VPF推导出QALY价值的方法：一种传统的方法，另一种新的方法。对这两种方法的优缺点进行了讨论，并分析了这些结果对政策和健康经济学评估方法的影响。

abstract.text: The Technological Change in Health Care Research Network collected unique patient-level data on three procedures for treatment of heart attack patients (catheterization, coronary artery bypass grafts and percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty) for 17 countries over a 15-year period to examine the impact of economic and institutional factors on technology adoption. Specific institutional factors are shown to be important to the uptake of these technologies. Health-care systems characterized as public contract systems and reimbursement systems have higher adoption rates than public-integrated health-care systems. Central control of funding of investments is negatively associated with adoption rates and the impact is of the same magnitude as the overall health-care system classification. GDP per capita also has a strong role in initial adoption. The impact of income and institutional characteristics on the utilization rates of the three procedures diminishes over time.

10.1002/hec.1417.abstractZh: 《医疗保健研究网络的技术变革》一文收集了17个国家在15年间关于三种心脏病治疗方法的独特患者级数据，包括导管插入术、冠状动脉旁路移植术和经皮腔内冠状动脉成形术，以研究经济与制度因素对技术采用的影响。研究发现，特定的制度因素对技术的采用至关重要。被归类为公共合同制度和报销制度的医疗保健系统，其技术采用率高于公共整合型医疗保健系统。对投资资金的中央控制与采用率呈负相关，其影响程度与整个医疗保健系统分类的影响相当。人均GDP在技术的初始采用中起着重要作用。随着时间的推移，收入与制度特征对这三种治疗方法使用率的影响逐渐减弱。

abstract.text: In 2001, a listpatient system with capitation payment was introduced in Norwegian general practice. After an allocation process where each inhabitant was listed with a general practitioner (GP), a considerable share of the GPs got fewer persons listed than they would have preferred. We examine whether GPs who experience a shortage of patients to a larger extent than other GPs seek to hold a second job in the community health service even though the wage rate is low compared with the wage rate in general practice. Assuming utility maximization, we model the effect of patient shortage on a GP's decision to contract for a second job in the community health service. The model predicts a positive relationship between patient shortage and participation in the community health service. This prediction is tested by means of censored regression analyses, taking account of labour supply as a censored variable. We find a significant effect of patient shortage on the number of hours the GPs supply to community health service. The estimated marginal effect is 1.72 hours per week.

10.1002/hec.1418.abstractZh: 2001年，挪威的普通医疗实践中引入了以人头费为基础的病例列表制度。在分配过程中，每个居民都被分配了一位全科医生，但相当一部分全科医生的接诊患者数量低于他们的期望。我们研究的是，那些比其他全科医生面临更严重的患者短缺问题的医生是否会在社区医疗服务领域寻求第二份工作，尽管其工资水平低于普通医疗实践中的工资水平。在假设效用最大化的情况下，我们模拟了患者短缺对全科医生在社区医疗服务领域寻求第二份工作的决策影响。模型预测，患者短缺与参与社区医疗服务之间存在正相关关系。通过受检回归分析来验证这一预测，同时考虑了劳动力供应作为受检变量。我们发现，患者短缺对全科医生为社区医疗服务提供的服务时间有显著影响，估计的边际效应为每周1.72小时。

abstract.text: Priority setting research in health economics has traditionally employed quantitative methodologies and been informed by post-positivist philosophical assumptions about the world and the nature of knowledge. These approaches have been rewarded with well-developed and validated tools. However, it is now commonly noted that there has been limited uptake of economic analysis into actual priority setting and resource allocation decisions made by health-care systems. There seem to be substantial organizational and political barriers. The authors argue in this paper that understanding and addressing these barriers will depend upon the application of qualitative research methodologies. Some efforts in this direction have been attempted; however these are theoretically under-developed and seldom rooted in any of the established qualitative research traditions. Two such approaches - narrative inquiry and discourse analysis - are highlighted here. These are illustrated with examples drawn from a real-world priority setting study. The examples demonstrate how such conceptually powerful qualitative traditions produce distinctive findings that offer unique insight into organizational contexts and decision-maker behavior. We argue that such investigations offer untapped benefits for the study of organizational priority setting and thus should be pursued more frequently by the health economics research community.

10.1002/hec.1419.abstractZh: 在健康经济学领域，优先级设定研究传统上采用定量研究方法，并受到后实证主义哲学观点对世界和知识本质的启示。这些方法带来了成熟且经过验证的工具。然而，现在普遍认识到，经济分析在医疗系统的实际优先级设定和资源分配决策中的应用仍然有限。这似乎存在大量的组织性和政治性障碍。作者认为，理解和解决这些障碍需要应用定性研究方法。虽然已经有一些这方面的尝试，但这些方法在理论上尚未充分发展，且很少植根于已有的定性研究传统。本文重点介绍了两种定性研究方法——叙事探究和话语分析。通过实际案例研究来说明这两种方法的应用效果，这些案例展示了这些概念性强且富有成效的定性研究方法如何产生独特的发现，为组织背景和决策者行为的研究提供了独特的视角。我们认为，这类研究为组织优先级设定研究提供了未被充分利用的潜力，因此应该得到健康经济学研究界的更多关注。

abstract.text: The total redistributive effect (RE) of health-care finance has been decomposed into vertical, horizontal and reranking effects. The vertical effect has been further decomposed into tax rate and tax structure effects. We extend this latter decomposition to the horizontal and reranking components of the RE. We also show how to measure the vertical, horizontal and reranking effects of each component of the redistributive system, allowing analysis of the RE of health-care finance in the context of that system. The methods are illustrated with application to the RE of health-care financing in Canada.

10.1002/hec.1420.abstractZh: 医疗融资的总再分配效应被分解为垂直效应、水平效应和重新排序效应。垂直效应进一步被分解为税率效应和税收结构效应。我们将这种分解扩展到医疗融资再分配效应的水平效应和重新排序效应部分。我们还展示了如何衡量再分配系统各组成部分的垂直效应、水平效应和重新排序效应，从而能够在该系统的背景下分析医疗融资的再分配效应。这些方法以加拿大医疗融资的再分配效应为例进行了说明。

abstract.text: Objective Expose the weak loops in the Chinese medical insurance coverage and uncover hospitals' role of over-pricing hospitalized insured patients compared with those non-insured. Methods A multi-linear regression method was used to analyze hospitalization expense for insured and uninsured patients with uncomplicated acute appendicitis, cholecystitis, benign uterine tumors, and normal delivery. Results Hospitalization cost is higher among insured than uninsured patients due to longer hospitalization lengths of stay, type of disease (highest among cholecystitis patients), type of gender - females, old-aged people, and type of marital status - singles, as well as drugs expenses, surgical expenses, and other medical acts. Conclusion Require a better government's supervision system over medical insurance expenses such as reforming methods of payments, building up new cost compensation mechanism, and unifying and stabilizing prices for each category of medicines.

10.1002/hec.1421.abstractZh: 目的：揭示中国医疗保险覆盖中的薄弱环节，以及医院在过度收费方面对参保患者与非参保患者之间的差异。方法：采用多元线性回归方法，分析患有单纯性急性阑尾炎、胆囊炎、良性子宫肿瘤以及正常分娩的参保与非参保患者的住院费用。结果：由于住院时间更长、疾病类型（以胆囊炎患者最为明显）、性别因素（女性、老年人）、婚姻状况（单身）等因素的影响，参保患者的住院费用高于非参保患者。此外，药物费用、手术费用及其他医疗行为也导致了参保患者的住院费用增加。结论：需要政府加强对医疗保险费用的监管，包括改革支付方式、建立新的费用补偿机制，以及统一和稳定各类药品的价格。

abstract.text: This paper compares two quite different approaches to estimating costs: a 'bottom-up' approach, represented by the US Department of Veterans Affairs' (VA) Decision Support System that uses local costs of specific inputs; and a 'top-down' approach, represented by the costing system created by the VA Health Economics Resource Center, which assigns the VA national healthcare budget to specific products using various weighting systems. Total annual costs per patient plus the cost for specific services (e.g. clinic visit, radiograph, laboratory, inpatient admission) were compared using scatterplots, correlations, mean difference, and standard deviation of individual differences. Analysis are based upon 2001 costs for 14 915 patients at 72 facilities. Correlations ranged from 0.24 for the cost of outpatient encounters to 0.77 for the cost of inpatient admissions, and 0.85 for total annual cost. The mean difference between costing methods was $707 ($4168 versus $3461) for total annual cost. The standard deviation of the individual differences was $5934. Overall, the agreement between the two costing systems varied by the specific cost being measured and increased with aggregation. Administrators and researchers conducting cost analyses need to carefully consider the purpose, methods, characteristics, strengths, and weaknesses when selecting a method for assessing cost.

10.1002/hec.1422.abstractZh: 本文比较了两种截然不同的成本估算方法：一种是以美国退伍军人事务部决策支持系统为代表的“自下而上”的方法，该系统采用特定投入的本地成本进行估算；另一种是以退伍军人事务部健康经济资源中心创建的成本核算系统为代表的“自上而下”的方法，该系统通过多种加权系统将退伍军人事务部的全国医疗保健预算分配到具体项目。通过比较散点图、相关性分析、平均差异以及个体差异的标准差，对每位患者的年度总成本以及特定服务的成本（如门诊就诊、放射检查、实验室检测、住院等）进行了对比。分析基于2001年14,915名患者在72家机构的成本数据。相关性分析结果显示，门诊就诊成本的相关率为0.24，住院费用的相关率为0.77，而年度总成本的相关率为0.85。两种成本核算方法之间的平均差异为707美元（4168美元对比3461美元），年度总成本的标准差则为5934美元。总体而言，两种成本核算系统之间的吻合度因具体成本项目的不同而有所差异，且随着数据聚合程度的增加而提高。进行成本分析的管理人员和研究人员在选择成本评估方法时，需要仔细考虑其目的、方法、特点、优势及劣势。

abstract.text: In many public healthcare systems treatments are rationed by waiting time. We examine the optimal allocation of a fixed supply of a given treatment between different groups of patients. Even in the absence of any distributional aims, welfare is increased by third degree waiting time discrimination: setting different waiting times for different groups waiting for the same treatment. Because waiting time imposes dead weight losses on patients, lower waiting times should be offered to groups with higher marginal waiting time costs and with less elastic demand for the treatment.

10.1002/hec.1423.abstractZh: 在许多公共医疗保健系统中，治疗资源的分配是根据等待时间来进行的。我们研究了在固定供应量的特定治疗资源下，如何最优地分配给不同患者群体。即使没有分配目标，通过实施第三级等待时间歧视仍然可以提高福利：为不同群体设定不同的等待时间，以等待相同的治疗。由于等待时间会给患者带来不必要的损失，因此应该为那些边际等待成本较高且对治疗的弹性需求较小的群体提供较短的等待时间。

abstract.text: This paper focuses on the contrast between describing the benefit of a healthcare intervention as gain in health (QALY-type ideas) or a disability reduction (DALY-type ideas). The background is an apparent convergence in practice of the work conducted under both traditions. In the light of these methodological developments, we contrast a health planner who wants to maximise health and one who wants to minimise disability. To isolate the effect of framing the problem from a health or a disability perspective, we do not use age-weighting in calculating DALY and employ a common discounting methodology and the same set of quality of life weights. We find that interventions will be ranked in a systematically different way. The difference, however, is not determined by the use of a health or a disability perspective but by the use of life expectancy tables to determine the years of life lost. We show that this feature of the DALY method is problematic and we suggest its dismissal in favour of a fixed reference age rendering the use of a health or a disability perspective merely stylistic.

10.1002/hec.1424.abstractZh: 本文重点探讨了将医疗干预的效益描述为健康增益（以QALY为代表的概念）或残疾减少（以DALY为代表的概念）之间的区别。这一背景表明，两种传统下的研究在实践中呈现出趋同的趋势。鉴于这些方法论的发展，我们将关注两类规划者：一类希望最大化健康水平，另一类则希望最小化残疾。为了区分从健康或残疾角度出发的问题框架，我们在计算DALY时未使用年龄加权方法，而是采用了统一的折现方法和相同的生活质量权重。我们发现，不同干预措施的评价结果会呈现出系统性差异。然而，这种差异并非由使用健康或残疾视角决定，而是由用于计算损失寿命的预期寿命表所决定。我们指出，DALY方法中的这一特性存在问题，建议摒弃该方法，转而采用固定参考年龄，从而使使用健康或残疾视角仅具有形式上的意义。

abstract.text: The General Health Questionnaire (GHQ) is frequently used as a measure of mental well-being with those people with values below a certain threshold regarded as suffering from mental stress. Comparison of mental stress levels across populations may then be sensitive to the chosen threshold. This paper uses stochastic dominance techniques to show that mental stress fell in Ireland over the 1994-2000 period regardless of the threshold chosen. Decomposition techniques suggest that changes in the proportion unemployed and in the protective effect of income, education and marital status upon mental health were the principal factors underlying this fall.

10.1002/hec.1425.abstractZh: 一般健康问卷（GHQ）常被用作衡量心理健康状况的工具，那些价值观低于一定阈值的个体被视为患有心理压力。因此，不同人群之间的心理压力水平比较可能会受到所选阈值的敏感性影响。本文采用随机优势技术表明，在1994至2000年期间，爱尔兰的心理压力水平存在下降趋势，而这一趋势与所选阈值无关。分解分析表明，失业比例的变化以及收入、教育和婚姻状况对心理健康的保护作用的变化是导致这一趋势的主要因素。

abstract.text: There is an increasing interest in using data derived from ordinal methods, particularly data derived from discrete choice experiments (DCEs), to estimate the cardinal values for health states to calculate quality adjusted life years (QALYs). Ordinal measurement strategies such as DCE may have considerable practical advantages over more conventional cardinal measurement techniques, e.g. time trade-off (TTO), because they may not require such a high degree of abstract reasoning. However, there are a number of challenges to deriving the cardinal values for health states using ordinal data, including anchoring the values on the full health-dead scale used to calculate QALYs. This paper reports on a study that deals with these problems in the context of using two ordinal techniques, DCE and ranking, to derive the cardinal values for health states derived from a condition-specific sexual health measure. The results were compared with values generated using a commonly used cardinal valuation technique, the TTO. This study raises some important issues about the use of ordinal data to produce cardinal health state valuations.

10.1002/hec.1426.abstractZh: 目前，人们越来越倾向于使用基于有序方法的数据，尤其是来自离散选择实验的数据，来估算健康状态的数量值，进而计算质量调整生命年。与传统的数量测量技术（如时间权衡法）相比，有序测量方法如离散选择实验可能在实践上具有显著优势，因为它们可能不需要如此高的抽象推理能力。然而，使用有序数据来估算健康状态的数量值存在若干挑战，其中包括将数值锚定在用于计算质量调整生命年的完整健康-死亡量表上。本文报道了一项研究，该研究在两种有序技术——离散选择实验和排序法的基础上，探讨了如何从特定健康状况的性健康测量数据中得出健康状态的数量值。研究结果与使用常见的数量评估技术——时间权衡法得出的数值进行了比较。这项研究提出了一些关于使用有序数据来生成健康状态数量评估的重要问题。

abstract.text: US prison health care has recently been in the news and in the courts. A particular issue is whether prisons should contract out for health care. Contracting out has been growing over the past few decades. The stated motivation for this change ranges from a desire to improve the prison healthcare system, sometimes in response to a court mandate, to a desire to reduce costs. This study is a first attempt to quantify the impact of this change on inmate health. As morbidity measures are not readily obtainable, we focus on mortality. More specifically, we use a panel of state prisons from 1979 to 1990 and a fixed effects Poisson model to estimate the change in mortality associated with increase in the percentage of medical personnel employed under contract. In contrast to the first stated aim of contracting, we find that a 13% increase in percentage of medical personnel employed under contract increases mortality by 1.3%.

10.1002/hec.1427.abstractZh: 美国监狱的医疗保健问题最近成为新闻焦点，并引发了法律诉讼。一个关键问题是，监狱是否应该将医疗保健服务外包。外包现象在过去几十年中逐渐增多。这种变革的动机多种多样，从改善监狱医疗系统的需求，有时是为了响应法院的指令，到降低成本的考虑。本研究首次尝试量化这种变革对囚犯健康的影响。由于无法轻易获取发病率数据，我们重点关注死亡率的变化。具体来说，我们使用了1979年至1990年间各州监狱的数据，并采用固定效应泊松模型来估算因医疗人员外包比例增加而导致的死亡率变化。与外包最初的目的不同，我们发现，医疗人员外包比例增加13%会导致死亡率增加1.3%。

abstract.text: This study examines the impact that private financing of prescription drugs in Canada has on equity in the utilization of publicly financed physician services. The complementary nature of prescription drugs and physician service use alongside the reliance on private finance for drugs may induce an income gradient in the use of physicians. We use established econometric methods based on concentration curves to measure equity in physician utilization and its contributors in the province of Ontario. We find that individuals with prescription drug insurance make more physician visits than do those without insurance, and the effect on utilization is stronger for the likelihood of a visit than the conditional number of visits, and stronger for individuals with at least one chronic condition than those with no conditions. Results of the equity analyses reveal that the most important contributors to the pro-rich inequity in physician utilization are income and private prescription drug insurance, while public insurance, which covers older people and those on social assistance, has a pro-poor effect. These findings highlight that inequity in access to and use of publicly funded services may arise from the interaction with privately financed health services that are complements to the use of public services.

10.1002/hec.1428.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了加拿大私人融资处方药对公共资助的医生服务利用公平性影响。处方药与医生服务使用的互补性，以及药物对私人融资的依赖，可能导致医生服务的利用存在收入梯度。我们采用基于浓度曲线的成熟计量经济学方法，来衡量安大略省医生服务利用的公平性及其影响因素。研究发现，拥有处方药保险的人比没有保险的人进行更多的医生就诊，且这种影响在就诊可能性上更为显著，而在有至少一种慢性疾病的个体中更为明显。公平性分析结果显示，导致医生服务利用不公平性的最重要因素包括收入和个人处方药保险，而覆盖老年人和社会援助领取者的公共保险则具有促进贫困群体公平性的效果。这些发现表明，公共资助服务的获取和利用的不公平性可能源于与私人融资的医疗服务之间的互动，而这些私人融资的医疗服务是对公共服务的补充。

abstract.text: Waiting times for specialist consultation and non-emergency surgery are often considered an equitable rationing mechanism in the public healthcare sector, because access to care is not based on socioeconomic status. This study tests empirically this claim using data from the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE). The sample includes nine European countries: Austria, Denmark, France, Germany, Greece, Italy, the Netherlands, Spain and Sweden. For specialist consultation, we find that individuals with high education experience a reduction in waiting times of 68% in Spain, 67% in Italy and 34% in France (compared with individuals with low education). Individuals with intermediate education report a waiting-time reduction of 74% in Greece (compared with individuals with low education). There is also evidence of a negative and significant association between education and waiting times for non-emergency surgery in Denmark, the Netherlands and Sweden. High education reduces waits by 66, 32 and 48%, respectively. We also find income effects, although generally modest. An increase in income of 10 000 Euro reduces waiting times for specialist consultation by 8% in Germany and waiting times for non-emergency surgery by 26% in Greece. Surprisingly, an increase in income of 10 000 Euro increases waits by 11% in Sweden.

10.1002/hec.1429.abstractZh: 在公共医疗保健领域，等待专科咨询和非紧急手术的时间通常被视为一种公平的配给机制，因为医疗服务的获取并不基于社会经济地位。本研究利用《欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查》的数据对这一说法进行了实证检验。样本包括九个欧洲国家：奥地利、丹麦、法国、德国、希腊、意大利、荷兰、西班牙和瑞典。对于专科咨询，我们发现受教育程度较高的个体在西班牙的等待时间减少了68%，在意大利减少了67%，在法国减少了34%（与受教育程度较低的个体相比）。受教育程度中等的人群在希腊的等待时间减少了74%（与受教育程度较低的个体相比）。此外，在丹麦、荷兰和瑞典，教育程度与非紧急手术的等待时间之间存在显著的负相关关系。受教育程度较高的人群分别减少了66%、32%和48%的等待时间。我们还发现了收入效应，尽管通常较为温和。在德国，收入增加10,000欧元可使专科咨询的等待时间减少8%，在希腊则可使非紧急手术的等待时间减少26%。令人惊讶的是，在瑞典，收入增加10,000欧元反而会使等待时间增加11%。

abstract.text: The rising rate of obesity has reached epidemic proportions and is now one of the most serious public health challenges facing the US. However, the underlying causes for this increase are unclear. This paper examines the effect of family income changes on body mass index (BMI) and obesity using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 cohort. It does so by using exogenous variation in family income in a sample of low-income women and men. This exogenous variation is obtained from the correlation of their family income with the generosity of state and federal Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) program benefits. Income is found to significantly raise the BMI and probability of being obese for women with EITC-eligible earnings, and have no appreciable effect for men with EITC-eligible earnings. The results imply that the increase in real family income from 1990 to 2002 explains between 10 and 21% of the increase in sample women's BMI and between 23 and 29% of their increased obesity prevalence.

10.1002/hec.1430.abstractZh: 肥胖率的上升已经达到了流行病的程度，现在成为美国面临的最严重的公共卫生挑战之一。然而，导致这一增长的根本原因尚不清楚。本文利用1979年青年纵向调查的数据，研究了家庭收入变化对体重指数（BMI）和肥胖的影响。研究通过低收入女性与男性的样本数据，分析了家庭收入的外生变化对BMI和肥胖的影响。这些外生变化是根据家庭收入与州和联邦劳动收入税收抵免计划福利的关联度来确定的。研究发现，对于有资格享受劳动收入税收抵免计划的女性来说，收入显著提高了BMI和肥胖的概率，而对于有资格享受该计划的男性来说，则没有明显的效果。研究结果表明，从1990年到2002年，实际家庭收入的增加解释了样本女性BMI上升的10%到21%，以及她们肥胖率上升的23%到29%。

abstract.text: The effects of prenatal care utilization on birth weight (BW) may vary by unobserved fetal health endowments. This heterogeneity will be masked by estimating the effects at BW mean but can be evaluated by estimating the effects at BW quantiles as fetal health endowment is a strong correlate with the BW quantile order. We estimated the effects of prenatal care visits and delay before prenatal care initiation, on BW mean and quantiles using a sample of infants from Argentina. Self-selection into prenatal care was modeled using 2SLS and instrumental variable quantile regression. Results suggest that the 'mean' effect of prenatal care utilization largely underestimates the effects at lower BW quantiles. About 35 and 77 g increase in BW mean and 0.1 quantile respectively, per visit and about 30 and 139 g decrease in BW mean and 0.1 quantile respectively, per week delayed, were estimated. Ignoring self-selection into prenatal care resulted in underestimation of mean and quantile effects. Results highlight the limitation of analyses focused on 'mean effects' in the presence of treatment heterogeneity and emphasize the importance of identifying women at risk for having infants at lower BW quantiles as they may benefit most from earlier and more intensive prenatal care.

10.1002/hec.1431.abstractZh: 产前护理利用对出生体重的影响可能因未观察到的胎儿健康状况而有所不同。这种差异可以通过在出生体重均值上估计效应来掩盖，但也可以通过估计出生体重的分位数效应来评估，因为胎儿健康状况与出生体重的分位数顺序有很强的相关性。我们使用来自阿根廷的婴儿样本，估计了产前护理访问次数和产前护理开始时间延迟对出生体重均值和分位数效应的影响。使用2SLS和工具变量分位数回归模型对产前护理的自我选择进行了建模。结果表明，产前护理利用的“均值”效应大大低估了较低出生体重分位数的效应。每进行一次产前护理，出生体重均值分别增加了约35克和77克，而每延迟一周，出生体重均值分别减少了约30克和139克。忽略产前护理的自我选择会导致对均值和分位数效应的低估。研究结果强调了在存在治疗异质性的情况下，仅关注“均值效应”分析的局限性，并强调了识别那些生育低出生体重婴儿风险较高的女性的重要性，因为这些女性可能从更早和更密集的产前护理中获益最多。

abstract.text: This article analyzes the effect of gatekeeper and network restrictions on use of health-care services using simulation-based estimation methods. Data from the Community Tracking Survey (1996-1997) show significant evidence of selection into plans with gatekeeper and/or network restrictions. Enrollees in plans with networks of physicians have fewer office-based visits to non-physician medical professionals, but more emergency room visits and hospital stays. Individuals in plans that require signups with a primary-care provider have more visits to non-physician providers of care, more surgeries and hospital stays but substantially fewer emergency room visits. Enrollees of plans that do not pay for out-of-network services have more office-based and emergency room visits, but less surgeries and hospitalizations.

10.1002/hec.1432.abstractZh: 本文采用基于模拟的估算方法，分析了“守门人”机制和网络限制对医疗服务使用的影响。社区追踪调查（1996-1997年）的数据表明，存在“守门人”和/或网络限制的计划中，患者确实受到了选择性影响。在由医生网络覆盖的计划中，患者到非医生医疗专业人员的门诊就诊次数较少，但急诊室就诊次数和住院时间较多。而在需要向初级保健提供者登记才能加入的计划中，患者到非医生医疗专业人员的就诊次数、手术次数和住院时间较多，但急诊室就诊次数显著减少。对于不支付网络外服务费用的计划，患者到门诊和急诊室的就诊次数较多，但手术次数和住院次数较少。

abstract.text: Understanding the costs associated with early detection of disease is important for determining the fiscal implications of government-funded screening programs. We estimate the lifetime medical costs for patients with screen-detected versus undetected polyps and early-stage colorectal cancer. Typically, cost-effectiveness studies of screening account only for the direct costs of screening and cancer care. Our estimates include costs for unrelated conditions. We applied the Kaplan-Meier Smoothing Estimator to estimate lifetime costs for beneficiaries with screen-detected polyps and cancer. Phase-specific costs and survival probabilities were calculated from the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results-Medicare database for Medicare beneficiaries aged >or=65. We estimate costs from the point of detection onward; therefore, our results do not include the costs associated with screening. We used a modified version of the model to estimate what lifetime costs for these patients would have been if the polyps or cancer remained undetected, based on assumptions about the 'lead time' for polyps and early-stage cancer. For younger patients, polyp removal is cost saving. Treatment of early-stage cancer is cost increasing.

10.1002/hec.1434.abstractZh: 了解与疾病早期检测相关的成本对于确定政府资助的筛查项目的财政影响至关重要。我们估算了通过筛查发现与未发现的息肉以及早期结直肠癌患者的终生医疗成本。通常，筛查的成本效益研究仅考虑筛查和癌症治疗的直接成本。我们的估算还包括了与无关疾病相关的成本。我们采用Kaplan-Meier平滑估计器来估算通过筛查发现息肉和癌症的受益人的终生成本。针对65岁及以上的Medicare受益者，我们从 Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results-Medicare数据库中计算了特定阶段的成本和生存概率。我们从检测点开始估算成本；因此，我们的结果不包括与筛查相关的成本。我们使用修改后的模型来估算如果这些息肉或癌症未被发现，这些患者的终生成本会是多少，这一估算基于关于息肉和早期癌症“潜伏期”的假设。对于年轻患者而言，切除息肉可以节省成本；而早期癌症的治疗则会增加成本。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether there are differences in patient outcomes across different types of hospitals using patient-level data on readmission and mortality associated with acute myocardial infarction (AMI). Hospitals are grouped according to their ownership type (private, public teaching, public non-teaching) and their location (metropolitan, country and remote country). Using data collected from 130 Victorian hospitals on 19,000 patients admitted to a hospital with their first AMI between January 2001 and December 2003, we consider how the likelihood of unplanned re-admission and mortality varies across hospital type. We find that there are significant differences across hospital types in the observed patient outcomes - private hospitals persistently outperform public hospitals.

10.1002/hec.1435.abstractZh: 本文研究了不同类型医院在急性心肌梗塞患者再住院率和死亡率方面的差异。研究依据的是关于130家维多利亚州医院在2001年1月至2003年12月期间首次因急性心肌梗塞住院的19,000名患者的数据。根据医院的所有权类型（私立、公立教学医院、公立非教学医院）和地理位置（城市、乡村及偏远地区）对医院进行分组。研究发现，不同类型医院在患者再住院率和死亡率方面存在显著差异，私立医院的表现始终优于公立医院。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship of medical malpractice litigation and medical costs in the United States. We relate medical malpractice settlements to medical costs for 190 metro and non-metro areas in the United States over a 5-year period and find that litigation is positively and significantly related to medical costs. Using a panel data set and a fixed-effects specification, the estimates indicate that malpractice litigation accounts for roughly 2-10% of medical expenditures, with the impact exceeding the dollar amount of settlements.

10.1002/hec.1436.abstractZh: 本文探讨了美国医疗事故诉讼与医疗成本之间的关系。我们研究了5年间美国190个城市及非城市地区的医疗事故和解金额与医疗成本的关系，发现诉讼金额与医疗成本之间存在正向且显著的关联。通过面板数据分析和固定效应模型分析，估计结果显示医疗事故诉讼占医疗支出的比例约为2-10%，其影响超过了和解金额的数值。

abstract.text: Background Patient preferences can affect colorectal cancer (CRC) screening test use. We compared utility-based preferences for alternative CRC screening tests from a stated-preference discrete-choice survey of the general population and physicians in Canada and the United States. Methods General population respondents (Canada, n = 501; US, n = 1087) participated in a survey with 12 choice scenarios and 9 CRC screening test attributes. Physicians (n = 100, both Canada and US) reported expected patient preferences. We estimated relative importance of attributes using bivariate probit regression analysis and calculated willingness-to-pay for various CRC screening tests. Results In 28 and 31% of scenarios, Canadian and US respondents, respectively, chose no screening over a hypothetical test. Canadian (45%) and US (46%) physicians expected patients to choose no screening more often. For all groups the most important attribute was sensitivity, but physicians' perception of patients' preferences are significantly different from actual preferences. Other key attributes are those related to test performance or the testing process. Fecal DNA, colonoscopy, and virtual colonoscopy were the most preferred tests by all groups, but respondents were willing-to-pay more than physicians predicted. Conclusion Physicians' perception of patients' preferences are quite different from those of the general population. However, among general population and physicians, Canadian and US preferences were similar.

10.1002/hec.1437.abstractZh:
背景：患者偏好可能会影响结直肠癌（CRC）筛查测试的使用。我们对比了加拿大和美国普通人群和医生在一项陈述偏好离散选择调查中，对不同CRC筛查测试的效用偏好。  
方法：普通人群受访者（加拿大，501人；美国，1087人）参与了包含12种选择情景和9种CRC筛查测试属性的调查。医生（100人，来自加拿大和美国）报告了他们预期的患者偏好。我们通过双变量Probit回归分析估计了各属性的重要性，并计算了不同CRC筛查测试的支付意愿。  
结果：在28%和31%的情景中，加拿大和美国的受访者分别选择不进行筛查，而不是进行假设中的测试。加拿大（45%）和美国（46%）的医生预计患者更常选择不进行筛查。对于所有群体来说，最重要的属性是灵敏度，但医生对消费者偏好的认知与实际偏好存在显著差异。其他关键属性与测试性能或测试过程相关。粪便DNA检测、结肠镜检查和虚拟结肠镜检查是所有群体最偏好的测试，但受访者的支付意愿高于医生的预测。  
结论：医生对消费者偏好的认知与普通人群有很大不同。然而，在普通人群和医生之间，加拿大和美国消费者的偏好较为相似。

abstract.text: Older people are intensive users of hospital and long-term care services. This paper explores the extent to which these services are substitutes. A small area analysis was used with both care home and (tariff cost-weighted) hospital utilisation for older people aggregated to electoral wards in England.Health and social-care structural equations were specified using a theoretical model. The estimation accounted for the skewed and censored nature of the data. For health utilisation, both a fixed effects instrumental variables GMM model and a generalised estimating equations (GEE) model were fitted, the later on a log dependent variable with predicted values of social care utilisation used to account for endogeneity (bootstrapping was used to derive standard errors). In addition to a GMM model, the social-care estimation used both two-part and tobit models (also with predicted health utilisation and bootstrapping).The results indicate that for each additional pound1 spent on care homes, hospital expenditure falls by pound0.35. Also, pound1 additional hospital spend corresponds to just over pound0.35 reduction on care home spend. With these cost substitution effects offsetting, a transfer of resources to care homes is efficient if the resultant outcome gain is greater than the outcome loss from reduced hospital use.

10.1002/hec.1438.abstractZh: 老年人是医院和长期护理服务的密集使用者。本文探讨了这些服务在多大程度上是替代品。研究采用了小区域分析的方法，对英格兰各选区内的老年人在护理院和医院的利用情况进行了统计。通过理论模型建立了健康和社会护理的结构方程。在估计过程中考虑了数据的偏态和截尾特性。对于健康利用情况，采用了固定效应工具变量GMM模型和广义估计方程模型进行估计，后者以对数因变量为基础，并利用社会护理利用情况的预测值来消除内生性问题（通过自举法获得标准误差）。除了GMM模型外，社会护理的估计还使用了两部分模型和托比模型（同样基于健康利用情况的预测值，并采用自举法获得标准误差）。研究结果表明，每增加一英镑用于护理院，医院支出将减少0.35英镑；同样，每增加一英镑用于医院，护理院支出将减少0.35英镑以上。如果这些成本替代效应能够相互抵消，那么将资源转移到护理院是有效的，因为由此带来的收益大于减少医院使用所带来的损失。

abstract.text: This paper examines the economics of pricing practices at artificial reproductive clinics, which have introduced money-back guarantees (MBGs) for in vitro fertilization. We identify incentives for clinics to offer MBGs and evaluate the impact on couples' choices and on social welfare. Introducing MBGs allows a clinic to (i) segment couples simultaneously on their relative fertility and on risk preferences; (ii) offer quantity discounts to relatively infertile couples; and (iii) offer some risk-sharing to couples for this costly procedure, whose outcome is uncertain. Our results also show how the addition of MBGs can affect the overall social welfare.

10.1002/hec.1439.abstractZh: 本文探讨了人工生殖诊所定价行为的经济学效应，这些诊所为体外受精服务引入了退款保证机制。我们分析了诊所提供退款保证的动机，并评估了这一机制对夫妻选择及社会福利的影响。引入退款保证机制使诊所能够：(i) 根据夫妻的相对生育能力和风险偏好进行细分市场定位；(ii) 为相对不育的夫妻提供数量折扣；(iii) 为接受这项成本高昂且结果不确定的服务过程的夫妻提供部分风险分担。我们的研究结果还揭示了退款保证机制如何影响整体社会福利。

abstract.text: This paper focuses on the switching behaviour of enrolees in the Swiss basic health insurance system. Even though the new Federal Law on Social Health Insurance (LAMal) was implemented in 1996 to promote competition among health insurers in basic insurance, there is limited evidence of premium convergence within cantons. This indicates that competition has not been effective so far, and reveals some inertia among consumers who seem reluctant to switch to less expensive funds. We investigate one possible barrier to switching behaviour, namely the influence of supplementary insurance. We use survey data on health plan choice (a sample of 1943 individuals whose switching behaviours were observed between 1997 and 2000) as well as administrative data relative to all insurance companies that operated in the 26 Swiss cantons between 1996 and 2005. The decision to switch and the decision to subscribe to a supplementary contract are jointly estimated.Our findings show that holding a supplementary insurance contract substantially decreases the propensity to switch. However, there is no negative impact of supplementary insurance on switching when the individual assesses his/her health as 'very good'. Our results give empirical support to one possible mechanism through which supplementary insurance might influence switching decisions: given that subscribing to basic and supplementary contracts with two different insurers may induce some administrative costs for the subscriber, holding supplementary insurance acts as a barrier to switch if customers who consider themselves 'bad risks' also believe that insurers reject applications for supplementary insurance on these grounds. In comparison with previous research, our main contribution is to offer a possible explanation for consumer inertia. Our analysis illustrates how consumer choice for one's basic health plan interacts with the decision to subscribe to supplementary insurance.

10.1002/hec.1441.abstractZh: 本文聚焦于瑞士基本健康保险体系中参保人的转换行为。尽管1996年实施了新的《联邦社会健康保险法》，旨在促进基本保险领域健康保险公司之间的竞争，但各州内保费趋同的证据却十分有限。这表明竞争至今尚未有效发挥作用，同时也反映出消费者在转换到价格较低的保险计划时存在一定的惯性。我们研究了转换行为的一个可能障碍，即补充保险的影响。我们使用了关于健康计划选择的调查数据（样本为1943名个体，其转换行为在1997年至2000年间被观察），以及1996年至2005年间在瑞士26个州运营的所有保险公司的行政数据。我们同时估计了转换决策和订阅补充合同的决策。研究发现，持有补充保险合同会显著降低转换的倾向。然而，当个体认为自己的健康状况“非常好”时，补充保险对转换行为没有负面影响。我们的研究结果为补充保险可能影响转换决策的一种机制提供了实证支持：由于订阅不同保险公司提供的基本保险和补充合同可能会给客户带来一定的行政成本，如果认为自己是“高风险”的顾客也相信保险公司会基于这一理由拒绝补充保险申请，那么持有补充保险就会成为转换的障碍。与以往的研究相比，我们的主要贡献在于为消费者惰性现象提供了一种可能的解释。我们的分析说明了消费者选择基本健康计划与购买补充保险之间的相互作用。

abstract.text: This paper looks at health inequality and deprivation, with a particular focus on developing countries. It is specifically concerned with relationships between health and income, especially the extent to which inequality and deprivation in the former is driven by changes in the latter. The paper reports increasing disparity in child mortality among country groups since the mid-1970s. It also reports decreased inequality in life expectancy among countries from the early 1960s until the late 1980s and increased inequality thereafter. Similar patterns in life expectancy deprivation are reported. The paper finds that this is partly due to a changing behavioural relationship between life expectancy and income per capita among countries with low achievement in the former variable. The paper also introduces and provides an overview of the papers that follow in this Supplement.

10.1002/hec.1456.abstractZh: 本文探讨了健康不平等与匮乏问题，特别关注发展中国家的情况。文章特别研究了健康与收入之间的关系，尤其是前者中的不平等与匮乏在多大程度上是由后者变化所驱动的。报告指出，自20世纪70年代中期以来，不同国家群体之间的儿童死亡率差距不断增大。同时，报告还指出，从20世纪60年代初到80年代末，各国的预期寿命不平等程度有所降低，此后则出现了不平等程度的增加。报告还发现了类似的预期寿命匮乏现象。文章认为，这部分是由于在预期寿命这一变量表现不佳的国家中，预期寿命与人均收入之间的行为关系发生了变化。文章还介绍了本增刊中后续论文的内容，并提供了相关概述。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between level of well-being and inequality at inter-country and intra-household levels, using individuals' body mass index (BMI) rather than income as the indicator of well-being. BMI is useful for these purposes because (1) it is measured at the individual rather than household level; (2) it reflects command over food, but also non-food resources that affect health status like sanitary conditions and labour-saving technologies; (3) it accounts for caloric consumption relative to needs; (4) it is easily measured; and (5) any measurement error is likely to be random. We do not find any evidence to support the idea of an intra-household or inter-country Kuznets curve. We study the correlations between average household well-being, still measured by BMI, and differences in the BMIs of males and females, parents and children. Here, we find a tendency to protect the BMI of young children when living standards are very low. We find no clear patterns by gender. Perhaps the most striking finding in the paper is that about half of total BMI inequality at the country level is within households. Thus, standard measures of inequality that use household-level data may drastically understate true inequality.

10.1002/hec.1459.abstractZh: 本文探讨了福祉水平与不平等之间的关系，涉及国家间和家庭内部层面的不平等问题。研究以个体体质指数（BMI）而非收入作为福祉的衡量指标。选择BMI作为衡量标准的原因包括：（1）该指标是在个体层面而非家庭层面进行测量的；（2）它反映了对食物资源的掌控，同时也反映了影响健康状况的非食物资源，如卫生条件和节省劳动力的技术；（3）它考虑了相对于需求的卡路里摄入量；（4）该指标易于测量；（5）任何测量误差都可能是随机的。我们没有发现任何证据支持家庭内部或国家间存在“库兹涅茨曲线”的观点。我们研究了以BMI衡量的平均家庭福祉与男女、父母与子女之间的BMI差异之间的相关性。研究发现，在生活水平非常低的情况下，幼儿的BMI有保护的趋势。但并未发现明显的性别差异。本文最引人注目的发现是，国家层面的总BMI不平等中约有一半发生在家庭内部。因此，使用家庭层面数据的标准不平等衡量方法可能会严重低估真实的不平等程度。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the recent evolution of life expectancy in Latin American and Caribbean countries, and evaluates how much it has contributed to the overall improvements in welfare. We argue that increases in life expectancy between 1960 and 2000, which were largely independent of income, represented gains in welfare comparable to the ones derived from income growth. For countries in the region, estimates of welfare improvements accounting for health increase the numbers obtained from income alone by 40% on average. The available evidence suggests that improvements in public health infrastructure - such as provision of treated water and sewerage services - and large-scale immunization programs may have been the key factors behind the mortality reductions observed in the period.

10.1002/hec.1460.abstractZh: 本文分析了拉丁美洲和加勒比地区国家预期寿命的近期变化，并评估了这些变化对整体福利改善的贡献程度。我们认为，1960年至2000年间预期寿命的增加在很大程度上与收入无关，这种福利提升所带来的收益与收入增长带来的收益相当。对于该地区的国家而言，考虑到健康状况的福利改善因素后，仅从收入角度得出的数值平均增加了40%。现有证据表明，公共健康基础设施的改善——如提供处理过的水和污水服务——以及大规模的免疫计划可能是这一时期死亡率下降的关键因素。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a new method to measure health inequalities that are caused by conditions amenable to policy intervention. The method is built on a technique that can separate avoidable and unavoidable mortality risks, using world mortality data compiled by the World Health Organization for the year 2000. The new method is applied to data from 191 countries. It is found that controlling for unavoidable mortality risks leads to a lower estimate of health inequality than otherwise, especially for developed countries. Furthermore, although countries with a higher life expectancy at birth tend to have lower health inequality, there are significant variations in health inequalities across countries with the same life expectancy. The results therefore support the WHO's plea for using health inequality as a distinct parameter from the average level of health in assessing the performance of health systems.

10.1002/hec.1461.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新方法，用于衡量由政策干预可解决的条件所导致的健康不平等。该方法基于一种技术，能够区分可避免和不可避免的死亡风险，使用的是世界卫生组织在2000年汇编的世界死亡数据。该方法被应用于191个国家的数据。研究发现，控制不可避免的死亡风险后，对健康不平等的估计值会更低，尤其是在发达国家。此外，尽管出生时的预期寿命较高的国家往往具有较低的健康不平等程度，但即使预期寿命相同的国家之间，健康不平等也存在显著差异。因此，这些结果支持了世界卫生组织关于将健康不平等作为评估卫生系统绩效的独立参数而非仅以平均健康水平来衡量的建议。

abstract.text: This paper argues that indicators of anthropometric shortfall - especially low height and low weight-for-age - are uniquely suited for assessing absolute deprivation in developing countries. Anthropometric indicators are relatively precise, readily available for most countries, reflect the preferences and concerns of many poor people, consistent with reckoning the phenomenon directly in the space of functionings, intuitive, easy to use for advocacy, and consistent over time and across subgroups. Anthropometric indicators can therefore complement (but not replace) standard indicators of income/consumption poverty, especially for comparisons across subgroups, within households, across countries, and in the long run. In addition, the paper analyses spells of change in malnutrition over time, finding that the association between economic growth and chronic child malnutrition is very small (but statistically significant) and much lower than the elasticity of growth on poverty. The policy implication of this finding is that direct interventions aimed at reducing infant malnutrition are required.

10.1002/hec.1462.abstractZh: 本文认为，人体测量指标——尤其是身高过低和体重过低——特别适合用于评估发展中国家的绝对贫困状况。人体测量指标相对精确，大多数国家都能轻松获取，能够反映许多贫困人口的偏好和关切，与直接通过功能评估来识别这一现象的方式一致，易于使用，并且在不同时间和不同群体间具有一致性。因此，人体测量指标可以补充（而非替代）收入/消费贫困的标准指标，尤其是在不同群体、家庭内部、国家之间以及长期比较时。此外，本文还分析了营养不良状况随时间的变化情况，发现经济增长与儿童慢性营养不良之间的关联非常微弱（但统计上显著），且远低于经济增长对贫困影响的弹性。这一发现的政策意义在于，需要采取直接干预措施来减少婴儿营养不良的问题。

abstract.text: How did rapid growth in per capita income and rising income inequality during 1991-2000 in China affect the health status of Chinese children, given that the disappearance in the 1990s of subsidized food coupons simultaneously increased the importance of money income in enabling consumption of basic foods by poor families? Using the China Health and Nutrition Survey data for 1991, 1993, 1997, and 2000 on 4400 households in nine provinces, we examine the height-for-age of Chinese children aged 2-13, with particular emphasis on the growth of children living in poor households. We use mean regression and quantile regression models to isolate the dynamic impact of poverty status and food coupon use on child height-for-age. Our principal findings are: (i) controlling for standard variables (e.g. parents' weight, height, and education) poverty is correlated with slower growth in height-for-age between 1997 and 2000 but not earlier; (ii) in 2000, poverty is negatively correlated with strong growth in height-for-age; and (iii) food coupon use in earlier periods correlates positively with growth in height-for-age. The general moral is the crucial social protection role that subsidized food programmes can potentially play in maintaining the health of poor children.

10.1002/hec.1463.abstractZh: 1991年至2000年间，中国人均收入快速增长以及收入不平等加剧，这对中国儿童的健康状况产生了怎样的影响？特别是在1990年代补贴食品券的消失使得货币收入在贫困家庭基本食品消费中的重要性上升的情况下。我们利用1991年、1993年、1997年和2000年中国健康和营养调查的数据，对九个省份的4400户家庭进行了研究，重点关注2-13岁儿童的身高与年龄的关系，特别是生活在贫困家庭中的儿童。我们通过均值回归和分位数回归模型，分析了贫困状况与食品券使用对儿童身高与年龄动态影响的关系。我们的主要发现包括：(i) 控制标准变量（如父母体重、身高和教育水平）后，贫困与1997年至2000年间儿童身高增长速度较慢有关，但更早时期则不存在这种关系；(ii) 在2000年，贫困与儿童身高快速增长呈负相关；(iii) 早期使用食品券与儿童身高增长速度呈正相关。总体而言，补贴食品计划在维护贫困儿童健康方面发挥着重要的社会保护作用。

abstract.text: Given the public goods nature of research, economic research on health in developing countries is likely to have the highest returns by focusing, inter alia, on diseases and health conditions that are relatively widespread and costly and that are relatively rapidly growing. This article first summarizes the time patterns in economic research on diseases and health in developing countries for 1990-2005. It then compares those time patterns with the distribution of disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) for diseases and health conditions in developing countries estimated for 2005 and for 2030. These comparisons suggest relatively overemphasis on HIV/AIDS and underemphasis on noncommunicable diseases (NCDs). This opens the possibility for individuals or organizations initiating, re-evaluating, or increasing their economic research on health and development to make a significant contribution by focusing particularly on the analysis of behaviour and policy choices related to NCDs. Careful consideration must, of course, be given to other demands, but on the basis of these two criteria, potential contributions are likely to be greatest from research with such a focus.

10.1002/hec.1464.abstractZh: 鉴于研究的公共物品性质，对发展中国家健康问题的经济研究通过重点关注那些相对普遍、成本高昂且增长迅速的疾病和健康状况，可能会获得最大的回报。本文首先总结了1990至2005年间关于发展中国家疾病和健康的经济研究的时间趋势。然后，将这些时间趋势与2005年和2030年对发展中国家疾病和健康状况的残疾调整生命年（DALYs）数据进行了比较。这些比较表明，研究相对过于关注艾滋病，而对非传染性疾病（NCDs）的关注不足。这为个人或组织提供了机会，可以重新评估或加强他们在健康与发展方面的经济研究，通过特别关注与非传染性疾病相关的行为和政策选择，做出有意义的贡献。当然，必须仔细考虑其他需求，但基于这两个标准，以这种方式聚焦的研究可能会带来最大的潜在贡献。

abstract.text: Despite widespread efforts to expand health insurance in developing countries, there is scant evidence as to whether doing so actually improves people's health. This paper aims to fill this gap by evaluating the impact of Rural Mutual Health Care (RMHC), a community-based health insurance scheme, on enrollees' health outcomes. RMHC is a social experiment that was conducted in one of China's western provinces from 2003 to 2006. The RMHC experiment adopted a pre-post treatment-control study design. This study used panel data collected in 2002, 1 year prior to the intervention, and followed up in 2005, 2 years after the intervention, both in the intervention and control sites. We measured health status using both a 5-point Categorical Rating Scale and the EQ-5D instruments. The estimation method used here is difference-in-difference combined propensity score matching. The results show that RMHC has a positive effect on the health status of participants. Among the five dimensions of EQ-5D, RMHC significantly reduces pain/discomfort and anxiety/depression for the general population, and has a positive impact on mobility and usual activity for those over 55-years old. Our study provides useful policy information on the development of health insurance in developing countries, and also identifies areas where further research is needed.

10.1002/hec.1465.abstractZh: 尽管在发展中国家广泛开展了扩大医疗保险的尝试，但几乎没有证据表明这样做是否真的能够改善人们的健康状况。本文旨在通过评估基于社区的农村互助医疗计划对参与者健康结果的影响来填补这一空白。农村互助医疗计划是一项社会实验，于2003年至2006年间在中国西部的一个省份进行。该实验采用了前后对照研究设计。本研究使用了2002年收集的数据，即干预前一年，以及2005年的数据，即干预后两年，这些数据在干预组和对照组地区均进行了收集。我们通过5点分类评分量表和EQ-5D工具来衡量健康状况。本研究采用差异-差异结合倾向得分匹配的方法进行估计。结果表明，农村互助医疗计划对参与者的健康状况有积极影响。在EQ-5D的五个维度中，该计划显著降低了普通人群的疼痛/不适和焦虑/抑郁症状，并对55岁以上人群的活动能力和日常活动能力产生了积极影响。我们的研究为发展中国家医疗保险的发展提供了有用的政策信息，同时也指出了需要进一步研究的领域。

abstract.text: The impact of market concentration has been little studied in markets for ambulatory care in the developing world, where the retail sector often accounts for a high proportion of treatments. This study begins to address this gap through an analysis of the consumer market for malaria treatment in rural areas of three districts in Tanzania. We developed methods for investigating market definition, sales volumes and concentration, and used these to explore the relationship between antimalarial retail prices and competition.The market was strongly geographically segmented and highly concentrated in terms of antimalarial sales. Antimalarial prices were positively associated with market concentration. High antimalarial prices were likely to be an important factor in the low proportion of care-seekers obtaining appropriate treatment.Retail sector distribution of subsidised antimalarials has been proposed to increase the coverage of effective treatment, but this analysis indicates that local market power may prevent such subsidies from being passed on to rural customers. Policymakers should consider the potential to maintain lower retail prices by decreasing concentration among antimalarial providers and recommending retail price levels.

10.1002/hec.1473.abstractZh: 在发展中国家，针对门诊护理市场的市场集中度影响研究较少，因为零售部门通常占治疗费用的很大比例。本研究通过分析坦桑尼亚三个农村地区疟疾治疗市场的消费者需求，试图填补这一空白。我们开发了用于研究市场定义、销售量和集中度的方法，并利用这些方法来探讨抗疟药物零售价格与竞争之间的关系。该市场在地理上高度分割，在抗疟药物销售方面也高度集中。抗疟药物价格与市场集中度呈正相关。较高的抗疟药物价格可能是导致寻求治疗的人难以获得适当治疗的一个重要因素。虽然有人提出通过零售部门分配补贴的抗疟药物来增加有效治疗的覆盖率，但分析表明，当地市场力量可能会阻止这种补贴传递给农村消费者。政策制定者应考虑通过降低抗疟药物提供者的集中度并建议零售价格水平来保持较低的零售价格。

abstract.text: The current air quality limit values for airborne pollutants in the UK are low by historical standards and are at levels that are believed not to harm health. We assess whether this view is correct. We examine the relationship between common sources of airborne pollution and population mortality for England. We use data at local authority level for 1998-2005 to examine whether current levels of airborne pollution, as measured by annual mean concentrations of carbon monoxide, nitrogen dioxide, particulate matter less than 10 microm in diameter (PM(10)) and ozone, are associated with excess deaths. We examine all-cause mortality and deaths from specific cardiovascular and respiratory causes that are known to be exacerbated by air pollution. The panel nature of our data allows us to control for any unobserved time-invariant associations at local authority level between high levels of air pollution and poor population health and for common time trends. We estimate multi-pollutant models to allow for the fact that three of the pollutants are closely correlated. We find that higher levels of PM(10) and ozone are associated with higher mortality rates, and the effect sizes are considerably larger than previously estimated from the primarily time series studies for England.

10.1002/hec.1475.abstractZh: 英国当前针对空气污染物的大气质量限制值，按照历史标准来看属于较低水平，且被认为不会对健康造成危害。我们评估这一观点是否正确。我们研究了英格兰常见空气污染源与人口死亡率之间的关系。我们使用1998-2005年的地方当局级数据，来考察当前空气污染水平——通过年度平均一氧化碳、二氧化氮、直径小于10微米的颗粒物（PM(10)）和臭氧浓度来衡量——是否与超额死亡率相关。我们研究了全因死亡率以及由空气污染加剧的特定心血管和呼吸系统疾病的死亡率。我们的数据具有面板性质，这使我们能够控制地方当局级上空气污染水平与人口健康状况不佳之间任何未观察到的时间不变关联，以及常见的时间趋势。我们估计了多污染物模型，以考虑到三种污染物之间存在密切关联的事实。我们发现，较高水平的PM(10)和臭氧与更高的死亡率相关，其效应大小比之前从英格兰主要时间序列研究中估计的还要大得多。

abstract.text: As the latest government effort to reform China's health care system, Urban Resident Basic Medical Insurance (URBMI) was piloted in seventy-nine cities during the summer of 2007, following State Council Policy Document 2007 No. 20's guidelines. This study presents the first economic analysis of URBMI, following a national household survey in nine representative Chinese cities. The survey aimed to answer three questions: Who is covered by the plan? Who gains from the plan? Who is most satisfied with the plan? We have found that there is a U-shaped relationship between URBMI participation rate and income. That is, the extremely rich or poor are the most likely to participate. Those with any inpatient treatment last year or with any chronic disease are also more likely to enroll in URBMI, indicating adverse selection into participation. We have also found that in reducing financial barriers to care, URBMI most significantly benefits the poor and those with previous inpatient care. Finally, those participants in the bottom 20% of family incomes are happier with URBMI than are their more affluent counterparts.

10.1002/hec.1500.abstractZh: 作为中国政府改革医疗体系的最新举措，城市居民基本医疗保险在2007年夏季在79个城市进行了试点，这一试点遵循了国务院2007年第20号政策文件的指导方针。本研究首次对城市居民基本医疗保险进行了经济分析，基于在中国九个代表性城市的全国家庭调查数据。调查旨在回答三个问题：该计划覆盖哪些人群？哪些人群从该计划中受益？哪些人群对该计划最为满意？研究发现，城市居民基本医疗保险的参与率与收入之间存在U形关系。也就是说，极端富裕或贫困的人群最有可能参与该计划。过去曾接受过住院治疗或患有慢性疾病的群体也更容易加入该计划，这表明存在逆向选择现象。此外，研究发现，在降低医疗服务的经济障碍方面，城市居民基本医疗保险对贫困人群和曾经接受过住院治疗的人群最为有益。最后，家庭收入处于最低20%的人群对城市居民基本医疗保险的满意度高于收入较高的群体。

abstract.text: This paper explores the impact of the New Cooperative Medical Scheme (NCMS), a newly adopted public health insurance program in rural China. Using a longitudinal sample drawn from the China Health and Nutrition Survey (CHNS), we employed multiple estimation strategies (individual fixed-effect models, instrumental variable estimation, and difference-in-differences estimation with propensity score matching) to correct the potential selection bias. We find that participating in the NCMS significantly decreases the use of traditional Chinese folk doctors and increases the utilization of preventive care, particularly general physical examinations. However, we do not find that the NCMS decreases out-of-pocket expenditure nor do we find that it increases utilization of formal medical service or improves health status, as measured by self-reported health status and by sickness or injury in the past four weeks. Our study indicates that despite the wide expansion of coverage, the impact of the NCMS is still limited.

10.1002/hec.1501.abstractZh: 本文探讨了新合作医疗计划（NCMS）对中国农村地区公共卫生保险制度的影响。本研究基于中国健康与营养调查（CHNS）的纵向样本数据，采用多种估计方法（个体固定效应模型、工具变量估计法以及通过倾向得分匹配的差分匹配法）来纠正潜在的选择偏差。研究发现，参与NCMS显著减少了传统中医的使用，并增加了预防性医疗服务的利用，尤其是一般体检。然而，我们并未发现NCMS能够降低个人自付费用，也未发现它能提高正式医疗服务的利用率或改善健康状况，后者是通过自我报告的健康状况以及过去四周内的疾病或受伤情况来衡量的。研究表明，尽管NCMS的覆盖范围得到了广泛扩展，但其影响仍然有限。

abstract.text: With a total population of more than 1.3 billion people where more than 31% of adults smoke, China has become the world's largest producer and consumer of cigarettes. We adopt a life-course perspective to study the economics of smoking behavior in China. We use data from the China Health and Nutrition Survey (CHNS) to follow individuals over their whole lives and to analyze their decisions to both start and stop smoking. We extend the small but growing body of economic research on smoking in China. Our life-course approach emphasizes that current smoking participation reflects a decision to start and a series of past decisions to not quit. We explore how the determinants of smoking initiation differ from the determinants of smoking cessation. We find results, consistent with some previous empirical evidence, that Chinese smoking is not strongly related to the price of cigarettes. Based on our results, we offer some speculative hypotheses that, we hope, might guide future research on the economics of smoking in China. It seems especially useful to compare the broad patterns we document with the experiences of other countries.

10.1002/hec.1507.abstractZh: 中国总人口超过13亿，超过31%的成年人吸烟，因此中国已成为世界上最大的香烟生产和消费国。我们采用生命周期视角来研究中国吸烟行为的经济学现象。我们利用中国健康与营养调查的数据，追踪个体的一生，分析他们开始和停止吸烟的决策过程。我们扩展了关于中国吸烟问题的经济研究，尽管研究规模较小，但成果不断积累。我们的生命周期研究方法强调，当前的吸烟参与行为反映了开始吸烟的决策以及一系列过去的戒烟决策。我们探讨了吸烟开始的决定因素与戒烟决定因素的不同之处。我们的研究结果与一些先前的实证证据一致，即中国人的吸烟行为与其香烟价格并无强烈关联。基于这些结果，我们提出了一些推测性假设，希望这些假设能指导未来对中国吸烟经济学的研究。将我们发现的广泛模式与其他国家的经验进行比较，似乎特别有参考价值。

abstract.text: Since the dissolution of the Rural Cooperative Medical System at the end of the commune period, illness has emerged as a leading cause of poverty in rural China. To address the poor state of health care, the Chinese government unveiled the New Cooperative Medical System in 2002. Because local governments have been given significant control over program design, fundamental characteristics of the program vary from one county to the next. These differences may influence the decision to seek health care as well as the choice of hospital conditional on that initial decision. In this paper, we use a nested logit model to analyze household survey data from 25 counties to analyze the determinants of such health-seeking behavior. We find that age, the share of household expenditures allocated to food consumption (a measure of relative income), and the presence of other sick people in the household negatively affect the decision to seek health care while disability has a positive influence. Further, conditional on seeking treatment, the reimbursement scheme in place in each county and the average daily expenditure associated with hospitalization strongly influence hospital choice.

10.1002/hec.1508.abstractZh: 自公社时期结束农村合作医疗制度解体以来，疾病已成为中国农村贫困的主要诱因。为改善医疗状况，中国政府于2002年推出了新的合作医疗制度。由于地方政府在制度设计中拥有较大自主权，不同地区的制度特征存在差异。这些差异可能会影响人们寻求医疗服务的决策，以及基于该决策而选择医院的方式。本文采用嵌套Logit模型，分析了来自25个县的住户调查数据，以研究此类健康行为的影响因素。研究发现，年龄、家庭用于食品消费的开支比例（衡量相对收入的一个指标）以及家中其他病人的存在，都会对寻求医疗服务的决策产生负面影响，而残疾状况则具有正面影响。此外，在寻求治疗的前提下，各县的报销方案以及住院期间的日均支出，也会对医院选择产生重要影响。

abstract.text: The overall goal of the paper is to understand the progress of the design and implementation of China's New Cooperative Medical System (NCMS) program between 2004 (the second year of the program) and 2007. In the paper we seek to assess some of the strengths and weaknesses of the program using a panel of national-representative, household survey data that were collected in 2005 and early 2008. According to our data, we confirm the recent reports by the Ministry of Health that there have been substantial improvements to the NCMS program in terms of coverage and participation. We also show that rural individuals also perceive an improvement in service by 2007. While the progress of the NCMS program is clear, there are still weaknesses. Most importantly, the program clearly does not meet one of its key goals of providing insurance against catastrophic illnesses. On average, individuals that required inpatient treatment in 2007 were reimbursed for 15% of their expenditures. Although this is higher than in 2004, on average, as the severity of the illness (in terms of expenditures on health care) rose, the real reimbursement rate (reimbursement amount/total expenditure on medical care) fell. The real reimbursement rate for illnesses that required expenditures between 4000 and 10,000 yuan (over 10,000 yuan) was only 11% (8%). Our analysis shows that one of the limiting factors is constrained funding.

10.1002/hec.1510.abstractZh: 本文的总体目标是了解中国新型合作医疗制度在2004年（该计划的第二年）至2007年期间的设计与实施进展。通过2005年和2008年初收集的国家代表性家庭调查数据，我们试图评估该计划的一些优势和劣势。根据我们的数据，证实了卫生部最近的报告所述，新型合作医疗计划在覆盖范围和参与率方面取得了显著改善。我们还发现，到2007年，农村地区的民众也感觉到服务质量的提升。尽管新型合作医疗计划的进展明显，但仍存在一些弱点。最重要的是，该计划显然未能实现其关键目标之一，即提供针对严重疾病的保险保障。2007年，需要住院治疗的患者的报销比例仅为15%。虽然这一比例高于2004年，但随着疾病严重程度的增加（体现在医疗支出上），实际报销率（报销金额/总医疗支出）却有所下降。对于需要4000至10000元（或更高）医疗支出的疾病，实际报销率仅为11%（2004年为8%）。我们的分析表明，限制因素之一在于资金不足。

abstract.text: This paper has two parts. The first part examines the regional health expenditure inequality in China by testing two hypotheses on health expenditure convergence. Cross-section regressions and cluster analysis are used to study the health expenditure convergence and to identify convergence clusters. We find no single nationwide convergence, only convergence by cluster. In the second part of the paper, we investigate the long-run relationship between health expenditure inequality, income inequality, and provincial government budget deficits (BD) by using new panel co-integration tests with health expenditure data in China's urban and rural areas. We find that the income inequality and real provincial government BD are useful in explaining the disparity in health expenditure prevailing between urban and rural areas. In order to reduce health-spending inequality, one long-run policy suggestion from our findings is for the government to implement more rapid economic development and stronger financing schemes in poorer rural areas.

10.1002/hec.1511.abstractZh: 本文分为两部分。第一部分通过检验两个关于健康支出收敛的假设，来研究中国地区间健康支出不平等现象。采用横截面回归和聚类分析方法来研究健康支出的收敛情况，并识别出不同的收敛群体。我们发现并不存在全国性的单一收敛趋势，而是存在基于群体的收敛现象。在第二部分中，我们利用新的面板协整检验方法，结合中国城乡地区的健康支出数据，研究健康支出不平等、收入不平等与省级政府预算赤字之间的长期关系。研究发现，收入不平等和省级政府预算赤字的实际数值有助于解释城乡之间健康支出差异的成因。为了减少健康支出不平等现象，我们的研究提出了一项长期政策建议：政府应在贫困的农村地区实施更快的经济发展和更有效的融资计划。

abstract.text: We examine the physical and mental health effects of providing care to an elderly mother on the adult child caregiver. We address the endogeneity of the selection in and out of caregiving using an instrumental variable approach, using the death of the care recipient and sibling characteristics. We also carefully control for baseline health and work status of the adult child. We explore flexible specifications, such as Arellano-Bond estimation techniques. Continued caregiving over time increases depressive symptoms and decreases self-rated health for married women and married men. In addition, the increase in depressive symptoms is persistent for married women. While depressive symptoms for single men and women are not affected by continued caregiving, there is evidence of increased incidence of heart conditions for single men, and that these effects are persistent. Robustness checks indicate that these health changes can be directly attributable to caregiving behavior, and not due to a direct effect of the death of the mother. The initial onset of caregiving has modest immediate negative effects on depressive symptoms for married women and no immediate effects on physical health. Negative physical health effects emerge 2 years later, however, suggesting that there are delayed effects on health that would be missed with a short recall period. Initial caregiving does not affect health of married men.

10.1002/hec.1512.abstractZh: 我们研究了为年长母亲提供护理对成年子女照顾者身心健康的影响。我们通过工具变量方法探讨了选择进入和退出护理状态的内生性，使用了护理对象的死亡情况以及兄弟姐妹特征作为变量。我们还仔细控制了成年子女的基线健康状况和工作状态。我们采用了灵活的估计方法，如Arellano-Bond估计技术。持续进行护理会增加已婚女性的抑郁症状，并降低其自我健康评分；对于已婚男性来说，抑郁症状的增加是持续的。虽然单身男女的抑郁症状并未受到持续护理的影响，但有证据表明单身男性的心脏病发病率有所上升，且这些影响是持续的。稳健性检验表明，这些健康变化可以直接归因于护理行为，而非母亲死亡的直接影响。护理行为的开始对已婚女性的抑郁症状有轻微的即时负面影响，但对身体健康没有即时影响。然而，2年后会出现负面的身体健康影响，这表明存在延迟的健康影响，而短暂的回顾期可能无法发现这些影响。初步的护理行为并未影响已婚男性的健康状况。

abstract.text: China has introduced a system of community health centers (CHCs) to provide primary care. To test whether services provided by such centers are more cost-effective than treatment at local higher-level hospitals, the study compared health outcomes and expenditures for patients with hypertension and diabetes mellitus in three cities. We hypothesized that treating patients in stable condition at CHCs is less costly than providing treatment in higher-level hospitals with no differences in health outcomes. Results indicate that daily drug and other medical expenditures were consistently equal or lower for patients seeking treatment in CHCs than for those treated in hospitals. Patients also saved time by visiting CHCs. Health outcomes, measured as mean arterial pressure for hypertension and plasma glucose for diabetes, were similar for patients seeking treatment in CHCs and hospitals in most cases. Results suggest that CHCs are more cost-effective than hospitals in treating chronic diseases. Findings may also indicate that those patients seeking care at hospitals have more serious--and therefore more expensive and time-consuming--conditions. Further empirical research is needed to clarify these results.

10.1002/hec.1517.abstractZh: 中国已经建立了社区健康中心体系，以提供初级医疗服务。为了测试这些中心提供的服务是否比当地高级医院的治疗更具成本效益，本研究比较了三个城市中高血压和糖尿病患者的健康结果和支出情况。我们假设在社区健康中心治疗病情稳定的患者比在高级医院接受治疗成本更低，且健康结果没有差异。研究结果表明，寻求在社区健康中心治疗的患者的日常药物和其他医疗支出始终等于或低于在医院治疗的患者的支出。患者通过前往社区健康中心还能节省时间。对于高血压患者的平均动脉压和糖尿病患者的血浆葡萄糖等健康结果而言，在大多数情况下，寻求在社区健康中心治疗的患者与在医院治疗的患者相似。研究结果表明，社区健康中心在治疗慢性疾病方面比医院更具成本效益。此外，这些发现也可能表明，在医院接受治疗的患者病情更为严重，因此治疗费用更高且耗时更长。需要进一步的研究来阐明这些结果。

abstract.text: This paper provides a survey of the recent empirical research on China's 'old' health system (i.e. prior to the spate of reforms beginning in 2003). It argues that this research has enhanced our understanding of the system prior to 2003, in some cases reinforcing conclusions (e.g. the demand-inducement associated with perverse incentives) while in other cases suggesting a slightly less clear storyline (e.g. the link between insurance and out-of-pocket spending). It also concludes that the research to date points to the importance of careful evaluation of the current reforms, and its potential to modify policies as the rollout proceeds. Finally, it argues that the research on the pre-2003 system suggests that while the recently announced further reforms are a step in the right direction, the hoped-for improvements in China's health system will far more likely occur if the reforms become less timid in certain key areas, namely provider payments and intergovernmental fiscal relations.

10.1002/hec.1518.abstractZh: 本文对关于中国“旧”卫生系统的近期实证研究进行了综述，这些研究涵盖了2003年开始的一系列改革之前的情况。研究表明，这些研究在一定程度上加深了我们对2003年之前卫生系统的理解，有些结论得到了强化（例如，与扭曲性激励相关的需求诱导现象），而另一些结论则表明情况更为复杂（例如，保险与自付费用之间的关联）。研究还指出，目前的研究强调了仔细评估当前改革的重要性，以及随着改革推进，这些改革有可能对政策产生进一步的影响。最后，研究认为，尽管最近宣布的进一步改革是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，但如果改革在某些关键领域——如医疗服务提供者的支付机制以及政府间的财政关系——能够更加大胆，那么中国卫生系统的预期改进将会更加显著。

abstract.text: To solve the problem of 'Kan bing nan, kan bing gui' (medical treatment is difficult to access and expensive), a Harvard-led research team implemented a community-based health insurance scheme known as Rural Mutual Health Care (RMHC) in Chinese rural areas from 2004 to 2006. Two major policies adopted by RMHC included insurance coverage of outpatient services (demand-side policy) and drug policy (supply-side policy). This paper focuses on the effects of these two policies on outpatient service utilization in Chinese village clinics. The data used in this study are from 3-year household follow-up surveys. A generalized negative binomial regression model and a Heckman selection model were constructed using panel data from 2005 to 2007. The results indicate that the price elasticities of demand for outpatient visits and per-visit outpatient expenses were -1.5 and -0.553, respectively. After implementing the supply-side policy, outpatient visits and per-visit outpatient expenses decreased by 94.7 and 55.9%, respectively, controlling for insurance coverage. These findings can be used to make recommendations to the Chinese government on improving the health care system.

10.1002/hec.1519.abstractZh: 为了解决“医疗难以获得且费用高昂”的问题，由哈佛大学领导的研究团队于2004至2006年间在中国农村地区实施了名为“农村互助医疗保健”的社区型医疗保险计划。该计划采取的两项主要政策包括门诊服务的保险覆盖（需求侧政策）和药品政策（供应侧政策）。本文重点研究这两项政策对中国农村诊所门诊服务利用的影响。研究数据来自为期三年的家庭随访调查。利用2005至2007年的面板数据，构建了广义负二项回归模型和Heckman选择模型。研究结果表明，门诊就诊需求的价格弹性分别为-1.5和-0.553，每次门诊费用的价格弹性分别为-0.553。在实施供应侧政策后，门诊就诊次数和每次门诊费用分别减少了94.7%和55.9%，同时保险覆盖因素也被纳入了分析。这些研究结果可以为中国政府改善医疗体系提供参考建议。

abstract.text: Payment methods can affect providers' behaviour and in turn influence the outcome of medical services. The per-diem reimbursement method is predicted to increase length of stay (LOS) and reduce daily expenditure. Using a Difference in Differences design, this study empirically examines the impact of changing from fee-for-service to per-diem reimbursement in a large psychiatric hospital in Beijing. Results show that the LOS did not increase but daily expenditure in fact increased. We provide several potential explanations for these puzzling findings, including the internal contracts between the hospitals and their physician staff among public hospitals in China.

10.1002/hec.1522.abstractZh: 支付方式会影响医疗服务提供者的行为，进而影响医疗服务的结果。按日报销方式预计会增加住院时间，并减少每日支出。本研究采用差异比较设计，实证分析了在北京一家大型精神病医院从按服务收费改为按日报销后产生的影响。结果显示，住院时间并未增加，而每日支出实际上增加了。我们对这些令人困惑的发现提供了几种可能的解释，包括中国公立医院内部医院与医生员工之间的合同关系。

abstract.text: This article is focused on children providing and financing long-term care for their elderly parent. The aim of this work is to highlight the interactions that may take place among siblings when deciding whether or not to become a caregiver. We look at families with two children using data from the Survey of Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe; our sample contains 314 dependent elderly and their 628 adult children. In order to identify the interactions between siblings, we have specified a two-person discrete game model. To estimate this model, without invoking the 'coherency' condition, we have added an endogenous selection rule to solve the incompleteness problem arising from multiplicity or absence of equilibrium. Our empirical results suggest that the three classical effects identified by Manski could potentially explain the observed correlation between the siblings' caregiving behaviour. Correlated effects alone appear to be weak. Contextual interactions and endogenous interactions reveal cross-effects. The asymmetric character of the endogenous interactions is our most striking result. The younger child's involvement appears to increase the net benefit of caregiving for the elder one, whereas the elder child's involvement decreases the net benefit of caregiving for the younger child.

10.1002/hec.1533.abstractZh: 本文聚焦于子女为年迈的父母提供和长期照顾的财务支持问题。本研究旨在探讨兄弟姐妹在决定是否成为照顾者时可能产生的互动关系。我们选取了拥有两个孩子的家庭作为样本，数据来源于《欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查》；样本中包含314名需要照顾的老年人及其628名成年子女。为了分析兄弟姐妹之间的互动关系，我们构建了一个两人离散博弈模型。在估计该模型时，我们没有采用“一致性”条件，而是引入了一个内生选择规则，以解决因多重均衡或均衡缺失引起的不完整性问题。实证结果表明，Manski提出的三种经典效应可能解释了兄弟姐妹在照顾行为上的相关性。单独来看，这些相关性似乎并不显著。情境互动和内生互动揭示了跨代效应。最引人注目的是，内生互动具有非对称性特征：年轻孩子的参与似乎会增加年长子女获得照顾的净收益，而年长孩子的参与则会降低年轻子女获得照顾的净收益。

abstract.text: This paper proposes an empirical implementation of the concept of inequality of opportunity in health and applies this to data from the UK National Child Development Study. Drawing on the distinction between circumstance and effort variables in John Roemer's work on equality of opportunity, circumstances are proxied by parental socio-economic status and childhood health; effort is proxied by health-related lifestyles and educational attainment. Stochastic dominance tests are used to detect inequality of opportunity in the conditional distributions of self-assessed health in adulthood. Two alternative approaches are used to measure inequality of opportunity. Econometric models are estimated to illuminate and quantify the triangular relationship between circumstances, effort and health. The results indicate the existence of a considerable and persistent inequality of opportunity in health. Circumstances affect health in adulthood both directly and through effort factors such as educational attainment. This indicates that, while the influence of some unjust circumstances can only be tackled during childhood, the implementation of complementary educational policies may be of paramount importance.

10.1002/hec.1535.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种实证方法，用于研究健康领域中的机会不平等现象，并将该方法应用于英国国家儿童发展研究的数据。借鉴John Roemer关于机会平等的研究中“情境”与“努力”变量的区分，将情境通过父母的社会经济地位和儿童时期的健康状况来近似表示；将努力通过健康相关生活方式和教育成就来近似表示。通过随机优势检验来检测成年后自我评估健康状况的条件分布中的机会不平等现象。文中采用了两种替代方法来衡量机会不平等。通过经济计量模型来揭示和量化情境、努力与教育成就之间的三角关系。研究结果表明，健康领域存在相当严重且持续存在的机会不平等现象。情境直接影响成年后的健康状况，同时努力因素如教育成就也会对健康状况产生影响。这表明，虽然某些不公正情境的影响只能在儿童时期得到解决，但实施补充性的教育政策可能具有至关重要的意义。

abstract.text: An incentive program for general practitioners to encourage systematic and igh-quality care in chronic disease management was introduced in Australia in 1999. There is little empirical evidence and ambiguous theoretical guidance on which effects to expect. This paper evaluates the impact of the incentive program on quality of care in diabetes, as measured by the probability of ordering an HbA1c test. The empirical analysis is conducted with a unique data set and a bivariate probit model to control for the self-selection process of practices into the program. The study finds that the incentive program increased the probability of an HbA1c test being ordered by 20 percentage points and that participation in the program is facilitated by the support of Divisions of General Practice.

10.1002/hec.1536.abstractZh: 1999年，澳大利亚引入了一项激励计划，旨在鼓励全科医生在慢性病管理方面提供系统且高质量的护理服务。关于该计划预期效果，目前缺乏实证数据，理论指导也较为模糊。本文评估了该激励计划对糖尿病护理质量的影响，具体通过测量患者订购HbA1c测试的概率来衡量。研究采用独特的数据集和双变量Probit模型进行分析，以控制诊所参与该计划的自我选择过程。研究发现，该激励计划使患者订购HbA1c测试的概率增加了20个百分点，且全科医学部门的支持有助于促进诊所参与该计划。

abstract.text: This study estimates the effect of job loss on health for near elderly employees based on longitudinal data from the Health and Retirement Study. Previous studies find a strong negative correlation between unemployment and health. To control for possible reverse causality, this study focuses on people who were laid off for an exogenous reason - the closure of their previous employers' business. I find no causal effect of exogenous job loss on various measures of physical and mental health. This suggests that the inferior health of the unemployed compared to the employed could be explained by reverse causality.

10.1002/hec.1537.abstractZh: 本研究基于《健康与退休研究》的纵向数据，估计了失业对接近退休年龄员工健康的影响。先前的研究发现，失业与健康状况之间存在强烈的负相关关系。为了控制可能的反向因果关系，本研究重点关注那些因外部原因被解雇的员工——即他们之前工作的企业倒闭了。研究发现，外部失业并未对各项身体和心理健康指标产生因果影响。这表明，失业者相对于就业者较差的健康状况，可能是由反向因果关系所解释的。
