abstract.text: In recent years attention has been drawn to several shortcomings of the Concentration Index, a frequently used indicator of the socioeconomic inequality of health. Some modifications have been suggested, but these are only partial remedies. This paper proposes a corrected version of the Concentration Index which is superior to the original Concentration Index and its variants, in the sense that it is a rank-dependent indicator which satisfies four key requirements (transfer, level independence, cardinal invariance, and mirror). The paper also shows how the corrected Concentration Index can be decomposed and generalized.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.02.003.abstractZh: 近年来，人们开始关注“集中指数”这一常用于衡量健康领域社会经济不平等的指标存在的几个缺陷。虽然已经提出了一些改进措施，但这些措施只是部分性的解决方案。本文提出了一种修正后的集中指数，该指数优于原始的集中指数及其变体，因为它是一个基于排名的指标，并满足四个关键要求：传递性、水平独立性、基数不变性和镜像性。本文还展示了如何分解和推广修正后的集中指数。

abstract.text: What is the right balance among policy interventions in order to ensure economic growth over the long run when an epidemic causes heavy mortality among young adults? We argue that, in general, policies to combat the disease and promote education must be concentrated, in certain ways, at first on some subgroups of society. This concentration involves what we term the macroeconomics of targeting. The central comparison is then between programs under which supported families enjoy the benefits of spending on health and education simultaneously (DT), and those under which the benefits in these two domains are sequenced (ST). When levels of human capital are uniformly low at the outbreak, DT is superior to ST if the mortality rate exceeds some threshold value. Outside aid makes DT more attractive; but DT restricts support to fewer families initially and so increases inequality. A summary account of the empirical evidence is followed by an application of the framework to South Africa.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.011.abstractZh: 在疫情导致年轻人大量死亡的情况下，为了确保长期经济增长，政策干预之间应如何平衡？我们认为，一般来说，抗击疾病和促进教育的政策应首先集中在社会的某些子群体上。这种集中涉及我们所说的“目标选择宏观经济学”。核心比较在于，在支持家庭同时享受健康和教育支出的计划（DT）与这两个领域收益依次进行的计划（ST）之间。当疫情爆发时人力资本水平普遍较低时，如果死亡率超过某个阈值，DT优于ST。外部援助使DT更具吸引力；但DT最初将支持范围限制在较少的家庭中，从而加剧不平等。对实证证据的总结之后，本文将这一框架应用于南非的情况。

abstract.text: Inequalities in health and health care are caused by different factors. Measuring "unfair" inequalities implies that a distinction is introduced between causal variables leading to ethically legitimate inequalities and causal variables leading to ethically illegitimate inequalities. An example of the former could be life-style choices, an example of the latter is social background. We show how to derive measures of unfair inequalities in health and in health care delivery from a structural model of health care and health production: "direct unfairness", linked to the variations in medical expenditures and health in the hypothetical distribution in which all legitimate sources of variation are kept constant; "fairness gap", linked to the differences between the actual distribution and the hypothetical distribution in which all illegitimate sources of variation have been removed. These two approaches are related to the theory of fair allocation. In general they lead to different results. We propose to analyse the resulting distributions with the traditional apparatus of Lorenz curves and inequality measures. We compare our proposal to the more common approach using concentration curves and analyse the relationship with the methods of direct and indirect standardization. We discuss how inequalities in health care can be integrated in an overall evaluation of social inequality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.07.016.abstractZh: 健康与医疗保健方面的不平等是由多种因素造成的。衡量“不公平”的不平等意味着需要区分那些导致伦理上合法不平等的因果变量，以及那些导致伦理上非法不平等的因果变量。前者的例子可以是生活方式选择，而后者的例子则是社会背景。我们展示了如何从医疗保健和健康生产的结构模型出发，来推导健康与医疗保健服务中不公平不平等的度量标准：“直接不公平性”，与医疗支出和健康状况的变动有关，在这种假设的分布中，所有合法的变动来源都保持不变；“公平差距”，与实际分布与假设分布之间的差异有关，在假设分布中，所有非法的变动来源都被消除了。这两种方法与公平分配理论相关。总体而言，它们得出的结果有所不同。我们建议使用传统的洛伦兹曲线和不平等度量方法来分析这些结果。我们将我们的提议与更常见的方法进行比较，后者使用集中曲线，并分析其与直接和间接标准化方法的关系。我们还讨论了如何将医疗保健方面的不平等纳入社会不平等的整体评估中。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of several chronic diseases on the probability of labour force participation using data from the Australian National Health Surveys. An endogenous multivariate probit model is used to account for the potential endogeneity of the incidence of chronic conditions such as diabetes, cardiovascular diseases and mental illnesses. The cross-equation correlations are significant, rejecting the exogeneity of the chronic illnesses. Marginal effects of exogenous socio-demographic and lifestyle variables are estimated through their direct effects on labour market participation and indirect effects via the chronic diseases. The treatment effects of chronic diseases on labour force participation are estimated via conditional probabilities using five-dimensional normal distributions. The estimated effects differ by gender and age groups. Although computationally more demanding, these treatment effects are compared with results from a univariate model treating the chronic conditions exogenous and the structural effects from the multivariate probit model; both significantly overestimate the effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.08.001.abstractZh: 我们利用澳大利亚国家健康调查的数据，研究了几种慢性疾病对劳动力参与概率的影响。采用内生多变量Probit模型来解释诸如糖尿病、心血管疾病和精神疾病等慢性疾病发生的可能性是否存在内生性。交叉方程相关性显著，表明慢性疾病并非外生性的。通过直接影响劳动力参与以及通过慢性疾病间接影响的方式，估计了外生社会人口统计和生活方式变量的边际效应。通过条件概率和五维正态分布来估计慢性疾病对劳动力参与的影响。估计出的效应因性别和年龄组而异。尽管计算上更为复杂，但这些处理效应与单变量模型的结果进行了比较，后者将慢性疾病视为外生因素，并考虑多变量Probit模型中的结构效应；两者都显著高估了效应。

abstract.text: Objective We evaluated the impact of Seguro Popular (SP), a program introduced in 2001 in Mexico primarily to finance health care for the poor. We focused on the effect of household enrollment in SP on pregnant women's access to obstetrical services, an important outcome measure of both maternal and infant health. Data We relied upon data from the cross-sectional 2006 National Health and Nutrition Survey (ENSANUT) in Mexico. We analyzed the responses of 3890 women who delivered babies during 2001-2006 and whose households lacked employer-based health care coverage. Methods We formulated a multinomial probit model that distinguished between three mutually exclusive sites for delivering a baby: a health unit specifically accredited by SP; a non-SP-accredited clinic run by the Department of Health (Secretaría de Salud, or SSA); and private obstetrical care. Our model accounted for the endogeneity of the household's binary decision to enroll in the SP program. Results Women in households that participated in the SP program had a much stronger preference for having a baby in a SP-sponsored unit rather than paying out of pocket for a private delivery. At the same time, participation in SP was associated with a stronger preference for delivering in the private sector rather than at a state-run SSA clinic. On balance, the Seguro Popular program reduced pregnant women's attendance at an SSA clinic much more than it reduced the probability of delivering a baby in the private sector. The quantitative impact of the SP program varied with the woman's education and health, as well as the assets and location (rural vs. urban) of the household. Conclusions The SP program had a robust, significantly positive impact on access to obstetrical services. Our finding that women enrolled in SP switched from non-SP state-run facilities, rather than from out-of-pocket private services, is important for public policy and requires further exploration.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.08.002.abstractZh:
研究目的  我们评估了2001年在墨西哥推出的Seguro Popular（SP）计划对贫困人群医疗保健的影响。我们重点关注家庭参与SP计划对孕妇获得产科服务的影响，这是衡量母婴健康的重要指标。  

数据来源  我们依据2006年墨西哥全国健康与营养调查（ENSANUT）的数据进行分析。研究纳入了2001至2006年间分娩的3890名女性，她们的家中缺乏雇主提供的医疗保险。  

研究方法  我们构建了一个多项概率模型，区分了三种不同的分娩地点：由SP专门认证的医疗单位；由卫生部运营的非SP认证诊所；以及私人产科护理机构。我们的模型考虑了家庭是否参与SP计划这一二元决策的内生性。  

研究结果  参与SP计划的家庭中的女性更倾向于在SP认证的医疗单位分娩，而不是自费选择私人产科护理。同时，参与SP计划也意味着她们更倾向于在私人机构分娩，而非在卫生部运营的诊所。总体而言，Seguro Popular计划减少了孕妇前往卫生部诊所分娩的比例，但减少私人机构分娩的概率则更为显著。SP计划的实际效果因女性的教育水平、健康状况、家庭资产以及地理位置（农村 vs. 城市）而异。  

结论  Seguro Popular计划对孕产妇获得产科服务的机会产生了显著的正面影响。我们的研究发现，参加SP项目的女性是从非SP州立机构转向该项目的，而不是从自费私人服务中转向的。这一发现对公共政策具有重要意义，需要进一步研究。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of parental education on child health outcomes. To identify the causal effect we explore exogenous variation in parental education induced by a schooling reform in 1947, which raised the minimum school leaving age in the UK. Findings based on data from the National Child Development Study suggest that increasing the school leaving age by 1 year had little effect on the health of their offspring. Schooling did however improve economic opportunities by reducing financial difficulties among households.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.08.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了父母教育水平对儿童健康结果的影响。为了确定这种因果效应，我们研究了1947年教育改革导致的父母教育水平的外部变化，该改革提高了英国的最低离校年龄。根据《国家儿童发展研究》的数据分析，将离校年龄增加1年对后代的健康几乎没有影响。然而，教育确实通过减少家庭的经济困难，改善了经济机会。

abstract.text: In this paper we use individual level data from the Australian National Drug Strategy Household Survey to study the relationship between initiation into cannabis use and educational attainment. Using bivariate duration analysis we find that those initiating into cannabis use are much more likely to dropout of school, and that the reduction in years of education depends on the age at which initiation into cannabis occurs. We also find that the impact of cannabis uptake is larger for females than males.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.09.001.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们利用了澳大利亚国家药物战略家庭调查中的个体数据，研究了开始使用大麻与教育程度之间的关系。通过双变量持续时间分析发现，开始使用大麻的人更有可能辍学，而教育年限的减少程度则取决于开始使用大麻的年龄。我们还发现，大麻使用对女性的影响比男性更大。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the impact of informal care by adult children on the use of long-term care among the elderly in Europe and the effect of the level of the parent's disability on this relationship. We focus on two types of formal home care that are the most likely to interact with informal care: paid domestic help and nursing care. Using recent European data emerging from the Survey on Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe (SHARE), we build a two-part utilization model analyzing both the decision to use each type of formal care or not and the amount of formal care received by the elderly. Instrumental variables estimations are used to control for the potential endogeneity existing between formal and informal care. We find endogeneity of informal care in the decision to receive paid domestic help. Estimation results indicate that informal care substitutes for this type of formal home care. However, we find that this substitution effect tends to disappear as the level of disability of the elderly person increases. Finally, informal care is a weak complement to nursing care, independently of the level of disability. These results highlight the heterogeneous effects of informal care on formal care use and suggest that informal care is an effective substitute for long-term care as long as the needs of the elderly are low and require unskilled type of care. Any policy encouraging informal care to decrease long-term care expenditures should take it into account to assess its effectiveness.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.09.002.abstractZh: 本文分析了成年子女提供的非正式照顾对欧洲老年人长期照顾需求的影响，以及父母残疾程度对这一关系的影响。我们重点关注两种最可能与非正式照顾发生互动的正式家庭照顾形式：有偿家务帮助和护理服务。利用来自“欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查”的最新欧洲数据，我们构建了一个两部分的使用模型，分别分析老年人是否选择使用每种正式照顾形式以及他们实际获得的正式照顾量。通过工具变量估计，我们控制了正式照顾与非正式照顾之间的潜在内生性。研究发现，非正式照顾在决定接受有偿家务帮助时起到了替代作用。但我们发现，随着老年人残疾程度的增加，这种替代效应趋于消失。最后，无论残疾程度如何，非正式照顾对护理服务的补充作用都很有限。这些结果凸显了非正式照顾对正式照顾使用的不同影响，并表明只要老年人的需求较低且需要非技术性照顾，非正式照顾就可以有效替代长期照顾服务。任何旨在减少长期照顾支出的政策都应考虑非正式照顾的影响，以评估其有效性。

abstract.text: Recent studies have claimed to show a significant causal impact of education on health status. Their empirical strategy usually relied on changes in compulsory schooling laws. Using a French longitudinal dataset, we focus on the effect of school leaving age on mortality at later ages. The two identifying shocks are the Zay and Berthoin reforms, which respectively raised the minimum school leaving age to 14 and 16 years. We implement a non-parametric regression discontinuity design, comparing cohorts born immediately before or after the reforms, and a parametric two-stage approach using information from a larger part of our sample. None of these approaches reveals a significant causality of education on health. Despite the fact that these reforms increased education levels, and that subsequent declines in mortality are observed, none of these declines appears to be significant. We conclude with a discussion on possible limitations of these two reforms as identifying devices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.09.003.abstractZh: 近期的研究声称，教育对健康状况有显著的因果影响。这些研究的实证策略通常依赖于义务教育法律的变化。我们利用一个法国纵向数据集，重点关注离校年龄对后期死亡率的影响。两个重要的改革措施是Zay改革和Berthoin改革，它们分别将最低离校年龄提高到14岁和16岁。我们采用了非参数回归断点设计，比较了在改革前后出生的群体，并采用了参数化两阶段方法，利用更大样本量的数据进行分析。然而，这些方法都没有发现教育对健康的显著因果效应。尽管这些改革提高了教育水平，并且随后死亡率有所下降，但这些下降幅度并不显著。最后，我们讨论了这两项改革作为识别工具可能存在的局限性。

abstract.text: Repetitive values of the ranking indicators of economic welfare are often introduced due to incidental ties or censoring in the welfare variable, or the categorical nature of welfare variables used in numerous national surveys. In calculating concentration index (CI), assigning different fractional ranks to observations that have same values of the welfare measure leads to unstable and inconsistent CI estimates when the welfare variable is categorical or censored. In this paper, we establish an interval within which the CI estimates lie, and propose a solution, which is an extension of (Kakwani, N.C., Wagstaff, A., van Doorslaer, E., 1997. Socioeconomic inequalities in health: measurement, computation, and statistical inference. Journal of Econometrics 77, 87-103), for consistent and replicable estimates of CI when there are a substantial number of ties of the welfare indicator.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.09.004.abstractZh: 由于福利变量中的偶然关联或数据缺失，或者许多国家调查中福利变量的分类性质，经济福利排名指标的重复值常常被引入。在计算集中指数时，如果为具有相同福利值的数据点分配不同的分数等级，会导致当福利变量为分类或存在数据缺失时，集中指数的估计结果不稳定且不一致。本文提出了一种区间，用于确定集中指数的估计范围，并提出了一种解决方案，该方案是对Kakwani等人（1997年，《社会经济健康不平等：测量、计算与统计推断》，经济计量学杂志，第77卷，第87-103页）工作的扩展，旨在在福利指标存在大量关联数据时，获得一致且可复制的集中指数估计。

abstract.text: This paper replicates Gruber et al.'s [Gruber, J., Kim, J., Mayzlin, D., 1999. Physician fees and procedure intensity: the case of cesarean delivery. Journal of Health Economics, 18 (4), 473-490] analysis of the effect of physician financial incentives on cesarean delivery rates, using their data, sample selection criteria, and specification. Coincident trends explain much of their estimated positive relation between fees and cesarean utilization, which also falls somewhat upon the inclusion of several childbirth observations that had been inadvertently excluded from their estimation sample. The data ultimately indicate that a $1000 increase, in current dollars, in the reimbursement for a cesarean section increases cesarean delivery rates by about one percentage point, one-quarter of the effect estimated originally.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.09.005.abstractZh: 本文复制了Gruber等人[Gruber, J., Kim, J., Mayzlin, D., 1999. 医生收费与手术强度：以剖宫产为例. 健康经济学杂志, 18 (4), 473-490]对医生财务激励对剖宫产率影响的分析，采用了他们的数据、样本选择标准和模型设定。同期趋势解释了他们估计的收费与剖宫产使用之间的正相关关系，这一关系在一定程度上也归因于他们估计样本中无意遗漏的一些分娩观察数据。数据最终表明，以当前货币价值计算，剖宫产手术的费用增加1000美元，会使剖宫产率增加约一个百分点，这比最初估计的效果要低四分之一。

abstract.text: Within a horizontal differentiation model and allowing for heterogeneous qualities, we analyze the effects of reference pricing reimbursement on firms' pricing strategies. With this analysis we find inherent incentives for firms' pricing behavior, and consequently we shed some light on the time consistency of such policy. The analysis encompasses different reference price rules: (i) reference price as the minimum of the observed prices in the market, (ii) reference price as a linear combination of firms' prices. Results show that under the "minimum policy" firms are not able to coordinate on higher prices while the "linear policy", implicitly, provides a coordination device. We have also found that, relatively to the "linear policy", when the reference price is the minimum of observed prices, after policy implementation, total and private expenditures are higher and consumer surplus and firms' profits are lower. With quality differentiation both the minimum and linear policies unambiguously lead to higher prices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.09.006.abstractZh: 在水平差异化模型框架下，考虑到产品质量的异质性，我们分析了参考定价机制对企业定价策略的影响。通过这一分析，我们发现企业定价行为存在内在动机，从而揭示了此类政策的时间一致性问题。研究涵盖了两种不同的参考定价规则：(i) 参考价格作为市场上观察到的价格最低值；(ii) 参考价格作为企业价格之间的线性组合。研究结果表明，在“最低价格政策”下，企业无法协调一致地设定更高的价格，而“线性价格政策”则隐含了一种协调机制。我们还发现，与“线性价格政策”相比，当参考价格设定为观察到的价格最低值时，政策实施后总支出和私人支出都会增加，而消费者剩余和企业利润则会降低。在质量差异显著的情况下，无论是最低价格政策还是线性价格政策，都会导致价格上升。

abstract.text: In health insurance, a traditional deductible (i.e. with a deductible range [0,d]) is in theory not effective in reducing moral hazard for individuals who know (ex-ante) that their expenditures will exceed the deductible amount d, e.g. those with a chronic disease. To increase the effectiveness, this paper proposes to shift the deductible range to [s(i),s(i)+d], with starting point s(i) depending on relevant risk characteristics of individual i. In an empirical illustration we assume the optimal shift to be such that the variance in out-of-pocket expenditures is maximized. Results indicate that for the 10-percent highest risks in our data the optimal starting point of a euro1000-deductible is to be found (far) beyond euro1200, which corresponds with a deductible range of [1200,2200] or further. We conclude that, compared to traditional deductibles, shifted deductibles with a risk-adjusted starting point lower out-of-pocket expenditures and may further reduce moral hazard.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.09.007.abstractZh: 在健康保险中，传统的免赔额制度（即免赔额范围为[0,d]）在理论上无法有效降低那些已知支出将超过免赔额d的个人的道德风险，例如患有慢性疾病的人。为了提高这一制度的有效性，本文提出将免赔额范围调整为[s(i),s(i)+d]，其中起始点s(i)取决于个体i的相关风险特征。在实证分析中，我们假设最优调整方案应使自付支出的方差最大化。结果表明，在我们数据中的10%最高风险群体中，最优的1000欧元免赔额起始点应位于1200欧元之外，对应的免赔额范围为1200至2200欧元或更高。与传统的免赔额制度相比，这种基于风险调整起始点的免赔额制度能够降低自付支出，并可能进一步减少道德风险。

abstract.text: Measurement of inequity in health care delivery has focused on the extent to which health care utilisation is or is not distributed according to need, irrespective of income. Studies using cross-sectional data have proposed various ways of measuring and standardizing for need, but inevitably much of the inter-individual variation in needs remains unobserved in cross-sections. This paper exploits panel data methods to improve the measurement by including the time-invariant part of unobserved heterogeneity into the need-standardization procedure. Using latent class hurdle models for GP and specialist visits estimated on 8 annual waves of the European Community Household Panel we compute indices of horizontal equity that partition total income-related variation in use into a need- and a non-need related part, not only for the observed but also for the unobserved but time-invariant component. We also propose and compare a more conservative index of horizontal inequity to the conventional statistic. We find that many of the cross-country comparative results appear fairly robust to the panel data test, although the panel-based methods lead to significantly higher estimates of horizontal inequity for most countries. This confirms that better estimation and control for need often reveals more pro-rich distributions of doctor utilisation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.09.008.abstractZh: 在医疗服务的公平性评估中，人们通常关注医疗服务利用是否根据需求进行分配，而不考虑收入因素。使用横截面数据的研究提出了多种衡量和标准化需求的方法，但不可避免地，个体间需求的差异在横截面数据中仍然无法被观察到。本文利用面板数据方法，通过将未观察到的异质性纳入需求标准化过程中，从而改进了公平性评估。我们基于欧洲社区家庭面板调查中的8个年度数据，使用潜在类别障碍模型对全科医生和专科医生的就诊情况进行了分析，并计算出水平公平性的指数，将总收入相关的利用差异分为需求相关和非需求相关两部分，不仅适用于已观察到的数据，也适用于未观察到的但具有时间不变性的成分。我们还提出并比较了一个更为保守的水平公平性指数与传统的统计指标。研究发现，尽管基于面板数据的方法会导致大多数国家水平公平性的估计值显著升高，但许多跨国比较结果仍然相当稳健。这证实了，更好的需求估计和控制往往会导致医生利用的分配更加偏向富人。

abstract.text: This study evaluates the effectiveness of a pro-poor nation-wide health card program, which provides free basic health care at public health facilities in Indonesia. To quantify the effect of the program, it departs from the traditional regression-based approach in the literature. It employs propensity score matching to reduce the selection bias due to non-random health card distribution. The setting of the program and the richness of the data set support this strategy in providing accurate estimates of the program's effect on its recipients. The results indicate that, in general, the health card program only has limited impact on the consumption of primary health care by its recipients. This finding suggests the presence of other factors counteracting the generous demand incentive.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.001.abstractZh: 本研究评估了一项针对贫困群体的全国性健康卡计划的有效性，该计划为印度尼西亚的公共卫生设施提供免费的基本医疗服务。为了量化该计划的效果，本研究采用了文献中传统的回归分析方法，并采用倾向得分匹配技术来减少因健康卡分配非随机性导致的选择偏差。该计划的实施背景以及数据的丰富性支持了这一策略，有助于准确估计该计划对受助者的影响。研究结果表明，总体而言，健康卡计划对受助者对初级医疗服务的消费影响有限。这一发现表明，还存在其他因素在抵消这种激励效应。

abstract.text: This paper seeks to determine the macro-economic impacts of changes in health care provision. The resource allocation issues have been explored in theory, by applying the Rybczynski theorem, and empirically, using a computable general equilibrium (CGE) model for the UK with a detailed health component. From the theory, changes in non-health outputs are shown to depend on factor-bias and scale effects, the net effects generally being indeterminate. From the applied model, a rise in the National Health Service (NHS) budget is shown to yield overall welfare gains, which fall by two-thirds assuming health care-specific factors. A nominally equivalent migration policy yields even higher welfare gains.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.002.abstractZh: 本文旨在探讨医疗供给变化对宏观经济的影响。在理论上，通过应用Rybczynski定理来探讨资源分配问题；在实证方面，则使用了一个包含详细医疗内容的英国通用均衡模型进行研究。从理论角度来看，非医疗产出的变化取决于要素偏差和规模效应，其净效应通常是不确定的。从应用模型来看，国家医疗服务体系（NHS）预算的增加能够带来整体福利的提升，但如果考虑到医疗特有的因素，这种提升会下降三分之二。而一种名义上等效的移民政策则能带来更高的福利收益。

abstract.text: The literature on income distribution has attempted to evaluate different degrees of inequality using a social welfare function (SWF) approach. However, it has largely ignored the source of such inequalities, and has thus failed to consider different degrees of inequity. The literature on egalitarianism has addressed issues of equity, largely in relation to individual responsibility. This paper builds upon these two literatures, and introduces individual responsibility into the SWF. Results from a small-scale study of people's preferences in relation to the distribution of health benefits are presented to illustrate how the parameter values of a SWF might be determined.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.003.abstractZh: 关于收入分配的文献试图使用社会福利函数的方法来评估不同程度的不平等。然而，这些研究大多忽略了不平等的来源，因此未能考虑不同程度的不公平现象。关于平等主义的文献则主要探讨了与个人责任相关的公平问题。本文在这两个文献的基础上进行拓展，将个人责任引入到社会福利函数中。通过一项针对人们对健康福利分配偏好偏好进行的小规模研究，本文展示了如何确定社会福利函数的参数值。

abstract.text: This paper describes and employs a new method to correct time tradeoff (TTO)-scores for utility of life duration curvature. In contrast to most previous attempts to do so, it uses a risk-free method that corresponds well to the risk-free properties of the TTO-method. In addition, the method is robust to several biases that occur under methods that incorporate risk. Our results show a significant degree of curvature in utility of life duration and therefore a clear bias in TTO-scores. The risk-free method seems to be useful to correct TTO-scores for this influence and leads to significantly higher quality-adjustment factors.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.004.abstractZh: 本文描述了一种新方法，用于修正因生命持续时间的曲率而导致的效用时间权衡（TTO）评分。与以往大多数尝试不同，该方法采用了一种无风险的方法，该方法与TTO方法的无风险特性相契合。此外，该方法能够抵御在包含风险的方法中可能出现的多种偏差。我们的研究结果显示，生命持续时间的效用存在显著的曲率，因此TTO评分存在明显的偏差。采用无风险方法可以校正这种影响，并显著提高质量调整因子。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine the effect of maternal education on the health of young children by using a large sample of adopted children from China. As adopted children are genetically unrelated to the nurturing parents, the educational effect on them is most likely to be the nurturing effect. We find that the mother's education is an important determinant of the health of adopted children even after we control for income, the number of siblings, health environments, and other socioeconomic variables. Moreover, the effect of the mother's education on the adoptee sample is similar to that on the own birth sample, which suggests that the main effect of the mother's education on child health is in post-natal nurturing. We also find suggestive evidence that the effect is causal. Our work provides new evidence to the general literature that examines the determinants of health and that examines the intergenerational immobility of socioeconomic status.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.005.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们采用中国大量被收养儿童的数据，研究母亲教育水平对幼儿健康的影响。由于被收养儿童与抚养他们的父母在基因上没有关联，因此教育对他们的影响更可能属于抚养效应。我们发现，即使控制了收入、兄弟姐妹数量、健康环境以及其他社会经济变量后，母亲的教育水平仍然是被收养儿童健康的重要决定因素。此外，母亲教育对被收养儿童的影响与对亲生儿童的影响相似，这表明母亲教育对儿童健康的主要影响体现在产后抚养上。我们还发现了一些表明这种影响具有因果关系的证据。我们的研究为那些研究健康决定因素以及社会经济地位代际不变性的相关文献提供了新的证据。

abstract.text: The enactment of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) in 1990 triggered a substantial academic debate about its consequences on employment rates of disabled people. In contrast, the employment provision of the 1996 Disability Discrimination Act (DDA) in Britain has received little attention. Exploiting both pooled and longitudinal data, this paper provides robust evidence that, similar to the ADA in the USA, the DDA has had no impact on the employment rate of disabled people or possibly worsened it. Possible reasons for this are higher uncertainty around litigation costs, low levels of general awareness about the Act among disabled people and employers, and a lack of financial support.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.006.abstractZh: 1990年颁布的《美国残疾人法案》引发了关于该法案对残疾人就业率影响的重大学术讨论。相比之下，1996年英国《残疾人歧视法案》在就业方面的实施却鲜受关注。本文利用汇总数据和纵向数据，提供了有力的证据：与美国的《美国残疾人法案》类似，英国《残疾人歧视法案》并未对残疾人的就业率产生积极影响，甚至可能使其状况恶化。造成这一现象的原因可能包括诉讼成本的不确定性较高、残疾人和雇主对法案的认知程度较低，以及缺乏资金支持。

abstract.text: In 2003, China launched a heavily subsidized voluntary health insurance program for rural residents. We combine differences-in-differences with matching methods to obtain impact estimates, using data collected from program administrators, health facilities and households. The scheme has increased outpatient and inpatient utilization, and has reduced the cost of deliveries. But it has not reduced out-of-pocket expenses per outpatient visit or inpatient spell. Out-of-pocket payments overall have not been reduced. We find heterogeneity across income groups and implementing counties. The program has increased ownership of expensive equipment among central township health centers but has had no impact on cost per case.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.007.abstractZh: 2003年，中国为农村居民推出了一项由政府大量补贴的自愿医疗保险计划。我们采用差异对比与匹配方法，结合从计划管理者、医疗机构和家庭收集的数据，来估算该计划的影响。结果显示，该计划增加了门诊和住院的利用度，并降低了分娩成本。然而，它并未减少每次门诊就诊或住院期间的自付费用。总体而言，自付费用并未减少。我们发现不同收入群体和实施地区的效果存在差异。该计划使中心乡镇卫生中心拥有更多昂贵的医疗设备，但对每例病例的成本影响并不明显。

abstract.text: This paper tests the hypothesis of whether or not financial incentives affect a physician's prescription decision on the choice of generic versus brand-name drugs within a system in which physicians prescribe and dispense drugs. By using data obtained from Taiwan and focusing on diabetic patients, our empirical results provide several consistent findings in support of the hypothesis that profit incentives do affect the physician's prescribing decision, suggesting that physicians act as imperfect agents. An important implication of our findings is that rent seeking for profit margin between the reimbursement and the acquisition price instead of reducing costs is the major driving force behind generic substitution. As a result, the providers instead of the payers or consumers reap the financial benefits of generic substitution.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.009.abstractZh: 本文检验了财务激励是否会影响医生在处方药选择上的决策——即医生在开具和使用药品时更倾向于选择仿制药还是品牌药。通过台湾的数据分析，重点关注糖尿病患者，我们的实证研究结果支持这一假设：利润激励确实会影响医生的处方决策，这表明医生并非完全理性的决策者。我们的研究发现还有一个重要启示：为了获取利润空间，医生更倾向于选择仿制药，而不是通过降低成本来优化医疗成本。因此，获得财务利益的实际上是仿制药的供应商，而非支付方或消费者。

abstract.text: Recent literature on tobacco taxation suggests that optimal tax rates should be very high. But such high taxes raise concerns over regressivity. Most econometric estimates of elasticities by income group use historic price data that are low, and the usefulness of such estimates is therefore questionable on account of the serious 'out of sample' prediction problem. To address that problem, this paper estimates price elasticities for different socioeconomic groups using recent Canadian survey data for a period during which prices rose to a level of about $7 per pack. The results provide little reason to overturn the traditional concerns about regressivity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.010.abstractZh: 近期关于烟草税制的文献表明，最优税率应该非常高。但如此高的税收引发了关于税收递减性的担忧。大多数基于收入群体进行的弹性估计都使用了历史价格数据，而这些数据的可靠性较低，因此这些估计的实用性值得怀疑，因为存在严重的“样本外”预测问题。为了解决这一问题，本文利用加拿大近期调查数据，对不同社会经济群体的价格弹性进行了估计，该时期烟草价格已上升至每包约7美元的水平。研究结果并未提供足够的理由来推翻关于税收递减性的传统担忧。

abstract.text: The post-Communist transition to social health insurance in many of the Central and Eastern European and Central Asian countries provides a unique opportunity to try to answer some of the unresolved issues in the debate over the relative merits of social health insurance and tax-financed health systems. This paper employs regression-based generalizations of the difference-in-differences method on panel data from 28 countries for the period 1990-2004. We find that, controlling for any concurrent provider payment reforms, adoption of social health insurance increased national health spending and hospital activity rates, but did not lead to better health outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.011.abstractZh: 许多中欧、东欧和中亚国家在后共产主义时期转向社会医疗保险制度，这为探讨社会医疗保险与税收资助的医疗保健系统各自的优缺点提供了独特的机会。本文采用基于回归的“差异中的差异”方法，对1990至2004年间28个国家的面板数据进行了分析。研究发现，在控制其他相关支付改革因素的情况下，社会医疗保险的采用确实增加了国家的医疗保健支出和医院活动率，但并未带来更好的健康结果。

abstract.text: Direct and indirect standardization procedures aim at comparing differences in health or in health care expenditures between subgroups of the population after controlling for observable morbidity differences. There is a close analogy between this problem and the issue of risk adjustment in health insurance. Traditional methods of risk adjustment are analogous to indirect standardization. They are equivalent to the so-called conditional egalitarian mechanism in social choice. In general, they do not remove incentives for risk selection, even if the effect of non-morbidity variables is correctly taken into account. A method of risk adjustment based on direct standardization does remove the incentives for risk selection, but at the cost of violating a neutrality condition, stating that insurers should receive the same premium subsidy for all members of the same risk group. Direct standardization is equivalent to the egalitarian-equivalent (or proportional) mechanism in social choice. The conflict between removing incentives for risk selection and neutrality is unavoidable if the health expenditure function is not additively separable in the morbidity and efficiency variables.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.012.abstractZh: 直接和间接标准化程序旨在在控制可观测的发病率差异后，比较人口不同亚群体之间的健康或医疗保健支出差异。这个问题与健康保险中的风险调整问题有密切的相似性。传统的风险调整方法类似于间接标准化，相当于社会选择中的所谓条件平等机制。总体而言，这些方法并不能消除风险选择的动机，即使非发病率变量的影响得到了正确的考虑。基于直接标准化的风险调整方法确实消除了风险选择的动机，但代价是违反了中性条件，即保险公司应为同一风险群体的所有成员提供相同的保费补贴。直接标准化相当于社会选择中的平等等效（或比例）机制。如果健康支出函数在发病率和效率变量上不是可加可分的，那么消除风险选择的动机与中性条件之间的冲突是不可避免的。

abstract.text: The value of a statistical life (VSL) is a very controversial topic, but one which is essential to the optimization of governmental decisions. We see a great variability in the values obtained from different studies. The source of this variability needs to be understood, in order to offer public decision-makers better guidance in choosing a value and to set clearer guidelines for future research on the topic. This article presents a meta-analysis based on 39 observations obtained from 37 studies (from nine different countries) which all use a hedonic wage method to calculate the VSL. Our meta-analysis is innovative in that it is the first to use the mixed effects regression model [Raudenbush, S.W., 1994. Random effects models. In: Cooper, H., Hedges, L.V. (Eds.), The Handbook of Research Synthesis. Russel Sage Foundation, New York] to analyze studies on the value of a statistical life. We conclude that the variability found in the values studied stems in large part from differences in methodologies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.10.013.abstractZh: 统计生命价值是一个极具争议的话题，但却是优化政府决策的关键所在。不同研究得出的统计生命价值存在很大差异，需要理解这种差异的来源，以便为公共决策者提供更好的指导，并为未来相关研究制定更明确的准则。本文基于来自37项研究（涉及9个不同国家）的39个观测数据进行了元分析，所有这些研究都采用了享乐工资法来计算统计生命价值。我们的元分析具有创新性，因为它是首次使用混合效应回归模型来分析统计生命价值的研究。我们得出结论，研究中发现的差异在很大程度上源于研究方法的差异。

abstract.text: Research has shown that managed care (MC) slowed the rate of growth in health care spending in the 1990s, primarily via lower unit prices paid. However, the mechanism of MC's price bargaining has not been well studied. This article uses a unique panel dataset with actual hospital prices in Massachusetts between 1994 and 2000 to examine the sources of MC's bargaining power. I find two significant determinants of price discounts. First, plans with large memberships are able to extract volume discounts across hospitals. Second, health plans that are more successful at channeling patients can extract greater discounts. Patient channeling can add to the volume discount that plans negotiate.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.11.001.abstractZh: 研究表明，在1990年代，管理式护理（MC）通过降低单位价格，减缓了医疗保健支出的增长速度。然而，管理式护理在价格谈判方面的机制尚未得到充分研究。本文利用1994年至2000年间马萨诸塞州的实际医院价格数据，通过独特的面板数据集来探讨管理式护理价格谈判能力的来源。我发现有两个重要的决定因素会影响价格折扣：首先，拥有大量会员的保险计划能够跨医院获取批量折扣；其次，那些更成功地将患者引导至特定医院的保险计划能够获得更大的折扣。将患者引导至特定医院的行为能够增加保险计划谈判的批量折扣。

abstract.text: The ECHP is used to analyse health care utilisation care in Europe. We estimate a new latent class hurdle model for panel data and compare it with the latent class NegBin model and the standard hurdle model. Latent class specifications outperform the standard hurdle model and the latent class hurdle model reveals income effects that are masked in the NegBin model. For specialist visits, low users are more income elastic than high users and the probability of using care is more income elastic than the conditional number of visits. The effects of income on total use of GPs are mostly negative or insignificant but positive elasticities are found for Austria, Greece and, to a greater extent, Portugal. On the whole, richer individuals tend to use more specialist care, especially in Portugal, Ireland, Finland, Greece and Austria. Features of the health care systems of these countries may contribute to the observed inequities.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.11.002.abstractZh: ECHP被用于分析欧洲的医疗保健利用情况。我们为面板数据构建了一个新的潜在类别障碍模型，并将其与潜在类别NegBin模型和标准障碍模型进行了比较。潜在类别模型的表现优于标准障碍模型，且潜在类别障碍模型揭示了NegBin模型中未被体现的收入效应。对于专科就诊，低收入用户比高收入用户更依赖医疗保健，使用医疗服务的可能性与条件访问次数之间的弹性更大。收入对全科医生总使用量的影响大多为负面或 insignificant，但在奥地利、希腊以及葡萄牙则发现了正弹性。总体而言，较富裕的个体更倾向于使用专科医疗服务，尤其是在葡萄牙、爱尔兰、芬兰、希腊和奥地利。这些国家医疗保健系统的特点可能加剧了观察到的不平等现象。

abstract.text: Discrete choice experiments (DCEs) in health economics have recently used the mixed logit (MXL) model to incorporate preference heterogeneity. These studies typically use a classical approach to estimation or have specified normal distributions for the attributes. Specifying normal distributions can lead to erroneous interpretation; non-normal distributions may cause problems with convergence to the global maximum of the simulated log-likelihood function. Hierarchical Bayes (HB) of MXL is an alternative estimation approach that may alleviate problems of convergence. We investigated Bayesian and classical approaches to MXL estimation using a DCE that elicited preferences for a genetic technology. The classical approach produced unrealistic results in one of the econometric specifications, which led to an erroneous willingness to pay estimate. The HB procedure produced reasonable results for both specifications and helped ascertain that the classical procedures were converging at a local maximum.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.11.003.abstractZh: 在健康经济学中的离散选择实验（DCEs）最近采用了混合逻辑斯蒂（MXL）模型来纳入偏好异质性。这些研究通常采用经典估计方法，或者为属性指定正态分布。指定正态分布可能导致错误的解释；非正态分布则可能引发模拟对数似然函数收敛到全局最大值的问题。MXL的层次贝叶斯（HB）是一种替代的估计方法，可能有助于缓解收敛问题。我们使用一个引发对某项基因技术偏好的DCE，研究了MXL估计的贝叶斯方法和经典方法。经典方法在其中一个计量经济学模型中产生了不现实的结果，导致支付意愿的估计出现错误。而HB程序为两种模型都产生了合理的结果，并有助于确认经典方法是在局部最大值处收敛的。

abstract.text: In this paper we assess the relative effectiveness of user charges and administrative waiting times as a tool for rationing public healthcare in Italy. We measure demand elasticities by estimating a simultaneous equation model of GP primary care visits, public specialist consultations and private specialist consultations, as if they were part of an incomplete system of demand. We find that for public specialist consultations, own price elasticity of demand is about -0.3, while elasticity to administrative waiting time is about -.04. No substitution exists between the demand for public and private specialists, so that user charges act as a net deterrent for over-consumption. The public provision of healthcare does not induce the wealthy to opt out. Moreover our evidence suggests that user charges and waiting lists do not serve redistributive purposes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.11.004.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们评估了用户收费和行政等待时间作为意大利公共医疗保健配给工具的相对有效性。我们通过估计一个同时方程模型来衡量需求弹性，该模型涉及GP初级保健就诊、公共专科咨询和私人专科咨询，将其视为一个不完整的需求系统的一部分。我们发现，对于公共专科咨询，自身价格需求弹性约为-0.3，而对行政等待时间的弹性约为-0.04。公共和私人专科服务之间不存在替代关系，因此用户收费起到了抑制过度消费的作用。公共医疗保健的提供并不会促使富人选择不使用医疗服务。此外，我们的证据表明，用户收费和等待名单并不具备再分配功能。

abstract.text: Approximately 10% of people have O-negative blood. Because it can be transfused into almost anyone, hospitals particularly value such blood. We use this fact, together with the assumption that blood types are exogenously assigned by nature, to design an empirical inquiry into altruism. We also investigate the timing of donations, especially focussing on the behaviour of new and established donors. We show that O-negative blood donors donate no more often than other people. Thus individuals apparently do not exhibit pure altruism. We speculate that instead blood donors may be driven by a broad notion of duty rather than by a far-sighted, rational unselfishness.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.11.005.abstractZh: 大约10%的人拥有O型阴性血。由于这种血型几乎可以输给任何人，医院特别重视这类血液。我们利用这一事实，并结合血型是由自然赋予的假设，设计了一项关于利他主义的实证研究。我们还研究了献血的时间安排，特别关注新献血者和已献血者的行为。研究表明，O型阴性血献血者的献血频率并不比其他血型的人更高。因此，个体显然并不表现出纯粹的利他行为。我们推测，献血者可能受到一种广义上的责任感的驱动，而非出于长远的、理性的无私精神。

abstract.text: This paper examines the influence of health conditions on academic performance during adolescence. To account for the endogeneity of health outcomes and their interactions with risky behaviors we exploit natural variation within a set of genetic markers across individuals. We present evidence that specific genetic markers have good statistical properties to identify the impacts of ADHD, depression and obesity. These markers help reveal a new dynamism from poor health to lower academic achievement with substantial heterogeneity in their impacts across genders. Our investigation further exposes the considerable challenges in identifying health impacts due to the prevalence of comorbid health conditions, with clear implications for the health economics literature.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.11.006.abstractZh: 本文探讨了健康状况对青少年学业表现的影响。为了考虑健康结果的内生性以及它们与风险行为的相互作用，我们利用了个体间遗传标记的自然变异。我们发现，某些遗传标记在识别多动症、抑郁症和肥胖症的影响方面具有良好的统计性能。这些标记有助于揭示从健康状况不佳到学业成绩下降之间的动态变化，且不同性别之间的影响存在显著异质性。我们的研究进一步揭示了由于共病健康状况的存在而识别健康影响的巨大挑战，这对健康经济学文献具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Between 1997 and 2005, the number of annual motorcyclist fatalities doubled. Motorcyclist fatalities now account for over 10 percent of all traffic-related fatalities. However, over the last three decades, states have generally been eliminating laws that require helmet use among all motorcyclists. This study examines the effectiveness of helmet use and state laws that mandate helmet use in reducing motorcyclist fatalities. Within-vehicle comparisons among two-rider motorcycles indicate that helmet use reduces fatality risk by 34 percent. State laws requiring helmet use appear to reduce motorcyclist fatalities by 27 percent. Fatality reductions of this magnitude suggest that the health benefits of helmet-use laws are not meaningfully compromised by compensating increases in risk-taking by motorcyclists.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.12.002.abstractZh: 在1997年至2005年间，每年摩托车驾驶员的死亡人数翻了一番。目前，摩托车驾驶员的死亡人数占所有交通相关死亡人数的10%以上。然而，在过去的三十年里，各州普遍取消了要求所有摩托车驾驶员佩戴头盔的法律。本研究探讨了头盔使用以及要求佩戴头盔的州法律在减少摩托车驾驶员死亡人数方面的效果。对双骑摩托车进行的车内比较表明，佩戴头盔可以将死亡风险降低34%。要求佩戴头盔的州法律似乎可以将摩托车驾驶员的死亡人数减少27%。如此显著的死亡人数减少表明，头盔使用法律带来的健康益处并未因摩托车驾驶员冒险行为的增加而受到实质性的损害。

abstract.text: While there are many reasons to continue to smoke in spite of its consequences for health, the concern that many smoke because they misperceive the risks of smoking remains a focus of public discussion and motivates tobacco control policies and litigation. In this paper we investigate the relative accuracy of mature smokers' risk perceptions about future survival, and a range of morbidities and disabilities. Using data from the survey on smoking (SOS) conducted for this research, we compare subjective beliefs elicited from the SOS with corresponding individual-specific objective probabilities estimated from the health and retirement study. Overall, consumers in the age group studied, 50-70, are not overly optimistic in their perceptions of health risk. If anything, smokers tend to be relatively pessimistic about these risks. The finding that smokers are either well informed or pessimistic regarding a broad range of health risks suggests that these beliefs are not pivotal in the decision to continue smoking. Although statements by the tobacco companies may have been misleading and thus encouraged some to start smoking, we find no evidence that systematic misinformation about the health consequences of smoking inhibits quitting.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.12.004.abstractZh: 尽管吸烟对健康有诸多危害，但仍有许多人继续吸烟，这主要是因为他们对吸烟风险的认识存在误解。这一担忧一直是公众讨论的焦点，也是推动烟草控制政策和法律诉讼的动力。本文研究了成熟吸烟者对未来生存机会以及各种疾病和残疾风险认知的相对准确性。通过本研究所使用的吸烟调查数据，我们将调查中获得的主观信念与从健康和退休研究中得出的个体特定客观概率进行了对比。总体而言，研究中的50-70岁年龄段的吸烟者对于健康风险的认知并不过于乐观，反而倾向于较为悲观。研究发现，吸烟者对各种健康风险要么了解充分，要么持悲观态度，这表明这些认知并不决定他们是否继续吸烟。虽然烟草公司的宣传可能具有误导性，从而促使一些人开始吸烟，但我们并未发现任何证据表明系统性地传播关于吸烟健康后果的错误信息会阻碍人们戒烟。

abstract.text: Governments of EU countries have declared that they would like to couple income growth with reductions in social inequalities in income and health. We show that, theoretically, both aims can be reconciled only under very specific conditions concerning the type of growth and the income responsiveness of health. We investigate whether these conditions were met in Europe in the 1990s using panel data from the European Community Household Panel. We demonstrate that (i) in most countries, the income elasticity of health was positive and increases with income, and (ii) that income growth was not pro-rich in most EU countries, resulting in small or negligible reductions in income inequality. The combination of both findings explains the modest increases we observe in income-related health inequality in the majority of countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.12.005.abstractZh: 欧盟国家的政府宣布，他们希望将收入增长与减少收入和健康方面的社会不平等结合起来。我们指出，从理论上讲，只有在特定的条件下，这两个目标才能同时实现，这些条件涉及经济增长的类型以及健康对收入的响应程度。我们使用欧洲社区家庭面板的数据，调查了20世纪90年代欧洲是否满足了这些条件。我们发现：(i) 在大多数国家，健康的收入弹性为正，并且随着收入的增加而上升；(ii) 在大多数欧盟国家，收入增长并不有利于富人，因此收入不平等的减少幅度很小或可以忽略不计。这两个发现结合起来，可以解释我们在大多数国家观察到的与收入相关的健康不平等的适度增加。

abstract.text: Proponents of tort reform applied to medical malpractice argue for change partly on the premise that the threat of lawsuits has made medical care more costly. Using U.S. longitudinal data from the National Long-Term Care Survey merged with Medicare claims and other data for 1985-2000, this study assesses whether tort reforms have reduced Medicare payments made on behalf of beneficiaries and the survival probability following an index event. Direct reforms (caps on damages, abolition of punitive damages, eliminating mandatory prejudgment interest, and collateral source offset) did not significantly reduce payments for Medicare-covered services in any specification. Indirect reforms (limitations on contingency fees, mandatory periodic payments, joint-and-several liability reform, and patient compensation funds) significantly reduced Medicare payments only in a specification based on any hospitalization, but not in analysis of hospitalization for each of four common chronic conditions. Neither direct nor indirect reforms had a significant effect on the health outcomes, with one exception. The overall conclusion is that tort reforms do not significantly affect medical decisions, nor do they have a systematic effect on patient outcomes.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.12.006.abstractZh: 主张侵权法改革的人针对医疗过失问题提出改革建议，部分原因是诉讼威胁使得医疗服务成本增加。本研究利用美国国家长期护理调查提供的美国纵向数据，结合医疗保险索赔数据及其他1985-2000年的数据，评估侵权法改革是否减少了为受益人支付的医疗保险费用，以及发生特定事件后的生存概率。直接改革措施（如损害赔偿上限、废除惩罚性赔偿、取消强制性预判利息以及提供替代赔偿机制）在任何情况下均未显著减少医疗保险覆盖服务的支付金额。间接改革措施（如限制应急费用、强制定期支付、改革联合与多重责任制度以及设立患者赔偿基金）仅在基于住院情况的分析中显著减少了医疗保险支付，但在分析四种常见慢性病的住院情况时并未产生明显效果。无论是直接还是间接改革措施，均未对健康结果产生显著影响，只有一个例外。总体结论是，侵权法改革并未显著影响医疗决策，也未对患者结果产生系统性影响。

abstract.text: I analyze the relationship between duration of the pension benefit spell and pension benefit claims from the German public pension system, with a special emphasis on differential results with respect to health. This relationship is crucial for a potential structural pattern of redistribution between different income and health groups, induced by the public pension system. Evidence for such redistribution from poor to rich is present for most of the specifications in my analysis. The most adequate specification is partially linear, does therefore not impose any parametrical restrictions between duration and benefit claims, and allows for potential endogeneity. The relationship I extract is clearly positive. I also find that redistribution from low-income individuals to individuals with high income is more pronounced the worse the health status is, despite longer benefit spells for pensioners in ill-health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.12.007.abstractZh: 我分析了德国公共养老金体系下养老金领取期限与养老金索赔之间的关系，特别关注健康状况对结果的差异影响。这种关系对于分析公共养老金体系引发的不同收入群体和健康状况群体之间的再分配结构模式至关重要。在我的分析对象中，大多数情况下都存在从低收入群体向高收入群体的再分配现象。最合适的模型是部分线性模型，因此不对领取期限和索赔金额之间的参数施加任何限制，并允许考虑潜在的内生性。我得出的结论是，这种再分配关系显然是正向的。我还发现，健康状况越差，低收入人群向高收入人群的再分配现象就越明显，尽管健康状况不佳的养老金领取者的领取期限更长。

abstract.text: We use a "natural experiment", the fiscal adjustment of Italy in the 1990s to meet the Maastricht criteria, to test a simple model of soft budget constraint that closely resembles the intergovernmental relationships in the Italian public health care sector. We show that the link between the ex-ante financing by the Central government and the health expenditure by regions was stronger when regional expectations of future bailing outs were presumably lower. Confirming previous research, we also prove that more fiscally autonomous regions were more financially responsible and that a political "alignment" effect was present, with "friendly" regional governments controlling more expenditure than unfriendly ones. Our results suggest that, at least in Italy, bailing out expectations by regions may be the missing variable emphasised by [Culyer A.J., 1988. Health care expenditures in Canada: Myth and reality. Canadian Tax Papers, 82] for empirical models explaining health expenditure. Our results also raise some worries about the outcome of the current decentralization process in Europe.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.12.008.abstractZh: 我们采用“自然实验”方法，以1990年代意大利为应对马斯特里赫特标准而进行的财政调整为例，来检验一个简单的软预算约束模型。该模型与意大利公共医疗保健领域的政府间关系非常相似。我们发现，当地区对未来财政援助的预期较低时，中央政府的事前融资与地区卫生支出之间的关联更为紧密。这一结果证实了先前的研究，并进一步证明了财政上更自主的地区更负责任，同时还存在政治“对齐”效应，即“友好”的地区政府比不友好的地区政府控制更多的支出。我们的研究结果表明，至少在意大利，地区对财政援助的预期可能是解释卫生支出问题的缺失变量。此外，我们的研究结果也引发了对当前欧洲分权进程结果的担忧。

abstract.text: Despite significant global efforts to improve vaccination coverage against major childhood diseases, vaccination rates are below 90%. To eradicate diseases such as measles, however, vaccination rates close to 95% are needed. We use a randomized experiment to investigate the effect of a demand incentive, a conditional cash transfer program, in improving vaccination coverage in rural Nicaragua. Double-difference estimates show the program led to large increases in vaccination coverage, and these resulted in vaccination levels greater than 95% for some vaccines. Effects were especially large for children who are typically harder to reach with traditional supply-side interventions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2008.12.010.abstractZh: 尽管全球在提高儿童主要疾病的疫苗接种覆盖率方面做出了显著努力，但疫苗接种率仍低于90%。然而，要根除麻疹等疾病，需要达到接近95%的疫苗接种率。我们通过一项随机实验来研究一种需求激励措施——即有条件现金转移计划，对提高尼加拉瓜农村地区的疫苗接种覆盖率的影响。双重差分估计显示，该计划显著提高了疫苗接种覆盖率，某些疫苗的接种率甚至超过了95%。对于那些传统供应侧干预措施难以覆盖的儿童来说，这种影响尤为显著。

abstract.text: Although policymakers have increasingly turned to provider report cards as a tool to improve health care quality, existing studies provide mixed evidence on whether they influence consumer choices. We examine the effects of providing consumers with quality information in the context of fertility clinics providing Assisted Reproductive Therapies (ART). We report three main findings. First, clinics with higher birth rates had larger market shares after the adoption of report cards relative to before. Second, clinics with a disproportionate share of young, relatively easy-to-treat patients had lower market shares after adoption versus before. This suggests that consumers take into account information on patient mix when evaluating clinic outcomes. Third, report cards had larger effects on consumers and clinics from states with ART insurance coverage mandates. We conclude that consumers respond to quality report cards when choosing among providers of ART.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.01.001.abstractZh: 尽管政策制定者越来越多地将医疗服务提供方的报告卡作为提高医疗质量的工具，但现有研究对于报告卡是否会影响消费者选择的结果并不一致。我们研究了在生育诊所提供辅助生殖技术的情况下，向消费者提供高质量信息的影响。我们的研究结果主要有三点：首先，在采用报告卡之后，出生率较高的诊所市场份额比采用之前有所提升；其次，那些主要接待年轻且相对容易治疗的患者的诊所，在采用报告卡后的市场份额低于采用之前，这表明消费者在评估诊所效果时会考虑患者构成信息；最后，在那些有辅助生殖技术保险覆盖要求的州，报告卡对消费者和诊所的影响更为显著。我们得出结论：消费者在选择辅助生殖技术提供方时，会对高质量的报告卡作出反应。

abstract.text: Public investments are dynamic in nature, and decision making must account for the uncertainty, irreversibility and potential for future learning. In this paper we adapt the theory for investment under uncertainty for a public referendum setting and perform the first empirical test to show that estimates of the value of a statistical life (VSL) from stated preference surveys are highly dependent on the inclusion of the option value. Our results indicate an option value of a major economic magnitude. This implies that previously reported VSL estimates, used in societal benefit-cost analysis of health investments, are exaggerated.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.01.002.abstractZh: 公共投资具有动态性，决策时必须考虑不确定性、不可逆性以及未来学习的潜力。在本文中，我们将这一理论应用于不确定性下的投资场景，并进行了首次实证测试，结果表明，通过陈述偏好调查得出的统计生命价值估计值，在很大程度上依赖于期权价值的考虑。我们的研究结果表明，期权价值具有显著的经济意义。这意味着，之前用于健康投资的社会效益成本分析中的统计生命价值估计值可能被高估了。

abstract.text: When entering the job market, nurses choose among different kind of jobs. Each of these jobs is characterized by wage, sector (primary care or hospital) and shift (daytime work or shift). This paper estimates a multi-sector-job-type random utility model of labor supply on data for Norwegian registered nurses (RNs) in 2000. The empirical model implies that labor supply is rather inelastic; 10% increase in the wage rates for all nurses is estimated to yield 3.3% increase in overall labor supply. This modest response shadows for much stronger inter-job-type responses. Our approach differs from previous studies in two ways: First, to our knowledge, it is the first time that a model of labor supply for nurses is estimated taking explicitly into account the choices that RN's have regarding work place and type of job. Second, it differs from previous studies with respect to the measurement of the compensations for different types of work. So far, it has been focused on wage differentials. But there are more attributes of a job than the wage. Based on the estimated random utility model we therefore calculate the expected value of compensation that makes a utility maximizing agent indifferent between types of jobs, here between shift work and daytime work. It turns out that Norwegian nurses working shifts may be willing to work shift relative to daytime work for a lower wage than the current one.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.01.003.abstractZh: 在进入就业市场时，护士会在不同类型的职位之间进行选择。这些职位的特点包括工资水平、行业（初级护理或医院）以及工作班次（白天工作或夜班）。本文基于2000年挪威注册护士的数据，估计了一个多行业-类型随机效用模型，用于分析劳动力供给。该模型表明，劳动力供给相对缺乏弹性；所有护士的工资水平增加10%，预计会导致整体劳动力供给增加3.3%。这种适度的响应掩盖了不同工作类型之间更为强烈的互动。我们的研究方法与以往的研究有所不同：首先，据我们所知，这是首次在考虑护士对工作场所和工作类型选择的情况下，对护士劳动力供给进行建模。其次，在衡量不同类型工作的报酬方面，我们的方法与以往的研究有所不同。迄今为止，研究主要集中在工资差异上。但实际上，工作的属性不仅仅包括工资。基于所估计的随机效用模型，我们计算了使效用最大化者在不同类型工作之间做出选择的报酬期望值，这里指的是夜班工作与白天工作的报酬差异。结果表明，从事夜班的挪威护士可能愿意以低于当前工资的夜班工作作为选择。

abstract.text: We use panel data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY) to examine how body weight changes with age for a cohort moving through early adulthood, to investigate how the age-obesity gradient differs with socioeconomic status (SES) and to study channels for these SES disparities. Our results show first that weight increases with age and is inversely related to SES during childhood. Second, the obesity gradient widens over the lifecycle, consistent with research on other health outcomes. Third, a substantial portion of the "effect" of early life conditions operates through race/ethnicity and the translation of advantaged family backgrounds during childhood into higher levels of subsequent education. By contrast, little of the SES gap appears to propagate through household composition, family income or health behaviors. Fourth, adult SES has independent effects after controlling for childhood status.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.01.004.abstractZh: 我们使用《国家青年纵向调查》的面板数据，来研究一个从青年早期到成年早期的人群中，体重如何随年龄变化，以及年龄与肥胖的梯度如何随社会经济地位的变化而变化，并探讨这些社会经济差异的成因。我们的研究结果表明：首先，体重会随着年龄增长而增加，并且在儿童时期与社会经济地位呈负相关。其次，肥胖的梯度在生命周期中逐渐扩大，这与其他健康结果的研究结果一致。第三，早期生活条件的“影响”在很大程度上是通过种族/民族因素以及儿童时期优越的家庭背景转化为后续更高水平的教育来实现的。相比之下，社会经济地位的差异似乎很少通过家庭构成、家庭收入或健康行为来传递。第四，在控制了儿童时期的社会经济地位后，成人的社会经济地位仍具有独立的影响。

abstract.text: Influenza is a serious disease, especially for older people, and incomplete vaccination take-up poses a major public health challenge. On both the side of physicians and patients, there could be promising channels for increasing immunization rates, but no attempt has yet been made to empirically unravel their respective influences. Using exclusion restrictions implied by an economic model of physician-patient interactions, our study quantifies the particular effects of supply and demand on influenza immunization. On the supply side, our estimates highlight the importance of physician agency and physician quality, while a patient's education and health behaviors are key demand side factors.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.01.005.abstractZh: 流感是一种严重的疾病，尤其是对老年人而言，而疫苗接种覆盖率的不完全性则构成了重大的公共卫生挑战。在医生和患者双方，都有一些有望提高免疫接种率的途径，但迄今为止尚未有人尝试从实证角度探讨这些因素各自的影响。本研究利用医生-患者互动的经济模型所蕴含的排除限制条件，量化了供给和需求对流感免疫接种的具体影响。在供给方面，我们的估计结果强调了医生能力和医生质量的重要性；而在需求方面，患者的教育水平和健康行为则是关键因素。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of three "criteria" air pollutants on infant health in New Jersey in the 1990s by combining information about mother's residential location from birth certificates with information from air quality monitors. Our work offers three important innovations. First, we use the exact addresses of mothers to select those closest to air monitors to improve the accuracy of air quality exposure. Second, we include maternal fixed effects to control for unobserved characteristics of mothers. Third, we examine interactions of air pollution with smoking and other risk factors for poor infant health outcomes. We find consistently negative effects of exposure to carbon monoxide (CO), both during and after birth, with effects considerably larger for smokers and older mothers. Since automobiles are the main source of carbon monoxide emissions, our results have important implications for regulation of automobile emissions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.001.abstractZh: 我们研究了20世纪90年代三种“标准”空气污染物对新泽西州婴儿健康的影响，通过结合出生证明中的母亲居住信息以及空气质量监测数据来进行分析。我们的研究提出了三项重要创新：首先，我们使用母亲的准确地址来选取距离空气质量监测站最近的母亲，以提高空气质量暴露的精确度；其次，我们纳入了母亲固定效应，以控制母亲未观察到的特征；第三，我们研究了空气污染与吸烟及其他不良婴儿健康结果的风险因素之间的相互作用。我们发现，一氧化碳的暴露对婴儿健康有持续的负面影响，这种影响在出生期间及之后都普遍存在，且对吸烟者和年龄较大的母亲影响更为显著。由于汽车是二氧化碳排放的主要来源，我们的研究结果对汽车排放的监管具有重要意义。

abstract.text: Suicide takes the lives of around a million people each year, most of whom suffer from depression. In recent years there has been growing controversy about whether one of the best-selling anti-depressants - selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) - increases or decreases the risk of completed suicide. Randomized clinical trials are not informative in this application because of small samples and other problems. We present what we believe are the most scientifically credible estimates to date on how SSRI sales affect suicide mortality using data from 26 countries for up to 25 years. We exploit just the variation in SSRI sales that can be explained by institutional differences in how drugs are regulated, priced, and distributed, as reflected by the sales growth of new drugs more generally. We find an increase in SSRI sales of 1 pill per capita (12% of 2000 sales levels) reduces suicide by 5%.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.002.abstractZh: 每年约有100万人死于自杀，其中大多数人都患有抑郁症。近年来，关于一种畅销的抗抑郁药——选择性血清素再摄取抑制剂（SSRIs）是否会增加或减少自杀风险的问题引发了越来越多的争议。由于样本量小和其他问题，随机临床试验在这一点上并不具有参考价值。我们基于26个国家长达25年的数据，提出了迄今为止最可信的估计结果，探讨SSRIs的销量如何影响自杀死亡率。我们仅关注那些可以通过药物监管、定价和分销等制度差异来解释的SSRIs销量变化，这些差异通常体现在新药的销量增长上。我们发现，每人口增加1片SSRIs的销量（相当于2000年销量的12%），自杀率会降低5%。

abstract.text: In this paper we study the feasibility of estimating a monetary value for a QALY (MVQ). Using two different surveys of the Spanish population (total n = 892), we consider whether willingness to pay (WTP) is (approximately) proportional to the health gains measured in QALYs. We also explore whether subjects' responses are prone to any significant biases. We find that the estimated MVQ varies inversely with the magnitude of health gain. We also find two other (ir)regularities: the existence of ordering effects; and insensitivity of WTP to the duration of the period of payment. Taken together, these effects result in large variations in estimates of the MVQ. If we are ever to obtain consistent and stable estimates, we should try to understand better the sources of variability found in the course of this study.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.003.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了估算QALY货币价值的可行性。通过对比西班牙人口的两项调查（总样本数为892人），我们探讨了支付意愿与以QALY衡量的健康收益之间的比例关系。我们还探讨了受试者的回答是否存在显著偏差。研究发现，估算出的MVQ与健康收益的大小成反比。此外，我们还发现了另外两个不规则现象：排序效应的存在；以及支付意愿对支付期限的不敏感性。综合这些效应，导致MVQ的估算结果出现较大波动。如果我们希望获得一致且稳定的估算结果，就应该努力更好地理解研究中发现的变异来源。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of a 'free drug program' on the market equilibrium of drugs. We introduce a screening model of the hard drug market in which dealers use payment and punishment options to screen between high and low risk users. We show that, if a free drug program selects sufficiently many high-risk drug users, the pure-strategy separating market equilibrium ceases to exist and a symmetric mixed-strategy equilibrium results, in which drug users derive a higher expected utility. This encourages new drug users to enter the market. The novelty of the paper is the transmission mechanism for this effect, which is via the influence on market price.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.004.abstractZh: 本文研究了“免费药物计划”对药物市场均衡的影响。我们引入了一个硬性药物市场的筛选模型，其中经销商通过支付和惩罚手段来区分高风险和低风险用户。研究表明，如果免费药物计划能够筛选出足够多的高风险药物使用者，那么纯策略分离市场均衡将不再存在，取而代之的是一种对称混合策略均衡，在这种均衡下，药物使用者获得的预期效用更高。这促使新的药物使用者进入市场。本文的创新之处在于揭示了这种效应的传递机制，即通过影响市场价格来实现。

abstract.text: In this paper, we simulate the effects of tax reforms aimed at encouraging healthier grain consumption. We use a rich data set on household grain consumption in 2003 from the market research institute GfK Sweden, combined with information on the nutritional content of the consumption. We estimate behavioral parameters, which are used to simulate the impact on the average household of tax reforms entailing either a subsidy on commodities particularly rich in fiber or a subsidy of the fiber density in grain products. Our results suggest that to direct the fiber intake towards nutritional recommendations, reforms with a substantial impact on consumer prices are required. Regardless of the type of subsidy implemented, the increase in the intake of fiber is accompanied by unwanted increases in nutrients that are often overconsumed: fat, salt and sugar. Funding the subsidies by taxing these nutrients, or less healthy commodities, helps to counteract such developments.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.005.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们模拟了旨在促进更健康谷物消费的改革所带来的影响。我们使用了来自市场研究机构GfK Sweden的2003年家庭谷物消费丰富数据，并结合了消费产品的营养成分信息。我们估算了行为参数，这些参数用于模拟税收改革对普通家庭的影响，这些改革包括对富含纤维的商品提供补贴，或者对谷物产品的纤维密度提供补贴。我们的结果表明，为了将纤维摄入量引导至营养推荐水平，需要能够对消费者价格产生重大影响的改革。无论采用何种补贴方式，纤维摄入量的增加往往伴随着过量摄入的营养素——脂肪、盐和糖。通过征税这些营养素或不健康的商品来资助补贴，有助于抵消这种趋势。

abstract.text: Alcohol policies have potentially far-reaching impacts on risky sexual behavior, prenatal health behaviors, and subsequent outcomes for infants. After finding initial evidence in the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY) that changes in the minimum legal drinking age (MLDA) are related to prenatal drinking, we examine whether the drinking age influences birth outcomes. Using data from the National Vital Statistics (NVS) for the years 1978-1988, we find that a drinking age of 18 is associated with adverse outcomes among births to young mothers-including higher incidences of low birth weight and premature birth, but not congenital anomalies. The effects are largest among black women. We also report evidence that the MLDA laws alter the composition of births that occur. In states with lenient drinking laws, young black mothers are less likely to report paternal information on the birth certificate, particularly in states with restrictive abortion policies. The evidence suggests that lenient drinking laws generate poor birth outcomes in part because they increase the number of unplanned pregnancies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.006.abstractZh: 酒精政策可能对 risky sexual behavior、 prenatal health behaviors以及婴儿的成长结果产生深远影响。在《全国青年纵向调查》中发现，最低法定饮酒年龄的变化与 prenatal 饮酒有关，我们进一步探讨了饮酒年龄是否会影响出生结果。利用1978-1988年的《国家生命统计数据》，我们发现18岁为最低饮酒年龄时，年轻母亲所生的婴儿出现不良结果的概率较高，包括低出生体重和早产的情况，但先天畸形并未受到影响。这种影响在黑人女性中最为明显。此外，研究还发现，最低法定饮酒年龄的变化会改变出生的构成。在饮酒法律较为宽松的州，年轻黑人母亲在出生证明上报告父亲信息的可能性较低，尤其是在堕胎政策较为严格的州。这些证据表明，宽松的饮酒法律导致不良出生结果的部分原因是它们增加了意外怀孕的数量。

abstract.text: People migrate to improve their well-being. Yet a large literature suggests that migration can be a stressful process, with potentially negative impacts on mental health. However, to truly understand the effect of migration one must compare the mental health of migrants to what their mental health would be had they stayed in their home country. The existing literature is not able to do this. New Zealand allows a quota of Tongans to immigrate each year with a random ballot used to choose amongst the excess number of applicants. Experimental estimates of the mental health effects of migration are obtained by comparing the mental health of migrants who were successful applicants in the random ballot to the mental health of those who applied to migrate under the quota, but whose names were not drawn. Migration is found to lead to improvements in mental health, particularly for women and those with poor mental health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.007.abstractZh: 人们迁移是为了改善自己的福祉。然而，大量研究表明，迁移可能是一个压力较大的过程，可能会对心理健康产生负面影响。然而，要真正了解迁移对心理健康的影响，必须比较移民的心理健康状况与他们如果留在祖国时的心理健康状况。现有的研究无法做到这一点。新西兰每年允许一定数量的汤加人移民，通过随机抽签的方式从过多的申请者中选出。通过实验方法，可以比较成功获得移民资格的申请者与那些申请但因姓名未被抽中而未能移民的人的心理健康状况。研究发现，迁移确实能够改善心理健康，尤其是对于女性以及那些心理健康状况较差的人来说。

abstract.text: In order to incorporate distributional concerns into cost-effectiveness analysis, it would be useful to elicit distributional weights that express people's valuation of marginal health gains at various levels of health. Distributional preferences are commonly elicited either through a person trade off (PTO) or a gain trade off (GTO) technique. An inherent problem of the GTO is that it is based on the valuation of non-marginal health gains. In practice, many contributions using the PTO also focus on non-marginal health gains. This paper demonstrates that the failure to distinguish appropriately between marginal and non-marginal health gains may lead to seriously misleading estimates of distributional weights. Moreover, the paper proposes a methodology for utilising information obtained through non-marginal analysis more efficiently in order to obtain more reliable estimates of distributional weights. The methodology was successfully applied in an empirical study of age weights.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.008.abstractZh: 为了将分配问题纳入成本效益分析，有必要确定能够表达人们对不同健康水平下边际健康收益的价值观的分配权重。分配偏好通常通过个人权衡（PTO）或收益权衡（GTO）技术来估算。GTO方法的一个固有问题在于它基于非边际健康收益的估值。实际上，许多使用PTO方法的分析也关注非边际健康收益。本文指出，未能正确区分边际收益与非边际收益可能会导致分配权重的估算出现严重偏差。此外，本文提出了一种方法，能够更有效地利用非边际分析获得的信息，从而得出更可靠的分配权重估算结果。该方法已在一项关于年龄权重的实证研究中成功应用。

abstract.text: Who pays the healthcare costs associated with obesity? Among workers, this is largely a question of the incidence of the costs of employer-sponsored coverage. Using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth and the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey, we find that the incremental healthcare costs associated with obesity are passed on to obese workers with employer-sponsored health insurance in the form of lower cash wages. Obese workers without employer-sponsored insurance do not have a wage offset relative to their non-obese counterparts. A substantial part of the lower wages among obese women attributed to labor market discrimination can be explained by their higher health insurance premiums.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.009.abstractZh: 谁承担与肥胖相关的医疗费用？对于工人来说，这主要取决于雇主提供的保险覆盖的成本负担情况。通过美国国家青年纵向调查和医疗支出调查的数据分析，我们发现，与肥胖相关的额外医疗费用以较低的现金工资形式转嫁给了拥有雇主提供健康保险的肥胖工人。而没有雇主提供保险的同龄肥胖工人则没有相应的工资补偿。肥胖女性较低的工资在很大程度上可以归因于劳动力市场中的歧视，而这部分差异可以通过她们更高的健康保险费用来解释。

abstract.text: Economists rely heavily on self-reported measures of health to examine the relationship between income and health. We directly compare survey responses of a self-reported measure of health that is commonly used in nationally representative surveys with objective measures of the same health condition. We focus on hypertension. We find no evidence of an income/health gradient using self-reported hypertension but a sizeable gradient when using objectively measured hypertension. We also find that the probability of false negative reporting is significantly income graded. Our results suggest that using commonly available self-reported chronic health measures might underestimate true income-related inequalities in health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.02.010.abstractZh: 经济学家在研究收入与健康之间的关系时，主要依赖自我报告的健康指标。我们直接比较了全国代表性调查中常用的自我报告健康指标与客观健康指标之间的数据。我们重点关注高血压这一指标。研究发现，使用自我报告的高血压数据时，并未发现收入与健康状况之间的梯度关系；而使用客观测量得到的高血压数据时，则发现了明显的梯度关系。此外，我们还发现，错误阴性报告的概率也呈现出明显的收入梯度效应。我们的研究结果表明，使用常见的自我报告慢性健康指标可能会低估与收入相关的健康不平等现象。

abstract.text: The small sample size of contingent valuation (CV) surveys conducted in patients may have limited the use of the single-bounded (SB) dichotomous choice format which is recommended in environmental economics. In this paper, we explore two ways to increase the statistical efficiency of the SB format: (1) by the inclusion of proxies in addition to patients; (2) by the addition of a follow-up dichotomous question, i.e. the double-bounded (DB) dichotomous choice format. We found that patients (n=223) and spouses (n=64) answering on behalf of the patient had on average a similar willingness-to-pay for earlier alleviation of flu symptoms. However, a patient was significantly more likely to anchor his/her answer on the first bid as compared to a spouse. Finally, our original DB model with shift effect and heterogeneous anchoring reconciled the discrepancies found in willingness-to-pay statistics between SB and DB models in keeping with increased statistical efficiency.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.03.002.abstractZh: 在患者中进行的微量条件价值评估调查的样本量有限，这可能限制了在环境经济学中推荐的单边界二分选择格式的应用。本文探讨了两种提高单边界格式统计效率的方法：(1) 在患者之外加入代理人；(2) 增加后续二分问题，即双边界二分选择格式。研究发现，代表患者回答问题的患者(n=223)和配偶(n=64)对早期缓解流感症状的支付意愿平均相似。然而，患者比配偶更有可能基于首次出价来做出回答。最后，我们的原始双边界模型结合转移效应和异质锚定机制，解决了单边界和双边界模型在支付意愿统计上的差异，从而提高了统计效率。

abstract.text: Economists have begun to debate if the rise in cigarette prices in the U.S. in recent decades has contributed to the nation's rise in obesity, reaching conclusions that are surprisingly sensitive to specification. I show that allowing for the effect to occur gradually over several years leads to the conclusion that a rise in cigarette prices is actually associated with a long-run reduction in body mass index and obesity. This result is robust to the different methodologies used in the literature. I also provide evidence that indirect effects on exercise and food consumption may explain the counterintuitive result.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.03.003.abstractZh: 经济学家们开始讨论近几十年来美国香烟价格的上涨是否导致了该国肥胖率的上升，得出的结论对具体参数设定非常敏感。我的研究表明，如果考虑到价格上涨是逐渐发生的，那么可以得出结论：香烟价格的上涨实际上与长期体重指数和肥胖率的下降有关。这一结果不受文献中使用的不同方法的影响。我还提供了证据，表明对运动和食物消费的直接间接影响可能解释了这一违反直觉的结果。

abstract.text: The empirical literature that explores whether physicians respond to financial incentives has not definitively answered the question of whether physicians alter their treatment behavior at the margin. Previous research has not been able to distinguish that part of a physician response that uniformly alters treatment of all patients under a physician's care from that which affects some, but not all of a physician's patients. To explore physicians' marginal responses to financial incentives while accounting for the selection of physicians into different financial arrangements where others could not, I use data from a survey of physician visits to isolate the effect that capitation, a form of reimbursement wherein physicians receive zero marginal revenue for a range of physician provided services, has on the care provided by a physician. Fixed effects regression results reveal that physicians spend less time with their capitated patients than with their non-capitated patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.03.004.abstractZh: 关于医生是否会对财务激励作出反应的实证研究尚未明确回答医生在边际情况下是否会改变其治疗行为的问题。先前的研究未能区分医生反应中那些会统一改变所有患者治疗行为的部分，以及那些只影响部分而非所有患者治疗行为的部分。为了探讨医生在边际情况下对财务激励的反应，同时考虑到医生因无法参与其他财务安排而被选中参与这种安排的情况，我使用了医生就诊调查的数据来研究按合同收费这种报销方式对医生所提供的医疗服务的影响。固定效应回归结果显示，医生在与按合同收费的患者相处时，花费的时间比与非按合同收费的患者相处时更少。

abstract.text: When a distribution can be described either in terms of attainment or in terms of shortfall, the classical inequality measures appear to be one-sided. I show that it is possible to find indicators which simultaneously measure attainment and shortfall inequality. I derive one indicator belonging to the Gini family, and another belonging to Coefficient of Variation family. I also indicate how they are connected to other measures.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.03.005.abstractZh: 当一个分布可以用成就或不足来描述时，经典的不平等度量似乎具有片面性。我展示了如何找到能够同时衡量成就不平等和不足不平等的指标。我推导出一个属于基尼家族的指标，另一个属于变异系数家族。我还指出了这些指标与其他度量之间的关联。

abstract.text: An age-cohort decomposition applied to panel data identifies how the mean, overall inequality and income-related inequality of self-assessed health evolve over the life cycle and differ across generations in 11 EU countries. There is a moderate and steady decline in mean health until the age of 70 or so and a steep acceleration in the rate of deterioration thereafter. In southern Europe and Ireland, where development has been most rapid, the average health of generations born in more recent decades is significantly better than that of older generations. This is not observed in the northern European countries. In almost all countries, health is more dispersed among older generations indicating that Europe has experienced a reduction in overall health inequality over time. Although there is no consistent evidence that health inequality increases as a given cohort ages, this is true in the three largest countries--UK, France and Germany. In the former two countries and the Netherlands, at least for males, the income gradient in health peaks around retirement age, as in the US. In most European countries, unlike the US, there is no evidence that income-related health inequality is greater among younger than older generations.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.04.001.abstractZh: 对面板数据进行的年龄-世代分解揭示了自我评估的健康状况在11个欧盟国家的生命周期中如何变化，以及不同世代之间的差异。平均健康状况在70岁左右之前呈温和且稳定的下降趋势，之后恶化速度则显著加快。在发展最快的南欧和爱尔兰，最近几十年出生的世代的平均健康状况明显优于较老的一代。而在北欧国家则没有这种现象。在几乎所有国家，老年一代的健康状况分布更为分散，这表明欧洲的整体健康不平等程度随时间有所降低。尽管没有一致的证据表明健康不平等会随着特定世代年龄的增长而加剧，但在英国、法国和德国这三个最大国家，这一趋势确实存在。在前两个国家以及荷兰，至少对于男性来说，健康状况的收入梯度在退休年龄时达到顶峰，这与美国的情况相似。与美国不同的是，在大多数欧洲国家，没有证据表明年轻一代与老年一代相比，与健康相关的不平等程度更高。

abstract.text: Using a sample of 137 hospitals over the period 1998-2002 in the English National Health Service, we estimate the elasticity of hospital costs with respect to waiting times. Our cross-sectional and panel-data results suggest that at the sample mean (103 days), waiting times have no significant effect on hospitals' costs or, at most, a positive one. If significant, the elasticity of cost with respect to waiting time from our cross-sectional estimates is in the range 0.4-1. The elasticity is still positive but lower in our fixed-effects specifications (0.2-0.4). In all specifications, the effect of waiting time on cost is non-linear, suggesting a U-shaped relationship between hospital costs and waiting times. However, the level of waiting time which minimises total costs is always below ten days.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.04.002.abstractZh: 我们选取了1998至2002年间英格兰国家卫生服务系统内的137家医院作为样本，研究了医院成本与等待时间之间的弹性关系。横截面数据和面板数据分析表明，在样本平均值（103天）的情况下，等待时间对医院成本没有显著影响，或者最多只有正的影响。如果这种影响显著，那么根据我们的横截面数据，成本与等待时间之间的弹性在0.4到1之间。在固定效应模型中，这种弹性仍然为正，但数值较低，为0.2到0.4。在所有模型中，等待时间对成本的影响都是非线性的，这表明医院成本与等待时间之间存在U形关系。不过，能够最小化总成本的等待时间长度始终低于十天。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine the effect of parental Medicaid expansions on job mobility. If expanded Medicaid eligibility makes it easier for a person to have health coverage between jobs, we expect it to reduce "job lock" that occurs for workers with employer-provided health insurance. Expanded eligibility could also decrease mobility among those in jobs without health insurance, since they experience less pressure to move to an insured job ("job push"). We find strong evidence that expanded eligibility reduces job lock among unmarried women but not men or married women, and only weak evidence of reduced job push among men.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.04.003.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了父母医疗补助扩展对就业流动性影响的研究。如果扩大医疗补助资格使得人们在不同工作之间更容易获得健康保障，我们预计这将减少那些拥有雇主提供健康保险的工人所面临的“就业锁定”问题。此外，扩大资格资格还可能降低那些没有健康保险的工作人员的流动性，因为他们面临更换到有保险工作的压力较小。我们发现，扩大资格资格确实减少了未婚女性的就业锁定问题，但对男性或已婚女性的影响则不明显，而男性面临的就业流动性减少现象则证据较弱。

abstract.text: Subjects with rheumatoid arthritis (RA) enrolled in an online panel were asked to evaluate pairs of treatment alternatives with different attributes. Half of the sample saw a cheap-talk text. Preference parameters were estimated using random-parameters logit models to account for unobserved taste heterogeneity. The models also were estimated in willingness-to-pay (WTP) space instead of conventional utility space. Cheap talk not only affected the coefficient on the cost attribute, but also preferences for other attributes. WTP estimates were generally lower in cheap talk sample, except for the most important attribute and a 2-level attribute. Subjects who were presented with cheap talk discriminated between the adjoning attribute levels better than the subjects in the control sample.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.04.004.abstractZh: 参与在线研究的类风湿性关节炎患者被要求评估具有不同属性的两种治疗方案。样本中的一半人收到了一些关于廉价疗法的信息。偏好参数通过随机参数逻辑模型进行估计，以考虑未观察到的口味差异。这些模型还在支付意愿空间中进行估计，而不是传统的效用空间。廉价疗法不仅影响了成本属性的偏好，还影响了其他属性的偏好。在收到廉价疗法的样本中，支付意愿的估计值普遍较低，除了最重要的属性和一个两级的属性。面对廉价疗法的受试者，他们在相邻属性级别上的区分能力比对照组受试者更强。

abstract.text: The positive relationship between household income and child health is well documented in the child health literature but the precise mechanisms via which income generates better health and whether the income gradient is increasing in child age are not well understood. This paper presents new Australian evidence on the child health-income gradient. We use data from the Longitudinal Study of Australian Children (LSAC), which involved two waves of data collection for children born between March 2003 and February 2004 (B-Cohort: 0-3 years), and between March 1999 and February 2000 (K-Cohort: 4-7 years). This data set allows us to test the robustness of some of the findings of the influential studies of Case et al. [Case, A., Lubotsky, D., Paxson, C., 2002. Economic status and health in childhood: the origins of the gradient. The American Economic Review 92 (5) 1308-1344] and Currie and Stabile [Currie, J., Stabile, M., 2003. Socioeconomic status and child health: why is the relationship stronger for older children. The American Economic Review 93 (5) 1813-1823], and a recent study by Currie et al. [Currie, A., Shields, M.A., Price, S.W., 2007. The child health/family income gradient: evidence from England. Journal of Health Economics 26 (2) 213-232]. The richness of the LSAC data set also allows us to conduct further exploration of the determinants of child health. Our results reveal an increasing income gradient by child age using similar covariates to Case et al. [Case, A., Lubotsky, D., Paxson, C., 2002. Economic status and health in childhood: the origins of the gradient. The American Economic Review 92 (5) 1308-1344]. However, the income gradient disappears if we include a rich set of controls. Our results indicate that parental health and, in particular, the mother's health plays a significant role, reducing the income coefficient to zero; suggesting an underlying mechanism that can explain the observed relationship between child health and family income. Overall, our results for Australian children are similar to those produced by Propper et al. [Propper, C., Rigg, J., Burgess, S., 2007. Child health: evidence on the roles of family income and maternal mental health from a UK birth cohort. Health Economics 16 (11) 1245-1269] on their British child cohort.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.05.001.abstractZh: 家庭收入与儿童健康之间的正相关关系在儿童健康文献中已有充分记载，但收入如何促进健康的具体机制以及收入梯度是否随儿童年龄的增长而递增，目前尚未得到充分理解。本文提出了关于儿童健康与收入关系的新澳大利亚证据。我们采用了澳大利亚儿童纵向研究的数据，该研究分为两期收集数据：一期针对2003年3月至2004年2月出生的儿童（B组：0-3岁），二期针对1999年3月至2000年2月出生的儿童（K组：4-7岁）。这一数据集使我们能够检验Case等人[Case, A., Lubotsky, D., Paxson, C., 2002. 经济地位与儿童健康：梯度的起源。《美国经济评论》92(5): 1308-1344]和Currie与Stabile[Currie, J., Stabile, M., 2003. 社会经济地位与儿童健康：为何对较大儿童的影响更为显著。《美国经济评论》93(5): 1813-1823]的研究结果，以及Currie等人[Currie, A., Shields, M.A., Price, S.W., 2007. 儿童健康/家庭收入梯度：来自英格兰的证据。《健康经济学杂志》26(2): 213-232]的最新研究结果的稳健性。LSAC数据集的丰富性还使我们能够进一步探索儿童健康的决定因素。我们的研究结果显示，使用与Case等人相同的协变量，收入梯度随儿童年龄的增长而递增。然而，如果我们纳入一系列丰富的控制变量，则收入梯度会消失。我们的研究结果表明，父母的健康状况，尤其是母亲的健康状况，起着重要作用，能够将收入系数降至零；这表明存在一个潜在机制，可以解释儿童健康与家庭收入之间的关系。总体而言，我们对澳大利亚儿童的研究结果与Propper等人[Propper, C., Rigg, J., Burgess, S., 2007. 儿童健康：关于家庭收入与母亲心理健康在英国出生队列中的作用的证据. 健康经济学 16 (11) 1245-1269]在其英国儿童队列中的研究结果相似。

abstract.text: Numerous studies have examined the effectiveness of alcohol and traffic policies in reducing automobile crashes and fatalities, but only a few have analyzed the impact of state-specific policies on motorcycle safety. Given the growing popularity and inherent safety risks of motorcycle riding, this study provides a comprehensive investigation of both fatal and non-fatal injuries. State-level longitudinal data from 1990 to 2005 are analyzed to determine how various alcohol and traffic policies impact motorcycle safety and whether there are differential effects by type of injury. The results consistently show that universal helmet laws have the most significant effect on both non-fatal and fatal injuries. Mandatory rider education programs and speed limits on rural interstates significantly impact non-fatal injuries.
