10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.05.002.abstractZh: 许多研究探讨了酒精和交通政策在减少汽车事故和死亡人数方面的有效性，但只有少数研究分析了州级政策对摩托车安全的影响。鉴于摩托车骑行的日益流行及其固有的安全风险，本研究对致命和非致命伤害进行了全面分析。通过分析1990年至2005年的州级纵向数据，研究探讨了各种酒精和交通政策对摩托车安全的影响，以及不同类型的伤害是否存在差异。研究结果表明，普遍实施的头盔法规对非致命和致命伤害都有显著的影响。强制性的骑手教育计划以及农村州际公路上的速度限制对非致命伤害也有显著影响。

abstract.text: This microeconometric study analyzes the effects of individual leisure sports participation on long-term labour market variables, health and subjective well-being indicators for West Germany based on individual data from the German Socio-Economic Panel study (GSOEP) 1984-2006. Econometric problems due to individuals choosing their own level of sports activities are tackled by combining informative data and flexible semiparametric estimation methods with a specific way to use the panel dimension of the data. The paper shows that sports activities have sizeable positive long-term labour market effects in terms of earnings and wages, as well as positive effects on health and subjective well-being.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.05.003.abstractZh: 这项微观计量经济学研究基于1984-2006年德国社会经济面板研究（GSOEP）的个体数据，分析了个人休闲体育参与对西德长期劳动力市场变量、健康及主观幸福感指标的影响。通过结合信息性数据和灵活的半参数估计方法，并采用特定的数据处理方式，解决了个体自主选择体育活动水平所带来的计量经济学问题。研究表明，体育活动在长期对劳动力市场产生显著的正面影响，包括收入和工资的提升，以及对健康与主观幸福感的积极影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between health aid and infant mortality, using data from 118 countries between 1973 and 2004. Health aid has a beneficial and statistically significant effect on infant mortality: doubling per capita health aid is associated with a 2 percent reduction in the infant mortality rate. For the average country, this implies that increasing per capita health aid by US$1.60 per year is associated with 1.5 fewer infant deaths per thousand births. The estimated effect is small, relative to the 2015 target envisioned by the Millennium Development Goals. It implies that achieving the MDG target through additional health aid alone would require a roughly 15-fold increase in current levels of aid.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.05.004.abstractZh: 本文通过1973年至2004年间118个国家的数据，探讨了健康援助与婴儿死亡率之间的关系。研究表明，健康援助对婴儿死亡率具有积极且显著的抑制作用：人均健康援助增加一倍，婴儿死亡率会降低2%。对于平均国家而言，这意味着每年人均健康援助增加1.60美元，每千个新生儿中婴儿死亡人数将减少1.5人。然而，相对于千年发展目标所设定的2015年目标而言，这一效应仍然较小。要实现千年发展目标的目标，仅通过增加健康援助，就需要将当前援助水平提高约15倍。

abstract.text: This paper addresses the rapid diffusion of obesity and the existence of different individual patterns of food consumption between non-dieters and chronic dieters. I propose a rational eating model where a forward-looking agent optimizes the intertemporal satisfaction from eating, taking into account the cost of changing consumption habits and the negative health consequences of having a non-optimal body weight. Consistent with the evidence, I show that the intertemporal maximization problem leads to a condition of overweightness, and that heterogeneity in the individual relevance of habits in consumption can determine the observed differences in the individual intertemporal patterns of food consumption and body weight. Sufficient conditions for determining when the convergence to the steady state implies oscillations or is monotonic are given. In the former case, the agent optimally alternates diets and binges until the steady state is reached, in the latter a regular intertemporal pattern of food consumption is optimal.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.001.abstractZh: 本文探讨了肥胖的迅速扩散现象，以及非节食者与长期节食者之间在食物消费模式上的差异。我提出了一个理性饮食模型，其中智能体会考虑改变消费习惯的成本以及非最佳体重带来的负面健康后果，从而优化不同时期的满意度。与现有证据一致，我表明这种跨时域最大化问题会导致超重状态，而不同个体在消费习惯上的差异可以决定个体食物消费和体重跨时域模式上的差异。文中还给出了确定系统何时会趋于稳态、出现波动或呈单调变化的充分条件。在前一种情况下，智能体会通过交替节食和暴饮暴食来优化行为，直至达到稳态；在后一种情况下，定期的跨时域食物消费模式才是最优选择。

abstract.text: Are mortality and life expectancy differences by socioeconomic groups increasing in the United States? Using a unique data set matching administrative and survey data, this study explores trends in these differentials by lifetime earnings for the 1983-2003 period. Results indicate a consistent increase in mortality differentials across sex and age groups. The study also finds a substantial increase in life expectancy differentials by lifetime earnings: the top-to-bottom quintile premium increased 30 percent for men and almost doubled for women. These results complement recent research to point to almost five decades of increasing differential mortality in the United States.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.003.abstractZh: 美国不同社会经济群体的死亡率和预期寿命差异是否在增加？本研究利用独特的数据集，将行政数据与调查数据相结合，探讨了1983年至2003年期间这些差异随终身收入变化的趋势。研究结果表明，不同性别和年龄组的死亡率差异持续增加。此外，研究还发现，预期寿命的差异随终身收入显著增加：收入最高的五分位人群男性的预期寿命增加了30%，女性则几乎翻了一番。这些结果进一步支持了近期研究的结果，即美国不同社会经济群体的死亡率差异在过去近五十年中持续上升。

abstract.text: This study measures the impact of information technology (IT) use on hospital operating costs during the late 1980s and early 1990s. Using a proprietary eight-year panel dataset (1987-1994) that catalogues application-level automation for the complete census of the 3000 U.S. hospitals with more than 100 beds, this study finds that both financial/administrative and clinical IT systems at the most thoroughly automated hospitals are associated with declining costs three and five years after adoption. At the application level, declining costs are associated with the adoption of some of the newest technologies, including systems designed for cost management, the administration of managed care contracts, and for both financial and clinical decision support. The association of cost declines with lagged IT as well as the cost patterns at the less automated hospitals both provide some evidence of learning effects.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.004.abstractZh: 本研究旨在评估信息技术（IT）使用在1980年代末至1990年代初对医院运营成本的影响。研究利用了一个包含八年数据的专有数据集（1987-1994年），该数据集记录了美国3000家拥有100张以上病房的医院在应用层面自动化技术的应用情况。研究发现，在自动化程度最高的医院中，无论是财务/行政方面的IT系统还是临床IT系统，在采用这些技术后的第三年和第五年，都能带来成本的下降。在应用层面，成本下降与采用一些最新技术有关，包括用于成本管理的系统、管理式护理合同的管理，以及用于财务和临床决策支持的系统。成本下降与滞后IT技术的使用以及自动化程度较低的医院的成本模式之间的关联，都表明存在学习效应。

abstract.text: A current proposal for reforming the German statutory health insurance suggests replacing earnings-related contributions by per-capita health premia. Combining a computable general equilibrium analysis with abundant empirical data on heterogenous household types, we investigate both the distributional and allocative impact of such a reform proposal. Our results indicate efficiency gains in terms of GDP and employment. This is because employed households of all skill types would increase their labour supply. Yet, while these household types would benefit from introducing health premia, others, such as those including pensioners or unemployed individuals, may suffer in terms of equivalent variations, despite tax-financed compensating transfers to these low-income households. Nonetheless, such transfers are an essential part of the reform proposal in order to mitigate redistributional effects. By comparing two different compensation schemes, we find that higher transfers go along with higher GDP and employment. This result may indicate that more redistribution comes at no efficiency costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.005.abstractZh: 目前关于改革德国法定健康保险的提案建议用人均健康保费来替代与收入相关的缴费。通过结合可计算的通用均衡分析与大量关于不同家庭类型的实证数据，我们研究了这一改革提案在分配和资源配置方面的影响。我们的研究结果表明，在GDP和就业方面会获得效率提升。这是因为所有技能类型的就业家庭都会增加劳动力供给。然而，尽管引入健康保费将使这些家庭受益，但其他类型家庭，如退休人员或失业者，可能会因相应的收入变化而受损，尽管有税收资助的对这些低收入家庭的补偿性转移支付。不过，这些转移支付是改革提案的重要组成部分，有助于减轻再分配效应。通过比较两种不同的补偿方案，我们发现更高的转移支付伴随着更高的GDP和就业水平。这一结果可能表明，更多的再分配不会带来效率损失。

abstract.text: This paper incorporates some theoretical ideas from the study of the epidemiology of infectious illness into a model of worker absence. The paper then seeks to quantify such infection effects by examining a personnel dataset which allows us to track daily absence decisions of a group of industrial workers employed in the same factory. We find significant effects of our measure of sickness in the (rest of the) workforce on the absence probabilities of individual workers, and offer a suggestion on how this might be used by managers to gauge the extent of illness transmission within the workplace.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.006.abstractZh: 本文将传染病流行病学研究中的一些理论思想融入了工人缺勤模型之中。随后，本文试图通过分析一个人员数据集来量化这种感染效应，该数据集能够让我们追踪同一工厂内一群工业工人的日常缺勤决策。我们发现，我们对工人病假情况的衡量对个别工人的缺勤概率产生了显著影响，并提出了一种建议，即管理者可以利用这一数据来评估工作场所内的疾病传播程度。

abstract.text: The objective of the paper is to estimate the effects of immigration on natives' probability of having private coverage and being uninsured. To examine whether immigrants affected employers' decisions to offer health benefits the study estimates immigration effects on natives' probability of being offered, eligible for, and a policy-holder of health insurance. Although in many cases the effects are statistically significant, most effects are very small. The increase in immigrant labor supply from 1995 to 2005 increases natives' uninsurance rates by about 0.7 percentage points and reduces the natives' probability of being offered and a holder of coverage by 0.8 and 1.9 percentage points, respectively. Immigrants' weaker preferences for coverage relative to natives' may be the key factor in this result.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.007.abstractZh: 本文旨在评估移民对本地人获得私人保险覆盖和未投保概率的影响。研究旨在考察移民是否影响了雇主提供健康福利的决策，并估算移民对本地人获得、符合资格以及成为保险保单持有人的概率的影响。尽管在许多情况下这些影响具有统计学意义，但大多数影响的幅度非常小。从1995年到2005年，移民劳动力的增加使本地人的未投保率上升了约0.7个百分点，同时降低了本地人获得保险和成为保险保单持有人的概率，分别下降了0.8个百分点和1.9个百分点。移民相对于本地人而言对保险覆盖的偏好较低，这可能是这一结果的关键因素。

abstract.text: Hospitals operate in markets with varied demographic, competitive, and ownership characteristics, yet research on ownership tends to examine hospitals in isolation. Here we examine three hospital ownership types -- nonprofit, for-profit, and government -- and their spillover effects. We estimate the effects of for-profit market share in two ways, on the provision of medical services and on operating margins at the three types of hospitals. We find that nonprofit hospitals' medical service provision systematically varies by market mix. We find no significant effect of market mix on the operating margins of nonprofit hospitals, but find that for-profit hospitals have higher margins in markets with more for-profits. These results fit best with theories in which hospitals maximize their own output.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.008.abstractZh: 医院在具有不同人口特征、竞争环境和所有权特征的市场中运营，然而关于所有权的研究往往只关注单个医院。本研究考察了三种医院所有权类型——非营利性、营利性和政府所有——以及它们之间的溢出效应。我们通过两种方式来估算营利性市场份额对医疗服务提供和三种类型医院经营利润的影响。研究发现，非营利性医院的医疗服务提供情况会因市场类型而有所变化。我们没有发现市场类型对非营利性医院经营利润有显著影响，但发现营利性医院在更多营利性占主导的市场中拥有更高的利润空间。这些结果最符合医院旨在最大化自身产出的理论。

abstract.text: This study draws on four waves of the 1997 National Longitudinal Survey of Youth and external data to examine the relationship between adolescent body mass index (BMI) and fast food prices and fast food restaurant availability using panel data estimation methods to account for individual-level unobserved heterogeneity. Analyses also control for contextual factors including general food prices and the availability of full-service restaurants, supermarkets, grocery stores, convenience stores and commercial physical activity-related facilities. The longitudinal individual-level fixed effects results confirm cross-sectional findings that the price of fast food but not the availability of fast food restaurants has a statistically significant effect on teen BMI with an estimated price elasticity of -0.08. The results suggest that the cross-sectional model over-estimates the price of fast food BMI effect by about 25%. There is evidence that the weight of teens in low- to middle-socioeconomic status families is most sensitive to fast food prices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.009.abstractZh: 本研究基于1997年《全国青少年纵向调查》的四个数据波以及外部数据，通过面板数据估计方法，探讨了青少年体质指数与快餐价格及快餐餐厅可用性之间的关系，同时考虑了个体层面的未观测异质性。分析还控制了包括一般食品价格、全服务餐厅的可用性、超市、杂货店、便利店以及与商业体育活动相关的设施等情境因素。纵向个体层面固定效应分析的结果证实了横截面研究结果：快餐价格而非快餐餐厅的可用性对青少年体质指数有显著的统计影响，其价格弹性估计值为-0.08。结果表明，横截面模型对快餐价格对体质指数影响的估计偏高约25%。有证据表明，来自低至中等社会经济地位家庭的青少年对快餐价格的敏感度最高。

abstract.text: The person tradeoff (PTO) is commonly used in health economic applications. However, to date it has no theoretical basis. The purpose of this paper is to provide this basis from a set of assumptions that together justify the most common applications of the PTO method. Our analysis identifies the central assumptions in PTO measurements. We test these assumptions in an experiment, but find only limited support for the validity of the PTO.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.010.abstractZh: “人-物权衡”（Person-Tradeoff，PTO）这一术语在健康经济学领域常被使用。然而，迄今为止，它尚未有理论基础。本文的目的是从一系列假设出发，为PTO方法最常见的应用提供理论基础。我们的分析确定了PTO测量中的核心假设。我们在实验中对这些假设进行了验证，但发现对PTO有效性的支持非常有限。

abstract.text: The Orphan Drug Act (ODA) was designed to spur the development of drugs for rare diseases. In principle, its design also incentivizes pharmaceutical firms to develop drugs for "rare" subdivisions of more prevalent diseases. I find that in response to this incentive, firms develop drugs for ODA-qualifying subdivisions of non-rare diseases. The impact in these tailored drug markets represents half of the total R&D response to the ODA. I also find that 10-percent of the innovation in subdivided disease drugs induced by the ODA would have been conducted without the policy. While modest in size, this inefficiency suggests that agency problems should be considered when designing innovation policy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.011.abstractZh: 《孤儿药法案》旨在促进针对罕见疾病药物的研发。从本质上讲，该法案还激励制药公司开发那些属于更常见疾病中的“罕见”分支的药品。我发现，作为对这一激励措施的响应，制药公司会开发符合《孤儿药法案》标准的非罕见疾病药品。这些定制药品市场所占据的研发投入占总量的半数。我还发现，如果没有这项政策，由《孤儿药法案》引发的针对细分疾病药品的创新活动，其规模仅为10%。尽管这一规模相对较小，但这种低效率表明，在制定创新政策时，应考虑机构层面的问题。

abstract.text: Previous research has estimated that food insecure children are more likely to suffer from a wide array of negative health outcomes than food secure children, leading many to claim that alleviating food insecurity would lead to better health outcomes. Identifying the causal impacts is problematic, however, given endogenous selection into food security status and potential mismeasurement of true food security status. Using recently developed nonparametric bounding methods and data from the 2001-2006 National Health and Nutritional Examination Survey (NHANES), we assess what can be identified about the effects of food insecurity on child health outcomes in the presence of nonrandom selection and nonclassical measurement error. Under relatively weak monotonicity assumptions, we can identify that food security has a statistically significant positive impact on favorable general health and being a healthy weight. Our work suggests that previous research has more likely underestimated than overestimated the causal impacts of food insecurity on health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.012.abstractZh: 先前的研究估计，食物不安全的儿童比食物安全的儿童更容易出现各种负面健康问题，因此许多人认为改善食物安全问题能够带来更好的健康结果。然而，由于食物安全状态的内生选择以及潜在的食物安全状态测量误差，确定因果影响存在困难。利用最近开发的非参数边界方法以及2001-2006年国民健康与营养调查的数据，我们评估了在非随机选择和非经典测量误差的情况下，食物不安全对儿童健康结果的影响。在相对较弱的单调性假设下，我们发现食物安全对良好的整体健康状况和健康的体重有显著的积极影响。我们的研究表明，先前的研究更有可能低估而非高估了食物不安全对健康的因果影响。

abstract.text: A whiplash is a sudden acceleration-deceleration of the neck and head, typically associated with a rear-end car collision that may produce injuries in the soft tissue. Often there are no objective signs or symptoms of injury, and diagnosing lasting whiplash-associated disorders (WAD) is difficult, in particular for individuals with mild or moderate injuries. This leaves a scope for compensation-seeking behaviour. The medical literature disagrees on the importance of this explanation. In this paper we trace the long-term earnings of a group of Danish individuals with mild to moderate injuries claiming compensation for having permanently lost earnings capacity and investigate if they return to their full pre-whiplash earnings when the insurance claim has been assessed. We find that about half of the claimants, those not granted compensation, return to an earnings level comparable with their pre-whiplash earnings suggesting that these individuals do not have chronic WAD in the sense that their earnings capacity is reduced. The other half, those granted compensation, experience persistent reductions in earnings relative to the case where they had not been exposed to a whiplash, even when they have a strong financial incentive to not reduce earnings. This suggests that moderate injuries tend to be chronic, and that compensation-seeking behaviour is not the main explanation for this group. We find that claimants with chronic WADs used more health care in the year prior to the whiplash than claimants with non-chronic cases. This suggests that lower initial health capital increases the risk that a whiplash causes persistent WAD.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.06.013.abstractZh: 颈部和头部的突然加速-减速现象被称为“挥鞭伤”，通常与汽车追尾事故相关，可能导致软组织损伤。通常，这种损伤没有明显的客观症状，因此诊断长期挥鞭伤相关疾病（WAD）较为困难，尤其是对于那些仅有轻度或中度损伤的人。这就为寻求赔偿的行为提供了可能。医学界对于这种解释的重要性存在分歧。在本文中，我们追踪了一组丹麦人的长期收入情况，这些人在遭受轻度至中度损伤后申请赔偿，声称自己因永久性丧失劳动能力而遭受了经济损失。我们调查了在保险索赔评估完成后，他们的收入是否恢复到受伤前的水平。我们发现，大约一半的索赔者，即那些未获得赔偿的人，其收入恢复到与受伤前相当的水平，这表明这些人并没有慢性挥鞭伤，即他们的劳动能力并未降低。而另一半获得赔偿的索赔者，即使有强烈的财务动机不减少收入，他们的收入仍然持续低于未遭受挥鞭伤的情况。这表明中度损伤往往具有慢性特征，而寻求赔偿的行为并不是导致这一群体出现这种情况的主要原因。我们还发现，患有慢性挥鞭伤的索赔者在受伤前一年使用的医疗服务比没有慢性挥鞭伤的索赔者更多。这表明较低的初始健康资本会增加挥鞭伤导致慢性挥鞭伤的风险。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a new approach to the measurement of inequality and inequity in the delivery of health care based on contributions from the literature on poverty and deprivation. This approach has some appealing characteristics: (1) inequity is additively decomposable by population subgroups; (2) the approach does not rely on socio-economic ranks; (3) it provides a graphical representation of the distribution of inequity; (4) it offers a range of indices consistent with dominance. An empirical application is provided investigating the effect of the GP fundholding reform on equity in English NHS. The results show that the most equitable GP practices self-selected into the scheme in 1991; evidence of an inequity-reducing treatment effect as well as a self-selection effect are found in 1992 and 1993; the self-selection process reduces and no evidence of a treatment effect is present thereafter.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.07.001.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于贫困与匮乏相关文献成果的新方法，用于衡量医疗保健服务中的不平等与不公平现象。该方法具有以下一些显著特点：(1) 不公平现象可以通过人口子群体进行加性分解；(2) 该方法不依赖于社会经济等级；(3) 它能够以图形形式展示不公平分布的状况；(4) 该方法提供了一系列与支配关系一致的指标。文中还提供了一个实证案例，研究GP基金持有改革对英国NHS公平性的影响。结果表明，1991年时，最公平的GP诊所主动选择加入该计划；1992年和1993年则发现了减少不公平现象的治疗效果以及自我选择效应；此后，自我选择过程导致不公平现象减少，且不再有治疗效果的迹象。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of recent federal and state level increases in the deductibility of health insurance premiums for self-employed individuals, which reduced the after-tax price of health insurance, on both the take-up of coverage and the amount of insurance purchased. Using a panel of tax returns filed by self-employed taxpayers from 1999 to 2004, we estimate a take-up elasticity of -0.316 overall, with significantly higher elasticities for single taxpayers. On the intensive margin, we find an elasticity of -0.733 overall.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.07.002.abstractZh: 本文估计了最近联邦和州级对个体经营者健康保险保费扣除额的增加对保险覆盖率的采纳率和所购买保险金额的影响。通过分析1999至2004年间个体纳税人提交的税务申报表，我们得出整体采纳率弹性为-0.316，而单身纳税人的弹性则更高。在密集型分析中，我们发现整体弹性为-0.733。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes sickness absenteeism among self-employed in the Netherlands. Using a unique data set provided by a large Dutch private insurance company, we assess the determinants of sick leave durations. Our study suggests that several risk factors affect the sick leave durations of self-employed in a similar way as they influence the absence spells of employees according to the literature. For example, the recovery rate decreases with age and claimants suffering from psychological diseases have a lower recovery rate relative to claimants with other disorders. Furthermore, the sick leave durations of self-employed last longer when the economy is booming. In contrast to what the literature generally documents for employees, we do not find any evidence for moral hazard effects with respect to the benefit compensation level. Moreover, the absence spells of self-employed last longer in periods of high unemployment, whereas the opposite effect is usually documented for employees. We do not establish any significant gender differences in the sick leave durations of self-employed. Contract-specific factors such as insurance brand and deferment period are typical characteristics of insurance contracts for self-employed and play an important role in explaining their sick leave durations. Finally, the introduction of insurer-based case management significantly increased the recovery rate of self-employed with an ongoing spell up to 1 year. By contrast, case management did not succeed in improving the recovery rate of claimants trapped in long-term sickness absence.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.07.003.abstractZh: 本文分析了荷兰个体经营者中的病假现象。利用一家大型荷兰私人保险公司提供的独特数据集，我们评估了影响病假持续时间的因素。研究表明，与文献中描述的员工缺勤情况类似，多个风险因素会影响个体经营者的病假持续时间。例如，康复率随年龄增长而下降，患有心理疾病的索赔者相对于其他疾病的索赔者而言，康复率较低。此外，在经济繁荣时期，个体经营者的病假持续时间更长。与文献中通常描述的员工情况不同，我们没有发现与福利补偿水平相关的道德风险效应。此外，在高失业率时期，个体经营者的缺勤时间更长，而通常对于员工来说，这种效应是相反的。我们没有发现个体经营者的病假持续时间存在显著的性别差异。与保险合约相关的特定因素，如保险品牌和延期期限，是个体经营者保险合约的典型特征，并在解释其病假持续时间方面起着重要作用。最后，引入基于保险公司的病例管理后，持续病假长达一年的个体经营者的康复率显著提高。相比之下，病例管理未能改善长期病假索赔者的康复率。

abstract.text: Many economists have argued that income is an inadequate indicator of welfare. In this paper, we conduct a multivariate analysis of the distribution of individual welfare in China at three selected time points: 1991, 1997 and 2006. Instead of using income as the only welfare indicator as in most distributional analyses, we explicitly consider the role of health in welfare distribution. We adopt the Naga and Geoffard (2006) decomposition method by which we can decompose a bidimensional welfare inequality index into two univariate Atkinson-Kolm-Sen indices that measure the inequalities in health and income, and a third term that measures the contribution from the joint distribution of the two attributes to total inequality. We show that the third term might be used as an alternative to the concentration index to measure the income-related inequality in health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.08.001.abstractZh: 许多经济学家认为，收入并非衡量福利的恰当指标。在本文中，我们对中国个体福利分布进行了多变量分析，研究的时间点分别为1991年、1997年和2006年。与大多数分配分析仅以收入作为唯一福利指标不同，我们明确考虑了健康在福利分配中的作用。我们采用了Naga和Geoffard（2006年）的分解方法，将二维福利不平等指数分解为两个单变量Atkinson-Kolm-Sen指数，分别衡量健康与收入的不平等程度，以及第三个指标，用于衡量这两种属性共同分布对总不平等的贡献。研究表明，第三个指标可以作为浓度指数的替代指标，用于衡量与健康相关的收入不平等。

abstract.text: This paper investigates household purchasing behavior in response to differing alcohol and tobacco taxes near an international border. Our study suggests that large tax differentials near borders induce economically important tax avoidance behavior, which may limit a government's ability to raise revenue and potentially undermine important health and social policy goals. We match novel supermarket scanner and consumer expenditure data to measure the size and scope of the effect for households and stores. We find that stores near/far from the international border have statistically significantly lower/higher sales of beer and tobacco than comparable stores far/near the border. Moreover, we find that households near the border report higher consumption of these same goods. This is consistent with households facing lower prices. Finally, we find measures of externalities associated with these goods are higher near the border.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.08.002.abstractZh: 本文研究了家庭在面临不同国际边境附近的酒精和烟草税变化时所采取的购买行为。我们的研究表明，边境附近较大的税收差异会引发重要的税收规避行为，这可能会限制政府增加收入的能力，并可能破坏重要的健康和社会政策目标。我们通过新颖的超市扫描数据及消费者支出数据来衡量这种效应对家庭和商店的影响大小和范围。研究发现，靠近或远离国际边境的商店在啤酒和烟草的销售量存在统计学上的显著差异。此外，我们还发现，靠近边境的家庭对这些商品的消费量更高。这与家庭面临更低价格的情况一致。最后，我们发现与这些商品相关的外部性在边境附近更为显著。

abstract.text: Small-area-variation studies have shown that physician treatment styles differ substantially both between and within markets, controlling for patient characteristics. Using data on the universe of deliveries in Florida and New York over a 15-year period, we examine why treatment styles differ across obstetricians at a point in time and why styles change over time. We find that variation in c-section rates across physicians within a market is about twice as large as variation between markets. Surprisingly, residency programs explain no more than four percent of the variation in physicians' risk-adjusted c-section rates, even among newly trained physicians. Although we find evidence that physicians learn from their peers, they do not substantially revise their prior beliefs regarding treatment due to the local exchange of information. Our results indicate that physicians are not likely to converge over time to a community standard; thus, within-market variation in treatment styles is likely to persist.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.08.003.abstractZh: 小区域差异研究表明，即使在控制患者特征的情况下，不同医生的治疗风格在市场和市场内部也存在显著差异。我们利用佛罗里达州和纽约15年期间的分娩数据，探讨为什么不同时期不同产科医生的治疗风格会有所不同，以及为什么这些风格会随时间变化。我们发现，同一市场中不同医生之间的剖宫产率差异大约是市场间差异的两倍。令人惊讶的是，即使是在新培训的医生中，住院医师培训项目对医生风险调整后的剖宫产率差异的解释程度也仅达到4%。虽然我们发现医生会从同行那里学习，但他们并不会因为当地的信息交流而大幅修改之前关于治疗的信念。我们的研究结果表明，医生不太可能随着时间而趋向于一个共同的行业标准；因此，市场内部的治疗风格差异很可能会持续存在。

abstract.text: Scandals of selective reporting of clinical trial results by pharmaceutical firms have underlined the need for more transparency in clinical trials. We provide a theoretical framework which reproduces incentives for selective reporting and yields three key implications concerning regulation. First, a compulsory clinical trial registry complemented through a voluntary clinical trial results database can implement full transparency (the existence of all trials as well as their results is known). Second, full transparency comes at a price. It has a deterrence effect on the incentives to conduct clinical trials, as it reduces the firms' gains from trials. Third, in principle, a voluntary clinical trial results database without a compulsory registry is a superior regulatory tool; but we provide some qualified support for additional compulsory registries when medical decision-makers cannot anticipate correctly the drug companies' decisions whether to conduct trials.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.08.004.abstractZh: 制药公司选择性报道临床试验结果的丑闻凸显了临床试验中增加透明度的必要性。我们提供了一个理论框架，该框架解释了选择性报道的动机，并提出了三个关于监管的关键启示。首先，通过自愿性临床试验结果数据库补充强制性临床试验登记系统，可以实现完全透明（所有试验及其结果都为人所知）。其次，完全透明是有代价的。它会对进行临床试验的动机产生抑制作用，因为减少了制药公司从试验中获得的收益。第三，原则上，没有强制性登记系统的自愿性临床试验结果数据库是更优的监管工具；但当我们无法准确预测制药公司是否进行试验时，我们提供了一些支持额外强制性登记系统的理由。

abstract.text: We examine the impact that medical research published in peer-reviewed journals has on the practice of medicine. We exploit the release of a recent New England Journal of Medicine article which demonstrated that the risks of attempting a vaginal birth after having a previous C-section birth (VBAC) were higher than previously thought. We find that immediately following this article, the national VBAC rate dropped by 16% and this change was largest among more educated mothers, particularly those with a graduate degree.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.08.005.abstractZh: 我们研究了发表在同行评审期刊上的医学研究对医学实践的影响。我们利用《新英格兰医学杂志》最近发表的一篇文章作为研究依据，该文章指出，在之前有过剖宫产分娩的情况下尝试阴道分娩的风险比之前认为的要高。我们发现，在该文章发表后不久，全国阴道分娩的尝试率下降了16%，这一变化在受教育程度较高的母亲中最为明显，尤其是那些拥有研究生学位的母亲。

abstract.text: Rankings and report cards have become a popular way of providing information in a variety of domains. I estimate the response to rankings in the hospital market and find that hospitals that improve their rank are able to attract significantly more patients. The average hospital in my sample experiences a 5% change in non-emergency, Medicare patient volume from year to year due to rank changes. These findings have implications regarding the competitiveness of hospital markets and the effect that the dissemination of quality information in hospital markets can have on individual choice.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.08.006.abstractZh: 排名和报告卡已成为提供各种领域信息的常见方式。我估算了医院市场中对排名的反应，发现排名提升的医院能够吸引更多患者。在我的样本中，平均每家医院的非紧急医疗医保患者数量每年会因排名变化而发生变化，变化幅度为5%。这些发现对于了解医院市场的竞争态势以及质量信息在医院市场中的传播对个人选择的影响具有重要意义。

abstract.text: While there is little doubt that the probability of poor health increases with age, and that less healthy people face a more difficult situation on the labor market, the precise relationship between facing the risks of health deterioration and labor market instability is not well understood. Using 12 years of data from the German Socio-Economic Panel we study the nature of the relationship between poor health and non-employment on a sample of German men aged 30-59. We propose a joint model of health and labor market risks which identifies the mechanism through which poor health contributes to the probability of being jobless and vice versa. We find an important role of unobserved heterogeneity and evidence for correlation in the unobservable characteristics determining the two processes. The results also show strong persistence in the dynamics of health and labor market risks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.09.001.abstractZh: 虽然毫无疑问，健康状况不佳的概率会随着年龄的增长而增加，而且健康状况较差的人在劳动力市场上的处境也会更加艰难，但健康状况恶化风险与劳动力市场不稳定之间的具体关系尚未得到充分理解。我们利用德国社会经济面板数据中的12年数据，研究了30-59岁的德国男性样本中健康状况不佳与非就业之间的关联。我们提出了一个关于健康和劳动力市场风险的联合模型，以揭示健康状况不佳如何增加失业的可能性，反之亦然。研究发现，未观察到的异质性在这两个过程之间起着重要作用，并且存在相关性的证据。结果还表明，健康和劳动力市场风险的变化具有强烈的持续性。

abstract.text: Most health care evaluations today still assume expected utility even though the descriptive deficiencies of expected utility are well known. Prospect theory is the dominant descriptive alternative for expected utility. This paper tests whether prospect theory leads to better health evaluations than expected utility. The approach is purely descriptive: we explore how simple measurements together with prospect theory and expected utility predict choices and rankings between more complex stimuli. For decisions involving risk prospect theory is significantly more consistent with rankings and choices than expected utility. This conclusion no longer holds when we use prospect theory utilities and expected utilities to predict intertemporal decisions. The latter finding cautions against the common assumption in health economics that health state utilities are transferable across decision contexts. Our results suggest that the standard gamble and algorithms based on, should not be used to value health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.09.002.abstractZh: 如今，大多数医疗保健评估仍然采用期望效用模型，尽管期望效用的描述性缺陷早已为人所知。前景理论是期望效用模型的主要替代理论。本文旨在检验前景理论是否比期望效用模型更能准确评估健康状况。我们的研究纯粹是描述性的：我们探讨了简单测量方法结合前景理论和期望效用模型如何预测更复杂的刺激因素下的选择和排序。在涉及风险的决定中，前景理论在排序和选择方面的表现明显优于期望效用模型。然而，当使用前景理论效用和期望效用模型来预测跨时间决策时，这一结论不再成立。这一发现提醒我们，在健康经济学中不应假设健康状态的效用可以在不同的决策情境之间转移。我们的研究结果表明，标准的赌博模型以及基于该模型的算法不应被用于评估健康状况的价值。

abstract.text: Waiting-time targets are used by policy makers to monitor providers' performance. Such targets are based on the distribution of the patients on the list. We compare and link such distribution with the distribution of waiting time of patients treated, as opposed to on the list, which is a better measure of total disutility from waiting (although can only be calculated retrospectively). We show that the latter can be calculated from the former, and vice versa. We also show that, depending on how the hazard rate varies with time waited, the proportion of patients on the list waiting more than x periods can be higher or lower than the proportion of patients treated waiting more than x periods. However, empirically we find that the proportion of patients waiting on the list more than x months is smaller than our estimate of the proportion of patients treated waiting more than x months.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.09.003.abstractZh: 等待时间目标被政策制定者用来监控提供者的表现。这些目标基于名单上患者的分布情况。我们将这种分布与接受治疗的患者等待时间的分布进行比较和关联，而名单上的分布则是衡量等待总不便利程度的更好指标（尽管只能进行事后计算）。我们表明，后者可以从前者计算得出，反之亦然。我们还发现，根据等待时间变化规律的不同，名单上等待超过x周期的患者比例可能高于或低于接受治疗的患者中等待超过x周期的比例。然而，从经验来看，名单上等待超过x个月的患者比例低于我们对接受治疗的患者中等待超过x个月的比例的估计。

abstract.text: We study the short-run effect of involuntary job loss on comprehensive measures of public health costs. We focus on job loss induced by plant closure, thereby addressing the reverse causality problem as job displacements due to plant closure are unlikely caused by workers' health status, but potentially have important effects on individual workers' health and associated public health costs. Our empirical analysis is based on a rich data set from Austria providing comprehensive information on various types of health care costs and day-by-day work history at the individual level. Our central findings are (i) overall expenditures on medical treatments are not strongly affected by job displacement; (ii) job loss significantly increases expenditures for antidepressants and related drugs, as well as for hospitalizations due to mental health problems for men (but not for women) although the effects are economically rather small; and (iii) sickness benefits strongly increase due to job loss.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.09.004.abstractZh: 我们研究了非自愿失业对公共健康成本综合指标在短期内的影响。我们重点关注由工厂关闭引起的失业问题，因此要解决反向因果关系的问题——因为工厂关闭导致的失业不太可能由工人的健康状况引起，但可能会对个体工人的健康以及相关的公共健康成本产生重要影响。我们的实证分析基于来自奥地利的丰富数据集，该数据集提供了关于各种类型医疗成本以及个人日常工作历史的全面信息。我们的主要发现包括：(i) 总体医疗支出并未受到失业的强烈影响；(ii) 失业显著增加了抗抑郁药及相关药物的支出，以及男性因心理健康问题而住院的费用（但女性则没有这种情况），尽管这些影响在经济上相当微小；(iii) 因失业而产生的疾病保险支出显著增加。

abstract.text: This paper presents an application of the Urban and Lambert "upgraded-AJL Decomposition" approach that was designed to deal with the problem of close-income equals in equity analysis, and as applied to the area of health care finance. Contrary to most previous studies, vertical and horizontal inequities and the triple effects of inter-groups, intra-group and entire-group reranking of various financing schemes are estimated, with statistical significance calculated using the bootstrap method. Application is made on the three financing schemes present in the case of the Occupied Palestinian Territory. Results demonstrate the relative importance of the three forms of reranking in determining overall inequality. The paper offers policy recommendations to limit the existing inequalities in the system and to enhance the capacity of the governmental insurance scheme.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2009.09.005.abstractZh: 本文介绍了Urban和Lambert提出的“升级-AJL分解”方法的应用，该方法旨在解决权益分析中收入差距问题，并应用于医疗保健金融领域。与大多数先前的研究不同，本文还估算了垂直和水平不平等现象，以及不同融资方案在群体间、群体内和整个群体中的三重效应，并使用自助法计算统计显著性。研究案例选取了被占领巴勒斯坦领土的三种融资方案。结果表明，这三种重新排序形式在决定整体不平等程度方面具有相对重要性。本文还提出了政策建议，以限制系统中的现有不平等现象，并提高政府保险计划的能力。

abstract.text: Efforts to understand how to improve the delivery of substance abuse treatment have led to a recent call for studies on the "business of addiction treatment." This study adapts an innovative survey tool to collect baseline management practice data from 147 addiction treatment programs enrolled in the Network for the Improvement of Addiction Treatment 200 project. Measures of "good" management practice were strongly associated with days to treatment admission. Management practice scores were weakly associated with revenues per employee but were not correlated with operating margins. Better management practices were more prevalent among programs with a higher number of competitors in their catchment area.

10.1016/j.jsat.2008.11.002.abstractZh: 为了了解如何改进物质滥用治疗的提供方式，最近有研究呼吁对“成瘾治疗业务”进行探讨。本研究采用了一种创新的调查工具，从参与“200项目——成瘾治疗改进网络”的147个成瘾治疗项目中收集了管理实践的基线数据。结果显示，“良好”的管理实践与接受治疗所需的天数密切相关。管理实践得分与每位员工收入之间存在弱相关性，但并未与经营利润率相关。在竞争环境较为激烈的地区，采用更优秀管理实践的项目数量更多。

abstract.text: The expansion of health insurance coverage in the United States is likely to be on the front burner of health care reform efforts in the new presidential administration. But boiling on the back burner is perhaps the most serious threat to Americans' access to care: rapid growth in health care costs.Pessimism abounds. Most observers see rising costs as an inexorable force, blame advancing technology, and conclude that only by rationing beneficial care or making draconian price cuts can we slow the growth of health care costs.But a careful look at variations in spending growth and spending patterns among . . .

10.1056/nejmp0809794.abstractZh: 美国医疗保险覆盖范围的扩大可能会成为新总统政府医疗改革工作的重点。但或许最严重的问题被忽视了：医疗费用的高速增长。悲观情绪普遍存在。大多数观察家认为，成本的上升是一种不可阻挡的趋势，他们将责任归咎于技术的进步，并得出结论：只有通过限制医疗服务或实施严厉的价格削减措施，才能减缓医疗费用的上涨。但仔细审视不同地区的支出增长和支出模式……

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Reducing rates of rehospitalization has attracted attention from policymakers as a way to improve quality of care and reduce costs. However, we have limited information on the frequency and patterns of rehospitalization in the United States to aid in planning the necessary changes. METHODS: We analyzed Medicare claims data from 2003-2004 to describe the patterns of rehospitalization and the relation of rehospitalization to demographic characteristics of the patients and to characteristics of the hospitals. RESULTS: Almost one fifth (19.6%) of the 11,855,702 Medicare beneficiaries who had been discharged from a hospital were rehospitalized within 30 days, and 34.0% were rehospitalized within 90 days; 67.1% [corrected] of patients who had been discharged with medical conditions and 51.5% of those who had been discharged after surgical procedures were rehospitalized or died within the first year after discharge. In the case of 50.2% [corrected] of the patients who were rehospitalized within 30 days after a medical discharge to the community, there was no bill for a visit to a physician's office between the time of discharge and rehospitalization. Among patients who were rehospitalized within 30 days after a surgical discharge, 70.5% were rehospitalized for a medical condition. We estimate that about 10% of rehospitalizations were likely to have been planned. The average stay of rehospitalized patients was 0.6 day longer than that of patients in the same diagnosis-related group whose most recent hospitalization had been at least 6 months previously. We estimate that the cost to Medicare of unplanned rehospitalizations in 2004 was $17.4 billion. CONCLUSIONS: Rehospitalizations among Medicare beneficiaries are prevalent and costly.

10.1056/nejmsa0803563.abstractZh:
背景：降低再住院率已成为政策制定者关注的重点，因为这有助于改善护理质量并降低成本。然而，关于美国再住院的频率和模式，我们掌握的信息有限，这不利于规划必要的变革。  
方法：我们分析了2003-2004年的Medicare索赔数据，以了解再住院的模式以及再住院与患者的人口统计特征及医院特征之间的关系。  
结果：在11,855,702名从医院出院的Medicare受益人中，近五分之一（19.6%）在30天内再次住院，34.0%在90天内再次住院；有医疗状况的出院患者中有67.1% [修正后]在出院后一年内再次住院或死亡；在50.2%的出院后30天内再次住院的患者中，出院到再次住院期间没有进行过医生门诊就诊的记录。在出院后30天内再次住院的患者中，有70.5%是因为医疗状况而再次住院。我们估计，大约10%的再住院可能是有计划的。再住院患者的平均住院时间比最近一次住院至少已过去6个月的相同诊断组患者长0.6天。我们估计，2004年Medicare因非计划性再住院而产生的费用达174亿美元。  
结论：Medicare受益者的再住院现象普遍存在且成本较高。

abstract.text: We document evidence of a persistent "early entry" advantage for brands in 34 consumer packaged goods industries across the 50 largest U.S. cities. Current market shares are higher in markets closest to a brand's historic city of origin than in those farthest. For six industries, we know the order of entry among the top brands in each of the markets. We find an early entry effect on a brand's current market share and perceived quality across U.S. cities. The magnitude of this effect typically drives the rank order of market shares and perceived quality levels across cities.

10.1086/597301.abstractZh: 我们记录了在美国50个最大城市中，34个消费品行业中的品牌在“早期进入”方面具有持续的优势。在距离品牌历史发源地最近的市场中，品牌的市场份额通常高于距离最远的市场。对于六个行业，我们了解每个市场中顶级品牌进入市场的顺序。我们发现，早期进入对品牌在美国各城市的当前市场份额和感知质量都有影响。这种影响的程度通常决定了各城市之间市场份额和感知质量水平的排名顺序。

abstract.text: A number of authors have argued that the conventional model of unemployment dynamics due to Mortensen and Pissarides has difficulty accounting for the relatively volatile behavior of labor market activity over the business cycle. We address this issue by modifying the Mortensen-Pissarides framework to allow for staggered multiperiod wage contracting. What emerges is a tractable relation for wage dynamics that is a natural generalization of the period-by-period Nash bargaining outcome in the conventional formulation. We then show that a reasonable calibration of the model can account for the cyclical behavior of wages and labor market activity observed in the data.

10.1086/597302.abstractZh: 一些学者认为，Mortensen和Pissarides提出的传统失业动态模型难以解释劳动力市场活动在商业周期中的波动现象。我们通过修改Mortensen-Pissarides的模型框架，引入分阶段的多期工资契约机制，从而解决了这一问题。结果表明，这种模型能够提供一个易于处理的工资动态模型，该模型实际上是传统模型中逐期纳什谈判结果的自然推广。此外，我们还证明了，通过合理校准模型参数，可以很好地解释数据中观察到的工资和劳动力市场活动的周期性变化。

abstract.text: We analyze the effects of competition on price dispersion in the airline industry, using panel data from 1993:Q1 through 2006:Q3. Competition has a negative effect on price dispersion, in line with the textbook treatment of price discrimination. This effect is pronounced for routes with consumers characterized by relatively heterogeneous elasticities of demand. On routes with a homogeneous customer base, the effects of competition on price dispersion are smaller. Our results contrast with those of Borenstein and Rose, who found that price dispersion increases with competition. We reconcile the different results by showing that the cross-sectional estimator suffers from omitted-variable bias.

10.1086/597328.abstractZh: 我们分析了竞争对航空业价格离散度的影响，使用了1993年第一季度到2006年第三季度的面板数据。竞争对价格离散度有负面影响，这与关于价格歧视的教科书理论一致。这种影响在需求弹性相对异质性的航线中更为明显。而在客户基础较为同质的航线中，竞争对价格离散度的影响较小。我们的结果与Borenstein和Rose的研究结果相反，他们发现竞争会导致价格离散度增加。我们通过分析横截面估计量存在遗漏变量偏差这一因素，解释了这些不同的结果。

abstract.text: The Lagos-Wright model-a monetary model in which pairwise meetings alternate in time with a centralized meeting-has been extensively analyzed, but always using particular trading protocols. Here, trading protocols are replaced by two alternative notions of implementability: one that allows only individual defections and one that also allows cooperative defections in meetings. It is shown that the first-best allocation is implementable under the stricter notion without taxation if people are sufficiently patient. And, if people are free to skip the centralized meeting, then lump-sum taxation used to pay interest on money does not enlarge the set of implementable allocations.

10.1086/597597.abstractZh: Lagos-Wright模型是一种货币模型，其中两两会议在时间上交替进行，同时还有一个集中的会议环节。该模型已被广泛研究，但始终采用特定的交易协议。在这里，交易协议被两种替代的可实施性概念所取代：一种只允许个人缺席，另一种则允许在会议中采取合作性的缺席策略。研究表明，如果人们有足够的耐心，那么在更严格的可实施性概念下，最优分配方案是可行的，且无需征税。此外，如果人们可以自由跳过集中的会议，那么用于支付货币利息的定额征税并不会扩大可实施分配方案的范围。

abstract.text: Who benefits from agricultural subsidies is an open question. Economic theory predicts that the entire subsidy incidence should be on the farmland owners. Using a complementary set of policy quasi experiments, I find that farmers who rent the land they cultivate capture 75 percent of the subsidy, leaving just 25 percent for landowners. This finding contradicts the prediction from neoclassical models. The standard prediction may not hold because of less than perfect competition in the farmland rental market; the share captured by landowners increases with local measures of competitiveness in the farmland rental market.

10.1086/598688.abstractZh: 谁从农业补贴中获益仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。经济理论预测，所有的补贴都应该分配给农田所有者。通过一系列补充性的政策实验，我发现，那些租用自己耕种土地的农民占据了75%的补贴，而土地所有者仅获得25%的补贴。这一发现与新古典模型的预测相矛盾。由于农田租赁市场存在不完全竞争，标准的预测可能并不成立；土地所有者获得的补贴比例会随着当地农田租赁市场的竞争程度而上升。

abstract.text: We infer determinants of Latin American hyperinflations and stabilizations by using the method of maximum likelihood to estimate a hidden Markov model that assigns roles both to fundamentals in the form of government deficits that are financed by money creation and to destabilizing expectations dynamics that can occasionally divorce inflation from fundamentals. Levels and conditional volatilities of monetized deficits drove most hyperinflations and stabilizations, with a notable exception in Peru, where a cosmetic reform of the type emphasized by Marcet and Nicolini occurred.

10.1086/599014.abstractZh: 我们通过最大似然法估计一个隐藏马尔可夫模型，以推断拉丁美洲恶性通货膨胀和稳定化的决定因素。该模型同时考虑了由货币创造融资的政府赤字这一基本因素，以及可能使通货膨胀脱离基本因素的不稳定预期动态。货币化赤字的水平和条件波动性是推动大多数恶性通货膨胀和稳定化的主要因素，但秘鲁的情况有所不同，那里发生了Marcet和Nicolini所强调的那种表面性改革。

abstract.text: Because California was a pioneer in the development of large-scale branching, we use its experience during the 1920s and 1930s to assess the effects of branching on competition and on the stability of banking systems. Using individual bank balance sheets, income statements, and branch establishment data, we show that smaller incumbent banks responded to the entry of a large branch bank by adjusting their operations in a manner consistent with increased efficiency. Competition from branching networks also produced an externality: unit banks exposed to this competition were more likely to survive the Great Depression than banks not exposed to it.

10.1086/599015.abstractZh: 由于加利福尼亚州在大规模分支机构发展方面处于领先地位，我们借鉴了20世纪20年代和30年代的经验，来评估分支机构对竞争以及银行系统稳定性的影响。通过研究单个银行的资产负债表、损益表以及分支机构设立数据，我们发现，规模较小的现有银行在面对大型分支银行的进入时，会调整其经营方式，以提高效率。此外，分支机构的竞争还产生了一种外部效应：受到这种竞争影响的银行比未受到影响的银行更有可能在大萧条期间存活下来。

abstract.text: Recessions appear to be times when the marginal rate of substitution between goods and workers' time falls below the marginal product of labor. If so, the allocation of workers' time is inefficient. I develop a model of households and production that reconciles cyclical movements in the marginal value of time and the marginal product. The model embodies the findings of research that the Frisch elasticity of labor supply is less than one. It treats unemployment in a search-and-matching setup. Recessions do not result in private inefficiency in the allocation of labor, but the unemployment rate may be socially inefficiently high.

10.1086/599022.abstractZh: 经济衰退似乎是指商品与工人时间之间的边际替代率低于劳动边际产出的时期。在这种情况下，工人时间的分配效率较低。我提出了一个家庭与生产的模型，该模型能够协调时间边际价值与边际产出的周期性变化。该模型体现了相关研究的发现，即劳动力供给的弗里希弹性小于1。该模型在搜索与匹配的背景下处理失业问题。经济衰退并不会导致私人层面在劳动力分配上的效率低下，但失业率可能会在社会层面上显得过高，从而影响效率。

abstract.text: This paper studies the role of product discovery in the demand for recorded music. We show that releasing a new album causes a substantial and permanent increase in sales of the artist's old albums-especially if the new release is a hit. Patterns in these "backward spillovers" suggest that they result from consumers discovering the artist upon hearing the new release. To explore the implications of consumers' incomplete information, we estimate a simple, learning-based model of market demand. Our results imply that the distribution of sales is substantially more skewed than it would be if consumers were more fully informed.

10.1086/599283.abstractZh: 本文研究了产品发现对录制音乐需求的作用。我们发现，新专辑的发行会导致艺术家旧专辑的销量出现显著且持久的增长——尤其是当新专辑大获成功时。这些“逆向溢出效应”表明，消费者是在听到新专辑后才发现这位艺术家的。为了探讨消费者信息不完全所带来的影响，我们建立了一个基于学习的简单市场需求模型。我们的研究结果表明，如果消费者拥有更完整的信息，那么销售分布的偏斜程度将会大大降低。

abstract.text: The Collective Clemency Bill passed by the Italian Parliament in July 2006 represents a natural experiment to analyze the behavioral response of individuals to an exogenous manipulation of prison sentences. On the basis of a unique data set on the postrelease behavior of former inmates, we find that 1 month less time served in prison commuted into 1 month more in expected sentence for future crimes reduces the probability of recidivism by 0.16 percentage points. From this result we estimate an elasticity of average recidivism with respect to the expected punishment equal to - 0.74 for a 7-month period.

10.1086/599286.abstractZh: 2006年7月，意大利议会通过了《集体宽恕法案》，这相当于一个自然实验，用于分析个体对监狱刑期外源性操控的行为反应。基于关于前囚犯出狱后行为的独特数据集，我们发现，在监狱服刑时间减少1个月的情况下，未来犯罪行为的预期刑期会相应增加1个月，这一变化可以将再犯的概率降低0.16个百分点。根据这一结果，我们估计，在7个月的时间内，平均再犯率与预期惩罚之间的弹性为-0.74。

abstract.text: Global financial imbalances can result from financial integration when countries differ in financial markets development. Countries with more advanced financial markets accumulate foreign liabilities in a gradual, long-lasting process. Differences in financial development also affect the composition of foreign portfolios: countries with negative net foreign asset positions maintain positive net holdings of nondiversifiable equity and foreign direct investment. Three observations motivate our analysis: (1) financial development varies widely even among industrial countries, with the United States on top; (2) the secular decline in the U.S. net foreign asset position started in the early 1980s, together with a gradual process of international financial integration; (3) the portfolio composition of U.S. net foreign assets features increased holdings of risky assets and a large increase in debt.

10.1086/599706.abstractZh: 全球金融失衡可能源于金融一体化，当各国在金融市场发展上存在差异时就会出现这种情况。金融市场较为发达的国家会在一个渐进且持续的过程中积累外部债务。金融发展的差异还会影响外国投资组合的构成：那些净外国资产为负的国家，其非多元化股权和外国直接投资持有量却保持正值。我们的分析基于以下三个观察结果：（1）即使是在工业国家之间，金融发展也存在很大差异，美国处于领先地位；（2）美国净外国资产地位的长期下降始于20世纪80年代初，与此同时，国际金融一体化进程也在逐步推进；（3）美国净外国资产的投资组合构成表现为高风险资产持有量增加，同时债务水平也大幅上升。

abstract.text: This paper tests whether the behavior of corrupt officials is consistent with standard industrial organization theory. We designed a study in which surveyors accompanied Indonesian truck drivers on 304 trips, during which they observed over 6,000 illegal payments to police, soldiers, and weigh station attendants. Using plausibly exogenous changes in the number of checkpoints, we show that market structure affects the level of illegal payments. We further show that corrupt officials use complex pricing schemes, including third-degree price discrimination and a menu of two-part tariffs. Our findings illustrate the importance of considering the market structure for bribes when designing anticorruption policy.

10.1086/599707.abstractZh: 本文探讨了腐败官员的行为是否符合标准产业组织理论。我们设计了一项研究，让调查员陪同印度尼西亚的卡车司机进行了304次行程，期间他们观察到超过6,000起向警察、士兵和称重站工作人员进行的非法支付行为。通过模拟检查点数量的变动，我们发现市场结构会影响非法支付的程度。此外，我们还发现腐败官员采用了复杂的定价策略，包括三级价格歧视以及双部分定价等多种手段。我们的研究结果表明，在制定反腐败政策时，考虑市场结构对于评估贿赂行为的重要性不言而喻。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of Russia's 2001 flat rate income tax reform on consumption, income, and tax evasion. We use the gap between household expenditures and reported earnings as a proxy for tax evasion with data from a household panel for 1998-2004. We associate large and significant changes in tax evasion following the flat tax reform with changes in voluntary compliance. We develop a consumption-based framework to assess the deadweight loss from income tax in the presence of tax evasion and show that the efficiency gains from the reform are at least 30 percent smaller than the gains implied by conventional approaches.

10.1086/599760.abstractZh: 我们研究了俄罗斯2001年统一所得税改革对消费、收入和逃税行为的影响。我们采用1998-2004年家庭面板数据中的家庭支出与报告收入之间的差距作为逃税行为的指标。我们发现，统一税制改革后逃税行为的显著变化与自愿遵从度的变化密切相关。我们基于消费框架来评估在逃税行为存在的情况下所得税制度造成的无谓损失，并表明改革带来的效率提升至少比传统方法所预测的要小30%。

abstract.text: We compare the empirical performance of a standard incomplete markets asset pricing model with that of a novel model with constrained Pareto-optimal allocations. We represent the models' stochastic discount factors in terms of the cross-sectional distribution of consumption and use these representations to evaluate the models' empirical implications. The first model is inconsistent with the equity premium in the United States, United Kingdom, and Italy. The second model is consistent with the equity premium and the risk-free rate in all three countries if the coefficient of relative risk aversion is roughly 5 and the quarterly discount factor is less than 0.5.

10.1086/599761.abstractZh: 我们比较了标准的不完全市场资产定价模型的实证表现，以及一种具有约束性帕累托最优分配的新型模型的实证表现。我们用消费的横截面分布来表示模型的随机贴现因子，并通过这些表示来评估模型的实证含义。第一个模型与美国、英国和意大利的股票溢价不一致。第二个模型在所有三个国家都与股票溢价和无风险利率一致，前提是相对风险厌恶系数大约为5，且季度贴现因子小于0.5。

abstract.text: I study whether households make Pareto-efficient intrahousehold resource allocation decisions. Combining randomized variation in women's income generated by the evaluation of the Mexican PROGRESA program with variation attributable to localized rainfall shocks as distribution factors in the collective model, I find evidence favoring Pareto optimality. More specifically, female-specific income changes have positive effects on children's goods expenditures, whereas changes due to rainfall shocks have a smaller influence on household public goods expenditures. The evidence is consistent with female partners having greater sensitivity to own-income changes and norms that oblige women to devote their earnings to meet collective consumption needs.

10.1086/600076.abstractZh: 我研究了家庭是否做出了帕累托效率高的内部资源分配决策。通过将墨西哥PROGRESA计划评估导致的女性收入随机变化，与因局部降雨冲击导致的分布因素变化结合起来，我在模型中发现了支持帕累托最优性的证据。具体来说，女性收入的变化对儿童的商品支出有积极影响，而降雨冲击导致的收入变化对家庭公共物品的支出影响较小。这些证据表明，女性伴侣对自身收入变化的敏感度更高，并且存在一种规范，要求女性将收入用于满足集体消费需求。

abstract.text: Suppose that the nominal money supply could be cut literally overnight. What would happen to prices, wages, and output? Such an experiment was carried out three times in France in 1724, resulting in a cumulative 45 percent cut. Prices adjusted instantaneously and fully on the foreign exchange market. Prices of commodities and of manufactured goods and industrial wages fell slowly, over many months, and not by the full amount of the nominal reduction. The industrial sector experienced a contraction of 30 percent. When the government changed course and increased the nominal money supply overnight by 20 percent, prices responded more, and industry rebounded.

10.1086/605130.abstractZh: 假设名义货币供应量可以一夜之间被削减。那么价格、工资和产出会发生什么变化呢？1724年，法国进行了三次这样的实验，结果名义货币供应量累计削减了45%。价格在外汇市场上立即且完全调整。商品、制造品和工业工资的价格在数月内缓慢下降，下降幅度并未达到名义削减的全部幅度。工业部门经历了30%的收缩。当政府改变政策，一夜之间将名义货币供应量增加了20%时，价格反应更为明显，工业部门也恢复了正常水平。

abstract.text: In the United States, workers in cities offering above-average wages-cities with high productivity, low quality of life, or inefficient housing sectors-pay 27 percent more in federal taxes than otherwise identical workers in cities offering below-average wages. According to simulation results, taxes lower long-run employment levels in high-wage areas by 13 percent and land and housing prices by 21 and 5 percent, causing locational inefficiencies costing 0.23 percent of income, or $28 billion in 2008. Employment is shifted from north to south and from urban to rural areas. Tax deductions index taxes partially to local cost of living, improving locational efficiency.

10.1086/605309.abstractZh: 在美国，那些提供高于平均水平工资的城市的工人——这些城市通常具有高生产力、低生活质量或低效的住房部门——缴纳的联邦税款比那些提供低于平均水平工资的城市的相同工人高出27%。根据模拟结果，高工资地区的税收会导致长期就业水平下降13%，土地和房价分别下降21%和5%，从而导致区位效率低下，造成相当于收入0.23%的损失，即2008年约为280亿美元。就业从北部转移到了南部，从城市转移到了农村地区。税收减免在一定程度上反映了当地的生活成本，从而提高了区位效率。

abstract.text: Theory models of platform competition predict that prices and buyer-seller ratios should be approximately equal on coexisting auction sites. Using field experiments on eBay and Yahoo Auctions, we find evidence that is inconsistent with equilibrium hypotheses and suggest that the market is tipping. Prices on eBay are consistently 20-70 percent higher than those on Yahoo, and eBay attracts two additional buyers per seller. On Yahoo, prices and bidders counts are unaffected by the auction ending rule. Various differences between the sites cannot account for the magnitude of these disparities. However, a model of imitation dynamics can rationalize our findings.

10.1086/605358.abstractZh: 平台竞争的理论模型预测，在共存拍卖平台上，价格与买家-卖家比例应该大致相等。通过对eBay和Yahoo拍卖的实地实验，我们发现与均衡假设不符的证据，并认为市场正在发生转变。eBay上的价格始终比Yahoo高出20-70%，而且eBay每卖出一件商品能吸引两名额外的买家。而在Yahoo上，价格与竞拍者数量不受拍卖结束规则的影响。这些差异的幅度无法用网站之间的各种差异来解释。不过，模仿动态模型可以解释我们的发现。

abstract.text: The classical Heckscher-Ohlin-Mundell paradigm states that trade and capital mobility are substitutes in the sense that trade integration reduces the incentives for capital to flow to capital-scarce countries. In this paper we show that in a world with heterogeneous financial development, a very different conclusion emerges. In particular, in less financially developed economies (South), trade and capital mobility are complements in the sense that trade integration increases the return to capital and thus the incentives for capital to flow to South. This interaction implies that deepening trade integration in South raises net capital inflows (or reduces net capital outflows). It also implies that, at the global level, protectionism may backfire if the goal is to rebalance capital flows.

10.1086/605583.abstractZh: 经典的赫克歇尔-奥林-蒙代尔模型认为，贸易和资本流动是替代关系，因为贸易一体化会降低资本流向资本稀缺国家的动机。然而，在金融发展差异较大的世界中，结论却截然不同。具体而言，在金融发展相对落后的南方国家，贸易和资本流动是互补关系，因为贸易一体化能够提升资本的回报，从而刺激资本流向南方国家。这种互动意味着，南方国家深化贸易一体化会增加净资本流入（或减少净资本流出）。此外，从全球层面来看，如果保护主义的目的是重新平衡资本流动，那么这种政策可能会适得其反。

abstract.text: This paper studies a recent British reform that allowed public high schools to opt out of local authority control and become autonomous schools funded directly by the central government. Schools seeking autonomy had only to propose and win a majority vote among current parents. Almost one in three high schools voted on autonomy between 1988 and 1997, and using a version of the regression discontinuity design, I find large achievement gains at schools in which the vote barely won compared to schools in which it barely lost. Despite other reforms that ensured that the British education system was, by international standards, highly competitive, a comparison of schools in the geographic neighborhoods of narrow vote winners and narrow vote losers suggests that these gains did not spill over.

10.1086/605604.abstractZh: 本文研究了一项近期的英国改革，该改革允许公立高中摆脱地方政府的控制，成为由中央政府直接资助的自主学校。寻求自主权的学校只需提出提案并赢得大多数家长的投票支持即可。在1988年至1997年间，几乎每三所高中中就有一所投票支持自主权。通过回归断点设计，我发现那些在投票中勉强获胜的学校比那些在投票中勉强失败的学校在学业成绩上取得了显著进步。尽管有其他改革措施确保英国教育体系在国际上具有高度竞争力，但将那些在投票中获胜和失败的学校所在地理位置进行比较后，发现这些成绩提升并未扩散到其他学校。

abstract.text: This paper presents an equilibrium labor search model in which workers can simultaneously apply to multiple firms to increase their search intensity. They observe firms' wage postings before choosing where to apply. Owing to coordination frictions, a firm may not receive any applications; otherwise it is able to hire unless all its applicants have better offers. It is shown that the equilibrium converges to the efficient Walrasian outcome as application costs vanish. Even for nonnegligible application costs, the entry of firms, the search intensity, and the number of filled vacancies are constrained efficient. Wage dispersion is essential for constrained efficiency.

10.1086/644791.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个均衡劳动搜寻模型，在该模型中，工人可以同时向多家公司申请，从而增加他们的搜寻强度。他们在选择申请地点之前会查看公司的薪资公告。由于协调摩擦的存在，一家公司可能不会收到任何申请；否则，除非所有申请者都获得了更好的录用机会，否则该公司无法招聘。研究表明，当申请成本消失时，均衡会收敛到有效的瓦尔拉斯均衡状态。即使申请成本仍然不可忽略，公司的进入、搜寻强度以及空缺职位的填补数量仍然受到效率约束。工资差异对于实现效率约束是必不可少的。

abstract.text: We propose a measure of riskiness of “gambles” (risky assets) that is objective: it depends only on the gamble and not on the decision maker. The measure is based on identifying for every gamble the critical wealth level below which it becomes “risky” to accept the gamble.

10.1086/644840.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种衡量“赌博”（风险资产）风险性的客观方法：该方法仅取决于赌博本身，而不依赖于决策者。该衡量方法的关键在于为每一笔赌博确定一个临界财富水平，低于这个水平时，接受该赌博就会变得具有风险。

abstract.text: We study costs and benefits of differences of opinion between an adviser and a decision maker. Even when they share the same underlying preferences over decisions, a difference of opinion about payoff-relevant information leads to strategic information acquisition and transmission. A decision maker faces a fundamental trade-off: a greater difference of opinion increases an adviser's incentives to acquire information but exacerbates the strategic disclosure of any information that is acquired. Nevertheless, when choosing from a rich pool of opinion types, it is optimal for a decision maker to select an adviser with some difference of opinion. Centralization of authority is essential to harness these incentive gains since delegation to the adviser can discourage effort.

10.1086/648432.abstractZh: 我们研究了顾问与决策者之间意见分歧的成本与收益。即使他们在决策上有着相同的偏好，但如果关于收益相关信息的意见存在分歧，就会导致战略信息的获取与传递。决策者面临一个基本的权衡：意见分歧越大，顾问获取信息的动机就越强，但由此导致的战略信息披露也会更加严重。不过，当从众多意见类型中选择顾问时，选择具有一定意见分歧的顾问是最优的。权力的集中对于利用这些激励收益至关重要，因为将决策权委托给顾问可能会降低决策者的积极性。

abstract.text: The theory of human capital is agnostic on what constitutes firm-specific skills. The theory specifies that specific skills contribute to productivity only at the current firm. A broader approach lets all skills be general, but firms use them with different weights attached. For example, computer programming, economics, and accounting are general skills, but there may be only one firm that wants workers trained in all three. One implication is that wage profiles and the split of human capital costs depend on thickness of the market. Another is that firms pay for what appears to be general training.

10.1086/648671.abstractZh: 人力资本理论对于哪些技能属于特定企业所需并不明确。该理论指出，特定技能只有在当前企业环境中才能提升生产力。更宽泛的方法则认为所有技能都是通用的，但企业会根据不同的权重来使用这些技能。例如，计算机编程、经济学和会计都是通用技能，但可能只有一家企业希望员工同时掌握这三种技能。这意味着工资结构和人力资本成本的分配取决于市场的规模。另一个含义是，企业支付的是那些看似通用的培训费用。

abstract.text: The demand for durable goods is more cyclical than that for nondurable goods and services. Consequently, the cash flows and stock returns of durable‐good producers are exposed to higher systematic risk. Using the benchmark input‐output accounts of the National Income and Product Accounts, we construct portfolios of durable‐good, nondurable‐good, and service producers. In the cross section, an investment strategy that is long on the durable‐good portfolio and short on the service portfolio earns a risk premium exceeding 4 percent annually. In the time series, an investment strategy that is long on the durable‐good portfolio and short on the market portfolio earns a countercyclical risk premium. We explain these findings in a general equilibrium asset‐pricing model with endogenous production.

10.1086/648882.abstractZh: 耐用商品的需求比非耐用商品和服务更具周期性。因此，耐用商品生产者的现金流和股票回报面临更高的系统性风险。利用国民收入和产品账户中的基准投入产出账户，我们构建了耐用商品、非耐用商品和服务生产者的投资组合。在横截面分析中，一种在耐用商品投资组合中持有较多，在服务投资组合中持有较少的投资策略，每年可获得超过4%的风险溢价。在时间序列分析中，一种在耐用商品投资组合中持有较多，在市场投资组合中持有较少的投资策略，可获得反周期风险溢价。我们在一个具有内生生产的广义均衡资产定价模型中解释了这些发现。

abstract.text: Significant departures from log normality are observed in income data, in violation of Gibrat's law. We show empirically that the distribution of consumption expenditures across households is, within cohorts, closer to log normal than the distribution of income. We explain this empirical result by showing that the logic of Gibrat's law applies not to total income, but to permanent income and to marginal utility.

10.1086/648995.abstractZh: 在收入数据中观察到与对数正态分布显著不同的现象，这违反了吉布拉特定律。我们通过实证分析表明，在各个队列中，家庭消费支出的分布更接近对数正态分布，而收入分布则不然。我们通过论证吉布拉特定律的逻辑并不适用于总收入，而是适用于永久收入和边际效用，来解释这一实证结果。

abstract.text: We provide "revealed preference" tests of general collective consumption models that account for public consumption and externalities within the household. We further propose a novel approach to model special cases of this model, which imply alternative assumptions regarding the sharing rule. Our application uses the panel data from the Russia Longitudinal Monitoring Survey. We find that the general model, together with a large class of special cases, cannot be rejected. By contrast, we do reject the standard unitary model. Since our tests are entirely nonparametric, this provides strong evidence in favor of models focusing on intrahousehold decision making.

10.1086/649563.abstractZh: 我们提供了“揭示偏好”测试，用于评估一般集体消费模型，这些模型考虑了家庭内部的公共消费和外部性。我们还提出了一种新颖的方法，用于建模该模型的特殊情况，这些情况涉及到关于共享规则的不同假设。我们的研究采用了俄罗斯纵向监测调查的面板数据。我们发现，一般模型以及大量特殊情况都无法被拒绝。相比之下，我们确实拒绝了标准的单位模型。由于我们的测试完全是非参数化的，这为我们支持以家庭内部决策为中心的模型提供了强有力的证据。

abstract.text: The Federal Reserve Act divided Mississippi between the 6th (Atlanta) and 8th (St. Louis) Districts. During the Great Depression, these districts' policies differed. Atlanta championed monetary activism and the extension of aid to ailing banks. St. Louis eschewed expansionary initiatives. During a banking crisis in 1930, Atlanta expedited lending to banks in need. St. Louis did not. Outcomes differed across districts. In Atlanta, banks survived at higher rates, lending continued at higher levels, commerce contracted less, and recovery began earlier. These patterns indicate that central bank intervention influenced bank health, credit availability, and business activity.

10.1086/649603.abstractZh: 《联邦储备法》将密西西比州划分为第6区（亚特兰大）和第8区（圣路易斯）。在大萧条期间，这两个地区的政策有所不同。亚特兰大地区主张货币干预措施，并加大对陷入困境银行的援助力度。而圣路易斯地区则避免采取扩张性政策。在1930年的银行危机期间，亚特兰大地区加快了对需要帮助的银行的贷款支持，而圣路易斯地区则没有这样做。不同地区的政策效果各异。在亚特兰大，银行以更高的比率存活下来，贷款规模也保持较高水平，商业活动收缩程度较小，经济复苏也来得更早。这些现象表明，中央银行的干预对银行的健康状况、信贷供应以及商业活动产生了影响。

abstract.text: We derive and test q-theory implications for cross-sectional stock returns. Under constant returns to scale, stock returns equal levered investment returns, which are tied directly to firm characteristics. When we use generalized method of moments to match average levered investment returns to average observed stock returns, the model captures the average stock returns of portfolios sorted by earnings surprises, book-to-market equity, and capital investment. When we try to match expected returns and return variances simultaneously, the variances predicted in the model are largely comparable to those observed in the data. However, the resulting expected return errors are large.

10.1086/649760.abstractZh: 我们推导并检验了q理论对横截面股票回报的影响。在规模报酬不变的情况下，股票回报等于杠杆投资回报，而杠杆投资回报直接与公司特征相关。当我们使用广义矩方法将平均杠杆投资回报与观测到的平均股票回报进行匹配时，模型能够捕捉到按收益惊喜、市净率和资本投资排序的投资组合的平均股票回报。当我们尝试同时匹配预期回报和回报方差时，模型预测的方差与数据中观测到的方差大体相当。然而，由此产生的预期回报误差却很大。

abstract.text: Knowles, Persico, and Todd (2001) present a model of police and motorist behavior in the context of vehicle searches and test it using data from Maryland. Their work marked a resurgence in interest on how to interpret purported evidence of statistical and racial discrimination. The main implication of the their model is that in the absence of racial discrimination, the proportion of searches yielding drugs (or “hit rate”) will be equated across races. A relatively low hit rate for any group suggests that police may improve their overall hit rate by shifting resources away from that group and is thus evidence toward discrimination. Using data on vehicle searches by the Maryland State Police (MSP), they find no bias against blacks relative to whites but significant bias against white females and particularly Hispanics.In this paper, I reconsider the Knowles et al. analysis. An important feature of the data used by Knowles et al. is that they are limited to searches occurring on Interstate 95, which was also the focus of the racial profiling lawsuit filed against the MSP in 1993. However, while the suit focused on I-95 searches, the settlement required the MSP to record all vehicle searches, of which I-95 searches constitute about one-third. When considering all MSP searches, I find evidence toward racial discrimination against blacks and especially Hispanics, and that these disparities have increased in recent years.

10.1086/649800.abstractZh: Knowles、Persico和Todd在2001年提出了一个关于警察与驾车者行为的模型，该模型以车辆搜查为背景，并使用了马里兰州的数据进行验证。他们的研究重新引发了人们对如何解释所谓的统计和种族歧视证据的兴趣。他们模型的主要结论是：在没有种族歧视的情况下，搜查中查获毒品的比例（即“命中率”）会在不同种族之间保持均衡。任何群体较低的命中率都表明，警方可以通过将资源从该群体转移出去来提高整体的命中率，这也就构成了种族歧视的证据。通过利用马里兰州警察局提供的车辆搜查数据，他们发现相对于白人来说，黑人并没有受到偏见，但白人女性尤其是西班牙裔则明显受到偏见。在本文中，我重新考虑了Knowles等人的分析。Knowles等人使用的数据有一个重要特点，即仅限于发生在95号州际公路上的搜查，而这条公路也是1993年针对马里兰州警察局提起的种族歧视诉讼的重点对象。然而，尽管诉讼主要针对95号州际公路上的搜查，但和解协议要求马里兰州警察局记录所有车辆搜查情况，而95号州际公路上的搜查约占所有搜查的三分之一。在考虑所有马里兰州警察局的搜查情况后，我发现存在针对黑人的种族歧视现象，尤其是针对西班牙裔的歧视，而且这些差异在近年来有所加剧。

abstract.text: This paper studies oligopoly firms' dynamic pricing strategies in a gasoline market before and after the introduction of a unique law that constrains firms to set price simultaneously and only once per day. The observed gasoline pricing behavior, both before and under the law, is well captured by the Edgeworth price cycle equilibrium in the Maskin and Tirole dynamic oligopoly model. My results highlight the importance of price commitment in tacit collusion. I also find evidence that the price leadership outcome under the law is better predicted by mixed strategies play than by alternative hypotheses.

10.1086/649801.abstractZh: 本文研究了在一项独特法律实施前后，汽油市场中的寡头企业动态定价策略。该法律要求企业必须同时且每天只设定一次价格。无论是法律实施之前还是之后，汽油价格的行为都可以通过Maskin和Tirole的动态寡头模型中的Edgeworth价格循环均衡来很好地解释。我的研究结果强调了价格承诺在默契合作中的重要性。我还发现，法律实施下价格领导的结果，可以通过混合策略博弈来更好地预测，而不是通过其他假设来预测。

abstract.text: This paper suggests that inequality in the distribution of landownership adversely affected the emergence of human-capital promoting institutions ( e.g. public schooling), and thus the pace and the nature of the transition from an agricultural to an industrial economy, contributing to the emergence of the great divergence in income per capita across countries. The prediction of the theory regarding the adverse effect of the concentration of landownership on education expenditure is established empirically based on evidence from the beginning of the 20th century in the U.S.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00506.x.abstractZh: 本文认为，土地所有权分配的不平等对促进人力资本发展的制度（如公共教育）的兴起产生了负面影响，从而影响了从农业经济向工业经济转型的节奏和性质，导致了各国人均收入之间的巨大差异。该理论关于土地所有权集中对教育支出负面影响的说法，基于20世纪初美国的相关证据得到了实证支持。

abstract.text: This paper helps close the gap between theory and empirical evidence in the literature on asymmetric employer learning. If an employer's private learning is reflected in a worker's wage and one employer's private information is transmitted to the next when the worker makes a job-to-job transition, then asymmetric employer learning will appear in wage regressions as learning over an employment spell. Extending previous work that assumes all learning takes place publicly, this paper develops wage regressions that test for both asymmetric employer learning and public learning. The empirical results, including tests of alternative explanations, are consistent with asymmetric employer learning's having at least as much of an effect on wages during an employment spell as does public learning. The model developed in this paper illustrates how the story suggested by the empirical work might unfold. It shows that outside firms can profitably compete with a better-informed employer through bidding wars, even when the worker is equally productive in all firms. Furthermore, this competition results in different wages for workers with the same publicly observable characteristics, a result that previous models of asymmetric learning have not produced.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00507.x.abstractZh: 本文有助于缩小关于不对称雇主学习理论的文献与实证证据之间的差距。如果雇主的私人学习体现在工人的工资上，并且当工人进行工作转换时，一个雇主的私人信息会传递给下一个雇主，那么不对称雇主学习就会在工资回归中表现为一个就业期间的“学习效应”。本文扩展了之前假设所有学习都是公开进行的观点，提出了工资回归模型，以检验不对称雇主学习和公开学习两种情况。实证结果，包括对其他解释方法的检验，表明不对称雇主学习对工资的影响至少与公开学习一样显著。本文所建立的模型展示了实证研究结果所暗示的情景如何发生。它表明，即使工人在所有公司中的生产力相同，外部公司仍可以通过竞价竞争与信息更充分的雇主进行有竞争力的竞争。此外，这种竞争导致具有相同公开可观察特征的工人获得不同的工资，这是之前的不对称学习模型未能得出的结果。

abstract.text: The institution of slavery is found mostly at intermediate stages of agricultural development and less often among hunter-gatherers and advanced agrarian societies. We explain this pattern in a growth model with land and labour as inputs in production and an endogenously determined property rights institution. The economy endogenously transits from an egalitarian state with equal property rights to a despotic slave society where the elite own both people and land; thereafter, it endogenously transits into a free labour society, where the elite own the land but people are free.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00511.x.abstractZh: 奴隶制主要出现在农业发展的中等阶段，而在狩猎采集者和先进的农业社会中则较为少见。我们在一个以土地和劳动力为生产投入的增长模型中解释了这一模式，该模型还考虑了由内生因素决定的产权制度。经济体系会从具有平等产权的平等主义状态，逐步转变为由精英阶级拥有人民和土地权力的专制奴隶社会；之后，经济体系又会内生性地转变为自由劳动力社会，此时精英阶级拥有土地，而人民则享有自由。

abstract.text: This paper explores three aspects of strategic uncertainty: its relation to risk, predictability of behavior and subjective beliefs of players. In a laboratory experiment we measure subjects' certainty equivalents for three coordination games and one lottery. Behavior in coordination games is related to risk aversion, experience seeking, and age. From the distribution of certainty equivalents we estimate probabilities for successful coordination in a wide range of games. For many games, success of coordination is predictable with a reasonable error rate. The best response to observed behavior is close to the global-game solution. Comparing choices in coordination games with revealed risk aversion, we estimate subjective probabilities for successful coordination. In games with a low coordination requirement, most subjects underestimate the probability of success. In games with a high coordination requirement, most subjects overestimate this probability. Estimating probabilistic decision models, we show that the quality of predictions can be improved when individual characteristics are taken into account. Subjects' behavior is consistent with probabilistic beliefs about the aggregate outcome, but inconsistent with probabilistic beliefs about individual behavior.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00512.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了战略不确定性的三个方面：其与风险的关系、行为的可预测性以及参与者的主观信念。在实验室实验中，我们测量了受试者在三种协调游戏和一种彩票中的确定性等价值。协调游戏中的行为与风险厌恶、经验寻求以及年龄有关。通过确定性等价值的分布，我们估算了多种游戏中成功协调的概率。对于许多游戏而言，协调的成功是可以以合理的误差率进行预测的。对观察到的行为的最佳反应接近于全局游戏的解。通过比较具有揭示性风险厌恶的协调游戏中的选择，我们估算了成功协调的主观概率。在协调要求较低的游戏中，大多数受试者低估了成功的概率；而在协调要求较高的游戏中，大多数受试者高估了这一概率。通过估算概率决策模型，我们发现当考虑个体特征时，预测的准确性可以得到提升。受试者的行为与他们对整体结果的概率信念一致，但与他们对个体行为的概率信念不一致。

abstract.text: This paper computes the change in welfare associated with the introduction of incentives. We calculate by how much the welfare gains of increased output due to incentives outweigh workers' disutility from increased effort. We accomplish this by studying the use of incentives by a firm in the check-clearing industry. Using this firm's production records, we model and estimate the worker's dynamic effort decision problem. We find that the firm's incentive scheme has a large effect on productivity, raising it by 12% over the sample period for the average worker. Using our parameter estimates, we show that the cost of increased effort due to incentives is equal to the dollar value of a 5% rise in productivity. Welfare is measured as the output produced minus the cost of effort; hence, the net increase in the average worker's welfare due to the introduction of the firm's bonus plan is 7%. Under a first-best scheme, we find that the net increase in welfare is 9%.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00513.x.abstractZh: 本文计算了引入激励措施所带来的福利变化。我们计算了由于激励措施而增加的产出所带来的福利增益与工人因增加努力而产生的不满意度之间的差额。我们通过研究一家在支票清算行业中的企业如何使用激励措施来实现这一目标。利用该企业的生产记录，我们对其工人的动态努力决策问题进行了建模和估计。我们发现，该企业的激励方案对生产率有显著影响，在样本期间，平均工人的生产率提高了12%。根据我们的参数估计，我们发现由于激励措施而增加努力的成本等于生产率提高5%所带来的美元价值。福利被定义为产出减去努力成本；因此，由于企业实施奖金计划而平均工人福利的净增加为7%。在最优方案下，我们发现福利的净增加为9%。

abstract.text: We explore how optimal information choices change the predictions of strategic models. When a large number of agents play a game with strategic complementarity, information choices exhibit complementarity as well: if an agent wants to do what others do, they want to know what others know. This makes heterogeneous beliefs difficult to sustain and may generate multiple equilibria. In models with substitutability, agents prefer to differentiate their information choices. We use these theoretical results to examine the role of information choice in recent price-setting models and to propose modelling techniques that ensure equilibrium uniqueness.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00515.x.abstractZh: 我们探讨了最优信息选择如何改变战略模型的预测结果。当大量代理人参与具有战略互补性的游戏时，信息选择也表现出互补性：如果某个代理人希望遵循其他代理人的行为，那么他们就需要了解其他代理人的信息。这使得异质信念难以维持，并可能导致多个均衡的出现。在可替代性的模型中，代理人更倾向于区分自己的信息选择。我们利用这些理论结果来研究信息选择在近期价格设定模型中的作用，并提出了确保均衡唯一性的建模技术。

abstract.text: This paper considers time series Generalized Method of Moments (GMM) models where a subset of the parameters are time varying. We focus on an empirically relevant case with moderately large instabilities, which are well approximated by a local asymptotic embedding that does not allow the instability to be detected with certainty, even in the limit. We show that for many forms of the instability and a large class of GMM models, usual GMM inference on the subset of stable parameters is asymptotically unaffected by the partial instability. In the empirical analysis of presumably stable parameters—such as structural parameters in Euler conditions—one can thus ignore moderate instabilities in other parts of the model and still obtain approximately correct inference.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00516.x.abstractZh: 本文探讨了时间序列广义矩估计（GMM）模型，其中一部分参数随时间变化。我们关注一个具有中等程度不稳定性的实证相关案例，这种不稳定性可以通过局部渐近嵌入方法得到很好的近似，但即使在极限情况下，也无法确定地检测到这种不稳定性。我们表明，对于许多形式的不稳定性以及大量GMM模型，对稳定参数子集的常规GMM推断在渐近意义上不会受到部分不稳定性的影响。在对假定稳定的参数进行实证分析时——例如欧拉条件下的结构参数——可以忽略模型其他部分的中等程度不稳定性，仍然可以获得大致正确的推断结果。

abstract.text: We study two-sided markets with a finite number of agents on each side, and with two-sided incomplete information. Agents are matched assortatively on the basis of costly signals. Asymmetries in signalling activity between the two sides of the market can be explained by asymmetries either in size or in heterogeneity. Our main results identify general conditions under which the potential increase in expected output due to assortative matching (relative to random matching) is offset by the costs of signalling. Finally, we examine the limit model with a continuum of agents and point out differences and similarities to the finite version. Technically, the paper is based on the elegant theory about stochastic order relations among differences of order statistics, pioneered by Barlow and Proschan in 1966 in the framework of reliability theory.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00517.x.abstractZh: 我们研究的是具有有限数量双方的双边市场，并且存在双边信息不完全的情况。代理人之间基于昂贵的信号进行选择性匹配。市场双方之间的信号传递活动的不对称性可以通过规模或异质性的差异来解释。我们的主要研究结果指出了一般条件下，由于选择性匹配所带来的预期产出潜在增加会被信号传递的成本所抵消。最后，我们探讨了具有连续代理人的极限模型，并指出了与有限版本之间的异同。从技术上讲，本文基于Barlow和Proschan在1966年可靠性理论框架内提出的关于顺序统计差异之间随机顺序关系的优雅理论。

abstract.text: Political dynasties have long been present in democracies, raising concerns that inequality in the distribution of political power may reflect imperfections in democratic representation. However, the persistence of political elites may simply reflect differences in ability or political vocation across families and not their entrenchment in power. We show that dynastic prevalence in the Congress of the U.S. is high compared to that in other occupations and that political dynasties do not merely reflect permanent differences in family characteristics. On the contrary, using two instrumental variable techniques we find that political power is self-perpetuating: legislators who hold power for longer become more likely to have relatives entering Congress in the future. Thus, in politics, power begets power.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00519.x.abstractZh: 政治世家在民主国家中早已存在，这引发了人们对政治权力分配不平等可能反映民主代表制度缺陷的担忧。然而，政治精英的持续存在可能仅仅反映了不同家族之间的能力或政治志向的差异，而非他们权力地位的固化。我们发现在美国国会中，政治世家的盛行程度高于其他职业领域，而且政治世家并不仅仅反映了家族特征的永久性差异。相反，通过两种工具变量技术分析发现，政治权力具有自我延续的特性：长期掌权的立法者更有可能在未来有亲属进入国会。因此，在政治领域，权力会滋生更多权力。

abstract.text: We define and explore the notion of a Dynamic Condorcet Winner (DCW), which extends the notion of a Condorcet winner to dynamic settings. We show that, for every DCW, every member of a large class of dynamic majoritarian games has an equivalent equilibrium, and that other equilibria are not similarly portable across this class of games. Existence of DCWs is guaranteed when members of the community are sufficiently patient. We characterize sustainable and unsustainable outcomes, study the effects of changes in the discount factor, investigate efficiency properties, and explore the potential for achieving renegotiation-proof outcomes. We apply this solution concept to a standard one-dimensional choice problem wherein agents have single-peaked preferences, as well as to one involving the division of a fixed aggregate pay-off.

10.1111/j.1467-937x.2008.00520.x.abstractZh: 我们定义并探讨了动态康德赛特胜者这一概念，该概念将康德赛特胜者的概念扩展到了动态环境中。我们证明，对于每一个动态康德赛特胜者，一大类动态多数博弈中的每个参与者都存在一个等效的均衡，而其他均衡则无法在这种博弈类中进行类似转换。当社区成员具有足够的耐心时，动态康德赛特胜者的存在是得到保证的。我们描述了可持续与不可持续的结果，研究了折扣因子变化的影响，探讨了效率特性，并探索了实现无需重新协商的结果的潜力。我们将这一解决方案概念应用于一个标准的一维选择问题，其中代理人具有单峰偏好，同时也应用于涉及固定总收益分配的问题。

abstract.text: In this paper, we document whether and how much the equalizing force of earnings mobility has changed in France in the 1990's. For this purpose, we use a representative three-year panel, the French Labour Force Survey. We develop a model of earnings dynamics that combines a flexible specification of marginal earnings distributions (to fit the large cross-sectional dimension of the data) with a tight parametric representation of the dynamics (adapted to the short time-series dimension). Log earnings are modelled as the sum of a deterministic component, an individual fixed effect and a transitory component which is assumed first-order Markov. The transition probability of the transitory component is modelled as a one-parameter Plackett copula. We estimate this model using a sequential expectation-maximization algorithm.
