We document that this trust is affected not only by the characteristics of the country being trusted, but also by cultural aspects of the match between trusting country and trusted country, such as their history of conflicts and their religious, genetic, and somatic similarities. We then find that lower bilateral trust leads to less trade between two countries, less portfolio investment, and less direct investment, even after controlling for the characteristics of the two countries. This effect is stronger for goods that are more trust intensive. Our results suggest that perceptions rooted in culture are important (and generally omitted) determinants of economic exchange.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.3.1095.abstractZh: 文化偏见对经济交流有多大的影响？我们通过欧洲国家之间的双边信任数据来回答这个问题。我们发现，这种信任不仅受到被信任国家自身特征的影响，还受到信任双方国家之间的文化因素的影响，例如它们的冲突历史以及宗教、遗传和体质上的相似性。研究发现，即使控制了两国自身的特征，双边信任较低会导致两国之间的贸易、证券投资以及直接投资的减少。对于需要更多信任投入的商品来说，这种效应更为明显。我们的结果表明，基于文化的认知是经济交流的重要（且通常被忽视的）决定因素。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact on pilgrims of performing the Hajj pilgrimage to Mecca. Our method compares successful and unsuccessful applicants in a lottery used by Pakistan to allocate Hajj visas. Pilgrim accounts stress that the Hajj leads to a feeling of unity with fellow Muslims, but outsiders have sometimes feared that this could be accompanied by antipathy toward non-Muslims. We find that participation in the Hajj increases observance of global Islamic practices, such as prayer and fasting, while decreasing participation in localized practices and beliefs, such as the use of amulets and dowry. It increases belief in equality and harmony among ethnic groups and Islamic sects and leads to more favorable attitudes toward women, including greater acceptance of female education and employment. Increased unity within the Islamic world is not accompanied by antipathy toward non-Muslims. Instead, Hajjis show increased belief in peace, and in equality and harmony among adherents of different religions. The evidence suggests that these changes are likely due to exposure to and interaction with Hajjis from around the world, rather than to a changed social role of pilgrims upon return.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.3.1133.abstractZh: 我们评估了前往麦加进行朝觐对朝圣者的影响。我们的方法比较了巴基斯坦用于分配朝觐签证的彩票中成功与失败的申请者。朝圣者的叙述表明，朝觐能够增强与穆斯林同胞的团结感，但外界有时担心这可能会伴随着对非穆斯林的敌意。我们发现，参与朝觐会增加对全球伊斯兰习俗的遵守，如祈祷和斋戒，同时减少了对地方习俗和信仰的参与，如使用护身符和嫁妆。朝觐还增强了人们对不同民族和伊斯兰派别之间平等与和谐的信念，并导致对女性的态度更加积极，包括更接受女性接受教育和就业。伊斯兰世界内部的团结增强并未伴随着对非穆斯林的敌意。相反，朝觐者表现出对和平以及不同宗教信徒之间平等与和谐的更大信念。证据表明，这些变化可能是由于与来自世界各地的朝觐者接触和互动所导致的，而非朝圣者返回后社会角色的变化。

abstract.text: This paper examines how costly financial contracting and weak investor protection influence the cross-border operational, financing, and investment decisions of firms. We develop a model in which product developers can play a useful role in monitoring the deployment of their technology abroad. The analysis demonstrates that when firms want to exploit technologies abroad, multinational firm (MNC) activity and foreign direct investment (FDI) flows arise endogenously when monitoring is nonverifiable and financial frictions exist. The mechanism generating MNC activity is not the risk of technological expropriation by local partners but the demands of external funders who require MNC participation to ensure value maximization by local entrepreneurs. The model demonstrates that weak investor protections limit the scale of MNC activity, increase the reliance on FDI flows, and alter the decision to deploy technology through FDI as opposed to arm's length technology transfers. Several distinctive predictions for the impact of weak investor protection on MNC activity and FDI flows are tested and confirmed using firm-level data. (c) 2009 by the President and Fellows of Harvard College and the Massachusetts Institute of Technology..

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.3.1171.abstractZh: 本文探讨了昂贵的财务契约安排和薄弱的投资者保护如何影响企业的跨境运营、融资和投资决策。我们建立了一个模型，在该模型中，产品开发者可以在监控其技术海外部署方面发挥重要作用。分析表明，当企业希望利用海外技术时，跨国公司的活动和外国直接投资流动会在监控不可验证且存在财务摩擦的情况下内生性地出现。产生跨国公司活动的机制并非由于当地合作伙伴对技术进行征用，而是由于外部资助者需要跨国公司的参与来确保当地企业家实现价值最大化。该模型还表明，薄弱的投资者保护限制了跨国公司的活动规模，增加了对外国直接投资流动的依赖，并改变了通过外国直接投资而非正常技术转让来部署技术的决策。利用企业层面的数据，对薄弱投资者保护对跨国公司活动和外国直接投资流动的影响进行了多项独特预测，并得到了验证。© 2009 哈佛学院院长和麻省理工学院。

abstract.text: This paper provides new insight into the relationship between inflation and the setting of individual prices by examining a large data set of Mexican consumer prices covering episodes of both low and high inflation. When the annual rate of inflation is low (below 10%–15%), the frequency of price changes comoves weakly with inflation because movements in the frequency of price decreases and increases partly offset each other. In contrast, the average magnitude of price changes correlates strongly with inflation because it is sensitive to movements in the relative shares of price increases and decreases. When inflation rises beyond 10%–15%, few price decreases are observed and both the frequency and average magnitude are important determinants of inflation. I show that a menu-cost model with idiosyncratic technology shocks predicts the average frequency and magnitude of price changes well over a range of inflation similar to that experienced by Mexico.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.3.1221.abstractZh: 本文通过研究墨西哥消费者价格的大型数据集，探讨了通货膨胀与个人价格设定之间的关系。在通货膨胀率较低（低于10%–15%）的情况下，价格变化的频率与通货膨胀的变动相互作用，因为价格下降和上升的频率变化在一定程度上相互抵消。相反，价格变化的平均幅度与通货膨胀密切相关，因为价格变化的幅度对价格上涨和下降的相对比例变化非常敏感。当通货膨胀率超过10%–15%时，观察到的价格下降次数较少，而频率和平均幅度成为决定通货膨胀的重要因素。研究表明，具有特异性技术冲击的菜单成本模型能够很好地预测价格变化的平均频率和幅度，这一预测在类似墨西哥所经历的通货膨胀范围内仍然适用。

abstract.text: We use administrative data on the quarterly employment and earnings of Pennsylvanian workers in the 1970s and 1980s matched to Social Security Administration death records covering 1980–2006 to estimate the effects of job displacement on mortality. We find that for high-seniority male workers, mortality rates in the year after displacement are 50%–100% higher than would otherwise have been expected. The effect on mortality hazards declines sharply over time, but even twenty years after displacement, we estimate a 10%–15% increase in annual death hazards. If such increases were sustained indefinitely, they would imply a loss in life expectancy of 1.0–1.5 years for a worker displaced at age forty. We show that these results are not due to selective displacement of less healthy workers or to unstable industries or firms offering less healthy work environments. We also show that workers with larger losses in earnings tend to suffer greater increases in mortality. This correlation remains when we examine predicted earnings declines based on losses in industry, firm, or firm-size wage premiums.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.3.1265.abstractZh: 我们利用1970年代和1980年代宾夕法尼亚州工人的季度就业和收入数据，以及1980年至2006年的社会保障管理局死亡记录，来估算工作变动对死亡率的影响。研究发现，对于高资历的男性工人来说，在工作变动后的那一年，死亡率比预期高出50%至100%。随着时间的推移，这种对死亡风险的影响逐渐减弱，但即使在工作变动二十年后，我们仍估计每年的死亡风险增加了10%至15%。如果这种增加持续下去，那么对于在四十岁时遭遇工作变动的工人来说，其预期寿命将减少1.0至1.5年。我们的研究表明，这些结果并非由于选择性地淘汰了健康状况较差的工人，或是由于行业或企业提供了较差的工作环境所致。此外，我们发现，收入损失较大的工人往往面临更大的死亡风险增加。当根据行业、企业或企业规模工资溢价的变化来预测收入下降时，这种相关性仍然存在。

abstract.text: This paper builds a theory of trust based on informal contract enforcement in social networks. In our model, network connections between individuals can be used as social collateral to secure informal borrowing. We define network-based trust as the largest amount one agent can borrow from another agent and derive a reduced-form expression for this quantity, which we then use in three applications. (1) We predict that dense networks generate bonding social capital that allows transacting valuable assets, whereas loose networks create bridging social capital that improves access to cheap favors such as information. (2) For job recommendation networks, we show that strong ties between employers and trusted recommenders reduce asymmetric information about the quality of job candidates. (3) Using data from Peru, we show empirically that network-based trust predicts informal borrowing, and we structurally estimate and test our model.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.3.1307.abstractZh: 本文基于社交网络中的非正式合同执行构建了一种信任理论。在我们的模型中，个体之间的网络联系可以被用作社会担保，以换取非正式借贷。我们将基于网络的信任定义为一个代理可以从另一个代理处借入的最大金额，并推导出这一数量的简化表达式，随后将其应用于三个场景。(1) 我们预测，密集的网络能够产生促进交易有价值资产的社会资本，而稀疏的网络则能创造有助于获取廉价信息等便利条件的桥梁型社会资本。(2) 对于工作推荐网络，我们表明雇主与可信推荐者之间的紧密关系可以减少关于求职者质量的非对称信息。(3) 利用秘鲁的数据，我们通过实证研究表明基于网络的信任能够预测非正式借贷，并系统地估计和验证了我们的模型。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the effects of changes in the duration of paid, job-protected parental leave on mothers' higher-order fertility and postbirth labor market careers. Identification is based on a major Austrian reform increasing the duration of parental leave from one year to two years for any child born on or after July 1, 1990. We find that mothers who give birth to their first child immediately after the reform have more second children than prereform mothers, and that extended parental leave significantly reduces return to work. Employment and earnings also decrease in the short run, but not in the long run. Fertility and work responses vary across the population in ways suggesting that both cash transfers and job protection are relevant. Increasing parental leave for a future child increases fertility strongly but leaves short-run postbirth careers relatively unaffected. Partially reversing the 1990 extension, a second 1996 reform improves employment and earnings while compressing the time between births.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.3.1363.abstractZh: 本文分析了带薪、具有工作保护的育儿假时长变化对母亲更高阶生育率及产后劳动力市场职业发展的影响。研究基于一项奥地利重大改革，该改革将任何在1990年7月1日或之后出生的孩子的育儿假时长从一年延长至两年。研究发现，在改革后不久生育第一个孩子的母亲，其第二个孩子的数量比改革前的母亲更多，而延长的育儿假显著降低了她们重返工作的意愿。短期内，就业率和收入也会下降，但长期来看则不会。不同人群在生育率和工作选择上的反应存在差异，这表明现金转移和工作保护都是重要的因素。为未来的孩子延长育儿假会大幅增加生育率，但短期内对产后职业发展的影响相对较小。如果部分逆转1990年的改革措施，通过1996年的第二次改革，可以在缩短生育间隔的同时提高就业率和收入。

abstract.text: We examine the responses of prices and inflation to monetary shocks in an inventory-theoretic model of money demand. We show that the price level responds sluggishly to an exogenous increase in the money stock because the dynamics of households' money inventories leads to a partially offsetting endogenous reduction in velocity. We also show that inflation responds sluggishly to an exogenous increase in the nominal interest rate because changes in monetary policy affect the real interest rate. In a quantitative example, we show that this nominal sluggishness is substantial and persistent if inventories in the model are calibrated to match U.S. households' holdings of M2.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.3.911.abstractZh: 我们在货币需求的库存理论模型中，研究了价格与通货膨胀对货币冲击的响应。我们发现，由于家庭货币库存的动态变化导致货币流通速度出现部分下降，因此价格水平对货币存量的外生增加反应迟缓。同时，我们也发现，由于货币政策的变化会影响实际利率，通货膨胀对名义利率的外生增加反应同样迟缓。在一个定量示例中，我们表明，如果模型中的库存数据能够与美国家庭持有的M2数量相匹配，这种名义上的迟缓反应将是显著且持续的。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether the salience of a tax system affects equilibrium tax rates. I analyze how tolls change after toll facilities adopt electronic toll collection (ETC); drivers are substantially less aware of tolls paid electronically. I estimate that, in steady state, tolls are 20 to 40 percent higher than they would have been without ETC. Consistent with a salience-based explanation for this toll increase, I find that under ETC, driving becomes less elastic with respect to the toll and toll setting becomes less sensitive to the electoral calendar. Alternative explanations appear unlikely to be able to explain the findings.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.3.969.abstractZh: 本文探讨了税收制度的显著性是否会影响均衡税率。我分析了在采用电子收费系统后，收费的变化情况；驾驶员对电子支付的收费意识明显降低。我的估计是，在稳态下，电子收费后的收费比没有电子收费时要高出20%到40%。与基于显著性解释的收费增加现象一致，我发现，在电子收费系统下，驾驶对收费的弹性降低，而收费设置对收费日期的敏感性也降低了。其他解释似乎不太能够解释这些发现。

abstract.text: Resource misallocation can lower aggregate total factor productivity (TFP). We use microdata on manufacturing establishments to quantify the potential extent of misallocation in China and India versus the United States. We measure sizable gaps in marginal products of labor and capital across plants within narrowly defined industries in China and India compared with the United States. When capital and labor are hypothetically reallocated to equalize marginal products to the extent observed in the United States, we calculate manufacturing TFP gains of 30%–50% in China and 40%–60%.in India.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1403.abstractZh: 资源错配会降低总体全要素生产率。我们利用制造业企业的微观数据来量化中国、印度与美国之间资源错配的潜在程度。研究发现，与中国和美国相比，中国和印度特定行业内的不同工厂之间，劳动力和资本的边际产品存在显著差距。当假设资本和劳动力被重新分配以使其边际产品达到美国水平时，我们计算出中国的制造业全要素生产率将提升30%至50%，而印度的提升幅度则为40%至60%。

abstract.text: We conduct a within-county analysis using detailed ZIP code—level data to document new findings regarding the origins of the biggest financial crisis since the Great Depression. The sharp increase in mortgage defaults in 2007 is significantly amplified in subprime ZIP codes, or ZIP codes with a disproportionately large share of subprime borrowers as of 1996. Prior to the default crisis, these subprime ZIP codes experience an unprecedented relative growth in mortgage credit. The expansion in mortgage credit from 2002 to 2005 to subprime ZIP codes occurs despite sharply declining relative (and in some cases absolute) income growth in these neighborhoods. In fact, 2002 to 2005 is the only period in the past eighteen years in which income and mortgage credit growth are negatively correlated. We show that the expansion in mortgage credit to subprime ZIP codes and its dissociation from income growth is closely correlated with the increase in securitization of subprime mortgages.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1449.abstractZh: 我们采用详细的邮政编码数据，对各个县进行了分析，以揭示自大萧条以来最严重的金融危机的起源。2007年，抵押贷款违约率急剧上升，在那些自1996年以来以大量次级借款人为主的邮政编码区表现得尤为明显。在违约危机之前，这些邮政编码区的抵押贷款信贷出现了前所未有的相对增长。尽管这些社区的相对收入增长（在某些情况下是绝对收入增长）出现了显著下降，但2002年至2005年间，次级邮政编码区的抵押贷款信贷仍然有所扩张。事实上，2002年至2005年是过去十八年中唯一一个收入和抵押贷款信贷增长呈负相关的时期。我们发现，次级邮政编码区抵押贷款信贷的扩张与其收入增长脱节的现象，与次级抵押贷款的证券化增加密切相关。

abstract.text: We exploit random assignment of gender quotas for leadership positions on Indian village councils to show that prior exposure to a female leader is associated with electoral gains for women. After ten years of quotas, women are more likely to stand for, and win, elected positions in councils required to have a female chief councilor in the previous two elections. We provide experimental and survey evidence on one channel of influence—changes in voter attitudes. Prior exposure to a female chief councilor improves perceptions of female leader effectiveness and weakens stereotypes about gender roles in the public and domestic spheres.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1497.abstractZh: 我们通过随机分配性别配额给印度村议会的领导职位，来研究女性在女性领袖面前的先前经历是否与选举中的优势相关。经过十年的配额制度实施，女性在需要任命女性议长的议会中更有可能获得选举职位，并且更有可能赢得这些职位。我们提供了关于影响渠道之一的实验和调查证据——即选民态度的变化。在女性领袖面前有先前的经历，能够提升人们对女性领袖能力的认知，并削弱公众对公共和家庭领域性别角色的刻板印象。

abstract.text: The nineteenth century witnessed dramatic improvements in the legal rights of married women. Given that they took place long before women gained the right to vote, these changes amounted to a voluntary renunciation of power by men. In this paper, we investigate men's incentives for sharing power with women. In our model, women's legal rights set the marital bargaining power of husbands and wives. We show that men face a trade-off between the rights they want for their own wives (namely none) and the rights of other women in the economy. Men prefer other men's wives to have rights because men care about their own daughters and because an expansion of women's rights increases educational investments in children. We show that men may agree to relinquish some of their power once technological change increases the importance of human capital. We corroborate our argument with historical evidence on the expansion of women's rights in England and the United States.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1541.abstractZh: 十九世纪，已婚女性的法律权利取得了显著改善。这些变革发生在女性获得投票权之前，实际上相当于男性自愿放弃了权力。在本文中，我们探讨了男性与女性分享权力的动机。在我们的模型中，女性的法律权利决定了丈夫和妻子的婚姻谈判能力。我们发现，男性在为自己妻子争取的权利（即不争取任何权利）与其他女性在经济中的权利之间面临着权衡。男性更倾向于让其他男性的妻子享有权利，因为男性关心自己的女儿，而且女性权利的扩大会增加对子女的教育投入。我们还发现，一旦技术变革提升了人力资本的重要性，男性可能会同意放弃部分权力。我们通过英格兰和美国女性权利扩展的历史证据来支持我们的论点。

abstract.text: Compensation, status, and press coverage of managers in the United States follow a highly skewed distribution: a small number of “superstars” enjoy the bulk of the rewards. We evaluate the impact of CEOs achieving superstar status on the performance of their firms, using prestigious business awards to measure shocks to CEO status. We find that award-winning CEOs subsequently underperform, both relative to their prior performance and relative to a matched sample of non-winning CEOs. At the same time, they extract more compensation following the awards, both in absolute amounts and relative to other top executives in their firms. They also spend more time on public and private activities outside their companies, such as assuming board seats or writing books. The incidence of earnings management increases after winning awards. The effects are strongest in firms with weak corporate governance. Our results suggest that the ex post consequences of media-induced superstar status for shareholders are negative.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1593.abstractZh: 在美国，管理者所获得的补偿、地位和媒体关注呈现出高度偏态分布：少数“超级明星”占据了大部分奖励。我们通过使用著名的商业奖项来衡量CEO获得“超级明星”地位对其公司绩效的影响，以评估这一变化所带来的冲击。研究发现，获得奖项的CEO随后表现不佳，无论是相对于他们之前的业绩，还是相对于那些未获奖的CEO而言。同时，他们在获奖后获得的补偿更多，无论是绝对金额还是相对于公司内其他高层管理人员而言。此外，他们还会在公开和私人的活动中花费更多时间，例如担任董事会成员或撰写书籍。在获奖后，盈余管理的现象也更为普遍。这些影响在公司治理较弱的公司中最为明显。我们的研究结果表明，媒体引发的“超级明星”地位对股东来说是一种负面后果。

abstract.text: Defaults often have a large influence on consumer decisions. We identify an overlooked but practical alternative to defaults: requiring individuals to make an explicit choice for themselves. We study such "active decisions" in the context of 401(k) saving. We find that compelling new hires to make active decisions about 401(k) enrollment raises the initial fraction that enroll by 28 percentage points relative to a standard opt-in enrollment procedure, producing a savings distribution three months after hire that would take 30 months to achieve under standard enrollment. We also present a model of 401(k) enrollment and derive conditions under which the optimal enrollment regime is automatic enrollment (i.e., default enrollment), standard enrollment (i.e., default non-enrollment), or active decisions (i.e., no default and compulsory choice). Active decisions are optimal when consumers have a strong propensity to procrastinate and savings preferences are highly heterogeneous. Financial illiteracy, however, favors default enrollment over active decision enrollment.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1639.abstractZh: 违约行为往往对消费者的决策产生重大影响。我们发现了一种被忽视但实用的替代方案：要求个人主动做出选择。我们在401(k)储蓄的背景下研究了这种“主动决策”。研究发现，强制新员工主动决定401(k)的参与率，会使初始参与率比标准自愿参与程序高出28个百分点，从而在入职三个月后产生储蓄效果，而这一效果需要30个月的标准参与程序才能实现。我们还提出了一个401(k)参与的模型，并推导出最优参与机制的条件：自动参与（即默认参与）、标准参与（即默认不参与）或主动决策（即无默认且强制选择）。当消费者有强烈的拖延倾向且储蓄偏好高度异质时，主动决策是最优选择。然而，金融知识匮乏的情况则更倾向于默认参与而非主动决策。

abstract.text: Most major American industrial business cycles from around 1880 to the First World War were caused by fluctuations in the size of the cotton harvest due to economically exogenous factors such as weather. Wheat and corn harvests did not affect industrial production; nor did the cotton harvest before the late 1870s. The unique effect of the cotton harvest in this period can be explained as an essentially monetary phenomenon, the result of interactions between harvests, international gold flows, and high-powered money demand under America's goldstandard regime of 1879–1914.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1675.abstractZh: 从1880年左右到第一次世界大战期间，美国大多数主要工业企业的周期性波动是由棉花收成的变化引起的，这些变化是由诸如天气等经济外生因素导致的。小麦和玉米的收成并未影响工业生产；在1870年代末之前，棉花收成同样也没有影响工业生产。这一时期棉花收成的独特影响可以被解释为一种本质上与货币相关的现象，它是棉花收成、国际黄金流动以及1879年至1914年美国的金本位制度下对高能货币需求之间的相互作用的结果。

abstract.text: We use prenatal exposure to Chernobyl fallout in Sweden as a natural experiment inducing variation in cognitive ability. Students born in regions of Sweden with higher fallout performed worse in secondary school, in mathematics in particular. Damage is accentuated within families (i.e., siblings comparison) and among children born to parents with low education. In contrast, we detect no corresponding damage to health outcomes. To the extent that parents responded to the cognitive endowment, we infer that parental investments reinforced the initial Chernobyl damage. From a public health perspective, our findings suggest that cognitive ability is compromised at radiation doses currently considered harmless.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1729.abstractZh: 我们在瑞典利用切尔诺贝利辐射暴露的产前影响作为自然实验，以观察认知能力的变化。在瑞典辐射暴露程度较高的地区出生的学生，在中学阶段的表现较差，尤其是在数学方面。这种影响在家庭成员之间更为明显（例如兄弟姐妹之间的比较），并且在教育程度较低的父母所生的孩子中更为显著。相比之下，我们没有发现与健康结果相关的损害。从父母对认知能力的反应来看，我们可以推断父母的投入加剧了最初的切尔诺贝利辐射造成的损害。从公共卫生的角度来看，我们的研究结果表明，在目前被认为无害的辐射剂量下，认知能力仍然会受到影响。

abstract.text: The folk theorem of repeated games has established that cooperative behavior can be sustained as an equilibrium in repeated settings. Early papers on private monitoring and a recent paper of Cole and Kocherlakota (Games and Economic Behavior, 53 [2005], 59–72) challenge the robustness of this result by providing examples in which cooperation breaks down when players observe only imperfect private signals about other players' actions, or when attention is restricted to strategies with finite memory. This paper shows that Cole and Kocherlakota's result is an artefact of a further restriction that they impose. We prove that the folk theorem with imperfect public monitoring holds with strategies with finite memory. As a corollary, we establish that the folk theorem extends to environments in which monitoring is close to public, yet private.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1773.abstractZh: 重复博弈的民间定理表明，合作行为可以在重复博弈中作为均衡状态持续存在。早期关于私人监控的研究以及Cole和Kocherlakota最近的一篇论文（《博弈与经济行为》，53 [2005]，59–72）通过提供例子来挑战这一结果的稳健性，这些例子表明，当玩家只能观察到关于其他玩家行为的不完美的私人信号，或者当注意力仅限于具有有限记忆的策略时，合作行为会破裂。本文表明，Cole和Kocherlakota的结果是他们施加的进一步限制所导致的产物。我们证明了在具有有限记忆的策略下，带有不完美公共监控的民间定理仍然成立。作为推论，我们确立了民间定理可以扩展到监控接近公共但仍然是私有的环境。

abstract.text: We conducted online field experiments in large real-world social networks in order to decompose prosocial giving into three components: (1) baseline altruism toward randomly selected strangers, (2) directed altruism that favors friends over random strangers, and (3) giving motivated by the prospect of future interaction. Directed altruism increases giving to friends by 52% relative to random strangers, whereas future interaction effects increase giving by an additional 24% when giving is socially efficient. This finding suggests that future interaction affects giving through a repeated game mechanism where agents can be rewarded for granting efficiency-enhancing favors. We also find that subjects with higher baseline altruism have friends with higher baseline altruism.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1815.abstractZh: 我们在大型现实社会网络中进行了在线实地实验，以将亲社会行为分解为三个组成部分：(1)对随机选择的陌生人的基础利他行为；(2)倾向于优先给予朋友而非随机陌生人的定向利他行为；以及(3)由未来互动前景所驱动的给予行为。与随机陌生人相比，定向利他行为使对朋友的给予增加了52%，而当给予行为具有社会效率时，未来互动效应则使给予增加了额外的24%。这一发现表明，未来互动通过重复博弈机制影响给予行为，其中参与者可以通过给予提高效率的善行而获得奖励。我们还发现，基础利他行为较高的受试者，其朋友也具有较高基础利他行为。

abstract.text: We test whether textbook consumers are forward-looking, using a large new data set on textbooks sold in college bookstores during the ten semesters from 1997 to 2001. The data strongly support the hypothesis that students are forward-looking with low short-run discount rates and that they behave as if they have rational expectations of publishers' revision behavior. Data from a second new data set on the market prices of used books at Amazon Marketplace also support the hypothesis of rational, forward-looking behavior. Simulation results indicate that students are sufficiently forward-looking that publishers cannot consistently raise revenue by accelerating current revision cycles.

10.1162/qjec.2009.124.4.1853.abstractZh: 我们测试了教科书消费者是否具有前瞻性，使用了1997年至2001年十年间在大学书店销售的教科书的大量新数据。数据强烈支持这样的假设：学生具有前瞻性，短期折扣率较低，并且他们似乎对出版商的修订行为有理性预期。来自亚马逊市场二手书价格的新数据也支持了这种理性、前瞻性的行为假设。模拟结果表明，学生的前瞻性足够强，以至于出版商无法通过加快当前修订周期来持续增加收入。

abstract.text: This article reviews the literature relating quality to consumer choice of health plan or health care provider. Evidence suggests that consumers tend to choose better performing health plans and providers and are responsive to initiatives that provide quality information. The response to quality and quality information differs significantly among consumers and across population subgroups. As such the effect of quality information on choice is apparent in only a relatively small, though perhaps consequential, number of consumers. Despite the wealth of findings on the topic to date, the authors suggest directions for future work, including better assessment of the dynamic issues related to information release, as well as a better understanding of how the response to information varies across different groups of patients.

10.1177/1077558708325887.abstractZh: 本文综述了关于质量对消费者选择健康计划或医疗服务提供者影响的文献。研究表明，消费者倾向于选择表现更好的健康计划和医疗服务提供者，并且会对提供质量信息的举措表现出积极反应。然而，不同消费者以及不同人群亚群对质量和质量信息的反应存在显著差异。因此，质量信息对消费者选择的影响仅在相对较少的消费者中显现出来，尽管这种影响可能非常重要。尽管迄今为止关于这一主题的研究成果丰富，作者仍提出了未来研究的方向，包括更好地评估与信息发布相关的动态问题，以及更好地理解不同患者群体对信息的反应差异。

abstract.text: The authors describe the history and development of the CAHPS Hospital Survey (also known as HCAHPS) and its associated protocols. The randomized mode experiment, vendor training, and "dry runs" that set the stage for initial public reporting are described. The rapid linkage of HCAHPS data to annual payment updates ("pay for reporting") is noted, which in turn led to the participation of approximately 3,900 general acute care hospitals (about 90% of all such United States hospitals). The authors highlight the opportunities afforded by this publicly reported data on hospital inpatients' experiences and perceptions of care. These data, reported on www.hospitalcompare.hhs. gov, facilitate the national comparison of patients' perspectives of hospital care and can be used alone or in conjunction with other clinical and outcome measures. Potential benefits include increased transparency, improved consumer decision making, and increased incentives for the delivery of high-quality health care.

10.1177/1077558709341065.abstractZh: 作者描述了CAHPS医院调查（也称为HCAHPS）的历史与发展及其相关协议。文中提到了随机模式实验、供应商培训以及为首次公开报告做准备的各种“预演”。同时指出，HCAHPS数据与年度支付更新（“付费以换取报告”）的快速关联，使得约3,900家普通急性护理医院参与了这项调查，约占美国所有此类医院的90%。作者强调了这一公开报告的数据在了解医院住院患者体验与护理感受方面的价值。这些数据可在www.hospitalcompare.hhs.gov网站上获取，有助于在全国范围内比较患者对于医院护理的看法，可以单独使用，也可以与其他临床和结果指标结合使用。其潜在益处包括提高透明度、改善消费者决策能力，以及增加提供高质量医疗保健的激励措施。

abstract.text: We study peer effects in the workplace. Specifically, we investigate whether, how, and why the productivity of a worker depends on the productivity of coworkers in the same team. Using high-frequency data on worker productivity from a large supermarket chain, we find strong evidence of positive productivity spillovers from the introduction of highly productive personnel into a shift. Worker effort is positively related to the productivity of workers who see him, but not workers who do not see him. Additionally, workers respond more to the presence of coworkers with whom they frequently interact. We conclude that social pressure can partially internalize free-riding externalities that are built into many workplaces. (JEL J24, L81, M54)

10.1257/aer.99.1.112.abstractZh: 我们研究了工作场所中的同伴效应。具体来说，我们探讨了工人的生产力是否、如何以及为何取决于同一团队中同事的生产力。利用大型超市连锁企业提供的工人生产力高频数据，我们发现，引入高生产力的员工到轮班工作中，会带来积极的生产力溢出效应。工人的努力程度与看到他的同事的生产力呈正相关，而与看不到他的同事则无关。此外，工人对经常互动的同事的反应更为积极。我们得出结论，社会压力可以部分内生化许多工作场所中存在的搭便车外部性。（JEL J24, L81, M54）

abstract.text: Using estate tax returns data, we observe that the share of women among the very wealthy in the United States peaked in the late 1960s at nearly one-half and then declined to one-third. We argue that this pattern reflects changes in the importance of dynastic wealth, with the share of women proxying for inherited wealth. If so, wealth mobility decreased until the 1970s and rose thereafter. Such an interpretation is consistent with technological change driving long-term trends in mobility and inequality, as well as the recent divergence between top wealth and top income shares documented elsewhere. (JEL D31, J16, J62, O33)

10.1257/aer.99.1.146.abstractZh: 通过房地产税申报数据，我们发现美国非常富有的人群中女性的比例在1960年代末达到近一半的峰值，之后下降到三分之一。我们认为这一模式反映了世袭财富重要性变化的影响，女性在继承财富中的比例发生了变化。如果真是这样，那么财富流动性在1970年代之前有所下降，之后又有所上升。这种解释与技术变革对流动性和不平等长期趋势的影响相一致，也与其他研究中所记录的顶级财富与顶级收入份额之间的近期差异相符。（JEL D31, J16, J62, O33）

abstract.text: This paper examines how schools' choices of class size and households' choices of schools affect regression-discontinuity-based estimates of the effect of class size on student outcomes. We build a model in which schools are subject to a class-size cap and an integer constraint on the number of classrooms, and higher-income households sort into higher-quality schools. The key prediction, borne out in data from Chile's liberalized education market, is that schools at the class-size cap adjust prices (or enrollments) to avoid adding an additional classroom, which generates discontinuities in the relationship between enrollment and household characteristics, violating the assumptions underlying regression-discontinuity research designs. (JEL D12, I21, I28, O15)

10.1257/aer.99.1.179.abstractZh: 本文探讨了学校班级规模的选择以及家庭对学校的选择如何影响基于回归不连续性的班级规模对学生学业成果影响的估计。我们构建了一个模型，其中学校受到班级规模上限的约束，并且教室数量也受到整数约束；同时，高收入家庭更倾向于选择质量更高的学校。根据智利自由化教育市场的数据，这一模型的关键预测是：处于班级规模上限的学校会调整学费或入学人数，以避免增加额外的教室，这导致入学人数与家庭特征之间的关系出现不连续性，从而违反了基于回归不连续性的研究设计的假设。（JEL D12, I21, I28, O15）

abstract.text: This paper explores how to optimally set taxes and transfers when taxation authorities are uninformed about individuals' value of time in both market and nonmarket activities; and can observe both market-income and time allocated to market employment. We show that optimal redistribution in this environment involves a cutoff wage whereby workers above the cutoff are taxed as they increase their income, while workers earning a wage below the cutoff receive an income supplement as they increase their income. Finally, we show that the optimal program transfers zero income to individuals who choose not to work. (JEL D31, H21, H23, H24)

10.1257/aer.99.1.216.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在税收部门无法了解个人在市场和非市场活动中的时间价值时，如何最优地设定税收和转移支付；同时需要考虑市场收入以及用于市场就业的时间。我们指出，在这种环境下，最优的再分配方案涉及一个临界工资水平，超过该水平的工人会随着收入的增加而纳税，而收入低于临界工资的工人则会在收入增加时获得收入补贴。最后，我们表明，最优的转移支付方案会向选择不工作的个人转移零收入。（JEL D31, H21, H23, H24）

abstract.text: A representative-consumer model with Epstein-Zin-Weil preferences and i.i.d. shocks, including rare disasters, accords with observed equity premia and risk-free rates if the coefficient of relative risk aversion equals 3–4. If the intertemporal elasticity of substitution exceeds one, an increase in uncertainty lowers the price-dividend ratio for equity, and a rise in the expected growth rate raises this ratio. Calibrations indicate that society would willingly reduce GDP by around 20 percent each year to eliminate rare disasters. The welfare cost from usual economic fluctuations is much smaller, though still important, corresponding to lowering GDP by about 1.5 percent each year. (JEL E13, E21, E22, E32)

10.1257/aer.99.1.243.abstractZh: 一个包含Epstein-Zin-Weil偏好和独立同分布冲击的代表性消费者模型，如果相对风险厌恶系数等于3-4，则符合观察到的股权溢价和无风险利率。如果跨期替代弹性超过1，不确定性的增加会降低股权的价格-股息比率，而预期增长率的上升则会提高这一比率。校准结果表明，社会愿意每年减少约20%的GDP来消除罕见灾害。虽然通常的经济波动带来的福利成本要小得多，但仍然很重要，相当于每年减少约1.5%的GDP。（JEL E13, E21, E22, E32）

abstract.text: We quantitatively characterize the optimal capital and labor income tax in an overlapping generations model with idiosyncratic, uninsurable income shocks and permanent productivity differences of households. The optimal capital income tax rate is significantly positive at 36 percent. The optimal progressive labor income tax is, roughly, a flat tax of 23 percent with a deduction of $7,200 (relative to average household income of $42,000). The high optimal capital income tax is mainly driven by the life-cycle structure of the model, whereas the optimal progressivity of the labor income tax is attributable to the insurance and redistribution role of the tax system. (JEL E13, H21, H24, H25)

10.1257/aer.99.1.25.abstractZh: 我们在一个具有独特、不可保险的收入冲击以及家庭间永久性生产力差异的重叠代模型中对最优资本和劳动所得税进行了定量分析。最优资本所得税税率显著为正，为36%。最优累进劳动所得税税率大致为23%，并附带7,200美元的扣除（相对于平均家庭收入42,000美元）。较高的最优资本所得税税率主要源于模型的生命周期结构，而劳动所得税的累进性则归因于税收制度的保险和再分配功能。（JEL E13, H21, H24, H25）

abstract.text: Thinking about contingencies, designing covenants, and seeing through their implications is costly. Parties to a contract accordingly use heuristics and leave it incomplete. The paper develops a model of limited cognition and examines its consequences for contractual design. (JEL D23, D82, D86, L22)

10.1257/aer.99.1.265.abstractZh: 考虑各种可能性、设计契约以及理解其含义都是成本高昂的。因此，合同各方会采用启发式方法来处理这些问题，并让契约内容保持不完整。本文提出了一个有限认知模型，并探讨了其对契约设计的影响。（JEL D23, D82, D86, L22）

abstract.text: We present the results of an experiment that attempts to measure the social value of groups. In the experiment, group membership is induced artificially: subjects interact with insiders and outsiders in trust games and periodically enter markets where they can trade group membership. We find that trust falls with groups because of negative discrimination against outsiders. Against this, however, there is evidence that group membership provides a psychological benefit, albeit one that may induce social inertia. Overall, the welfare effects of groups are at best neutral and could be negative. (JEL: D17, Z13)

10.1257/aer.99.1.295.abstractZh: 我们展示了一项实验的结果，该实验试图衡量群体的社会价值。在实验中，群体成员身份被人为地诱导：参与者在信任游戏中与内部成员和外部成员互动，并定期进入可以交易群体成员身份的市场。我们发现，由于对外部成员的负面歧视，群体的信任度下降。然而，有证据表明，群体成员身份提供了某种心理上的好处，尽管这种好处可能会引发社会惰性。总体而言，群体的福利效应最多是中性的，甚至可能是负面的。（JEL：D17, Z13）

abstract.text: In mid-1995, a government effort to reduce the supply of methamphetamine precursors successfully disrupted the methamphetamine market and interrupted a trajectory of increasing usage. The price of methamphetamine tripled and purity declined from 90 percent to 20 percent. Simultaneously, amphetaminerelated hospital and treatment admissions dropped 50 percent and 35 percent, respectively. Methamphetamine use among arrestees declined 55 percent. Although felony methamphetamine arrests fell 50 percent, there is no evidence of substantial reductions in property or violent crime. The impact was largely temporary. The price returned to its original level within four months; purity, hospital admissions, treatment admissions, and arrests approached preintervention levels within eighteen months. (JEL I12, K42).

10.1257/aer.99.1.324.abstractZh: 1995年中期，政府为减少甲基苯丙胺前体的供应而采取的行动成功扰乱了甲基苯丙胺市场，并中断了其使用量的上升趋势。甲基苯丙胺的价格翻了三倍，纯度从90%降至20%。与此同时，与安非他明相关的医院治疗和入院人数分别下降了50%和35%。被捕者中甲基苯丙胺的使用量下降了55%。尽管重罪甲基苯丙胺的逮捕数量减少了50%，但并没有证据表明财产犯罪或暴力犯罪有显著减少。这种影响主要是暂时的。价格在四个月内回到了原来的水平；纯度、医院治疗人数和逮捕数量在十八个月内逐渐回到了干预前的水平。（JEL I12, K42）

abstract.text: This paper shows that the recent evidence that disaggregated prices are volatile does not necessarily challenge the hypothesis of price rigidity used in a large class of macroeconomic models. We document the effect of macroeconomic and sectoral disturbances by estimating a factor-augmented vector autoregression using a large set of macroeconomic indicators and disaggregated prices. Our main finding is that disaggregated prices appear sticky in response to macroeconomic and monetary disturbances, but flexible in response to sector-specific shocks. The observed flexibility of disaggregated prices reflects the fact that sector-specific shocks account on average for 85 percent of their monthly fluctuations. (JEL E13, E31, E32, E52)

10.1257/aer.99.1.350.abstractZh: 本文指出，近期关于分解后价格具有波动性的证据，并不必然挑战许多宏观经济模型中使用的价格刚性假设。我们通过使用大量宏观经济指标和分解后的价格，估计了因子增强的向量自回归模型，从而揭示了宏观经济和部门性扰动的影响。我们的主要发现是，分解后的价格在应对宏观经济和货币扰动时表现出粘性，但在应对部门特定冲击时则表现出灵活性。分解后价格所表现出的灵活性反映了部门特定冲击平均占其月度波动的85%。（JEL E13, E31, E32, E52）

abstract.text: Choice problems in the spirit of Ellsberg (1961) suggest that rank-dependent (“Choquet expected utility”) preferences over subjective gambles might be subject to the same difficulties that Ellsberg's earlier examples posed for subjective expected utility. These difficulties stem from event-separability properties that rank-dependent preferences partially retain from expected utility, and suggest that nonseparable models of preferences might be better at capturing features of behavior that lead to these paradoxes. (JEL D81)

10.1257/aer.99.1.385.abstractZh: 根据Ellsberg在1961年提出的观点，基于等级依赖的偏好（即Choquet期望效用）在主观赌博中的处理可能会遇到与Ellsberg早期研究中的主观期望效用问题相同的困难。这些困难源于等级依赖偏好部分保留了期望效用中的事件可分离性特性，这表明非可分离偏好模型可能更能捕捉导致这些悖论的行为特征。（JEL D81）

abstract.text: I use data on the hospital networks offered by managed care health insurers to estimate the expected division of profits between insurers and providers. I include a simple profit-maximization framework and an additional effect: hospitals that can secure demand without contracting with all insurers (e.g., those most attractive to consumers and those that are capacity constrained) may demand high prices that some insurers refuse to pay. Hospital mergers may also affect price bargaining. I estimate that all three types of hospitals capture higher markups than other providers. These results provide information on the hospital investment incentives generated by bargaining.

10.1257/aer.99.1.393.abstractZh: 我使用了管理式医疗健康保险公司提供的医院网络数据，来估算保险公司与医疗服务提供者之间利润的预期分配。我引入了一个简单的利润最大化框架，并考虑了另一个影响因素：那些能够在不与所有保险公司合作的情况下获得需求的医院（例如，那些对消费者最具吸引力的医院以及那些面临产能限制的医院），可能会要求较高的价格，而有些保险公司则拒绝支付这样的价格。医院合并也可能影响价格谈判。我的估计是，这三种类型的医院比其他医疗服务提供者获得了更高的利润加成。这些结果提供了关于医院投资激励机制的信息。

abstract.text: We present a laboratory experiment that measures the effects of induced group identity on social preferences. We find that when participants are matched with an ingroup member, they show a 47 percent increase in charity concerns and a 93 percent decrease in envy. Likewise, participants are 19 percent more likely to reward an ingroup match for good behavior, but 13 percent less likely to punish an ingroup match for misbehavior. Furthermore, participants are significantly more likely to choose social-welfare-maximizing actions when matched with an ingroup member. All results are consistent with the hypothesis that participants are more altruistic toward an ingroup match. (JEL C91, D03, Z13)

10.1257/aer.99.1.431.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项实验室实验，旨在测量群体认同对社会偏好影响的效果。研究发现，当参与者与某个群体成员配对时，他们的慈善意愿会增加47%，嫉妒情绪则会减少93%。同样，参与者奖励表现出良好行为的群体成员的可能性增加19%，而惩罚表现出不当行为的群体成员的可能性则减少13%。此外，当参与者与某个群体成员配对时，他们选择能够最大化社会福利的行为的可能性显著增加。所有结果都支持这样的假设：参与者对与群体成员配对的个体表现出更多的利他行为。（JEL C91, D03, Z13）

abstract.text: I examine excise taxes levied on multiproduct retailers. Excise taxes reduce equilibrium output and decrease equilibrium product variety in the short run, but taxes can raise output per product in the long run and induce entry. Excise taxes are overshifted into prices in a wide range of cases, including under linear and concave demand conditions, and excise taxes shift less than one-for-one into prices only when demand is highly convex. Multiproduct transactions substantively alter the efficiency of ad valorem and specific forms of excise taxes and affect the comparison of relative tax performance over short-run and long-run time horizons. (JEL H25, H32, L11, L13, L81)

10.1257/aer.99.1.458.abstractZh: 我研究了针对多产品零售商的消费税。消费税在短期内会减少均衡产出和商品种类，但在长期内可以提高每产品的产出并促进新企业的进入。在多种情况下，消费税会转移到价格上，包括在线性需求和凹形需求条件下，只有当需求高度凸形时，消费税的转移比例才会小于1:1。多产品交易实质上改变了从价税和从量税的效率，并影响了短期和长期内相对税收绩效的比较。（JEL H25, H32, L11, L13, L81）

abstract.text: We study minority representation in the workplace when employers engage in optimal sequential search and minorities convey noisier signals of ability than mainstream job candidates. The greater signal noise makes it harder for minorities to change employers' prior beliefs. When employers are selective, this leads to minority underrepresentation in the workplace. Diversity improves when the cost of interviewing, the average skill level of candidates, or the opportunity cost of not hiring increases. Reducing the cost of firing also increases minority representation. When employers are sufficiently unselective, the rigidity of employers' beliefs leads to overrepresentation of minorities. (JEL D83, J15, J24, J71, M12, M51)

10.1257/aer.99.1.472.abstractZh: 我们研究了在雇主进行最优顺序搜索时，少数族裔在工作场所中的代表性问题。由于少数族裔传递的能力信号比主流求职者更嘈杂，因此他们更难以改变雇主先前的认知。当雇主具有选择性时，这会导致少数族裔在工作场所中的代表性不足。当面试成本、候选人的平均技能水平或不招聘的机会成本增加时，多样性会得到改善。降低解雇成本也能增加少数族裔的代表性。当雇主的选择性足够低时，雇主认知的僵化会导致少数族裔的过度代表性。（JEL D83, J15, J24, J71, M12, M51）

abstract.text: Cash transfers to eligible households indirectly increase the consumption of ineligible households living in the same villages. This effect operates through insurance and credit markets: ineligible households benefit from the transfers by receiving more gifts and loans and by reducing their savings. Thus, the transfers benefit the local economy at large; looking only at the effect on the treated underestimates their impact. One should analyze the effects of this class of programs on the entire local economy, rather than on the treated only, and use a village-level randomization, rather than selecting treatment nd control subjects from the same community. (JEL H23, I38, O12, O15)

10.1257/aer.99.1.486.abstractZh: 向符合条件的家庭进行现金转移会间接增加同一村庄内不符合条件的家庭的消费。这种效应是通过保险和信贷市场实现的：不符合条件的家庭通过获得更多的赠与和贷款，以及减少储蓄而从中受益。因此，这些转移实际上对当地经济整体都有益处；仅关注对受干预群体的影响会低估其实际效果。应当分析这类项目对整个当地经济的影响，而不仅仅是受干预群体，并且应采用村庄级别的随机化方法，而不是从同一社区中选择处理组和对照组。（JEL H23, I38, O12, O15）

abstract.text: We present new evidence on consumer liquidity constraints and the credit market conditions that might give rise to them. We analyze unique data from a large auto sales company serving the subprime market. Short-term liquidity appears to be a key driver of consumer behavior. Demand increases sharply during tax rebate season and purchases are highly sensitive to down-payment requirements. Lenders also face substantial informational problems. Default rates rise significantly with loan size, providing a rationale for loan caps, and higher-risk borrowers demand larger loans. This adverse selection is mitigated, however, by risk-based pricing. (JEL D14, D82, D83, G21)

10.1257/aer.99.1.49.abstractZh: 我们提出了关于消费者流动性约束的新证据，以及可能导致这些约束的信贷市场状况。我们分析了一家服务于次级市场的大型汽车销售公司的独特数据。短期流动性似乎是驱动消费者行为的关键因素。在税收返还期间，需求会急剧增加，而购买行为对首付要求非常敏感。贷款机构也面临巨大的信息问题。随着贷款规模的扩大，违约率会显著上升，这为设定贷款上限提供了依据；高风险借款人则要求更大的贷款额度。然而，基于风险的定价可以缓解这种逆向选择问题。（JEL D14, D82, D83, G21）

abstract.text: The concept of “governance ” has risen from obscurity to buzzword status in just three decades. EconLit shows only 5 mentions of the word governance in the 1970s; by the end of 2008, it was mentioned 33,177 times. The much more specific phrase “economic governance ” has appeared 192 times;1 its more popular cousin, “corporate governance, ” 9,717 times. My focus is on economic governance, but I also examine its relation to corporate governance. As with any buzzword, everyone understands the concept a little differently. This is unavoidable, so I will just give my definition for the purpose of this article, and leave it at that. By economic governance I mean the structure and functioning of the legal and social institutions that support economic activity and economic transactions by protecting property rights, enforcing contracts, and taking collective action to provide physical and organizational infrastructure. Economic governance is important because markets, and economic activity and transactions more generally, cannot function well in its absence. Good governance is needed to secure three essential prerequisites of market economies: (1) Security of property rights: Without this, individuals will lack the incentives to save and invest, because they will fear that others will deprive them of the fruits of these activities. They will also forgo capital market trades to achieve efficient allocation of

10.1257/aer.99.1.5.abstractZh: “治理”这一概念在短短三十年内从默默无闻发展成为热门词汇。根据EconLit的数据，20世纪70年代，“治理”一词仅被提及5次；而到了2008年底，其被提及的次数已上升至33,177次。更为具体的“经济治理”一词则出现了192次；而更为流行的“公司治理”一词则出现了9,717次。我的重点在于经济治理，但我也探讨了它与公司治理之间的关系。就像任何热门词汇一样，人们对这一概念的理解各不相同。这是不可避免的，因此我仅为本文提供我的定义，不再赘述。所谓经济治理，指的是通过保护财产权、执行合同以及采取集体行动来提供物理和组织基础设施，从而支持经济活动和经济交易的法律和社会机构的架构与运作。经济治理之所以重要，是因为没有它，市场以及更广泛的经济活动和交易将无法良好运作。良好的治理对于确保市场经济的三个基本前提至关重要：（1）财产权的保障：如果没有这种保障，个人将缺乏储蓄和投资的动力，因为他们会担心他人会剥夺他们从这些活动中获得的收益。他们还会放弃资本市场交易以实现有效的资源配置。

abstract.text: Speeding tickets are determined not only by the speed of the offender, but also by incentives faced by police officers and their vote-maximizing principals. We hypothesize that police officers issue fines more frequently when drivers have a higher opportunity cost of contesting a ticket, and when drivers are not residents of the local municipality. We also predict that local officers are more likely to issue a ticket to out-of-town drivers when fiscal conditions are tight and legal limits prevent increases in property taxes. Using data from traffic stops in Massachusetts, we find support for our hypotheses. (JEL H76, R41)

10.1257/aer.99.1.509.abstractZh: 超速罚单的判定不仅取决于违规者的速度，还取决于警察面临的激励因素以及他们追求利益最大化原则。我们假设，当司机对罚单提出异议的机会成本较高，或者司机并非当地居民时，警察更有可能开出罚单。我们还预测，在财政状况紧张且法律限制导致财产税无法增加时，当地警察更有可能对外地司机开出罚单。通过马萨诸塞州交通拦截的数据分析，我们发现我们的假设得到了支持。（JEL H76, R41）

abstract.text: Despite the large amount of private and public resources spent on foreign education, there is no systematic evidence that foreign-educated individuals foster democracy in their home countries. Using a unique panel dataset on foreign students starting in the 1950s, I show that foreign-educated individuals promote democracy in their home country, but only if the foreign education is acquired in democratic countries. The results are robust to several estimation techniques, to different definitions of democracy, and to the inclusion of a variety of control variables, including democracy in trading partners, neighboring countries, level of income, and level and stock of education. (JEL D72, I21, O15, O17, P26)

10.1257/aer.99.1.528.abstractZh: 尽管在外国教育上投入了大量私人和公共资源，但并没有系统性的证据表明接受外国教育的人能够促进其祖国的民主发展。通过利用1950年代开始使用的独特学生面板数据集，我发现接受外国教育的人确实能够促进其祖国的民主发展，但前提是这些教育是在民主国家获得的。研究结果在采用不同的估计方法、对民主的定义进行调整，以及纳入各种控制变量时依然保持稳定。（JEL D72, I21, O15, O17, P26）

abstract.text: This paper experimentally examines image motivation—the desire to be liked and well regarded by others—as a driver in prosocial behavior (doing good), and asks whether extrinsic monetary incentives (doing well) have a detrimental effect on prosocial behavior due to crowding out of image motivation. Using the unique property of image motivation—its dependency on visibility—we show that image is indeed an important part of the motivation to behave prosocially, and that extrinsic incentives crowd out image motivation. Therefore, monetary incentives are more likely to be counterproductive for public prosocial activities than for private ones. (JEL D64, L31, Z13)

10.1257/aer.99.1.544.abstractZh: 本文通过实验研究图像动机——即被他人喜爱和尊敬的愿望——作为亲社会行为（做好事）的驱动力，并探讨外部金钱激励（做好事）是否会对亲社会行为产生负面影响，原因是它会挤占图像动机的作用。利用图像动机的独特特性——其依赖于可见性——我们发现，图像确实是促使人们采取亲社会行为的动机的重要组成部分，而外部激励则会挤占图像动机的作用。因此，金钱激励更有可能对公共亲社会活动产生反效果，而对私人活动则不然。（JEL D64, L31, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper studies the estate tax in a quantitative framework with business investment, borrowing constraints, estate transmission, and wealth inequality. We find that the estate tax has little effect on the saving and investment decisions of small businesses, but does distort the decisions of larger firms, thereby reducing aggregate output and savings. Removing such distortions by eliminating the estate tax does not necessarily imply that everyone would be better off. If other taxes were raised to reestablish fiscal balance, those at the top of the wealth distribution would experience a large welfare gain, but most of the population would lose. (JEL D31, E21, H2)

10.1257/aer.99.1.85.abstractZh: 本文采用定量框架研究遗产税对商业投资、借贷限制、遗产传承以及财富不平等的影响。研究发现，遗产税对小型企业的储蓄和投资决策影响较小，但确实扭曲了大型企业的决策，从而降低了总体产出和储蓄。通过取消遗产税来消除这种扭曲，并不一定意味着每个人的状况都会改善。如果通过提高其他税收来重新实现财政平衡，那么财富分布顶端的人群将获得较大的福利收益，而大多数人口则会遭受损失。（JEL D31, E21, H2）

abstract.text: We examine the effect of early-life rainfall on the health, education, and socioeconomic outcomes of Indonesian adults. We link historical rainfall for each individual's birth year and birth location with adult outcomes from the 2000 Indonesia Family Life Survey (IFLS). Higher early-life rainfall has large positive effects on the adult outcomes of women, but not of men. Women with 20 percent higher rainfall (relative to the local norm) are 0.57 centimeters taller, complete 0.22 more schooling grades, and live in households scoring 0.12 standard deviations higher on an asset index. Schooling attainment appears to mediate the impact on adult women's socioeconomic status. (JEL I12, I21, J16, O15)

10.1257/aer.99.3.1006.abstractZh: 我们研究了早期降雨对印度尼西亚成年人健康、教育和社会经济成果的影响。我们将每个人出生年份和出生地的历史降雨数据与2000年印度尼西亚家庭生活调查中的成年人结果进行了关联分析。较高的早期降雨对女性的成年结果有显著的正面影响，但对男性则没有这种影响。降雨量比当地标准高出20%的女性，身高会高出0.57厘米，完成的教育年级会多出0.22个年级，并且生活在资产指数上高出0.12个标准差的家庭中。教育程度似乎在影响女性成年后的社会经济地位方面起到了中介作用。（JEL I12, I21, J16, O15）

abstract.text: This paper shows that the price of a painting sold at an art auction and the experts' pre-sale valuations are anchored on the price at which the painting previously sold at auction. We are able to separate anchoring from rational learning by using the identifying strategy that the unobservable component of quality for a particular painting remains constant between the last auction sale and the current auction sale. We interpret these results as anchoring on the part of the buyers, with the sellers and auctioneers either anticipating anchoring on the part of the buyers or exhibiting anchoring effects themselves. (JEL D44, Z11)

10.1257/aer.99.3.1027.abstractZh: 本文指出，在艺术拍卖中出售的画作价格以及专家在拍卖前的估值，都是基于该画作之前在拍卖中的售价。我们通过使用一种识别策略来区分“锚定”和“理性学习”：即对于特定画作而言，其不可观测的质量成分在最后一次拍卖和当前拍卖之间保持不变。我们将这些结果解释为买家的“锚定”行为，而卖家和拍卖行则要么预期买家的“锚定”行为，要么自身表现出“锚定”效应。（JEL D44, Z11）

abstract.text: Post-1980 US data trace out a stable long-run money demand relationship of Cagan's semi-log form between the M1-income ratio and the nominal interest rate, with an interest semielasticity below 2. Integrating under this money demand curve yields estimates of the welfare costs of modest departures from Friedman's zero nominal interest rate rule for the optimum quantity of money that are quite small. The results suggest that the Federal Reserve's current policy, which generates low but still positive rates of inflation, provides an adequate approximation in welfare terms to the alternative of moving all the way to the Friedman rule. (JEL E31, E41, E52)

10.1257/aer.99.3.1040.abstractZh: 1980年后的美国数据表明，M1收入比率与名义利率之间存在一种稳定的长期货币需求关系，这种关系的利息半弹性低于2。根据这一货币需求曲线，可以估算出适度偏离弗里德曼的零名义利率规则所带来的福利成本，这些成本相当小。结果表明，美联储当前的政策虽然能维持较低但依然为正的通胀率，但从福利角度来看，这一政策足以替代完全遵循弗里德曼规则的政策。（JEL E31, E41, E52）

abstract.text: Shocks to the real price of oil may reflect oil supply shocks, shocks to the global demand for all industrial commodities, or demand shocks that are specific to the crude oil market. Each shock has different effects on the real price of oil and on US macroeconomic aggregates. Changes in the composition of shocks help explain why regressions of macroeconomic aggregates on oil prices tend to be unstable. Evidence that the recent surge in oil prices was driven primarily by global demand shocks helps explain why this shock so far has failed to cause a major recession in the United States. (JEL E31, E32, Q41, Q43)

10.1257/aer.99.3.1053.abstractZh: 石油实际价格的波动可能反映了石油供应方面的冲击、全球对所有工业商品需求的冲击，或是特定于原油市场的需求冲击。每种冲击对石油实际价格以及美国宏观经济总量都有不同的影响。不同冲击构成的改变有助于解释为何将宏观经济总量与油价进行回归分析时结果往往不稳定。有证据表明，近期石油价格飙升主要是由全球需求方面的冲击所推动的，这也有助于解释为何这一冲击至今未能导致美国出现严重的经济衰退。（JEL E31, E32, Q41, Q43）

abstract.text: In a recent paper, Chiara Fumagalli and Massimo Motta (2006) challenge the idea that an incumbent can foreclose efficient entry in the face of scale economies by using exclusive contracts. They claim that inefficient exclusion does not arise when buyers are homogenous firms that compete downstream. However, when upstream firms can compete in two-part tariffs, their equilibrium analysis contains some errors. Fixing these errors, inefficient exclusion arises when scale economies are sufficiently large or the entrant's cost advantage is not too big. Inefficient exclusion arises to protect industry profits from competition. (JEL L11, L13, L14)

10.1257/aer.99.3.1070.abstractZh: 在最近的一篇论文中，Chiara Fumagalli和Massimo Motta（2006年）对“在位企业可以通过使用独家合同来阻止有效进入”这一观点提出了质疑。他们指出，当买家是同质企业且进行下游竞争时，并不会出现无效的排斥现象。然而，当上游企业能够以两部分定价的方式进行竞争时，他们的均衡分析存在某些错误。修正这些错误后，当规模经济足够大或新进入者的成本优势不是特别大时，就会出现无效的排斥现象。这种无效的排斥是为了保护行业利润免受竞争的影响。（JEL L11, L13, L14）

abstract.text: (June 2009) - Thirty years have passed since a small group of theorists began applying concepts and tools from industrial organization to the analysis of international trade. The new models of trade that emerged from that work didn't supplant traditional trade theory so much as supplement it, creating an integrated view that made sense of aspects of world trade that had previously posed major puzzles. The "new trade theory"—an unfortunate phrase, now quite often referred to as "the old new trade theory"—also helped build a bridge between the analysis of trade between countries and the location of production within countries. In this paper I will try to retrace the steps and, perhaps even more important, the state of mind that made this intellectual transformation possible. At the end I'll also ask about the relevance of those once-revolutionary insights in a world economy that, as I'll explain, is arguably more classical now than it was when the revolution in trade theory began.

10.1257/aer.99.3.561.abstractZh: （2009年6月）——自一小群理论家开始将产业组织学的概念和工具应用于国际贸易分析以来，已经过去了三十年。由此产生的新贸易模型并非完全取代传统贸易理论，而是对其进行了补充，形成了一种综合视角，使得那些曾经构成重大难题的世界贸易问题得以解释。“新贸易理论”——这个不幸的术语，现在常被称作“旧的新贸易理论”——还帮助建立了国家间贸易分析与国内生产布局之间的桥梁。在本文中，我将试图追溯这一思想转变的过程，或许更重要的是，探讨使这一转变成为可能的心态。最后，我还将探讨这些曾经具有革命性的见解在当今世界经济中的相关性，正如我将要解释的，当今世界经济可以说比贸易理论革命开始的时候更加传统了。

abstract.text: This paper develops a model in which a desire to avoid criticism prompts otherwise public-spirited bureaucrats to behave inefficiently. Decisions are taken to keep interest groups quiet and to keep mistakes out of the public eye. The policy implications of this “minimal squawk” behavior are at odds with the view that agencies should be structured to minimize the threat of “capture.” An empirical test using data from US State Public Utility Commissions rejects the capture hypothesis and is consistent with the squawk hypothesis: longer PUC terms of office are associated with a higher incidence of rate reviews and lower household electricity bills. (JEL D73, L51, L97, L98)

10.1257/aer.99.3.572.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，该模型表明，出于避免批评的动机，原本热心服务的官僚会采取低效的行为。他们做出决策的目的是让利益集团保持沉默，避免错误被公众知晓。这种“最低限度抱怨”行为的政策含义与“最小化被收买风险”的观点相悖。通过对美国各州公共事业委员会数据的实证检验，发现“被收买”假说不成立，而“抱怨”假说则得到支持：公共事业委员会任期越长，电价审查的频率越高，家庭电费支出越低。（JEL D73, L51, L97, L98）

abstract.text: A number of labor markets and student placement systems can be modeled as many-to-one matching markets. We analyze the scope for manipulation in many-to-one matching markets under the student-optimal stable mechanism when the number of participants is large. Under some regularity conditions, we show that the fraction of participants with incentives to misrepresent their preferences when others are truthful approaches zero as the market becomes large. With an additional condition, truthful reporting by every participant is an approximate equilibrium under the student-optimal stable mechanism in large markets. (JEL C78)

10.1257/aer.99.3.608.abstractZh: 许多劳动力市场和学生安置系统可以被建模为多对一匹配市场。我们分析了在参与者数量较多的情况下，多对一匹配市场中操纵行为的可能性。在某些规律性条件下，我们表明，当市场规模扩大时，那些有动机在他人如实陈述偏好的情况下歪曲自身偏好的参与者比例趋近于零。在另一个条件下，每个参与者都如实报告偏好，这在大型市场中近似构成一种均衡状态。（JEL C78）

abstract.text: The central insight of asset pricing is that a security's value depends both on its distribution of payoffs across economic states and on state prices. In fixed income markets, many investors focus exclusively on estimates of expected payoffs, such as credit ratings, without considering the state of the economy in which default occurs. Such investors are likely to be attracted to securities whose payoffs resemble economic catastrophe bonds—bonds that default only under severe economic conditions. We show that many structured finance instruments can be characterized as economic catastrophe bonds, but offer far less compensation than alternatives with comparable payoff profiles. (JEL G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.99.3.628.abstractZh: 资产定价的核心观点是，证券的价值不仅取决于其在不同经济状态下的收益分布，还取决于各经济状态下的价格。在固定收益市场中，许多投资者仅关注预期收益的估计，例如信用评级，而忽略了导致违约的经济状况。这类投资者可能会倾向于选择那些收益类似于“经济灾难债券”的证券——这类债券只有在严重经济条件下才会违约。我们指出，许多结构化金融工具可以被视为经济灾难债券，但其补偿程度远低于具有类似收益特征的替代方案。（JEL G11, G12）

abstract.text: We examine the impacts of increased US gasoline taxes in a model that links the markets for new, used, and scrapped vehicles and recognizes the considerable heterogeneity among households and cars. Household choice parameters derive from an estimation procedure that integrates individual choices for car ownership and miles traveled. We find that each cent-per-gallon increase in the price of gasoline reduces the equilibrium gasoline consumption by about 0.2 percent. Taking account of revenue recycling, the impact of a 25-cent gasoline tax increase on the average household is about $30 per year (2001 dollars). Distributional impacts depend importantly on how additional revenues from the tax increase are recycled. (JEL D12, H22, H25, L62, L71)

10.1257/aer.99.3.667.abstractZh: 我们在一个模型中研究了美国汽油税增加的影响，该模型将新车、二手车以及报废车辆的市场联系起来，并考虑到不同家庭和汽车之间的巨大差异。家庭选择参数是通过一个估计程序得出的，该程序整合了个人对汽车拥有量和行驶里程的选择。我们发现，每加仑汽油价格上涨1美分，均衡汽油消费量会减少约0.2%。考虑到收入再分配，汽油税增加25美分对普通家庭的影响约为每年30美元（以2001年美元计算）。收入分配的影响很大程度上取决于税收增加带来的额外收入如何被再分配。（JEL D12, H22, H25, L62, L71）

abstract.text: This paper derives empirically tractable formulas for the welfare effects of fare adjustments in passenger peak and off-peak rail and bus transit, and for optimal pricing of those services. The formulas account for congestion, pollution, accident externalities, scale economies, and agency adjustment of transit service offerings. We apply them using parameter values for Washington (DC), Los Angeles, and London. The results support the efficiency of the large current fare subsidies; even starting with fares at 50 percent of operating costs, incremental fare reductions are welfare improving in almost all cases. These findings are robust to alternative assumptions and parameters. (JEL L92, R41, R42, R48)

10.1257/aer.99.3.700.abstractZh: 本文通过实证方法推导出了在客运高峰和非高峰时期，铁路和公交服务的票价调整对福利影响的可行公式，以及这些服务的最优定价方案。这些公式考虑了拥堵、污染、事故外部性、规模经济以及公共交通服务提供的机构调整等因素。我们运用华盛顿特区、洛杉矶和伦敦的参数值对这些公式进行了验证。结果表明，目前的大规模票价补贴是有效的；即使从票价仅为运营成本50%的水平开始，逐步降低票价在几乎所有情况下都能提升福利。这些发现不受其他假设和参数的影响而保持稳定。（JEL L92, R41, R42, R48）

abstract.text: We develop a theory of resource management where the degree to which countries escape the tragedy of the commons, and hence the de facto property rights regime, is endogenously determined. Three forces determine success or failure in resource management: the regulator's enforcement power, the extent of harvesting capacity, and the ability of the resource to generate competitive returns without being extinguished. The model can explain heterogeneity across countries and resources in the effectiveness of resource management, and it predicts that changes in prices, population, and technology can cause transitions to better or worse management regimes. (JEL P14, Q21, Q22, Q23, Q32)

10.1257/aer.99.3.725.abstractZh: 我们发展了一种资源管理理论，其中国家摆脱“公地悲剧”的程度，以及由此产生的实际产权制度，是由内生因素决定的。在资源管理中，有三个因素决定成败：监管机构的执行能力、资源的采集能力，以及资源在不被耗尽的情况下产生竞争收益的能力。该模型能够解释不同国家和不同资源在资源管理效果上的差异，并预测价格、人口和技术的变化可能导致管理制度的转变，从较好的制度转变为较差的制度。（JEL P14, Q21, Q22, Q23, Q32）

abstract.text: The cornerstone of cartel enforcement in the United States and elsewhere is a commitment to the lenient prosecution of early confessors. A burgeoning game-theoretical literature is ambiguous regarding the impacts of leniency. I develop a theoretical model of cartel behavior that provides empirical predictions and moment conditions, and apply the model to the complete set of indictments and information reports issued over a 20-year span. Statistical tests are consistent with the notion that leniency enhances deterrence and detection capabilities. The results have implications for market efficiency and enforcement efforts against cartels and other forms of organized crime. (JEL D43, L12, L13, K21)

10.1257/aer.99.3.750.abstractZh: 在美国及其他地区，打击卡特尔行为的核心在于对早期自首者的宽容处理。关于宽容政策的影响，现有的博弈论文献存在争议。我构建了一个关于卡特尔行为的理论模型，该模型提供了实证预测和必要条件，并将该模型应用于20年间发布的全部指控和情报报告。统计结果支持宽容政策能够增强威慑效果和检测能力这一观点。这些结果对市场效率以及针对卡特尔和其他形式有组织犯罪的执法行动具有启示意义。（JEL D43, L12, L13, K21）

abstract.text: This paper presents a model in which price setting firms decide what to pay attention to, subject to a constraint on information flow. When idiosyncratic conditions are more variable or more important than aggregate conditions, firms pay more attention to idiosyncratic conditions than to aggregate conditions. When we calibrate the model to match the large average absolute size of price changes observed in micro data, prices react fast and by large amounts to idiosyncratic shocks, but only slowly and by small amounts to nominal shocks. Nominal shocks have strong and persistent real effects. (JEL D21, D83, E31, E52)

10.1257/aer.99.3.769.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，其中定价企业决定关注哪些因素，同时受到信息流动的限制。当特异性条件比总体条件更可变或更重要时，企业会更多地关注特异性条件，而不是总体条件。当我们调整模型以匹配微观数据中观察到的价格变化的较大平均绝对规模时，价格对特异性冲击的反应迅速且幅度较大，而对名义冲击的反应则较为缓慢且幅度较小。名义冲击具有强烈且持久的实际影响。（JEL D21, D83, E31, E52）

abstract.text: We investigate the consequences of demographic change for business cycle analysis. We find that changes in the age composition of the labor force account for a significant fraction of the variation in cyclical volatility observed in the G7. Since World War II, these countries have experienced dramatic demographic changes, although details regarding timing and nature differ across countries. We exploit this variation to show that the workforce age composition has a large and significant effect on cyclical volatility. We relate our results to the recent decline in US macroeconomic volatility, finding that demographic change accounts for approximately one-fifth to one-third of this moderation. (JEL E32, J11)

10.1257/aer.99.3.804.abstractZh: 我们研究了人口变化对商业周期分析的影响。我们发现，劳动力年龄结构的变化在G7国家观察到的周期性波动变化中占有相当大的比例。自第二次世界大战以来，这些国家经历了显著的人口变化，尽管具体的时间和性质在不同国家之间存在差异。我们利用这种差异表明，劳动力年龄结构对周期性波动有显著的影响。我们将我们的研究结果与美国近期宏观经济波动的下降联系起来，发现人口变化对此缓和现象的贡献约为五分之一到三分之一。（JEL E32, J11）

abstract.text: We invent Implicit Marshallian demands, which combine desirable features of Hicksian and Marshallian demands. We propose and estimate the Exact Affine Stone Index (EASI) implicit Marshallian demand system. Like the Almost Ideal Demand (AID) system, EASI budget shares are linear in parameters given real expenditures. However, unlike the AID, EASI demands can have any rank and its Engel curves can have any shape over real expenditures. EASI error terms equal random utility parameters to account for unobserved preference heterogeneity. EASI demand functions can be estimated using GMM or three stage least squares, and, like AID, an approximate EASI model can be estimated by linear regression. (JEL D11, D12)

10.1257/aer.99.3.827.abstractZh: 我们提出了隐式马歇尔需求模型，该模型结合了希克斯需求和马歇尔需求的理想特性。我们提出了精确仿射石指数隐式马歇尔需求系统，并对其进行估计。与几乎理想需求系统类似，EASI预算份额在给定实际支出的条件下是线性的。然而，与AID不同，EASI需求可以具有任意阶数，其恩格尔曲线在实际支出上也可以具有任意形状。EASI误差项等于随机效用参数，以反映未观察到的偏好异质性。EASI需求函数可以使用广义最小二乘法或三阶段最小二乘法进行估计，并且与AID类似，可以通过线性回归估计近似的EASI模型。（JEL D11, D12）

abstract.text: We report results from a randomized natural field experiment conducted in a restaurant dining setting to distinguish the observational learning effect from the saliency effect. We find that, when customers are given ranking information of the five most popular dishes, the demand for those dishes increases by 13 to 20 percent. We do not find a significant saliency effect. We also find modest evidence that the observational learning effects are stronger among infrequent customers, and that dining satisfaction is increased when customers are presented with the information of the top five dishes, but not when presented with only names of some sample dishes. (JEL C93, D83)

10.1257/aer.99.3.864.abstractZh: 我们报告了一项在餐厅用餐环境中进行的随机自然田野实验的结果，旨在区分观察学习效应与显著性效应。研究发现，当顾客获得五道最受欢迎菜肴的排名信息时，这些菜肴的需求增加了13%至20%。我们没有发现显著的显著性效应。此外，我们还发现，观察学习效应在不常光顾的顾客中更为明显，并且当顾客获得前五道菜肴的信息时，用餐满意度会有所提升，而仅获得部分样本菜肴名称时则不会如此。（JEL C93, D83）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the implications of the inherent conflict between two tasks performed by direct marketing agents: prospecting for customers and advising on the product's “suitability” for the specific needs of customers. When structuring salesforce compensation, firms trade off the expected losses from “misselling” unsuitable products with the agency costs of providing marketing incentives. We characterize how the equilibrium amount of misselling (and thus the scope of policy intervention) depends on features of the agency problem including: the internal organization of a firm's sales process, the transparency of its commission structure, and the steepness of its agents' sales incentives. (JEL M31, M37, M52)

10.1257/aer.99.3.883.abstractZh: 本文分析了直销代理人所承担的两项任务之间固有的冲突所带来的影响：寻找客户以及为产品“适用性”提供咨询，以符合客户的特定需求。在设定销售团队薪酬时，企业需要在因推荐不适合的产品而产生的预期损失与提供营销激励所带来的代理成本之间进行权衡。我们研究了这种不平衡程度（以及政策干预的范围）如何受到代理问题特征的影响，包括：企业的销售流程内部组织、佣金结构的透明度，以及代理人的销售激励强度。（JEL M31, M37, M52）

abstract.text: We develop a rational dynamic model in which people are loss averse over changes in beliefs about present and future consumption. Because changes in wealth are news about future consumption, preferences over money are reference-dependent. If news resonates more when about imminent consumption than when about future consumption, a decision maker might (to generate pleasant surprises) overconsume early relative to the optimal committed plan, increase immediate consumption following surprise wealth increases, and delay decreasing consumption following surprise losses. Since higher wealth mitigates the effect of bad news, people exhibit an unambiguous first-order precautionary-savings motive. (JEL D14, D81, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.99.3.909.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个理性动态模型，其中人们对于关于当前和未来消费信念的变化持损失厌恶态度。由于财富的变化是关于未来消费的消息，人们对金钱的偏好依赖于参考点。如果关于即将发生的消费的消息比关于未来消费的消息更能引起共鸣，那么决策者可能会（为了制造惊喜）相对于最优承诺计划更早地过度消费，在意外获得财富后增加即时消费，并在意外损失后推迟减少消费。由于更高的财富可以减轻坏消息的影响，人们表现出明确的一级预防性储蓄动机。（JEL D14, D81, D83, D91）

abstract.text: This paper explores a general model of the evolution and adaption of hedonic utility. It is shown that optimal utility will be increasing strongly in regions where choices have to be made often and decision mistakes have a severe impact on fitness. Several applications are suggested. In the context of intertemporal preferences, the model offers an evolutionary explanation for the existence of conflicting short- and long-run interests that lead to dynamic inconsistency. Concerning attitudes toward risk, an evolutionary explanation is given for S-shaped value functions that adjust to the decision maker's environment. (JEL D81, D83)

10.1257/aer.99.3.937.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一种关于享乐效用演变与适应的通用模型。研究表明，在需要频繁做出选择且决策错误会对适应性产生严重影响的区域，最优效用将会显著上升。文中还提出了几种应用案例。在跨时期偏好背景下，该模型为短期与长期利益之间的冲突导致动态不一致现象提供了进化论解释。关于风险态度，模型为S形价值函数如何根据决策者的环境进行调整提供了进化论解释。（JEL D81, D83）

abstract.text: There is economic pressure to postpone the retirement age, but employers are still reluctant to employ older workers. We investigate the comparative behavior of juniors and seniors in experiments conducted both onsite with the employees of two large firms and in a conventional laboratory environment with students and retirees. We show that seniors are no more risk averse than juniors and are typically more cooperative; both juniors and working seniors respond strongly to competition. The implication is that it may be beneficial to define additional incentives near the end of the career to motivate and retain older workers. (JEL C90, J14, J26, M12, M51)

10.1257/aer.99.3.956.abstractZh: 存在经济上的压力要求推迟退休年龄，但雇主仍然不愿雇佣年长的工人。我们通过在两家大型公司的员工现场实验以及在一个传统的实验室环境中对学生和退休人员进行的实验，研究了年轻员工和年长员工之间的比较行为。我们发现，年长员工并不比年轻员工更厌恶风险，而且通常更加合作；年轻员工和在职的年长员工都对竞争表现出强烈的反应。这意味着，在职业生涯的末期提供额外的激励措施，可能有助于激励和留住年长的工人。（JEL C90, J14, J26, M12, M51）

abstract.text: We study the emergence of norms of cooperation in experimental economies populated by strangers interacting indefinitely. Can these economies achieve full efficiency even without formal enforcement institutions? Which institutions for monitoring and enforcement facilitate cooperation? Finally, what classes of strategies do subjects employ? We find that, first, cooperation can be sustained even in anonymous settings; second, some type of monitoring and punishment institutions significantly promote cooperation; and, third, subjects mostly employ strategies that are selective in punishment. (JEL C71, C73, D12, Z13)

10.1257/aer.99.3.979.abstractZh: 我们研究了在由陌生人无限期互动组成的实验经济中，合作规范的出现。即使没有正式的执法机构，这些经济能否实现完全的效率？哪些监控和执法机构能够促进合作？最后，参与者会采用哪些策略？我们发现，首先，即使在匿名环境中，合作也能得以维持；其次，某种形式的监控和惩罚机制能够显著促进合作；第三，参与者大多会采用选择性惩罚的策略。（JEL C71, C73, D12, Z13）

abstract.text: Aggregate and sectoral comovement are central features of business cycles, so the ability to generate comovement is a natural litmus test for macroeconomic models. But it is a test that most models fail. We propose a unified model that generates aggregate and sectoral comovement in response to contemporaneous and news shocks about fundamentals. The fundamentals that we consider are aggregate and sectoral total factor productivity shocks as well as investment-specific technical change. The model has three key elements: variable capital utilization, adjustment costs to investment, and preferences that allow us to parameterize the strength of short-run wealth effects on the labor supply. (JEL E13, E20, E32)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1097.abstractZh: 总体和部门共动性是商业周期的核心特征，因此能否产生共动性是衡量宏观经济模型优劣的天然标准。然而，大多数模型都未能通过这一测试。我们提出了一个统一的模型，该模型能够响应关于基本面的同时性冲击和新闻冲击而产生总体和部门共动性。我们考虑的基本面包括总体和部门的全要素生产率冲击以及投资特定的技术变革。该模型有三个关键要素：可变资本利用率、投资调整成本，以及允许我们参数化短期财富效应对劳动力供应影响的强度。（JEL E13, E20, E32）

abstract.text: Many classes of assets are illiquid or nonmarketable in that they cannot always be traded immediately. Thus, a portfolio position in these becomes at least temporarily irreversible. We study the asset-pricing implications of this type of illiquidity in an exchange economy with heterogeneous agents. In this market, one asset is always liquid. The other asset can be traded initially, but then not again until after a “blackout” period. Illiquidity has a dramatic effect. Agents abandon diversification and choose polarized portfolios instead. The value of liquidity can represent a large portion of the equilibrium price of an asset. (JEL G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1119.abstractZh: 许多类型的资产都是非流动或不可交易的，因为它们不能总是立即被交易。因此，这些资产的投资组合至少在短期内是不可逆转的。我们研究了这种非流动性在具有异质代理人的交换经济中的资产定价影响。在这个市场中，有一种资产总是可以交易的，而另一种资产最初可以交易，但在一个“禁售期”之后就无法再交易了。非流动性会产生显著的影响：代理人会放弃多元化策略，转而选择两极分化的投资组合。流动性的价值可能占资产均衡价格的重要部分。（JEL G11, G12）

abstract.text: Using two strategies, we show that consumers underreact to taxes that are not salient. First, using a field experiment in a grocery store, we find that posting tax-inclusive price tags reduces demand by 8 percent. Second, increases in taxes included in posted prices reduce alcohol consumption more than increases in taxes applied at the register. We develop a theoretical framework for applied welfare analysis that accommodates salience effects and other optimization failures. The simple formulas we derive imply that the economic incidence of a tax depends on its statutory incidence, and that even policies that induce no change in behavior can create efficiency losses. (JEL C93, D12, H25, H71)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1145.abstractZh: 通过两种策略，我们证明了消费者对不显著的税收反应不足。首先，在一家杂货店进行实地实验后发现，标注包含税收的价格标签会使需求减少8%。其次，在标价中增加税收比在收银台增加税收更能减少酒精消费。我们提出了一个理论框架，用于进行应用性福利分析，该框架能够考虑显著性效应以及其他优化失败情况。我们推导出的简单公式表明，税收的经济负担取决于其法定负担，即使政策不会改变行为，也可能造成效率损失。（JEL C93, D12, H25, H71）

abstract.text: We experimentally study decentralized organizational learning. Our objective is to understand how learning members of an organization cope with the confounding effects of the simultaneous learning of others. We test the predictions of a stylized, rational agent model of organizational learning that provides sharp predictions as to how learning members of an organization might cope with the simultaneous learning of others as a function of fundamental variables, e.g., firm size and the discount factor. While the problem of learning while others are learning is quite difficult, we find support for the comparative static predictions of the model's unique symmetric equilibrium. (JEL C72, D23, D83)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1178.abstractZh: 我们通过实验研究分散式组织学习现象。我们的目标是了解组织成员如何应对他人同时学习所带来的干扰效应。我们检验了一个简化的理性代理模型对组织学习的预测，该模型能够准确预测组织成员如何根据基本变量（如企业规模和折现因子）来应对他人的同时学习。尽管在他人学习时自己进行学习的问题相当复杂，但我们发现该模型所预测的独特对称均衡与比较静态预测结果相符。（JEL C72, D23, D83）

abstract.text: We analyze models with interjurisdictional spillovers among heterogeneous jurisdictions, such as CO 2 emissions that affect the global environment. Each jurisdiction's emissions depend upon the local stock of capital, which is inter-jurisdictionally mobile and subject to local taxation. In important cases, decentralized policymaking leads to efficient resource allocation, even in the complete absence of corrective interventions by higher-level governments or coordination of policy through Coasian bargaining. In particular, even when the preferences and production technologies differ among the agents, the decentralized system can result in globally efficient allocation. (JEL D62, H23, H73, H87, Q58)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1206.abstractZh: 我们分析了具有跨司法管辖区溢出效应的异质司法管辖区模型，例如影响全球环境的二氧化碳排放。每个司法管辖区的排放取决于当地的资本存量，而资本在司法管辖区之间是可以流动的，并且受到当地税收的调控。在重要的情况下，即使没有上级政府的纠正性干预或通过科斯式谈判进行政策协调，去中心化的政策制定也能实现有效的资源分配。特别是，即使各主体之间的偏好和生产技术存在差异，去中心化系统仍然可以实现全球范围内的有效分配。（JEL D62, H23, H73, H87, Q58）

abstract.text: Economists generally assume that the state has sufficient institutional capacity to support markets and levy taxes. This paper develops a framework where “policy choices” in market regulation and taxation are constrained by past investments in legal and fiscal capacity. It studies the economic and political determinants of such investments, demonstrating that legal and fiscal capacity are typically complements. The results show that, among other things, common interest public goods, such as fighting external wars, as well as political stability and inclusive political institutions, are conducive to building state capacity. Some correlations in cross-country data are consistent with the theory. (JEL D72, E62, H11, H20, P14)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1218.abstractZh: 经济学家通常认为，国家拥有足够的制度能力来支持市场并征收税收。本文提出了一个框架，其中市场监管和税收方面的“政策选择”受到过去在法律和财政能力方面的投资所制约。本文研究了这些投资的的经济和政治决定因素，表明法律和财政能力通常是互补的。研究结果表明，诸如打击外部战争这样的公共利益，以及政治稳定和包容性的政治制度，都有助于提升国家的制度能力。跨国数据中的一些相关性与这一理论相符。（JEL D72, E62, H11, H20, P14）

abstract.text: I elicit causal effects of spousal observability and communication on financial choices of married individuals in the Philippines. When choices are private, men put money into their personal accounts. When choices are observable, men commit money to consumption for their own benefit. When required to communicate, men put money into their wives' account. These strong treatment effects on men, but not women, appear related more to control than to gender: men whose wives control household savings respond more strongly to the treatment and women whose husbands control savings exhibit the same response. Changes in information and communication interact with underlying control to produce mutable gender-specific outcomes. (JEL D13, D14, J12, J16, O15)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1245.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了配偶的可观察性和沟通对菲律宾已婚人士财务选择的影响。当选择是私人的时候，男性会将资金存入个人账户。当选择是可观察的时候，男性会将资金用于自身利益的消费。当需要沟通时，男性会将资金存入妻子的账户。这些对男性的显著影响，但并未对女性产生影响，似乎更多地与控制变量相关，而非性别因素：那些妻子能够控制家庭储蓄的男性对干预措施的反应更为强烈，而那些丈夫能够控制储蓄的女性也表现出类似的反应。信息和沟通的变化与基础控制变量相互作用，从而产生了可变的性别特定结果。（JEL D13, D14, J12, J16, O15）

abstract.text: We propose a distinction between active and passive waste as determinants of the cost of public services. Active waste entails utility for the public decision maker, whereas passive waste does not. We analyze purchases of standardized goods by Italian public bodies and exploit a policy experiment associated with a national procurement agency. We find that: (i) some public bodies pay systematically more than others for equivalent goods; (ii) differences are correlated with governance structure; (iii) the variation in prices is principally due to variation in passive rather than active waste; and (iv) passive waste accounts for 83 percent of total estimated waste. (JEL H11, H57, H83)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1278.abstractZh: 我们提出了将浪费分为主动浪费和被动浪费的区分，以此作为公共服务成本的决定因素。主动浪费对公共决策者具有实用价值，而被动浪费则没有。我们通过分析意大利公共机构购买标准化商品的情况，并利用一个与全国采购机构相关的政策实验进行研究。研究发现：(i) 一些公共机构为同等商品支付的费用系统性地高于其他机构；(ii) 这些差异与治理结构有关；(iii) 价格差异主要源于被动浪费而非主动浪费；(iv) 被动浪费占总估计浪费的83%。(JEL H11, H57, H83)

abstract.text: Stem cell transplants save lives of many patients with blood diseases. Donation is painful, but rarely has lasting adverse effects. Patients can accept transplants only from donors with compatible immune systems. Those lacking a sibling match must seek donations from the general population. The probability that two unrelated persons are compatible is less than 1/10,000. Health authorities maintain a registry of several million genetically tested potential donors who agree to donate if asked. We find that the benefits of adding registrants of every race exceed costs. We also explore the peculiar structure of voluntary public good provision that faces potential donors.

10.1257/aer.99.4.1309.abstractZh: 干细胞移植为许多血液疾病患者带来了生的希望。捐献过程虽然痛苦，但很少会产生长期不良影响。患者只能接受与自身免疫系统兼容的捐赠者的干细胞。对于那些没有血缘匹配的捐赠者，患者必须从普通人群中寻找。两个无关人士之间达成兼容性的概率低于万分之一。卫生部门维护着一个包含数百万名经过基因检测的潜在捐赠者的登记名单，这些捐赠者同意在需要时进行捐献。我们发现，增加不同种族的登记捐赠者所带来的收益超过了成本。我们还探讨了自愿提供公共物品这一特殊现象对潜在捐赠者的影响。

abstract.text: Sanctioning institutions are of utmost importance for overcoming free-riding tendencies and enforcing outcomes that maximize group welfare in social dilemma situations. We investigate, theoretically and experimentally, the endogenous formation of institutions in public goods provision. Our theoretical analysis shows that players may form sanctioning institutions in equilibrium, including those governing only a subset of players. The experiment confirms that institutions are formed and that it positively affects cooperation and group welfare. However, the data also shows that success is not guaranteed. Players are unwilling to implement equilibrium institutions in which some players have the opportunity to free ride. Our results emphasize the role of fairness in the institution formation process. (JEL C72, D02, H41)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1335.abstractZh: 制裁机制在克服搭便车行为以及实现最大化群体福利的社会困境中起着至关重要的作用。我们通过理论和实验研究，探讨了公共物品供给过程中制度的内生形成机制。我们的理论分析表明，参与者在均衡状态下可能会形成制裁机制，包括仅针对部分参与者的制裁机制。实验结果证实，这些制度的形成确实能够提升合作程度并改善群体福利。然而，数据也显示，这种成功的实现并非必然。参与者并不愿意实施那些允许部分参与者搭便车的均衡制度。我们的研究结果强调了公平性在制度形成过程中的重要性。（JEL C72, D02, H41）

abstract.text: The tax burden on equity securities has varied substantially over time and remains a source of continuing policy debate. This paper investigates whether investors were compensated for the tax burden of equity securities over the period between 1913 and 2006. Taxes on equity securities vary over time due to changes in dividend and capital gains tax rates and due to changes in corporate payout policies. Equity taxes also vary across firms due to persistent differences in propensities to pay dividends. The results indicate an economically plausible and statistically significant tax capitalization over time and cross-sectionally. (JEL G10, G12, H22, H24, N21, N22)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1356.abstractZh: 股权证券的税收负担随时间发生了显著变化，仍然是持续的政策讨论话题。本文研究在1913年至2006年期间，投资者是否因股权证券的税收负担而获得了补偿。股权证券的税收因股息税和资本利得税率的变化以及企业支付政策的变化而不同。由于企业支付股息的倾向存在持续差异，股权税收在不同企业之间也有所不同。研究结果表明，税收资本化在时间和横截面上都存在经济上的合理性，并且具有统计学意义。（JEL G10, G12, H22, H24, N21, N22）

abstract.text: The Israeli matriculation certificate is a prerequisite for most postsecondary schooling. In a randomized trial, we attempted to increase certification rates among low-achievers with cash incentives. The experiment used a school-based randomization design offering awards to all who passed their exams in treated schools.
