This led to a substantial increase in certification rates for girls but had no effect on boys. Affected girls had a relatively high ex ante chance of certification. The increase in girls' matriculation rates translated into an increased likelihood of college attendance. Female matriculation rates increased partly because treated girls devoted extra time to exam preparation. (JEL I21, I28, J16)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1384.abstractZh: 以色列的毕业证书是大多数高等教育入学的前提条件。在一项随机试验中，我们试图通过现金激励措施来提高成绩较低的学生的认证率。该实验采用了基于学校的随机化设计，对经过处理的学校中通过考试的学生提供奖励。这导致女生的认证率显著上升，而男生则没有受到影响。受影响的女生在认证方面有相对较高的先验概率。女生毕业率的增加意味着她们上大学的可能性也增加了。女生毕业率上升的部分原因是经过处理的女生在考试准备上投入了更多时间。（JEL I21, I28, J16）

abstract.text: Policy analysis with potentially misspecified dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) models faces two challenges: estimation of parameters that are relevant for policy trade-offs, and treatment of the deviations from the cross-equation restrictions. Using post-1982 US data, we study the robustness of the policy prescriptions from a state-of-the-art DSGE model with respect to two approaches to model misspecification pursued in the recent literature: (i) adding shocks to the DSGE model and/or generalizing the processes followed by these shocks; and (ii) explicit modeling of deviations from cross-equation restrictions (DSGE-VAR). (JEL C51, E13, E43, E52, E58)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1415.abstractZh: 使用可能存在误设的动态随机一般均衡（DSGE）模型进行政策分析面临两个挑战：一是估计对政策权衡至关重要的参数，二是处理交叉方程限制条件的偏差。利用1982年后的美国数据，我们研究了基于最先进的DSGE模型所提出的政策建议的稳健性，这些建议针对近期文献中提出的两种误设模型方法：(i) 向DSGE模型中添加冲击因素，以及/或者扩展这些冲击所遵循的过程；(ii) 明确建模交叉方程限制的偏差（DSGE-VAR）。（JEL C51, E13, E43, E52, E58）

abstract.text: We develop a general equilibrium model in which stock prices of innovative firms exhibit “bubbles” during technological revolutions. In the model, the average productivity of a new technology is uncertain and subject to learning. During technological revolutions, the nature of this uncertainty changes from idiosyncratic to systematic. The resulting bubbles in stock prices are observable ex post but unpredictable ex ante, and they are most pronounced for technologies characterized by high uncertainty and fast adoption. We find empirical support for the model's predictions in 1830–1861 and 1992–2005 when the railroad and Internet technologies spread in the United States. (JEL G12, L86, L92, N21, N22, N71, N72)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1451.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个一般均衡模型，在该模型中，创新企业的股票价格在技术革命期间会出现“泡沫”。在模型中，新技术的平均生产率是不确定的，并且会受到学习的影响。在技术革命期间，这种不确定性的性质会从个体性转变为系统性。由此产生的股票价格泡沫在事后是可以观察到的，但在事前是无法预测的，尤其是在那些具有高不确定性且采用速度快的技术中表现得最为明显。我们在1830–1861年和1992–2005年期间，通过实证数据支持了该模型的预测，这两个时期分别是铁路技术和互联网技术在美国普及的时期。（JEL G12, L86, L92, N21, N22, N71, N72）

abstract.text: We experimentally test an endogenous-timing investment model in which subjects privately observe their cost of investing and a signal correlated with the common investment return. Subjects overinvest, relative to Nash. We separately consider whether subjects draw inferences, in hindsight, and use foresight to delay profitable investment and learn from market activity. In contrast to Nash, cursed equilibrium, and level-k predictions, behavior hardly changes across our experimental treatments. Maximum likelihood estimates are inconsistent with belief-based theories. We offer an explanation in terms of boundedly rational rules of thumb, based on insights about the game, which provides a better fit than quantal response equilibrium. (JEL C72, D82, D83, G11)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1484.abstractZh: 我们通过实验测试了一个内生时间投资模型，在该模型中，参与者私下观察自己的投资成本，以及与共同投资回报相关的信号。与纳什均衡相比，参与者的投资行为更为过度。我们分别考虑了参与者是否会在事后进行推断，以及是否利用前瞻性思维来推迟有利的投资，并从市场活动中学习。与纳什均衡、诅咒均衡和水平k预测相比，我们的实验结果几乎没有变化。最大似然估计与基于信念的理论不一致。我们提出了一种解释，即基于有限理性的经验法则，这种解释比量子响应均衡更符合实验结果。（JEL C72, D82, D83, G11）

abstract.text: We show that any decision maker who “narrowly brackets” (evaluates decisions separately) and does not have constant-absolute-risk-averse preferences will make a first-order stochastically dominated combined choice in some simple pair of independent binary decisions. We also characterize the preference-contingent monetary cost from this mistake. Empirically, in a real-stakes laboratory experiment that replicates Tversky and Kahneman's (1981) experiment, 28 percent of participants choose dominated combinations. In a representative survey eliciting hypothetical large-stakes choices, higher proportions do so. Violation rates vary little with personal characteristics. Average preferences are prospect-theoretic, with an estimated 89 percent of people bracketing narrowly. (JEL D12, D81)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1508.abstractZh: 我们表明，任何采用“狭义区间划分”方法（即分别评估不同决策）且不具备恒定绝对风险厌恶偏好的决策者，在某些简单的独立二元决策中，都会做出一阶随机支配的组合选择。我们还从这种错误的角度描述了与偏好相关的货币成本。在一项复制了Tversky和Kahneman（1981年）实验的真实风险实验室实验中，28%的参与者选择了被支配的组合。在一项代表性调查中，选择这种组合的比例更高。违规率与个人特征关系不大。平均偏好采用前景理论进行分析，估计有89%的人采用狭义区间划分方法。（JEL D12, D81）

abstract.text: We compare the most common methods for selling a company or other asset when participation is costly: a simple simultaneous auction, and a sequential process in which potential buyers decide in turn whether to enter the bidding. The sequential process is always more efficient. But preemptive bids transfer surplus from the seller to buyers. Because the auction is more conducive to entry—precisely because of its inefficiency—it usually generates higher expected revenue. We also discuss the effects of lock-ups, matching rights, break-up fees (as in takeover battles), entry subsidies, etc. (JEL D44, G34, L13)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1544.abstractZh: 我们比较了在参与成本较高的情况下，出售公司或其他资产时最常见的两种方法：一种是简单的同时拍卖，另一种是顺序流程，即潜在买家依次决定是否参与竞拍。顺序流程通常更为高效。但抢先出价的做法会将剩余收益从卖方转移到买方。由于拍卖更有利于参与——正是由于其效率低下——通常能带来更高的预期收益。我们还讨论了锁定机制、匹配权利、拆分费用（如收购战中的情况）、进入补贴等的影响（JEL D44, G34, L13）

abstract.text: We study an allocation problem where a set of objects needs to be allocated to agents arriving over time. The basic model is of the private, independent values type. The dynamically efficient allocation is implementable if the distribution of agents' values is known. Whereas lack of knowledge about the distribution is inconsequential in the static case, endogenous informational externalities arise if the designer gradually learns about the distribution by observing present values. These externalities may prevent the implementation of the dynamically efficient allocation. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions for the efficient allocation to be implementable. (JEL D11, D82)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1576.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个分配问题，其中一组对象需要分配给随时间到达的代理人。基本模型属于私人、独立价值类型。如果已知代理人价值的分布，那么动态高效的分配是可以实现的。而在静态情况下，对分布信息的缺乏并不重要，但如果设计者通过观察当前价值逐渐了解分布情况，就会产生内生性的信息外部性。这些外部性可能会阻碍动态高效分配的实现。我们提供了实现高效分配的必要充分条件。（JEL D11, D82）

abstract.text: We study ex post efficient policy responses to a run on the banking system and the ex ante incentives these responses create. We show that the efficient response to a run is typically not to freeze all remaining deposits, since doing so imposes heavy costs on some individuals. Instead, once a run is underway, (benevolent) government institutions would allow additional deposit withdrawals, placing further strain on the banking system. When depositors anticipate these extra withdrawals, their incentive to participate in the run increases. In fact, ex post efficient interventions can generate the conditions necessary for a self-fulfilling run to occur. (JEL G21, G8)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1588.abstractZh: 我们研究了银行系统挤兑事件后的有效政策反应以及这些反应所引发的预期激励。我们发现，对银行系统挤兑的有效应对通常不是冻结所有剩余存款，因为这样做会给某些个体带来巨大成本。相反，一旦挤兑开始，政府机构会允许进一步的存款提取，从而进一步加重银行系统的压力。当储户预期到这些额外的提取行为时，他们参与挤兑的动机就会增加。实际上，事后有效的干预措施可以创造出促使挤兑自我实现的条件。（JEL G21, G8）

abstract.text: This paper examines the efficiency of expectation damages as a breach remedy in a bilateral trade setting with renegotiation and relationship-specific investment by the buyer and the seller. As demonstrated by Edlin and Reichelstein (1996), no contract that specifies only a fixed quantity and a fixed per-unit price can induce efficient investment if marginal cost is constant and deterministic. We show that this result does not extend to more general payoff functions. If both parties face the risk of breaching, the first best becomes attainable with a simple price-quantity contract. (JEL D86, K12)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1608.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在双边贸易环境中，预期损害作为违约救济措施的效率问题，其中买方和卖方可能会进行重新谈判以及基于特定关系的投资。正如Edlin和Reichelstein（1996年）所证明的那样，如果边际成本是恒定且确定性的，那么仅规定固定数量与固定单位价格的合同无法促进有效的投资。我们指出，这一结论并不适用于更一般的收益函数。如果双方都面临违约的风险，那么通过简单的价格-数量合同，就能实现最优解。（JEL D86, K12）

abstract.text: In the centipede game, all standard equilibrium concepts dictate that the player who decides first must stop the game immediately. There is vast experimental evidence, however, that this rarely occurs. We first conduct a field experiment in which highly ranked chess players play this game. Contrary to previous evidence, our results show that 69 percent of chess players stop immediately. When we restrict attention to Grandmasters, this percentage escalates to 100 percent. We then conduct a laboratory experiment in which chess players and students are matched in different treatments. When students play against chess players, the outcome approaches the subgame-perfect equilibrium. (JEL C72, C93)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1619.abstractZh: 在蜈蚣游戏中，所有标准的均衡概念都指出，首先做出决策的玩家必须立即停止游戏。然而，大量的实验证据表明，这种情况很少发生。我们首先进行了一项实地实验，参与者为排名靠前的国际象棋选手。与之前的证据相反，我们的结果显示有69%的国际象棋选手立即停止了游戏。当我们将注意力集中在特级大师身上时，这一比例上升到了100%。随后，我们进行了另一项实验室实验，实验中国际象棋选手和学生的分组方式有所不同。当学生与国际象棋选手对战时，结果接近子博弈完美均衡。（JEL C72, C93）

abstract.text: Most analyses of the US Great Moderation are based on structural VARs, and point toward good luck as the main explanation for the recent macroeconomic stability. Based on an estimated New-Keynesian model where the only source of change is the move from passive to active monetary policy, we show that (i) the theoretical VAR innovation variances for all series decrease across regimes; (ii) VAR-based counterfactuals assign a minor role to improved policy; and (iii) VAR impulse-response functions to a monetary shock exhibit little variation across regimes. Our analysis suggests that existing VAR evidence is also compatible with the “good policy” hypothesis. (JEL C32, C52, E13, E52, N12)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1636.abstractZh: 大多数关于美国经济大缓和的分析都基于结构向量自回归模型，并认为运气是近期宏观经济稳定的主要解释因素。基于一个估计的新凯恩斯模型，该模型认为变化的唯一来源是从被动货币政策转向主动货币政策，我们发现：(i) 所有序列的理论向量自回归创新方差在不同制度下都有所下降；(ii) 基于向量自回归的反事实分析表明，政策改进的作用较小；(iii) 对货币冲击的向量自回归脉冲响应函数在不同制度下变化不大。我们的分析表明，现有的向量自回归证据也与“良好政策”假说相符。(JEL C32, C52, E13, E52, N12)

abstract.text: This paper provides a simple and empirically plausible model of artworks as investment vehicles. It reconciles the observation that average financial returns for collectibles are low and volatile with the theory of consumption-based asset pricing. Art assets are appealing both for their ability to transfer consumption over time and for their use as signals of wealth, as in the literature on the demand for luxuries. Adding art value to utility, returns also reflect this “conspicuous consumption” dividend; as a result, average financial returns are low. Risk premia for artworks are predicted to be modest or even negative. (JEL G11, Z11)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1653.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个简单且经实证验证的艺术品作为投资工具的模型。该模型解释了收藏品的平均财务回报较低且波动较大的现象，并符合基于消费的资产定价理论。艺术资产因其能够随时间转移消费价值以及作为财富信号的特性而具有吸引力，这一点在关于奢侈品需求的文献中已有论述。将艺术价值纳入效用分析中，回报也反映了这种“显性消费”的红利效应；因此，平均财务回报较低。艺术品的风险溢价预计会较为适中，甚至为负值。（JEL G11, Z11）

abstract.text: This paper studies the second-moment properties of offshoring, the arrangement whereby firms carry out particular stages of production abroad. It documents a new empirical regularity: maquiladora industries in Mexico that are associated with US offshoring experience fluctuations in employment that are twice as volatile as the corresponding industries in the United States. This finding is not attributable simply to higher volatility in the overall Mexican economy, nor to the smaller size of Mexico's industries compared to US counterparts. (JEL F14, F23, L24, L25, L60, O14)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1664.abstractZh: 本文研究了离岸生产的二阶矩特性，即企业将特定生产阶段转移到国外的经营方式。研究发现了一个新的经验规律：墨西哥与美国离岸生产相关的马基拉多拉工业，其就业状况的波动幅度是美国相应行业的两倍。这一发现并非仅仅由于墨西哥整体经济的波动性更高，也不是因为墨西哥工业的规模比美国同类产业更小所致。（JEL F14, F23, L24, L25, L60, O14）

abstract.text: Jan Eeckhout (2004) reports that the empirical city size distribution is lognormal, consistent with Gibrat's Law. We show that for the top 0.6 percent of the largest cities, the empirical distribution is dramatically different from the lognormal, and follows a power law. This top part is extremely important as it accounts for more than 23 percent of the population. The empirical hybrid lognormal-power-law distribution revealed may be characteristic of other key distributions, such as the wealth distribution and the income distribution. This distribution is not consistent with a simple Gibrat proportionate effect process, and its origin presents a puzzle yet to be answered. (JEL R11, R12, R23)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1672.abstractZh: Jan Eeckhout在2004年的研究中指出，实证数据表明城市规模分布呈对数正态分布，这与Gibrat定律相符。我们发现，对于规模最大的0.6%的城市来说，其分布形态与对数正态分布有很大差异，而是遵循幂律分布。这一高端分布部分极为重要，因为它涵盖了超过23%的人口。这种混合对数正态分布可能也是其他关键分布特征的表现，例如财富分布和收入分布。这种分布与简单的Gibrat比例效应模型并不一致，其成因仍是一个有待解答的谜题。（JEL R11, R12, R23）

abstract.text: This reply refutes the objection raised by Levy (2009) about the fit of the upper tail of the city size distribution in Eeckhout (2004). I show that the method on which his conclusion is based is unsubstantiated. The visual interpretation of the fit on log-log plots is misleading. In addition, the methodology used to estimate a truncated subsample of the distribution while testing its significance against a distribution with prespecified parameters is ill-founded. The main conclusion is that Gibrat's law holds: city sizes follow proportionate growth, thus giving rise to a lognormal size distribution, tail included. (JEL R11, R12, R23)

10.1257/aer.99.4.1676.abstractZh: 此回复驳斥了Levy（2009）对Eeckhout（2004）提出的城市规模分布尾部特征的质疑。我指出，Levy的结论所依据的方法缺乏依据。对数-对数图上的拟合结果直观解释可能会产生误导。此外，在检验分布显著性时，通过估计截断子样本的方法是不合理的，因为这种方法并未考虑到预先指定的参数。主要结论是：Gibrat定律成立：城市规模遵循比例增长，从而形成包含尾部的对数正态分布。（JEL R11, R12, R23）

abstract.text: We present a model in which investment in schooling generates two kinds of returns: the labor-market return, resulting from higher wages, and a marriage-market return, defined as the impact of schooling on the marital surplus share one can extract. Men and women may have different incentives to invest in schooling because of different market wages or household roles. This asymmetry can yield a mixed equilibrium with some educated individuals marrying uneducated spouses. When the labor-market return to schooling rises, home production demands less time, and the traditional spousal labor division norms weaken, more women may invest in schooling than men. (JEL I21, J12, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1689.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，在该模型中，对教育的投资会产生两种回报：一种是对劳动力市场的回报，表现为更高的工资；另一种是对婚姻市场的回报，即教育对婚姻中配偶比例的影响。由于市场工资或家庭角色的不同，男性和女性可能有不同的动机去投资教育。这种不对称性可能导致一种混合均衡状态，即一些受过教育的人会嫁给未受过教育的配偶。当教育的劳动力市场回报增加时，家庭生产所需的时间减少，传统的配偶劳动分工规范减弱，因此女性可能比男性更有可能投资教育。（JEL I21, J12, J24, J31）

abstract.text: This paper argues for efficient environmental regulations that equate the marginal damage of pollution to marginal abatement costs across space. The paper estimates the source-specific marginal damages of air pollution and calculates the welfare gain from making the current sulfur dioxide allowance trading program for power plants more efficient. The savings from using trading ratios based on marginal damages are between $310 and $940 million per year. The potential savings from setting aggregate emissions efficiently and from including more sources of air pollution are many times higher. (JEL H23, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1714.abstractZh: 本文主张实施高效的环境法规，使污染的边际损害与边际减排成本在空间上达到均衡。文章估算了空气污染源的边际损害，并计算出通过改进当前二氧化硫配额交易制度所能带来的福利收益。基于边际损害的交易比率每年可节省3.1亿至9.4亿美元。而通过有效设定总排放量和增加空气污染源的数量，潜在的节省额将更高得多。（JEL H23, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: We estimate a principal-agent model of moral hazard with longitudinal data on firms and managerial compensation over two disjoint periods spanning 60 years to investigate increased value and variability in managerial compensation. We find exogenous growth in firm size largely explains these secular trends in compensation. In our framework, exogenous firm size works through two channels. First, conflicts of interest between shareholders and managers are magnified in large firms, so optimal compensation plans are now more closely linked to insider wealth. Second, the market for managers has become more differentiated, increasing the premium paid to managers of large versus small firms. (JEL D82, L25, M12, M52)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1740.abstractZh: 我们基于60年间两个不连续时期的公司和管理层薪酬的纵向数据，建立了一个道德风险的主代理模型，以研究管理层薪酬的价值提升及其变动性。研究发现，公司规模的外部增长在很大程度上解释了这些长期薪酬趋势。在我们的框架中，公司规模的外部影响通过两个渠道发挥作用。首先，在大型公司中，股东与管理者之间的利益冲突更为严重，因此最优的薪酬计划现在与内部财富的联系更为紧密。其次，管理层的市场已经变得更加差异化，这导致大型公司与小型公司相比，管理层所获得的溢价更高。（JEL D82, L25, M12, M52）

abstract.text: Consumers may overestimate the precision of their demand forecasts. This overconfidence creates an incentive for both monopolists and competitive firms to offer tariffs with included quantities at zero marginal cost, followed by steep marginal charges. This matches observed cellular phone service pricing plans in the United States and elsewhere. An alternative explanation with common priors can be ruled out in favor of overconfidence based on observed customer usage patterns for a major US cellular phone service provider. The model can be reinterpreted to explain the use of flat rates and late fees in rental markets, and teaser rates on loans. Nevertheless, firms may benefit from consumers losing their overconfidence. (JEL D12, L11, L96)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1770.abstractZh: 消费者可能会高估自己需求预测的准确性。这种过度自信促使垄断企业和竞争企业都倾向于提供包含固定数量的零边际成本收费，随后再收取高额边际费用。这与美国及其他地区的手机服务定价模式相符。另一种基于常见先验假设的解释可以被排除，因为根据美国一家主要手机服务供应商的顾客使用模式，过度自信是解释此类定价模式的关键。该模型还可以用来解释租赁市场中使用固定费率及滞纳金的做法，以及贷款中的诱饵利率。不过，企业也可以从消费者失去过度自信中获益。（JEL D12, L11, L96）

abstract.text: Entrepreneurs bear substantial risk, but empirical evidence shows no sign of a positive premium. This paper develops a theory of endogenous entrepreneurial risk taking that explains why self-financed entrepreneurs may find it optimal to invest in risky projects offering no risk premium. Consistently with empirical evidence, the model predicts that poorer entrepreneurs are more likely to undertake risky projects. It also finds that incentives for risk taking are stronger when agents are impatient. (JEL G31, G32, L25, L26)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1808.abstractZh: 企业家承担的是巨大的风险，但实证数据并未显示出任何正风险溢价的现象。本文提出了一种内生性创业风险承担的理论，解释了为什么自筹资金的创业者可能会选择投资于没有风险溢价的冒险项目。与实证数据一致，该模型预测较贫困的创业者更有可能从事风险项目。研究还发现，当个体缺乏耐心时，承担风险的动机会更强。（JEL G31, G32, L25, L26）

abstract.text: We explore patterns of vertical integration in the US airline industry. Major airlines subcontract portions of their network to regional partners, which may or may not be owned. We investigate if ownership economizes on ex post renegotiation costs. We estimate whether airlines are more likely to use owned regionals on city pairs with adverse weather (which makes adaptation decisions more frequent) and on city pairs that are more integrated into the major's network (which raises the costs of having adaptation decisions resolved suboptimally). Our results suggest a robust empirical relationship between adaptation and vertical integration in this setting. (JEL L14, L22, L24, L93)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1831.abstractZh: 我们探讨了美国航空业中的垂直整合模式。主要航空公司将其网络的一部分分包给区域合作伙伴，这些合作伙伴可能是独立的，也可能属于同一集团。我们研究了所有权是否有助于降低事后重新谈判的成本。我们估计了在天气恶劣的城市对之间（这会增加调整决策的频率），以及在更紧密融入主要航空公司网络的城市对之间（这会增加调整决策解决成本的不理想情况），航空公司是否更有可能使用所属的区域合作伙伴。我们的研究结果表明，在这种环境下，调整与垂直整合之间存在稳健的实证关系。（JEL L14, L22, L24, L93）

abstract.text: This paper reports the results of an experiment on exclusive contracts. We replicate the strategic environment described by Rasmusen, Ramseyer, and Wiley (1991) and Segal and Whinston (2000). Our findings are as follows. First, when the buyers can communicate, discrimination raises the likelihood of exclusion. Second, when the incumbent seller is unable to discriminate and must make the same offers to the buyers, communication reduces the likelihood of exclusion. Communication also induces more generous offers when the seller cannot discriminate, and divide-and-conquer offers when the seller can discriminate. Third, when communication is allowed, payoff endogeneity increases the likelihood of exclusion. (JEL C72, C91, D62, D86, K12, K21, L12, L42)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1850.abstractZh: 本文报告了一项关于独占合同实验的结果。我们复制了Rasmusen、Ramseyer和Wiley（1991年）以及Segal和Whinston（2000年）所描述的战略环境。我们的研究发现如下：首先，当买家能够相互沟通时，歧视行为会增加被排除的可能性。其次，当现有卖方无法进行歧视，必须向买家提出相同的报价时，沟通行为会降低被排除的可能性。当卖方无法进行歧视时，沟通行为会促使卖方提出更慷慨的报价；而当卖方能够进行歧视时，沟通行为则会导致卖方提出分割式的报价。第三，当允许沟通行为时，支付结果的不确定性会增加被排除的可能性。（JEL C72, C91, D62, D86, K12, K21, L12, L42）

abstract.text: We compare house sales on a For-Sale-By-Owner (FSBO) platform to Multiple Listing Service (MLS) sales and find that FSBO precommission prices are no lower, but that FSBO is less effective in terms of time to sell and probability of a sale. We do not find direct evidence of the importance of network size as a reason for the lower effectiveness of FSBO. We do find evidence of endogenous platform differentiation: patient sellers use FSBO while patient buyers transact more often on the MLS (where they avoid patient sellers). We discuss the implications for platform competition, two-sided markets, and welfare. (JEL L85, M31, R31)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1878.abstractZh: 我们对比了在业主自售平台上的房屋销售与多列表服务上的销售情况，发现业主自售平台上的预佣金价格并不更低，但在销售时间和成交概率方面，业主自售平台的效果较差。我们没有找到直接证据表明网络规模是导致业主自售平台效果较差的原因。不过，我们发现了一个现象：耐心型卖家更倾向于选择业主自售平台，而耐心型买家则更常在多列表服务上进行交易（因为他们会避开耐心型卖家）。我们讨论了这一现象对平台竞争、双边市场以及福利的影响。（JEL L85, M31, R31）

abstract.text: New ideas, products, and practices take time to diffuse, a fact that is often attributed to some form of heterogeneity among potential adopters. This paper examines three broad classes of diffusion models—contagion, social influence, and social learning—and shows how to incorporate heterogeneity into each at a high level of generality without losing analytical tractability. Each type of model leaves a characteristic “footprint” on the shape of the adoption curve which provides a basis for discriminating empirically between them. The approach is illustrated using the classic study of Ryan and Gross (1943) on the diffusion of hybrid corn. (JEL D83, O33, Q16, Z13)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1899.abstractZh: 新想法、新产品和实践的普及需要时间，这一事实通常归因于潜在采纳者之间的某种异质性。本文探讨了三种主要的传播模型——传染、社会影响和社会学习——并展示了如何在不丧失分析可行性的前提下，将异质性纳入每种模型。每种模型都会在采纳曲线的形状上留下特定的“足迹”，这为实证区分这些模型提供了依据。该方法以Ryan和Gross在1943年关于杂交玉米传播的研究为例进行了说明。（JEL D83, O33, Q16, Z13）

abstract.text: We examine the evolutionary foundations of intertemporal preferences. When all the risk affecting survival and reproduction is idiosyncratic, evolution selects for agents who maximize the discounted sum of expected utility, discounting at the sum of the population growth rate and the mortality rate. Aggregate uncertainty concerning survival rates leads to discount rates that exceed the sum of population growth rate and death rate, and can push agents away from exponential discounting. (JEL D11, D81, D91)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1925.abstractZh: 我们研究了跨时期偏好的进化基础。当影响生存和繁殖的所有风险都是个体特异性的时，进化会选择那些能够最大化预期效用贴现值的代理人，这种贴现值是根据人口增长率和死亡率之和来计算的。关于生存率的整体不确定性会导致贴现率超过人口增长率和死亡率之和，这会使代理人偏离指数型贴现方式。（JEL D11, D81, D91）

abstract.text: The design of the New York City (NYC) high school match involved trade-offs among efficiency, stability, and strategy-proofness that raise new theoretical questions. We analyze a model with indifferences—ties—in school preferences. Simulations with field data and the theory favor breaking indifferences the same way at every school—single tiebreaking—in a student-proposing deferred acceptance mechanism. Any inefficiency associated with a realized tiebreaking cannot be removed without harming student incentives. Finally, we empirically document the extent of potential efficiency loss associated with strategy-proofness and stability, and direct attention to some open questions. (JEL C78, D82, I21)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1954.abstractZh: 纽约市高中匹配的设计涉及效率、稳定性和策略安全性之间的权衡，这引发了新的理论问题。我们分析了一个存在偏好差异的模型——即学校之间的偏好存在差异。基于实地数据的模拟和理论分析表明，采用学生提议的延迟接受机制时，应在每所学校单独进行偏好差异的解决。任何与实际差异解决相关的低效率，如果不影响学生的激励，则无法消除。最后，我们通过实证数据记录了与策略安全性和稳定性相关的潜在效率损失程度，并指出了一些未解决的问题。（JEL C78, D82, I21）

abstract.text: This paper presents evidence about the effect of individual monetary incentives on English and math teachers in Israel. Teachers were rewarded with cash bonuses for improving their students' performance in high-school matriculation exams. The main identification strategy is based on measurement error in the assignment to treatment variable that produced a randomized treatment sample. The incentives led to significant improvements in test taking rates, conditional pass rates, and mean test scores. Improvements were mediated through changes in teaching methods, enhanced after-school teaching, and increased responsiveness to students' needs. No evidence was found of manipulation of test scores by teachers. (JEL I21, J31, J45)

10.1257/aer.99.5.1979.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于个人货币激励对以色列英语和数学教师影响的证据。教师因提高学生的高中入学考试成绩而获得现金奖励。主要的识别策略基于分配处理变量时的测量误差，从而形成了随机处理的样本。这些激励措施显著提高了考试通过率、条件通过率以及平均考试分数。这些改进通过教学方法的变化、加强的课后教学以及对学生需求的更积极响应来实现。没有发现教师操纵考试分数的证据。（JEL I21, J31, J45）

abstract.text: Contrary to what is usually assumed, the expected revenue for lenders as a function of the loan rate cannot be globally hump-shaped in the Stiglitz-Weiss (1981) adverse selection model with a continuum of types. This has important implications. First, if there is credit rationing, there must be at least two equilibrium loan rates. Second, while at the low rate loans are rationed, all those applicants willing to pay the high rate are then served. Numerical analysis shows that unless the joint distribution of risk class and output is rather special, the two loan rate outcome with rationing is unlikely. (JEL D82, G21)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2012.abstractZh: 与通常的假设相反，在Stiglitz-Weiss（1981）的逆向选择模型中，贷款利率对贷款人的预期收益的影响并非全局呈驼峰形。这一发现具有重要意义。首先，如果存在信贷配给，则至少存在两个均衡贷款利率。其次，虽然低利率时贷款受到配给，但所有愿意支付高利率的申请人则能够获得贷款。数值分析表明，除非风险类别与产出之间的联合分布具有特殊性，否则不会出现两种均衡贷款利率的情况。（JEL D82, G21）

abstract.text: People exhibit peer-induced fairness concerns when they look to their peers as a reference to evaluate their endowments. We analyze two independent ultimatum games played sequentially by a leader and two followers. With peer-induced fairness, the second follower is averse to receiving less than the first follower. Using laboratory experimental data, we estimate that peer-induced fairness between followers is two times stronger than distributional fairness between leader and follower. Allowing for heterogeneity, we find that 50 percent of subjects are fairness-minded. We discuss how peer-induced fairness might limit price discrimination, account for low variability in CEO compensation, and explain pattern bargaining. (JEL C72, D63)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2022.abstractZh: 当人们将同伴作为评估自身禀赋的参考时，会表现出由同伴引发的公平感。我们分析了领导者与两名追随者依次进行的两个独立的最后通牒博弈。在同伴引发的公平感作用下，第二名追随者不愿意接受低于第一名追随者的回报。通过实验室实验数据，我们发现追随者之间的同伴引发的公平感是领导者与追随者之间分配公平感的两倍。考虑到个体差异，我们发现50%的受试者具有公平意识。我们探讨了同伴引发的公平感如何限制价格歧视、解释首席执行官薪酬的较低变异性，以及解释模式讨价还价行为。（JEL C72, D63）

abstract.text: This paper presents a model of business cycles driven by shocks to consumer expectations regarding aggregate productivity. Agents are hit by heterogeneous productivity shocks, they observe their own productivity and a noisy public signal regarding aggregate productivity. The public signal gives rise to “noise shocks,” which have the features of aggregate demand shocks: they increase output, employment, and inflation in the short run and have no effects in the long run. Numerical examples suggest that the model can generate sizable amounts of noise-driven volatility. (JEL D83, D84, E21, E23, E32)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2050.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个由消费者关于总体生产率的预期冲击所驱动的商业周期模型。各主体受到不同性质的生产率冲击，他们自身的生产率水平以及关于总体生产率的噪声公共信号都会对其产生影响。这种公共信号会引发“噪声冲击”，这些冲击具有总需求冲击的特征：在短期内会增加产出、就业和通货膨胀，但在长期内则不会产生任何影响。数值示例表明，该模型能够产生大量的由噪声驱动的波动性。（JEL D83, D84, E21, E23, E32）

abstract.text: Consistent with mental accounting, we document that investors sometimes choose the asset allocation for one account without considering the asset allocation of their other accounts. The setting is a firm that changed its 401(k) matching rules. Initially, 401(k) enrollees chose the allocation of their own contributions, but the firm chose the match allocation. These enrollees ignored the match allocation when choosing their own-contribution allocation. In the second regime, enrollees simultaneously selected both accounts' allocations, leading them to mentally integrate the two. Own-contribution allocations before the rule change equal the combined own- and match-contribution allocations afterwards, whereas combined allocations differ sharply across regimes.

10.1257/aer.99.5.2085.abstractZh: 与心理账户理论一致，我们发现投资者有时会选择某个账户的资产配置，而忽视其他账户的资产配置。研究背景是一家改变了401(k)匹配规则的公司。最初，401(k)计划的参与者自行选择自己的贡献资产配置，但公司则选择了匹配资产配置。这些参与者在选择自己的贡献资产配置时忽略了匹配资产配置。在第二种情况下，参与者同时选择了两个账户的资产配置，从而在心理上将两者整合在一起。规则变更之前，个人贡献的资产配置与合并后的个人和匹配贡献的资产配置相等，而两种情况下的合并资产配置则存在显著差异。

abstract.text: We use a new firm-level dataset that establishes the location, ownership, and activity of 650,000 multinational subsidiaries. Using a combination of four-digit-level information and input-output tables, we find the share of vertical FDI (subsidiaries that provide inputs to their parent firms) to be larger than commonly thought, even within developed countries. Most subsidiaries are not readily explained by the comparative advantage considerations whereby multinationals locate activities abroad to take advantage of factor cost differences. Instead, multinationals tend to own the stages of production proximate to their final production, giving rise to a class of high-skill, intra-industry vertical FDI. (JEL G11, J32)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2096.abstractZh: 我们使用了一个新的企业级数据集，该数据集记录了650,000家跨国子公司的位置、所有权及活动情况。通过结合四位数级别的信息和投入产出表，我们发现垂直外国直接投资（即向母公司提供投入的子公司）的比例比通常认为的要高，即便是在发达国家也是如此。大多数子公司的情况并不能简单地用比较优势来解释，即跨国公司将活动设在国外以利用要素成本差异。相反，跨国公司往往拥有与其最终生产密切相关的生产阶段，这导致了一类高技能、行业内垂直外国直接投资的出现。（JEL G11, J32）

abstract.text: In the past decade Americans have increasingly turned their attention to nonlocal information sources, raising concerns about disengagement from local communities. Regulation sometimes seeks to curtail the integration of media markets through the promotion of “localism.” This paper examines the role of local media. We make use of the rapid growth of Hispanic communities in the United States to test whether the presence of local television news affects local civic behavior. We find that Hispanic voter turnout increased by 5 to 10 percentage points, relative to non-Hispanic turnout, in markets where Spanish-language local television news became available. (JEL D72, J15, L82)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2120.abstractZh: 在过去的十年中，美国人越来越关注非本地信息来源，这引发了对与当地社区脱节问题的担忧。监管有时试图通过促进“本土化”来限制媒体市场的整合。本文探讨了地方媒体的作用。我们利用美国西班牙裔社区的迅速增长，来检验地方电视新闻的存在是否会影响当地公民的行为。研究发现，在提供西班牙语地方电视新闻的市场中，西班牙裔选民的投票率相对于非西班牙裔选民上升了5到10个百分点。（JEL D72, J15, L82）

abstract.text: Empirical analyses of parimutuel betting markets have documented that market probabilities of favorites (longshots) tend to underestimate (overestimate) the corresponding empirical probabilities. We argue that this favorite-longshot bias is consistent with bettors taking simultaneous positions on the basis of private information about the likelihood of different outcomes. The ex post realization of a high market probability indicates favorable information about the occurrence of an outcome—and the opposite is true for longshots. This explanation for the bias relies on the bettors' inability to incorporate the surprise revealed by the final odds. (JEL D81, D82, L83)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2129.abstractZh: 实证分析表明，轮盘赌市场中，热门选项的市场概率往往低估（或高估）了相应的实际概率。我们认为，这种热门选项与冷门选项之间的偏差，与赌徒基于不同结果发生概率的私人信息同时做出决策有关。市场概率较高的情况表明，该结果的发生具有有利信息；而冷门选项则相反。这种偏差的解释依赖于赌徒无法整合最终赔率所揭示的意外情况。（JEL D81, D82, L83）

abstract.text: This paper presents a theory of the maturity of international sovereign debt, and derives its implications for the reform of the international financial architecture. The analysis is based on a model in which the need to roll over external debt disciplines the policies of debtor countries, but makes them vulnerable to unwarranted debt crises due to bad shocks. The paper presents a welfare analysis of several measures that have been discussed in recent debates, such as international lending-in-last-resort or the establishment of a mechanism for suspending payments on the external debt of crisis countries. (JEL F34, O19)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2135.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种关于国际主权债务成熟度的理论，并探讨了其对国际金融体系改革的影响。分析基于一个模型，该模型认为外部债务的重续需求会约束债务国的政策，但也会使这些国家因负面冲击而面临不必要的债务危机。文章还对近期讨论中的几种措施进行了福利分析，例如“最后手段国际贷款”或建立机制以暂停危机国家的外部债务支付。（JEL F34, O19）

abstract.text: We study the departure time decisions of commuters traversing a traffic network with the goal of arriving at a common destination at a specified time. There are costs associated with arriving either too early or too late, and with delays experienced at bottlenecks. Our main hypothesis, based on the Nash equilibrium distribution of departure times, implies that, for certain parameter values, expanding the capacity of an upstream bottleneck can increase the total travel costs in the network. We report the results of a large-group laboratory experiment, which are strongly supportive of this counterintuitive hypothesis, and we discuss the implications. (JEL D85, R41)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2149.abstractZh: 我们研究了通勤者在交通网络中出行时出发时间的决策，目的是在指定时间内到达共同的目的地。过早或过晚到达都会产生成本，而在瓶颈处延误也会带来额外的成本。我们的主要假设基于出发时间的纳什均衡分布，认为在某些参数值下，扩大上游瓶颈的运输能力会增加整个网络的总旅行成本。我们报告了一项大规模实验室实验的结果，这些结果强烈支持这一反直觉的假设，并讨论了其意义。（JEL D85, R41）

abstract.text: Pollution emitted by US manufacturers declined markedly over the past several decades, even as real manufacturing output increased. I first show that most of the decline in US manufacturing pollution has resulted from changing production processes (“technology”), rather than changes in the mix of goods produced. I then show that increased net imports of polluting goods (“international trade”) accounts for only a small portion of the pollution reductions from the changing mix of goods. Together, these two findings demonstrate that shifting polluting industries overseas explains only a minor part—less than 10 percent—of the cleanup of US manufacturing. (JEL F18, L23, L60, O30, Q52, Q53)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2177.abstractZh: 过去几十年间，尽管实际制造业产出有所增加，美国制造商排放的污染量却显著减少。首先，我指出，美国制造业污染减少的主要原因在于生产过程的改变（“技术”），而非所生产商品组合的变化。其次，我指出，污染商品的净进口增加（“国际贸易”）仅对污染减少起到了很小的作用。这两项研究发现表明，海外污染行业的转移仅解释了美国制造业污染减少的一小部分——不到10%。（JEL F18, L23, L60, O30, Q52, Q53）

abstract.text: Principal-agent models usually invoke the strong assumption that the parties know for sure ex ante whether a variable is verifiable or not. This paper assumes that only the probability of verification is known, and that this probability is endogenously determined. We analyze a principal-agent relationship where the verifiability of the agent's output is determined by the principal's investment in drafting an explicit contract. The model is well suited for analyzing the relationship between explicit contracting, legal courts, trust, and relational contracting. In particular, we show how trust—established through repeated interaction—and legal courts may induce contractual incompleteness. (JEL D82, D86)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2193.abstractZh: 主体-代理模型通常假设双方能够事先确定某个变量是否可验证。本文则认为，人们只知道该变量可验证的概率，而这个概率是由内生因素决定的。我们分析了一种主体-代理关系，其中代理人输出的可验证性取决于委托人投入的精力来制定明确的合同。该模型非常适合用于研究明确契约、法律法庭、信任以及关系契约之间的关系。特别是，我们展示了通过反复互动建立的信任以及法律法庭如何可能导致契约的不完整性。（JEL D82, D86）

abstract.text: We investigate the size of the consumption drop at retirement in Italy by exploiting pension eligibility information to correct for endogenous retirement. We take a regression discontinuity approach and assume that spending would be smooth around pension eligibility if individuals did not retire. We estimate a 9.8 percent drop associated to retirement. This fall is not driven by liquidity problems for the less well off and can be accounted for by drops in work-related expenses. Retirement also induces a significant drop in the number of grown children living with their parents and this explains most of the retirement consumption drop. (JEL D91, E21, J26, J31)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2209.abstractZh: 我们通过利用养老金资格信息来纠正内生性退休现象，研究了意大利人在退休时消费下降的幅度。我们采用回归不连续方法，假设如果个体不退休，消费会在养老金资格时保持平稳。我们估计到退休时消费会下降9.8%。这种下降并非由流动性问题所驱动，而是由与工作相关的支出减少所导致。退休还导致与父母同住的成年子女数量显著减少，这解释了大部分退休消费下降的原因。（JEL D91, E21, J26, J31）

abstract.text: In the public sector, employment may be inefficiently high because of patronage, and wages may be inefficiently high because of public employee interest groups. This paper explores whether the initiative process, a direct democracy institution of growing importance, ameliorates these political economy problems. In a sample of 650+ cities, I find that when public employees cannot bargain collectively and patronage could be a problem, initiatives appear to cut employment but not wages. When public employees bargain collectively, driving up wages, the initiative appears to cut wages but not employment. The employment-cutting result is robust; the wage-cutting result survives some but not all robustness tests. (JEL D72, J31, J45, J52)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2227.abstractZh: 在公共部门，由于裙带关系，就业率可能过高，而由于公共雇员利益集团的存在，工资也可能过高。本文探讨了直接民主制度——一种日益重要的制度——是否能够改善这些政治经济问题。通过对650多个城市的样本分析，我发现当公共雇员无法进行集体谈判且存在裙带关系问题时，公民提案似乎会减少就业但不会影响工资。而当公共雇员能够进行集体谈判并推动工资上涨时，公民提案则似乎会减少工资但不会影响就业。减少就业的结果具有稳健性；而减少工资的结果则在某些稳健性检验中成立，但并非在所有检验中均成立。（JEL D72, J31, J45, J52）

abstract.text: Charness et al. (2007b) have shown that group membership has a strong effect on individual decisions in strategic games when group membership is salient through payoff commonality. In this comment, I show that their findings also apply to nonstrategic decisions, even when no outgroup exists, and I relate the effects of group membership on individual decisions to joint decision making in teams. I find in an investment experiment that individual decisions with salient group membership are largely the same as team decisions. This finding bridges the literature on team decision making and on group membership effects. (JEL D71, D82, Z13)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2247.abstractZh: Charness等人（2007b）的研究表明，当群体成员身份通过共同收益而显著时，群体成员身份对个体在战略游戏中的决策有着显著的影响。在本文中，我展示了他们的发现同样适用于非战略决策，即使不存在外群体时也是如此。我将群体成员身份对个体决策的影响与团队中的联合决策联系起来。在一项投资实验中，我发现具有显著群体成员身份的个体决策与团队决策在很大程度上是一致的。这一发现将关于团队决策和群体成员身份效应的研究联系起来。（JEL D71, D82, Z13）

abstract.text: This comment addresses a point raised in Russell Cooper and Jonathan Willis (2003, 2004), which discusses whether the “gap approach” is appropriate to describe the adjustment of production factors. They show that this approach to labor adjustment as applied in Ricardo J. Caballero, Eduardo Engel, and John C. Haltiwanger (1997) and Caballero and Engel (1993) can falsely generate evidence in favor of nonconvex adjustment costs, even if costs are quadratic. Simulating a dynamic model of firm-level employment decisions with quadratic adjustment costs and estimating a gap model from the simulated data, they identify two factors producing this spurious evidence: approximating dynamic adjustment targets by static ones, and estimating the static targets themselves. This comment reassesses whether the first factor indeed leads to spurious evidence in favor of fixed adjustment costs. We show that the numerical approximation of the productivity process is pivotal for Cooper and Willis's finding. With more precise approximations of the productivity process, it becomes rare to falsely reject the quadratic adjustment cost model due to the approximation of dynamic targets by static ones. (JEL E24, J3)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2258.abstractZh: 本文评论了Russell Cooper和Jonathan Willis在2003年和2004年提出的观点，他们探讨了“差距方法”是否适合描述生产要素的调整。他们指出，Ricardo J. Caballero、Eduardo Engel和John C. Haltiwanger在1997年以及Caballero和Engel在1993年提出的劳动调整方法，可能会错误地得出支持非凸调整成本的证据，即使成本本身是二次方的。通过模拟一个具有二次调整成本的公司级就业决策动态模型，并从模拟数据中估计出差距模型，他们发现了两个导致这种错误证据的因素：用静态目标来近似动态调整目标，以及本身对静态目标的估计。本文重新评估了第一个因素是否确实会导致支持固定调整成本的错误证据。我们表明，对生产率过程的数值近似对于Cooper和Willis的发现至关重要。随着对生产率过程近似的精确性提高，由于用静态目标来近似动态目标，错误地拒绝二次调整成本模型的情况就会变得罕见。（JEL E24, J3）

abstract.text: This note responds to Christian Bayer (2009). Cooper and Willis (2004), hereafter CW, find the aggregate nonlinearities reported in Ricardo Caballero and Eduardo Engel (1993) and Caballero, Engel, and John Haltiwanger (1997) reflect mismeasurement of the employment gap, not nonlinearities in plant-level adjustment. Bayer concludes the CW result is not robust to alternative aggregate shock processes. We concur, but argue that the nonlinearity created by mismeasurement does not disappear. Instead, it is directly related to the level of the aggregate shock. The CW findings are robust for the natural case of unobserved gaps. (JEL E24, J23)

10.1257/aer.99.5.2267.abstractZh: 本文对Christian Bayer（2009）的研究进行了回应。Cooper和Willis（2004）的研究表明，Ricardo Caballero和Eduardo Engel（1993）以及Caballero、Engel和John Haltiwanger（1997）所报告的聚合非线性现象，实际上反映了对就业差距的误测，而非工厂层面调整的非线性现象。Bayer认为，CW的研究结果并不适用于其他聚合冲击过程。我们同意这一观点，但认为由误测引起的非线性现象并不会消失。相反，这种非线性现象直接与聚合冲击的水平相关。对于未观察到的就业差距这一自然情况，CW的研究结果仍然具有稳健性。（JEL E24, J23）

abstract.text: This research aims to provide insights into the determinants of channel profitability and the relative power in the channel by considering consumer demand and the interactions between manufacturers and retailers in an equilibrium model. We use the Nash bargaining solution to determine wholesale prices and thus how margins are split in the channel. Equilibrium margins are a function of demand primitives and of retailer and manufacturer bargaining power. Bargaining power is itself a function of exogenous retail and manufacturer characteristics. The parties' bargaining positions are determined endogenously from the estimated substitution patterns on the demand side. The more they have to lose in a negotiation relative to an outside option, the weaker the bargaining position. We use the proposed bargaining model to investigate the role of the three main factors that have been blamed for the power shift from manufacturers to retailers in recent years (firm-size increases, store-brand introductions, and service-level differentiation). In our empirical analysis of the German market for coffee, we find that bargaining power varies among the different manufacturer-retailer pairs. This result suggests that bargaining power is not an inherent characteristic of a firm but rather depends on the negotiation partner. We are able to confirm empirically previous theoretical findings that there can be cases where the slice of the pie that goes to one of the channel members may decrease, but the overall pie increases and compensates for the smaller share of profits.

10.1287/mksc.1080.0472.abstractZh: 本研究旨在通过分析消费者需求以及制造商与零售商之间的互动关系，来揭示渠道盈利能力的决定因素以及渠道中的相对权力分配。我们采用纳什谈判模型来确定批发价格，从而了解渠道中的利润分配情况。均衡利润是需求基础、零售商与制造商的谈判能力等因素的函数。谈判能力本身又取决于外部零售和制造商的特征。各方的谈判地位是由需求方面的替代模式内生决定的。在谈判中，如果一方相对于外部选项而言有更大的损失，那么其谈判地位就会较弱。我们利用所提出的谈判模型来研究近年来导致制造商对零售商权力转移的三个主要因素：企业规模扩大、自有品牌引入以及服务水平的差异化。在对德国咖啡市场的实证分析中，我们发现不同制造商与零售商之间的谈判能力存在差异。这一结果表明，谈判能力并非企业的固有特征，而是取决于谈判伙伴。我们实证验证了先前理论研究的发现：在某些情况下，渠道成员之一的利润份额可能会减少，但整体利润会增加，从而弥补了利润份额的减少。

abstract.text: Public hospitals that are directly managed by government perform poorly in many developing countries. Approaches to improving them through internal managerial reforms have failed, and effective alternatives are much needed. Policymakers are considering reforms through public-private partnerships (PPPs)--a promising but so far unevaluated approach. We present results of a successful reform in São Paulo, Brazil. The PPP model gave facility managers latitude to manage human resources--a factor critical to success. Given the prevalence of direct management of public hospitals in developing countries, the São Paulo experience has implications for policymakers seeking to improve hospital performance.

10.1377/hlthaff.28.4.1114.abstractZh: 由政府直接管理的公立医院在许多发展中国家表现不佳。通过内部管理改革来改进这些医院的尝试已经失败，因此迫切需要有效的替代方案。政策制定者正在考虑通过公私合作伙伴关系来改革公立医院——这是一种有前景但至今尚未得到充分评估的方法。我们展示了巴西圣保罗地区一项成功的改革案例。公私合作伙伴关系模式为医院管理者提供了管理人力资源的自主权，这是成功的关键因素。鉴于发展中国家公立医院普遍采用政府直接管理的方式，圣保罗的经验对寻求改善医院绩效的政策制定者具有启示意义。

abstract.text: Numerous studies in the United States have examined the association between quality and spending at the regional level. In this paper we evaluate this relationship at the level of individual hospitals, which are a more natural unit of analysis for reporting on and improving accountability. For all of the quality indicators studied, the association with spending is either nil or negative. The absence of positive correlations suggests that some institutions achieve exemplary performance on quality measures in settings that feature lower intensity of care. This finding highlights the need for reporting information on both quality and spending.

10.1377/hlthaff.28.4.w566.abstractZh: 在美国，许多研究探讨了区域层面上的质量与支出之间的关联。本文在个体医院层面评估了这种关系，因为医院是报告和改进问责制更为合适的分析单位。对于所有研究的质量指标而言，其与支出的关联要么为零，要么为负。这种无正相关的现象表明，一些机构在护理强度较低的情况下，在质量指标上仍能表现出色。这一发现强调了需要同时报告质量和支出方面的信息。

abstract.text: Prior studies suggest that with elastically supplied inputs free entry may lead to an inefficiently high number of firms in equilibrium. Under input scarcity, however, the welfare loss from free entry is reduced. Further, free entry may increase use of high-quality inputs, as oligopolistic firms underuse these inputs when entry is constrained. We assess these predictions by examining how the 1996 repeal of certificate-of-need (CON ) legislation in Pennsylvania affected the market for cardiac surgery in the state. We show that entry led to a redistribution of surgeries to higher quality surgeons, and that this entry was approximately welfare neutral. (JEL I11, L13)

10.2139/ssrn.992928.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，在弹性供应的条件下，自由进入市场可能导致均衡状态下企业数量过高且效率低下。然而，在投入稀缺的情况下，自由进入带来的福利损失会有所减少。此外，自由进入可能会促进高质量投入的使用，因为在进入受限的情况下，寡头企业往往不会充分利用这些高质量投入。我们通过研究1996年宾夕法尼亚州废除需求证明立法对州内心脏外科手术市场的影响，来评估这些预测。我们发现，自由进入使得手术资源重新分配给了更优秀的外科医生，而这种自由进入对福利的影响大致为零。（JEL I11, L13）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the relationship between postmarketing promotional activity and reporting of adverse drug events by modeling the interaction between a welfare maximizing regulator (the FDA) and a profit maximizing firm. In our analysis demand is sensitive to both promotion and regulatory interventions. Promotion-driven market expansions enhance profitability yet may involve the risk that the drug would be prescribed inappropriately, leading to adverse regulatory actions against the firm. The model exposes the effects of the current regulatory system on consumer and producer welfare. Particularly, the emphasis on safety over benefits distorts the market allocation of drugs away from some of the most appropriate users. We then empirically test the relationship between drug promotion and reporting of adverse reactions using an innovative combination of commercial data on pharmaceutical promotion and FDA data on regulatory interventions and adverse drug reactions. We provide some evidence that increased levels of promotion and advertising lead to increased reporting of adverse medical events for certain conditions.

10.3386/w14634.abstractZh: 本文通过分析上市后推广活动与不良药物事件报告之间的关系，通过建模福利最大化的监管机构（美国食品药品监督管理局）与利润最大化的企业之间的互动关系来进行研究。我们的分析表明，需求对推广和监管干预都非常敏感。由推广驱动的市场扩张能够提升盈利能力，但也可能带来药物被不当使用的风险，从而导致针对该企业的不良监管措施。该模型揭示了当前监管体系对消费者和生产者福利的影响。特别是，对安全的重视超过了对效益的考虑，这导致药物的市场分配偏离了最合适的使用人群。随后，我们通过结合药品推广的商业数据与FDA关于监管干预和不良药物反应的数据的创新方法，实证检验了药物推广与不良反应报告之间的关系。我们有一些证据表明，推广和广告活动的增加确实会导致某些疾病的不良医疗事件的报告增加。

abstract.text: Height trends since World War II are analyzed using the most recent NHANES survey released in 2006. After declining for about a generation, the height of adult white men and women began to increase among the birth cohorts of c. 1975-1986, i.e., those who reached adulthood within the past decade (1995-2006). The increase in their height overcame the prior downturn that lasted between ca. 1965 and 1974. The height gap between white and black men has increased by only 0.43 cm (0.17 in.) during past decade compared to the previous quarter century to reach 1.0 cm (0.39 in.). However, the height of black women has been actually declining absolutely by 1.42 cm (0.56 in.) and relative to that of white women. Black women of the most recent birth cohort are (at 162.3 cm, 63.9 in.) shorter than almost all Western-European women including Spain and Italy. As a consequence, a very considerable wedge has developed between black and white women's height of 1.95 cm (0.77 in.). The decline in their height is most likely related to the obesity epidemic caused by inadequate dietary balance. Black women in the age range 20-39 weigh some 9.5 kg (21.0 lb) more than their white counterparts. It appears that black females are experiencing a double jeopardy in the sense that both their increasing weight and the diminution of their physical stature are both substantial and are both probably associated with negative health consequences.

10.3386/w14635.abstractZh: 自第二次世界大战以来，人的身高变化趋势通过2006年发布的最新NHANES调查数据进行了分析。在经历了大约一代人的身高下降后，1975-1986年出生的成年白人男女的身高开始上升，这些人的成年时间是在过去十年（1995-2006年）内。他们的身高增长弥补了1965年至1974年间持续的身高下降。在过去十年中，白人男性与黑人男性之间的身高差距仅增加了0.43厘米（0.17英寸），而前一个世纪则增加了1.0厘米（0.39英寸）。然而，黑人女性的身高实际上绝对下降了1.42厘米（0.56英寸），相对于白人女性而言也是如此。最近一代出生的黑人女性身高为162.3厘米（63.9英寸），比几乎所有西欧女性，包括西班牙和意大利的女性都要矮。因此，黑人女性与白人女性之间的身高差距达到了1.95厘米（0.77英寸）。她们身高的下降很可能与饮食不均衡导致的肥胖流行有关。20-39岁年龄段的黑人女性比白人女性重约9.5公斤（21.0磅）。看来，黑人女性面临着双重威胁，她们不仅体重不断增加，身体形态也在缩小，这两种情况都可能带来负面的健康后果。

abstract.text: We use data from the Gallup World Poll and from the Demographic and Health Surveys to investigate how subjective wellbeing (SWB) is affected by mortality in sub-Saharan Africa, including mortality from HIV/AIDS. The Gallup data provide direct evidence on Africans' own emotional and evaluative responses to high levels of infection and of mortality. By comparing the effect of mortality on SWB with the effect of income on SWB, we can attach monetary values to mortality to illuminate the often controversial question of how to value life in Africa. Large fractions of the respondents in the World Poll report the mortality of an immediate family member in the last twelve months, with malaria typically more important than AIDS, and deaths of women in childbirth more important than deaths from AIDS in many countries. A life evaluation measure (Cantril's ladder of life) is relatively insensitive to the deaths of immediate family, which suggests a low value of life. There are much larger effects on experiential measures, such as sadness and depression, which suggest much larger values of life. It is not clear whether either of these results is correct, yet our results demonstrate that experiential and evaluative measures are not the same thing, and that they cannot be used interchangeably as measures of "happiness" in welfare economics.

10.3386/w14637.abstractZh: 我们利用盖洛普世界民意调查和人口与健康调查的数据，研究主观幸福感如何受到撒哈拉以南非洲地区死亡率的影响，包括由艾滋病导致的死亡。盖洛普的数据直接反映了非洲人对高感染率和死亡率的情绪和评价反应。通过比较死亡率对主观幸福感的影响与收入对主观幸福感的影响，我们可以为死亡率赋予货币价值，从而阐明一个常常有争议的问题：如何评估非洲的生命价值。在盖洛普民意调查中，很大一部分受访者报告了过去十二个月内直系亲属的死亡情况，其中疟疾通常比艾滋病更为重要，而在许多国家，分娩中女性的死亡比艾滋病死亡更为重要。生命评估指标（坎特里的生命阶梯）对直系亲属的死亡反应相对不敏感，这表明生命的价值较低。然而，对体验性指标如悲伤和抑郁的影响则更为显著，这表明生命的价值可能更高。目前尚不清楚这两种结果中哪一种是正确的，但我们的研究结果表明，体验性和评价性指标并非同一回事，它们不能作为福利经济学中“幸福感”的替代指标。

abstract.text: Rich people, women, and healthy people live longer. We document that this heterogeneity in life expectancy is large, and we use an estimated structural model to assess its effect on the elderly's saving. We find that the differences in life expectancy related to observable factors such as income, gender, and health have large effects on savings, and that these factors contribute by similar amounts. We also show that the risk of outliving one's expected lifespan has a large effect on the elderly's saving behavior.

10.3386/w14653.abstractZh: 富人、女性和健康人群的平均寿命更长。我们观察到这种预期寿命的异质性非常显著，并利用一个结构模型来评估这一差异对老年人储蓄行为的影响。研究发现，与收入、性别和健康等可观测因素相关的预期寿命差异对储蓄行为有显著的影响，且这些因素的影响程度相近。此外，超出预期寿命的风险也对老年人的储蓄行为产生了重要影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of public health insurance expansions through both Medicaid and SCHIP on children's educational outcomes, measured by 4th and 8th grade reading and math test scores, available from the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP). We use a triple difference estimation strategy, taking advantage of the cross-state variation over time and across ages in children's health insurance eligibility. Using this approach, we find that test scores in reading, but not math, increased for those children affected at birth by increased health insurance eligibility. A 50 percentage point increase in eligibility is found to increase reading test scores by 0.09 standard deviations. We also examine whether the improvements in educational outcomes can be at least partially attributed to improvements in health status itself. First, we provide further evidence that increases in eligibility are linked to improvements in health status at birth. Second, we show that better health status at birth (measured by rates of low birth-weight and infant mortality), is linked to improved educational outcomes. Although the methods used to support this last finding do not completely eliminate potentially confounding factors, we believe it is strongly suggestive that improving children's health will improve their classroom performance.

10.3386/w14671.abstractZh: 本文探讨了通过医疗补助和儿童健康保险计划扩大公共健康保险对儿童教育成果的影响，通过国家教育进展评估中提供的四年级和八年级阅读与数学测试成绩来衡量。我们采用了三重差异估计方法，利用儿童健康保险资格在不同州和不同年龄阶段的变化情况。研究发现，那些在出生时就享有更多健康保险资格的儿童，其阅读成绩有所提高，但数学成绩并未出现类似变化。健康保险资格增加50个百分点，会使阅读成绩提高0.09个标准差。我们还研究了这些教育成果的改善是否至少部分可以归因于健康状况本身的改善。首先，我们进一步证明了资格增加与出生时的健康状况改善之间存在关联。其次，我们发现出生时的健康状况更好（以低出生体重率和婴儿死亡率来衡量）与更好的教育成果相关。尽管用于支持这一结论的方法并未完全排除潜在的混杂因素，但我们相信，改善儿童的健康状况确实会提升他们的课堂表现。

abstract.text: Nearly 30 percent of Americans age 65 and older supplement their Medicare health insurance through the Medigap private insurance market. We show that prices for Medigap policies vary widely, despite the fact that all plans are standardized, and even after controlling for firm heterogeneity. Economic theory suggests that heterogeneous consumer search costs can lead to a non-degenerate price distribution within a market for otherwise homogenous goods. Using a structural model of equilibrium search costs first posed by Carlson and McAfee (1983), we estimate average search costs to be $72. We argue that information problems arise from the complexity of the insurance product and lead individuals to rely on insurance agents who do not necessarily guide them to the lowest prices.

10.3386/w14679.abstractZh: 近30%的65岁及以上的美国人通过Medigap私人保险市场来补充他们的Medicare健康保险。我们发现，尽管所有计划都是标准化的，但Medigap保单的价格却存在很大差异，即使控制了企业异质性因素后也是如此。经济理论表明，异质性的消费者搜索成本可能导致原本同质化的市场中出现非递减的价格分布。基于Carlson和McAfee在1983年提出的结构性均衡搜索成本模型，我们估计平均搜索成本为72美元。我们认为，信息问题源于保险产品的复杂性，这导致个人依赖于不一定能带来最低价格的保险代理人。

abstract.text: There is currently much debate about the effectiveness of foreign aid and about what kind of projects can engender economic development. There is skepticism about the ability of econometric analysis to resolve these issues, or of development agencies to learn from their own experience. In response, there is movement in development economics towards the use of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to accumulate credible knowledge of what works, without over-reliance on questionable theory or statistical methods. When RCTs are not possible, this movement advocates quasi-randomization through instrumental variable (IV) techniques or natural experiments. I argue that many of these applications are unlikely to recover quantities that are useful for policy or understanding: two key issues are the misunderstanding of exogeneity, and the handling of heterogeneity. I illustrate from the literature on aid and growth. Actual randomization faces similar problems as quasi-randomization, notwithstanding rhetoric to the contrary. I argue that experiments have no special ability to produce more credible knowledge than other methods, and that actual experiments are frequently subject to practical problems that undermine any claims to statistical or epistemic superiority. I illustrate using prominent experiments in development. As with IV methods, RCT-based evaluation of projects is unlikely to lead to scientific progress in the understanding of economic development. I welcome recent trends in development experimentation away from the evaluation of projects and towards the evaluation of theoretical mechanisms.

10.3386/w14690.abstractZh: 目前，关于外援的有效性以及哪些项目能够促进经济发展存在许多争论。人们对外计量分析能否解决这些问题，或者发展机构能否从自身经验中吸取教训持怀疑态度。为此，发展经济学界正在尝试使用随机对照试验（RCT）来积累关于哪些方法有效的可信知识，而不过度依赖有问题的理论或统计方法。当无法进行RCT时，这一趋势主张通过工具变量（IV）技术或自然实验来进行近似随机化。我认为，这些应用中的许多不太可能获得对政策或理解有用的数据：两个关键问题是对外生性的误解以及异质性的处理。我以关于外援与增长的文献为例进行说明。实际的随机化面临着与近似随机化类似的问题，尽管有相反的言辞。我认为，实验并没有特别的能力比其他方法产生更可信的知识，而且实际实验经常受到实际问题的限制，这削弱了任何关于统计或认知优势的宣称。我以发展领域中的著名实验为例进行说明。与IV方法一样，基于RCT的项目评估不太可能带来对经济发展理解的科学进展。我欢迎发展实验中的最新趋势，即远离项目评估，转向对理论机制的评估。

abstract.text: We analyze data from the Health and Retirement Study on senior citizens' take-up of Medicare Part D. Take-up among those without drug coverage in 2004 was high; about fifty to sixty percent of this group have Part D coverage in 2006. Only seven percent of senior citizens lack drug coverage in 2006 compared with 24 percent in 2004. We find little circumstantial evidence that Part D crowded out private coverage in the short run, since the persistence of employer coverage was only slightly lower in 2004 -- 2006 than it was in 2002 -- 2004. We find that demand for prescription drugs is the most important determinant of the decision to enroll in Part D among those with no prior coverage. Many of those who remained without coverage in 2006 reported that they do not use prescribed medicines, and the majority had relatively low out-of-pocket spending. Thus, for the most part, Medicare beneficiaries seem to have been able to make economically rational decisions about Part D enrollment despite the complexity of the program. We also find that Part D erased socioeconomic gradients in drug coverage among the elderly.

10.3386/w14692.abstractZh: 我们分析了“健康与退休研究”中关于老年人对Medicare Part D的接受情况的数据。2004年时，没有药物覆盖的老年人比例较高，约五到六成的人在2006年仍拥有Part D覆盖。与2004年相比，2006年只有7%的老年人没有药物覆盖，而2004年这一比例高达24%。我们发现，几乎没有证据表明Part D在短期内挤占了私人保险的市场份额，因为雇主提供的保险覆盖比例在2004年至2006年间仅略有下降，而2002年至2004年则有所下降。我们发现，对于没有先前保险覆盖的人来说，对处方药的需求是决定他们是否选择加入Part D的最重要因素。许多在2006年仍没有药物覆盖的人表示他们不使用处方药，而且大多数人的自付费用相对较低。因此，总体而言，尽管Part D计划复杂，Medicare的受益人似乎能够做出经济理性的决策来决定是否加入该计划。我们还发现，Part D消除了老年人药物覆盖方面的社会经济差异。

abstract.text: Recent research on the economics of human development deepens understanding of the origins of inequality and excellence. It draws on and contributes to personality psychology and the psychology of human development. Inequalities in family environments and investments in children are substantial. They causally affect the development of capabilities. Both cognitive and noncognitive capabilities determine success in life but to varying degrees for different outcomes. An empirically determined technology of capability formation reveals that capabilities are self-productive and cross-fertilizing and can be enhanced by investment. Investments in capabilities are relatively more productive at some stages of a child's life cycle than others. Optimal child investment strategies differ depending on target outcomes of interest and on the nature of adversity in a child's early years. For some configurations of early disadvantage and for some desired outcomes, it is efficient to invest relatively more in the later years of childhood than in the early years.

10.3386/w14695.abstractZh: 最近关于人类发展经济学的研究加深了我们对不平等与卓越起源的理解。这些研究借鉴了人格心理学以及人类发展心理学的研究成果，并对其有所贡献。家庭环境差异以及对儿童的投资存在显著的不平等现象，这些不平等因素会因果性地影响能力的发展。认知能力和非认知能力都影响着人生成功，但影响程度不同，从而导致不同的结果。基于实证研究得出的能力形成技术表明，能力具有自我增值和相互促进的特性，并且可以通过投资加以提升。在儿童生命周期的某些阶段，对能力进行投资相对更为有效。最优的儿童投资策略取决于所追求的目标以及儿童早期所面临的逆境性质。对于某些早期不利条件和某些期望的结果，在儿童后期进行更多的投资比在早期进行更多的投资更为有效。

abstract.text: This paper applies ideas from mechanism design to model procurement of prescription drugs. We present a mechanism for government-funded market-driven drug procurement that achieves very close to full static efficiency -- all members have access to all but at most a single drug -- without distorting incentives for innovation.

10.3386/w14718.abstractZh: 本文运用机制设计的思想对处方药采购进行建模。我们提出了一种由政府资助、市场驱动的药物采购机制，该机制能够实现接近完全静态的效率——所有成员都能获得除最多一种药物之外的所有药物，同时不会扭曲创新的激励机制。

abstract.text: This paper uses the first three waves of the Gallup World Poll to investigate differences across countries, cultures and regions in the factors linked to life satisfaction, paying special attention to the social context. Our principal findings are: First, using the larger pooled sample, we find that answers to the satisfaction with life and Cantril ladder questions provide consistent views of what constitutes a good life, with an average of the two measures providing a clearer picture than either measure on its own. Second, we find strong evidence for the importance of both income and social context variables in explaining within-country and international differences in well-being. For most specifications tested, the combined effects of a few measures of the social and institutional context are as large as those of income in explaining both international and intra-national differences in life satisfaction. Third, the very significant influences of both income and social factors permit the calculation of compensating differentials for social factors. We find very large income-equivalent values for key measures of the social context. Fourth, the international similarity of the estimated equations suggests that the large international differences in average life evaluations are not due to different approaches to the meaning of a good life, but to differing social, institutional, and economic life circumstances.

10.3386/w14720.abstractZh: 本文利用盖洛普世界民意调查的前三波数据，研究了不同国家、文化和地区在与生活满意度相关的因素上的差异，特别关注社会背景的影响。我们的主要发现如下：首先，通过更大的合并样本，我们发现对生活满意度的回答以及坎特雷尔阶梯问题的回答能够一致地反映人们对美好生活的理解，这两种衡量方式结合起来比单独使用任何一种方式都能提供更清晰的图景。其次，我们发现收入和社交背景这两个变量在解释国内和国际间的幸福感差异方面具有重要作用。对于大多数测试的样本，社交和制度背景的几种衡量方式结合起来，在解释国际和国内生活满意度差异方面，其效果与收入一样显著。第三，收入和社交因素对幸福感的影响非常显著，这使得我们可以计算出社交因素的补偿差异。我们发现，对于社交背景的关键衡量指标，存在非常大的收入等效值。第四，估计出的方程在国际上呈现出相似性，这表明平均生活评价的巨大国际差异并非由于对美好生活含义的不同理解，而是由于不同的社会、制度和经济生活状况所致。

abstract.text: We investigate the health consequences of changes in the supply of fast food using the exact geographical location of fast food restaurants. Specifically, we ask how the supply of fast food affects the obesity rates of 3 million school children and the weight gain of over 3 million pregnant women. We find that among 9th grade children, a fast food restaurant within a tenth of a mile of a school is associated with at least a 5.2 percent increase in obesity rates. There is no discernable effect at .25 miles and at .5 miles. Among pregnant women, models with mother fixed effects indicate that a fast food restaurant within a half mile of her residence results in a 1.6 percent increase in the probability of gaining over 20 kilos, with a larger effect at .1 miles. The effect is significantly larger for African-American and less educated women. For both school children and mothers, the presence of non-fast food restaurants is uncorrelated with weight outcomes. Moreover, proximity to future fast food restaurants is uncorrelated with current obesity and weight gain, conditional on current proximity to fast food. The implied effects of fast-food on caloric intake are at least one order of magnitude larger for students than for mothers, consistent with smaller travel cost for adults.

10.3386/w14721.abstractZh: 我们研究了快餐供应变化对健康的影响，通过精确分析快餐餐厅的地理位置来进行研究。具体来说，我们探讨了快餐供应如何影响300万学龄儿童肥胖率以及300多万孕妇的体重增长情况。研究发现，在九年级学生中，距离学校十分之一英里范围内的快餐餐厅与肥胖率增加至少5.2%有关；在0.25英里和0.5英里范围内则没有明显影响。对于孕妇而言，带有母亲固定效应的模型表明，居住区半英里范围内的快餐餐厅会导致体重增加超过20公斤的概率增加1.6%，而在0.1英里范围内这种影响更为显著。对于非裔美国人和受教育程度较低的女性来说，这种影响更为明显。对于学龄儿童和孕妇而言，非快餐餐厅的存在与体重变化无关。此外，在假设当前距离快餐餐厅的距离不变的情况下，未来快餐餐厅的临近与当前肥胖和体重增长情况无关。快餐对热量摄入的影响对于学生来说至少比对于母亲大一个数量级，这与成年人较小的出行成本相一致。

abstract.text: We investigate the association between the timing of enrollment in the Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) and smoking among prenatal WIC participants. We use WIC data from eight states participating in the Pregnancy Nutrition Surveillance System (PNSS). Women who enroll in WIC in the first trimester of pregnancy are 2.7 percentage points more likely to be smoking at intake than women who enroll in the third trimester. Among participants who smoked before pregnancy and at prenatal WIC enrollment, those who enrolled in the first trimester are 4.5 percentage points more likely to quit smoking 3 months before delivery and 3.4 percentage points more likely to quit by postpartum registration, compared with women who do not enroll in WIC until the third trimester. Overall, early WIC enrollment is associated with higher quit rates, although changes are modest when compared to the results from smoking cessation interventions for pregnant women.

10.3386/w14728.abstractZh: 我们研究了女性在怀孕初期加入“妇女、婴儿和儿童特殊补充营养计划”（WIC）与孕期吸烟行为之间的关联。我们使用了八个参与“妊娠营养监测系统”（PNSS）的州的WIC数据。在怀孕第一孕期加入WIC的女性，在初次接受调查时吸烟的可能性比在怀孕第三孕期加入的女性高出2.7个百分点。对于在怀孕前及孕期加入WIC的吸烟者来说，在怀孕第一孕期加入WIC的女性在分娩前三个月戒烟的可能性高出4.5个百分点，而在产后注册时戒烟的可能性则高出3.4个百分点，相比之下，那些直到怀孕第三孕期才加入WIC的女性则没有这样的优势。总体而言，早期加入WIC与更高的戒烟率相关，尽管这一差异相对于针对孕妇的戒烟干预措施来说较为温和。

abstract.text: We present an empirical test for the addictiveness of lottery gambling. To distinguish state dependence from serial correlation, we exploit an exogenous shock to local market consumption of lottery gambling. We use the sale of a winning ticket in the zip code, the location of which is random conditional on sales, as an instrument for present consumption and test for a causal relationship between present and future consumption. This test of addiction is based on the definition of addiction commonly used in the economics literature. It has two key advantages over previous tests for addiction. First, our test is unique in being based on an observed increase in consumption coming from a randomly assigned shock. Second, our approach estimates the time path of persistence non-parametrically. Our data from the Texas State Lottery suggests that after 6 months, roughly half of the initial increase in lottery consumption is maintained. After 18 months, roughly 40 percent of the initial shock persists, though estimates become less precise. These estimates provide an upper bound on the degree of addictiveness in lottery gambling. They also highlight the potential effectiveness of innovations and advertising campaigns designed to increase lottery gambling.

10.3386/w14742.abstractZh: 我们针对彩票赌博的成瘾性进行了实证测试。为了区分状态依赖性和序列相关性，我们利用了一个外生冲击来影响当地市场的彩票消费。我们采用在某一邮政编码区售出中奖彩票的情况作为当前消费的指标，该邮政编码区的位置在售出彩票时是随机确定的。我们测试了当前消费与未来消费之间的因果关系。这种成瘾性测试基于经济学文献中常用的成瘾定义。与之前的成瘾性测试相比，我们的测试有两个主要优势：首先，我们的测试基于观察到的消费增加，这种增加是由随机分配的冲击引起的，这是独一无二的；其次，我们的方法非参数地估计了持续性的时间路径。来自德克萨斯州彩票的数据表明，在6个月后，最初增加的彩票消费大约有一半得以维持。在18个月后，大约40%的初始冲击仍然存在，不过估计的精确度有所下降。这些估计为彩票赌博的成瘾程度提供了上限。它们还凸显了旨在增加彩票赌博的创新和广告活动的潜在效果。

abstract.text: Health expenditures as a share of GDP have more than tripled over the last half century. A common conjecture is that this is primarily a consequence of rising real per capita income, which more than doubled over the same period. We investigate this hypothesis empirically by instrumenting for local area income with time-series variation in global oil prices between 1970 and 1990 interacted with cross-sectional variation in the oil reserves across different areas of the Southern United States. This strategy enables us to capture both the partial equilibrium and the local general equilibrium effects of an increase in income on health expenditures. Our central estimate is an income elasticity of 0.7, with an elasticity of 1.1 as the upper end of the 95 percent confidence interval. Point estimates from alternative specifications fall on both sides of our central estimate, but are almost always less than 1. We also present evidence suggesting that there are unlikely to be substantial national or global general equilibrium effects of rising income on health spending, for example through induced innovation. Our overall reading of the evidence is that rising income is unlikely to be a major driver of the rising health share of GDP.

10.3386/w14744.abstractZh: 在过去半个世纪里，健康支出占GDP的比例增加了两倍以上。一种常见的推测认为，这主要是由于实际人均收入的增加所致，同期实际人均收入翻了一番多。我们通过使用1970年至1990年间全球油价的时间序列变化与美国南部不同地区石油储备的横截面变化来实证检验这一假设。这种策略使我们能够同时捕捉到收入增加对健康支出的影响，包括局部均衡效应和全局均衡效应。我们的核心估计表明，收入弹性为0.7，95%置信区间的上限为1.1。其他模型得出的点估计值都位于我们核心估计值的两侧，但几乎总是小于1。我们还发现了一些证据，表明收入增加不太可能带来显著的全国或全球范围的均衡效应，例如通过诱导创新等方式。总体而言，我们认为收入增加不太可能是健康支出占GDP比例上升的主要驱动因素。

abstract.text: The Medicare Part D Prescription Drug Plan represents the most significant privatization of the delivery of a public insurance benefit in recent history, with dozens of private insurers offering a wide range of products with varying prices and product features; the typical elder had a choice of roughly 40 stand-alone drug plans. In this paper we evaluate the choices of elders across this wide array of Part D options using a unique data set of prescription drug claims matched to information on the characteristics of choice sets. We first document that the vast majority of elders are choosing plans that are not on the "efficient portfolio" of plan choice in the sense that an alternative plan offers better risk protection at a lower cost. We then estimate several discrete choice models to document three dimensions along which elders are making choices which are inconsistent with optimization under full information: elders place much more weight on plan premiums than they do on expected out of pocket costs; they place almost no value on variance reducing aspects of plans; and they value plan financial characteristics beyond any impacts on their own financial expenses or risk.These findings are robust to a variety of specifications and econometric approaches. We develop an "adjusted" revealed preference approach that combines data from consumer choices with ex ante restrictions on preferences, and find that in a partial equilibrium setting, restricting the choice set to the three lowest average cost options would have likely raised welfare for elders under the program.

10.3386/w14759.abstractZh: Medicare Part D处方药计划代表了近期历史上公共保险福利提供方式中最重大的私有化改革，有数十家私人保险公司提供各种价格和产品特性不同的产品；典型的老年人可以选择大约40种独立的处方药计划。在本文中，我们使用一个独特的处方药物索赔数据集，结合选择集的特征信息，来评估老年人在这些广泛的Part D选项中的选择。我们首先发现，绝大多数老年人选择的计划并不属于“有效组合”，即没有另一种计划能在更低成本下提供更好的风险保护。然后，我们建立了几个离散选择模型，以证明老年人在选择过程中存在与完全信息下的优化目标不一致的情况：老年人更重视计划的保费，而不是预期的自付费用；他们对计划中的方差减少功能几乎不感兴趣；他们重视计划的财务特性，而忽略了这些特性对自己财务支出或风险的影响。这些发现适用于多种规范和计量经济学方法。我们开发了一种“调整后的”揭示偏好方法，将消费者选择的数据与对偏好的事前限制结合起来，发现在一个部分均衡的设定下，将选择集限制在平均成本最低的三个选项上，可能会提高老年人在该计划下的福利水平。

abstract.text: In this paper we investigate the effect of relative income on marital status. We develop an identity model based on Akerlof and Kranton (2000) and apply it to the marriage decision. The empirical evidence is consistent with the idea that people are more likely to marry when their incomes approach a financial level associated with idealized norms of marriage. We hypothesize that the "marriage ideal" is determined by the median income in an individual's local reference group. After controlling flexibly for the absolute level of income and a number of other factors, the ratio between a man's income and the marriage ideal is a strong predictor of marital status -- but only if he is below the ideal. For white men, relative income considerations jointly drive co-residence, marriage, and fatherhood decisions. For black men, relative income affects the marriage decision only, and relative income is tied to marital status even for those living with a partner and children. Relative income concerns explain 10-15 percent of the decline in marriage since 1970 for low income white men, and account for more than half of the persistent marriage gap between high- and low-income men.

10.3386/w14773.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了相对收入对婚姻状况的影响。我们基于Akerlof和Kranton（2000年）的理论构建了一个恒等式模型，并将其应用于婚姻决策分析。实证结果支持这样的观点：当人们收入接近与理想婚姻规范相关的财务水平时，他们更有可能结婚。我们假设“婚姻理想”是由个体所在地区的平均收入所决定的。在灵活控制收入绝对值和其他因素后，男性收入与婚姻理想之间的比率成为婚姻状况的强预测因子——但前提是他的收入低于理想水平。对于白人男性来说，相对收入因素共同影响着同居、结婚和成为父亲的决定。而对于黑人男性来说，相对收入仅影响婚姻决策，即使是与伴侣及子女共同生活的黑人男性，相对收入也与婚姻状况密切相关。相对收入因素可以解释自1970年以来低收入白人男性婚姻率下降的10-15%，并且解释了高收入与低收入男性之间持续存在的婚姻差距。

abstract.text: The veterans disability compensation (VDC) program, which provides a monthly stipend to disabled veterans, is the third largest American disability insurance program. Since the late 1990s, VDC growth has been driven primarily by an increase in claims from Vietnam veterans, raising concerns about costs as well as health. We use the draft lottery to study the long-term effects of Vietnam-era military service on health and work in the 2000 Census. These estimates show no significant overall effects on employment or work-related disability status, with a small effect on non-work-related disability for whites. On the other hand, estimates for white men with low earnings potential show a large negative impact on employment and a marked increase in non-work-related disability rates. The differential impact of Vietnam-era service on low-skill men cannot be explained by more combat or war-theatre exposure for the least educated, leaving the relative attractiveness of VDC for less skilled men and the work disincentives embedded in the VDC system as a likely explanation.

10.3386/w14781.abstractZh: 退伍军人残疾补偿计划为残疾退伍军人提供每月津贴，是美国第三大残疾保险计划。自20世纪90年代末以来，该计划的增长主要得益于越南退伍军人的索赔增加，这引发了关于成本及健康问题的担忧。我们利用抽签方式研究了越南战争时期军事服务对2000年人口普查中健康和工作状况的长期影响。研究结果显示，该计划对就业或工作相关残疾状况没有显著影响，对白人非工作相关残疾的影响较小。然而，对于收入潜力较低的白人男性来说，该计划对就业产生了显著负面影响，并导致非工作相关残疾率显著增加。越南战争时期军事服务对低技能男性产生的不同影响，无法用战斗或战争经历来解释，较低教育水平的男性面临较低的残疾风险。因此，该计划对低技能男性的相对吸引力以及其中嵌入的工作激励缺失，可能是造成这一现象的主要原因。

abstract.text: U.S. state and local governments are increasingly restricting smoking in public places. This paper analyzes nationally representative databases, including the Nationwide Inpatient Sample, to compare short-term changes in mortality and hospitalization rates in smoking-restricted regions with control regions. In contrast with smaller regional studies, we find that workplace bans are not associated with statistically significant short-term declines in mortality or hospital admissions for myocardial infarction or other diseases. An analysis simulating smaller studies using subsamples reveals that large short-term increases in myocardial infarction incidence following a workplace ban are as common as the large decreases reported in the published literature.

10.3386/w14790.abstractZh: 美国州政府和地方政府正在越来越多地限制公共场所的吸烟行为。本文通过分析全国代表性数据库，包括全国住院病例样本，来比较吸烟限制区域与对照区域在短期内的死亡率和住院率变化。与较小的区域研究相比，我们发现工作场所禁烟措施并未导致心肌梗死或其他疾病相关的死亡率或住院率的显著下降。通过模拟较小规模研究的子样本分析发现，工作场所禁烟措施后心肌梗死发病率的显著上升与文献中报道的显著下降情况一样常见。

abstract.text: This paper focuses on the innovative actions of entrepreneurs, namely their tendency to reveal the intellectual capital that results from their research efforts either in the form of public knowledge (publications) or private knowledge (patents). Using data collected by the National Research Council within the U.S. National Academies from their survey of firm's that received National Institutes of Health Phase II Small Business Innovation Research awards between 1992 and 2001, we find that entrepreneurs with academic backgrounds are more likely to publish their intellectual capital compared to entrepreneurs with business backgrounds, who are more likely to patent their intellectual capital. We also find that when universities are research partners, their presence complements the tendencies of academic entrepreneurs but does not offset those of business entrepreneurs.

10.3386/w14797.abstractZh: 本文聚焦于企业家的创新行为，即他们倾向于以公开知识（出版物）或私人知识（专利）的形式，展现其研究成果所蕴含的智力资本。通过美国国家科学院下属国家研究委员会在1992至2001年间对获得美国国立卫生研究院第二阶段小型企业创新研究资助的企业进行的调查数据，我们发现，具有学术背景的企业家更有可能将他们的智力资本以出版物形式公开，而具有商业背景的企业家则更有可能将其智力资本申请专利。此外，我们还发现，当大学成为研究合作伙伴时，它们的存在能够补充学术型企业家的行为倾向，但并不能完全抵消商业型企业家的行为倾向。

abstract.text: It is well known that disability rates among the American elderly have declined over the past decades. The cause of this decline is less well established. In this paper, we test one important possible explanation--that the decline in disability occurred because of chronic disease prevention efforts among the elderly. For this purpose we analyze data from the National Long Term Care Survey and from the National Health and Interview Survey. Our findings suggest that primary prevention, as reflected in decreased disease prevalence, was not responsible for advances made in elderly functioning between 1980 and 2000. We found a broad decline in less severe forms of disability that is unlikely to have resulted from improved disease management. Instead, these measured improvements in functioning may reflect environmental, technological, and/or socioeconomic changes. Improvements in the more severe forms of disability were modest and were restricted to those suffering from particular illnesses, which make improved and/or more aggressive management a plausible explanation and one that might increase costs should the trend persist.

10.3386/w14811.abstractZh: 众所周知，美国老年人的残疾率在过去几十年中有所下降。这一下降的原因尚未完全明确。在本文中，我们探讨了一个重要的可能解释——即残疾率的下降是由于老年人中的慢性病预防工作所导致的。为此，我们分析了《国家长期护理调查》和《国家健康与调查》的数据。我们的研究结果表明，1980年至2000年间，老年人功能改善的主要原因在于初级预防，即疾病发病率的降低。我们发现，较轻微形式的残疾有所减少，但这不太可能是由于疾病管理水平的提高所致。相反，这些功能改善可能反映了环境、技术和/或社会经济方面的变化。而更严重的残疾形式的改善则较为有限，且仅限于那些患有特定疾病的人群，因此，改进和/或更积极的管理措施是一个合理的解释，但如果这种趋势持续下去，可能会增加成本。

abstract.text: Without well designed empirical studies, mathematical models are an important way to use data on needle infection for inferences about human infection. We develop a model with explicit behavioral foundations to explore an array of policy interventions related to HIV transmission among IDU. In our model, needle exchanges affect the spread of HIV in three ways: more HIV-negative IDUs use new needles instead of old ones; needles are retired after fewer uses; and the proportion of HIV-positive IDUs among users of both old and new needles rises owing to sorting effects. The first and second effects reduce the long-run incidence of HIV, while the third effect works in the opposite direction. We compare the results of our model with those of Kaplan and O'Keefe (1993) that is the foundation of many later models of HIV transmission among IDU.

10.3386/w14823.abstractZh: 如果没有设计良好的实证研究，数学模型就成为利用针具感染数据来推断人类感染情况的重要工具。我们开发了一个具有明确行为基础的模型，以探讨与艾滋病患者中的HIV传播相关的各种政策干预措施。在我们的模型中，针具交换通过三种方式影响HIV的传播：更多的HIV阴性艾滋病患者使用新的针具而非旧的针具；针具使用次数减少后会被废弃；由于排序效应，新旧针具使用者中HIV阳性者的比例上升。前两种效应有助于降低HIV的长期发病率，而第三种效应则产生相反的效果。我们将我们的模型结果与Kaplan和O'Keefe（1993年）的研究结果进行了比较，后者是许多后来关于艾滋病患者HIV传播模型的理论基础。

abstract.text: We estimate the role of benefits and peer effects in technology adoption using data from randomized distribution of menstrual cups in Nepal. Using individual randomization, we estimate causal effects of peer exposure on adoption; using differences in potential returns we estimate effects of benefits. We find both peers and value influence adoption. Using the fact that we observe both trial and usage of the product, we examine the mechanisms driving peer effects. We find that peers matters because individuals learn how to use the technology from their friends, but that they do not affect individual desire to use the cup.

10.3386/w14828.abstractZh: 我们利用尼泊尔月经杯随机分配的数据，来估计收益和同伴效应在技术采纳中的作用。通过个体随机分配，我们估计了同伴接触对采纳的因果效应；通过潜在收益的差异，我们估计了收益效应。我们发现同伴和价值观都对采纳有影响。由于我们同时观察到产品的试用和使用情况，我们进一步研究了驱动同伴效应的机制。我们发现，同伴的影响是因为个人从朋友那里学习如何使用这项技术，但他们并不会影响个人使用月经杯的意愿。

abstract.text: Can a rational choice modeling framework help broaden our understanding of anorexia nervosa? This question is interesting because anorexia nervosa is a serious health concern, and because of the following issue: could a rational choice approach shed useful light on a condition which appears to involve "choosing" to be ill? We present a model of weight choice and dieting applicable to anorexia nervosa, and the sometimes-associated purging behavior.
