We also present empirical evidence about factors possibly contributing to anorexia nervosa. We offer this analysis as a consciousness-raising way of thinking about the condition.

10.3386/w14838.abstractZh: 理性选择模型框架能否帮助我们更深入地理解神经性厌食症？这个问题很有趣，因为神经性厌食症是一种严重的健康问题，而且还有一个问题：理性选择的方法能否为这种似乎涉及“选择”生病的情况提供有用的见解？我们提出了一个适用于神经性厌食症以及与之相关的清除行为的体重选择和节食模型。同时，我们还提供了关于可能导致神经性厌食症的因素的实证证据。我们将这种分析视为一种提高对这种疾病认识的方式。

abstract.text: The central role that employers play in financing health care is a distinctive feature of the U.S. health care system, and the provision of health insurance through the workplace has important implications well beyond its role as source of health care financing. In this paper, we consider the "goodness of fit" of ESI in the current economic and health insurance environments and in light of prospects for a vigorous national debate over shape of health care reform. The main issue that we explore is whether ESI can have a viable role in health system reform efforts or whether such coverage will need to be significantly modified or even abandoned as reform seeks to address important issues in the efficient provision and equitable distribution of health insurance coverage, to create expanded health plan choices and competition in health insurance markets, and to structure incentives for the more efficient use of health services.

10.3386/w14839.abstractZh: 雇主在医疗保健融资中的核心作用是美国医疗保健系统的独特特征。通过工作场所提供健康保险不仅具有医疗保健融资的作用，还具有重要意义。在本文中，我们探讨了当前经济和健康保险环境下ESI的“契合度”，并考虑到关于医疗保健改革方向的激烈全国性讨论的前景。我们主要探讨的问题是，ESI是否能够在医疗系统改革中发挥有效作用，或者是否需要在改革过程中对这类覆盖方式进行重大调整，甚至完全放弃，以便解决在有效提供和公平分配健康保险、创造更多健康计划选择以及促进健康保险市场竞争等方面的重要问题，同时构建更有效的医疗服务利用激励机制。

abstract.text: This paper presents the results from a randomized evaluation that distributed menstrual cups (menstrual sanitary products) to adolescent girls in rural Nepal. Girls in the study were randomly allocated a menstrual cup for use during their monthly period and were followed for fifteen months to measure the effects of having modern sanitary products on schooling. While girls were 3 percentage points less likely to attend school on days of their period, we find no significant effect of being allocated a menstrual cup on school attendance. There were also no effects on test scores, self-reported measures of self-esteem or gynecological health. These results suggest that policy claims that barriers to girls' schooling and activities during menstrual periods are due to lack of modern sanitary protection may not be warranted. On the other hand, sanitary products are quickly and widely adopted by girls and are convenient in other ways, unrelated to short-term schooling gains.

10.3386/w14853.abstractZh: 本文报告了一项随机评估的结果，该评估向尼泊尔农村地区的青少年女孩分发月经杯（月经卫生用品）。研究中的女孩被随机分配使用月经杯来应对每月的经期，并在十五个月内跟踪她们，以评估现代卫生用品对她们就学情况的影响。虽然女孩在经期当天上学的可能性降低了3个百分点，但我们并未发现分配月经杯对她们就学率有显著影响。此外，月经杯对考试成绩、自我价值感或妇科健康也没有任何影响。这些结果表明，那些认为女孩在经期无法上学或参与活动是由于缺乏现代卫生保护的政策主张可能并不成立。另一方面，卫生用品被女孩迅速且广泛地采用，并且在其他方面也提供了便利，这些便利与短期内的就学成绩提升无关。

abstract.text: Inefficiency in the U.S. health care system has often been characterized as "flat of the curve" spending providing little or no incremental value. In this paper, we draw on macroeconomic models of diffusion and productivity to better explain the empirical patterns of outcome improvements in heart attacks (acute myocardial infarction). In these models, small differences in the propensity to adopt technology can lead to wide and persistent productivity differences across countries -- or in our case, hospitals. Theoretical implications are tested using U.S. Medicare data on survival and factor inputs for 2.8 million heart attack patients during 1986-2004. We find that the speed of diffusion for highly efficient and often low-cost innovations such as beta blockers, aspirin, and primary reperfusion explain a large fraction of persistent variations in productivity, and swamp the impact of traditional factor inputs. Holding technology constant, the marginal gains from spending on heart attack treatments appear positive but quite modest. Hospitals which during the period 1994/95 to 2003/04 raised their rate of technology diffusion (the "tigers") experienced outcome gains four times the gains in hospitals with diminished rates of diffusion (the "tortoises"). Survival rates in low-diffusion hospitals lag by as much as a decade behind high-diffusion hospitals, raising the question of why some hospitals (and the physicians who work there) adopt so slowly.

10.3386/w14865.abstractZh: 美国医疗保健系统的低效率常常被描述为“曲线平坦”，即支出提供的增量价值很小或几乎没有。在本文中，我们借助宏观经济模型中的扩散和生产率理论，来更好地解释心脏病发作（急性心肌梗塞）治疗效果的改善模式。在这些模型中，采用技术的倾向性差异虽小，却会导致各国之间——或在我们这里指的是医院之间——的生产率存在显著且持久的差异。利用1986年至2004年间美国医疗保险数据中的生存率和各项因素投入数据，我们测试了这些理论意义。研究发现，像β阻滞剂、阿司匹林和初级再灌注治疗这样高效且通常成本较低的创新技术的扩散速度，能够解释生产力持续变化的大部分原因，并且其影响超过了传统因素投入的影响。在技术保持不变的情况下，用于心脏病治疗支出的边际收益虽然为正，但相当有限。在1994/95年至2003/04年期间，技术扩散率较高的医院（“老虎”）所取得的效果是那些扩散率较低的医院（“乌龟”）的四倍。低扩散率医院在生存率上比高扩散率医院落后多达十年，这引发了关于为什么一些医院（以及在那里工作的医生）采用新技术如此缓慢的问题。

abstract.text: Despite the popularity of pay-for-performance (P4P) among health policymakers and private insurers as a tool for improving quality of care, there is little empirical basis for its effectiveness. We use data from published performance reports of physician medical groups contracting with a large network HMO to compare clinical quality before and after the implementation of P4P, relative to a control group. We consider the effect of P4P on both rewarded and unrewarded dimensions of quality. In the end, we fail to find evidence that a large P4P initiative either resulted in major improvement in quality or notable disruption in care.

10.3386/w14886.abstractZh: 尽管绩效付费（P4P）在健康政策制定者和私人保险公司中被视为提高护理质量的工具，但其有效性缺乏实证依据。我们利用了与大型网络HMO签约的医生医疗团体发布的绩效报告数据，比较了实施P4P前后与对照组之间的临床质量差异。我们考察了P4P对质量的两个方面——受奖励与不受奖励的方面的影响。最终，我们发现没有证据表明大规模的P4P计划能够显著改善质量或导致护理服务的显著中断。

abstract.text: American metropolitan areas have experienced rising residential segregation by income since 1970. One potential explanation for this change is growing income inequality. However, measures of residential sorting are typically mechanically related to the income distribution, making it difficult to identify the impact of inequality on residential choice. This paper presents a measure of residential segregation by income, the Centile Gap Index (CGI) which is based on income percentiles. Using the CGI, I find that a one standard deviation increase in income inequality raises residential segregation by income by 0.4-0.9 standard deviations. Inequality at the top of the distribution is associated with more segregation of the rich, while inequality at the bottom and declines in labor demand for less-skilled men are associated with residential isolation of the poor. Inequality can fully explain the rise in income segregation between 1970 and 2000.

10.3386/w14908.abstractZh: 自1970年以来，美国大都市地区的收入分层现象日益严重。这一变化的一个可能解释是收入不平等的加剧。然而，通常认为居住选择与收入分配之间存在机械性的关联，因此很难确定不平等对居住选择的影响。本文提出了一种基于收入百分位的居住隔离度量指标——Centile Gap Index（CGI）。通过CGI的分析，我发现收入不平等每增加一个标准差，居住收入隔离程度就会增加0.4至0.9个标准差。收入分配顶端的不平等与富人居住隔离的增加有关，而收入分配底端的不平等以及低技能男性劳动力需求的下降则与穷人居住隔离的增加有关。不平等可以完全解释1970年至2000年间居住隔离程度的上升。

abstract.text: While it is widely acknowledged that the family and childhood environments affect adult well being, why they matter is still an area of significant debate. Previous research concerned with this issue has focused on the influence of family income, family structure, and cognitive ability. Much of this research has focused on economic and social outcomes. Notably, the influence of childhood environments on adult health has not received as much attention as other outcomes, and when health has been the focus, interest has been mainly on childhood health. Here, I present a descriptive analysis of the associations between cognitive and non-cognitive traits measured at the end of childhood (age 14) and mental and physical health at age 41. Results suggest that, on average, adolescent cognitive ability and self esteem have a significant association with health at age 41. Other non-cognitive factors such as locus of control and adolescent substance use do not have significant associations with adult health. Net of adolescent influences, completed education has a significant association with adult health.

10.3386/w14924.abstractZh: 虽然人们普遍认同家庭环境和童年经历对成年人健康有着重要影响，但为何这些因素如此重要，仍然是一个值得深入探讨的问题。以往关于这一问题的研究主要关注家庭收入、家庭结构和认知能力的影响。这些研究大多集中在经济和社会层面。值得注意的是，童年环境对成年人健康的影响并未像其他方面那样受到重视，而当健康成为研究重点时，人们的关注主要集中在儿童时期的健康状况上。本文对儿童时期结束时（14岁）所测量的认知与非认知特质与41岁时心理和身体健康状况之间的关联进行了描述性分析。结果表明，平均而言，青少年的认知能力和自尊心与41岁时的健康状况存在显著关联。而其他非认知因素，如控制点类型和青少年物质使用行为，则与成年人健康之间没有显著关联。在排除青少年因素的影响后，完成的教育程度与成年人健康之间存在显著关联。

abstract.text: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) drug advisory committee members sometimes have financial interests tied to drug companies. Congress and the public have become concerned that these financial interests lead to conflicts of interest. They conclude that the conflicts bias committee recommendations, and lead to unsafe or ineffective drugs being approved for public consumption, or, conversely, delays in approval of safe and effective drugs. Our paper provides empirical evidence, based on an event study methodology, that advisory committee meetings lead to weak or statistically insignificant effects on stock prices and hence equity values of regulated companies assumed to be affected by the particular matters coming before committee meetings.

10.3386/w14932.abstractZh: 美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）的药品咨询委员会成员有时与制药公司存在财务利益关系。国会和公众对此表示担忧，认为这种财务利益可能导致利益冲突。他们认为，这种利益冲突会偏袒委员会的建议，导致不安全或无效的药品获得批准供公众使用，或者相反地，安全有效的药品审批被延迟。我们的论文基于事件研究方法，提供了实证证据，表明咨询委员会会议的召开对受会议讨论内容影响的受监管公司的股票价格以及股票价值几乎没有影响，甚至这些影响在统计上并不显著。

abstract.text: A pervasive problem in the literature on the health costs of pollution is that optimizing individuals may compensate for increases in pollution by reducing their exposure to protect their health. This implies that estimates of the health effects of pollution may vastly understate the full welfare effects of pollution, particularly for individuals most at risk who have the greatest incentive to adopt compensatory behavior. Furthermore, using ambient monitors to approximate individual exposure to pollution may induce considerable measurement error. We overcome these issues by estimating the short run effects of ozone on respiratory related health conditions using daily boat arrivals and departures into the two major ports of Los Angeles as an instrumental variable for ozone levels. While daily variation in boat traffic is a major contributor to local ozone pollution, time-varying pollution due to port activity is arguably a randomly determined event uncorrelated with factors related to health. Instrumental variable estimates are significantly larger than OLS estimates, indicating the importance of accounting for avoidance behavior and measurement error in understanding the full welfare effects from pollution.

10.3386/w14939.abstractZh: 在关于污染对健康成本的研究文献中，一个普遍存在的问题是，优化个体行为可能会通过减少污染暴露来弥补污染的增加，从而保护他们的健康。这意味着，对污染健康影响的估计可能会大大低估了污染的全部福利效应，尤其是对于那些风险最高、有最大动机采取补偿行为的个体而言。此外，使用环境监测设备来近似个体污染暴露情况可能会导致相当大的测量误差。我们通过使用洛杉矶两个主要港口的船只每日进出数据作为臭氧水平的工具变量，来估计臭氧对呼吸系统相关健康状况的短期影响。虽然船只交通的日变化是当地臭氧污染的主要来源，但由于港口活动引起的污染变化可以被认为是与健康因素无关的随机事件。工具变量的估计值明显大于普通最小二乘法估计值，这表明在理解污染的全部福利效应时，必须考虑规避行为和测量误差。

abstract.text: Age based school entry laws force parents and educators to consider an important tradeoff: Though students who are the youngest in their school cohort typically have poorer academic performance, on average, they have slightly higher educational attainment. In this paper we document that for a large cohort of California and Texas natives the school entry laws increased educational attainment of students who enter school early, but also lowered their academic performance while in school. However, we find no evidence that the age at which children enter school effects job market outcomes, such as wages or the probability of employment. This suggests that the net effect on adult labor market outcomes of the increased educational attainment and poorer academic performance is close to zero.

10.3386/w14945.abstractZh: 基于年龄的入学法律迫使家长和教育工作者面临一个重要的权衡：虽然学校中年龄最小的学生通常学术表现较差，但他们的教育水平平均而言略高。本文记录了在加利福尼亚州和德克萨斯州的大量本地人中，入学法律提高了早期入学的学生的教育水平，但同时也降低了他们在校期间的学术表现。然而，我们没有发现儿童入学年龄对就业市场结果（如工资或就业概率）有任何影响。这表明，增加教育水平和较差学术表现对成年劳动力市场的净影响几乎为零。

abstract.text: Many Americans report chronic and disabling pain, even in the absence of identifiable clinical disorders. We first examine the prevalence of pain in the older U.S. population using the Health and Retirement Study (HRS). Among 50-59 year females, for example, pain rates ranged from 26 percent for college graduates to 55 percent for those without a high school degree. Occupation, industry, and marital status attenuated but did not erase these educational gradients. Second, we used a study of patients with lower back pain and sciatica arising from intervertebral disk herniation (IDH). Initially, nearly all patients reported considerable pain and discomfort, with a sizeable fraction undergoing surgery for their IDH. However, baseline severity measures and surgical or medical treatment explained little of the variation in 10-year outcomes. By contrast, education exerted a strong impact on changes over time in pain: just 9 percent of college graduates report leg or back pain "always" or "almost always" after 10 years, compared to 34 percent for people without a high school degree. This close association of education with pain is consistent with recent research emphasizing the importance of neurological -- and perhaps economic -- factors in the perception of pain.

10.3386/w14964.abstractZh: 许多美国人报告有慢性且严重的疼痛症状，即使在没有可识别的临床疾病的情况下也是如此。我们首先使用“健康与退休研究”数据来考察美国老年人群中疼痛的普遍程度。例如，在50-59岁的女性中，疼痛发生率从大学毕业生中的26%上升到没有高中学历的人中的55%。职业、行业和婚姻状况虽然对这种教育差异有所缓和，但并未完全消除这些差异。其次，我们针对那些因椎间盘突出引起的下背痛和坐骨神经痛的患者进行了研究。最初，几乎所有患者都报告有严重的疼痛和不适，其中相当一部分人接受了手术治疗。然而，基线疼痛严重程度指标以及手术或药物治疗并不能很好地解释10年后的疼痛变化。相比之下，教育程度对疼痛随时间的变化有着显著的影响：仅9%的大学毕业生在10年后仍然“总是”或“几乎总是”感到腿部或背部疼痛，而没有高中学历的人这一比例达到了34%。教育与疼痛之间的密切关联与最近的研究结果一致，这些研究强调了神经因素——或许还有经济因素——在疼痛感知中的重要性。

abstract.text: The literature examining the relationship between body mass index (BMI) and wages has fairly consistently found that BMI has a negative impact on earnings for women, and less (if any) consequences for men. In this paper, we relax the assumption -- largely unquestioned in this research -- that the conditional mean of wages is linear or piecewise linear in body mass index (BMI). Using data from the 1986 and 1999-2005 Panel Study of Income Dynamics, we estimate semi-parametric wage models that allow earnings to vary with BMI in a highly flexible manner. For women, the results show that earnings peak at levels far below the clinical threshold of "obesity" or even "overweight". For men, our main estimates suggest a reasonably flat BMI-wage profile that peaks early in the "overweight" category. However, the results of instrumental variables (IV) models or specifications focusing on long-lags of BMI are more similar to those for women. The findings for females (and the IV estimates for males) suggest that it is not obesity but rather some other factor -- such as physical attractiveness -- that produces the observed relationship between BMI and wages. We also provide non-parametric estimates of the association between BMI and health expenditures, using data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey. These cast further doubt on the hypothesis that the wage penalties associated with increasing BMI occur because the latter serve as an index for underlying medical costs.

10.3386/w14984.abstractZh: 已有研究普遍发现，体重指数（BMI）对女性工资有负面影响，而对男性的影响则较小或不存在。在本文中，我们打破了这一假设——该假设在这类研究中几乎被普遍接受——即工资的条件均值与体重指数呈线性或分段线性关系。利用1986年和1999-2005年收入动态调查的数据，我们建立了半参数工资模型，这些模型允许工资随体重指数以高度灵活的方式变化。对于女性而言，结果显示她们的工资在远低于“肥胖”或“超重”临床阈值的情况下达到峰值。对于男性，我们的主要估计表明BMI与工资的关系较为平坦，在“超重”类别的早期就达到峰值。然而，使用工具变量模型或关注BMI长期趋势的模型得出的结果更类似于女性的情况。对于女性而言（以及男性工具变量估计结果），这表明导致BMI与工资之间关系的并非肥胖，而是其他因素，如身体吸引力。我们还利用医疗支出调查的数据，提供了BMI与健康支出之间关系的非参数估计。这些发现进一步质疑了“随着BMI增加，工资会因此受到惩罚”的假设，因为后者可能只是基础医疗成本的指标而已。

abstract.text: It has long been posited by scientists that we need to have a better understanding in the role that larger contextual factors -- like neighborhood quality and the built environment -- may have on the nation's obesity crisis. This paper explores whether maternal perceptions of neighborhood quality affect children's bodyweight outcomes, and whether racial and ethnic differences in such perceptions may explain any of the hitherto unexplained gap in bodyweight and obesity prevalence among Whites and minorities. The project uses data from the NLSY79 and the CoNLSY datasets. Results indicate that overall neighborhood quality is not significantly related to children's bodyweight. However, one particular characteristic, namely whether or not the mother believes there is enough police protection in the neighborhood, is related. Lack of police protection has robust and significant effects on the BMI-percentile of the children, though it has less robust effects on the risk of becoming obese per se. Finally, there are differences in perceptions about adequate police protection in their neighborhood between Whites and minorities which remain after controlling for other socio-economic characteristics like maternal education, family income and family structure. However, these differences play a minor role in explaining part of the gap in bodyweight between White and minority children.

10.3386/w14985.abstractZh: 科学家们长期以来一直认为，我们需要更好地理解更大的环境因素——如社区质量和建筑环境——对全国肥胖危机的影响。本文探讨了母亲对社区质量的看法是否会影响儿童的体重结果，以及种族和族裔在 이러한看法上的差异是否能够解释白人与少数族裔之间在体重和肥胖率上的差异。该项目使用了NLSY79和CoNLSY数据集的数据。结果表明，整体社区质量与儿童体重之间没有显著关系。然而，有一个特定特征，即母亲是否认为社区中有足够的警察保护，与体重有关。缺乏警察保护对儿童BMI百分位数有显著影响，但对肥胖风险的影响则较小。最后，在控制其他社会经济特征（如母亲教育水平、家庭收入和家庭结构）后，白人与少数族裔在社区中是否拥有足够的警察保护方面的看法仍然存在差异。不过，这些差异在解释白人与少数族裔儿童体重差异方面的作用较小。

abstract.text: Obesity rates in the U.S. have doubled since 1980. Given the medical, social, and financial costs of obesity, a large percentage of Americans are attempting to lose weight at any given time but the vast majority of weight loss attempts fail. Researchers continue to search for safe and effective methods of weight loss, and this paper examines one promising method - offering financial rewards for weight loss. This paper studies data on 2,407 employees in 17 worksites who participated in a year-long worksite health promotion program that offered financial rewards for weight loss. The intervention varied by employer, in some cases offering steady quarterly rewards for weight loss and in other cases requiring participants to post a bond that would be refunded at year's end conditional on achieving certain weight loss goals. Still others received no financial incentives at all and serve as a control group. We examine the basic patterns of enrollment, attrition, and weight loss in these three groups. Weight loss is modest. After one year, it averages 1.4 pounds for those paid steady quarterly rewards and 3.6 pounds for those who posted a refundable bond, under the assumption that dropouts experienced no weight loss. Year-end attrition is as high as 76.4%, far higher than that for interventions designed and implemented by researchers.

10.3386/w14987.abstractZh: 自1980年以来，美国的肥胖率翻了一番。鉴于肥胖带来的医疗、社会和经济成本，许多美国人试图减肥，但绝大多数减肥尝试都失败了。研究人员不断寻找安全有效的减肥方法，本文研究了一种有前景的方法——为减肥者提供经济奖励。本文研究了17个工作场所的2,407名员工的数据，这些员工参与了一项为期一年的工作场所健康促进计划，该计划为减肥者提供经济奖励。不同雇主的干预措施有所不同：有些情况下，为减肥者提供稳定的季度奖励；有些情况下，要求参与者质押债券，如果达到一定的减肥目标，债券将在年底退还。还有一些人没有获得任何经济激励，作为对照组。我们研究了这三组人群的注册情况、流失率和减肥效果。减肥效果较为温和，一年后，获得稳定季度奖励的人平均减重1.4磅，而质押债券的人平均减重3.6磅。假设未参与计划的群体没有减肥效果，年底的流失率高达76.4%，远高于研究人员设计的干预措施。

abstract.text: We study the effect of the Food Stamp Program (FSP) on consumption patterns in families headed by low-educated single mothers in the U.S. using the Consumer Expenditure Surveys for 1994-2004. Our analysis suggests that the food stamp caseload does not have any statistically significant association with per capita expenditure on food in families headed by low-educated single mothers. We find that state and federal welfare reforms during the 1990s lowered the food stamp caseload by approximately 18 percent and the introduction of the Electronic Benefit Transfer cards and simplified reporting procedures for recertification of food stamps increased participation by about seven percent. However, we do not find any evidence that these policies had any effect on total food expenditure, nor do we find any consistent evidence that the policies affected expenditures on specific food items.

10.3386/w14988.abstractZh: 我们研究了食品券计划对美国低教育水平单身母亲家庭消费模式的影响，使用了1994至2004年的消费者支出调查数据。我们的分析表明，食品券发放数量与低教育水平单身母亲家庭人均食品支出之间没有统计学上的显著关联。我们发现，20世纪90年代州和联邦层面的福利改革使食品券发放数量减少了约18%，而电子福利转账卡以及简化食品券重新认证流程的引入使参与食品券计划的人数增加了约7%。然而，我们没有发现这些政策对总食品支出有任何影响，也没有发现这些政策对特定食品项目的支出有任何影响。

abstract.text: We utilize clinical records of successive visits by children to pediatric clinics in Indianapolis to estimate the effects on their body mass of environmental changes near their homes. We compare results for fixed-residence children with those for cross-sectional data. Our environmental factors are fast food restaurants, supermarkets, parks, trails, and violent crimes, and 13 types of recreational amenities derived from the interpretation of annual aerial photographs. We looked for responses to these factors changing within buffers of 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, and 1 mile. We found that cross-sectional estimates are quite different from the Fixed Effects estimates of the impacts of amenities locating near a child. In cross section nearby fast food restaurants were associated with higher BMI and supermarkets with lower BMI. These results were reversed in the FE estimates. The recreational amenities that appear to lower children's BMI were fitness areas, kickball diamonds, and volleyball courts. We estimated that locating these amenities near their homes could reduce the weight of an overweight eight-year old boy by 3 to 6 pounds.

10.3386/w14989.abstractZh: 我们利用印第安纳波利斯儿童诊所中儿童连续就诊的临床记录，来估算家庭周边环境变化对其体重的影响。我们将固定居住地的儿童的结果与横截面数据的结果进行了比较。我们的环境因素包括快餐店、超市、公园、步道以及暴力犯罪，还包括从年度航空照片中解读出的13种娱乐设施。我们研究了这些因素在0.1英里、0.25英里、0.5英里和1英里范围内变化时的影响。研究发现，横截面数据的结果与固定效应模型对娱乐设施对孩子体重影响的估计结果有很大差异。在横截面数据中，附近的快餐店与较高的BMI相关，而超市则与较低的BMI相关。在固定效应模型中，这些关系则相反。那些似乎能降低儿童BMI的娱乐设施包括健身区、踢球场和排球场。我们估计，将这些设施设置在家庭附近，可以使一个8岁的超重男孩的体重减少3到6磅。

abstract.text: In this paper, we investigate the association between weight and adolescent's educational attainment, as measured by highest grade attended, highest grade completed, and drop out status. Data for the study came from the 1997 cohort of the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth (NLSY), which contains a large, national sample of teens between the ages of 14 and 18. We obtained estimates of the association between weight and educational attainment using several regression model specifications that controlled for a variety of observed characteristics. Our results suggest that, in general, teens that are overweight or obese have levels of attainment that are about the same as teens with average weight.

10.3386/w14994.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了体重与青少年教育成就之间的关联，教育成就通过所就读的最高年级、完成的最高年级以及辍学情况来衡量。研究数据来自1997年《全国青少年纵向调查》的队列数据，该数据包含了14至18岁青少年的大量全国样本。我们通过多种回归模型估计了体重与教育成就之间的关联，这些模型考虑了多种观察到的特征。研究结果表明，总体而言，超重或肥胖的青少年其教育成就水平与体重正常的青少年大致相同。

abstract.text: We employ a latent class model to assess the impact of Mexico's Seguro Popular ("SP") program on the number of prenatal visits in a cross-sectional sample of 4,381 women who gave birth during 2002-2005. We specify an ordered probit model to permit a pregnant woman's probability of membership in one of three latent classes to depend on observed covariates. In the ordered probit model, enrollment in SP is explicitly treated as an endogenous variable. We model the number of prenatal visits, conditional upon membership in a particular latent class, as a Poisson regression. We employ the EM algorithm to reduce the computational burden of model estimation. At any iteration of the algorithm, the parameters of the model of latent class membership can be estimated separately from the parameters of the model of prenatal care utilization. We find that enrollment in SP was associated with a mean increase in 1.65 prenatal visits during pregnancy. Approximately 59 percent of this treatment effect is the result of increased prenatal care among women in the first latent class, that is, women who had with little or no access to care. The remaining 41 percent of the treatment effect is the result of a shift in membership from the second to the third latent class, which we interpret as increased recognition of complications of pregnancy prior to labor and delivery. Our model has a better fit and predicts a larger impact of SP than alternative models that relax the assumption of endogeneity, do not impose ordering on the latent classes, or incorporate only two latent classes. Our findings are consistent with prior work on the favorable impact of SP on maternal health (Sosa-Rubí, Galárraga, Harris 2009).

10.3386/w14995.abstractZh: 我们采用潜在类模型来评估墨西哥的Seguro Popular计划对4,381名在2002-2005年间分娩的女性产前就诊次数的影响。我们指定了一个有序probit模型，以便让孕妇属于三个潜在类中的某一类的概率取决于观察到的协变量。在有序probit模型中，SP的注册被明确视为一个内生变量。我们将特定潜在类成员身份条件下的产前就诊次数建模为泊松回归。我们采用EM算法来减轻模型估计的计算负担。在算法的任何迭代中，潜在类成员身份模型的参数都可以与产前护理利用模型的参数分开估计。我们发现，注册SP与怀孕期间平均增加1.65次产前就诊有关。大约59%的这种治疗效果是由于第一潜在类中的女性——即那些几乎没有或完全没有获得护理的女性——接受了更多的产前护理。剩余41%的治疗效果是由于成员身份从第二潜在类转移到了第三潜在类，我们将其解释为在分娩前对妊娠并发症的认识更加充分。我们的模型拟合度更高，并且预测SP的影响比那些不假设内生性、不对潜在类进行排序或仅包含两个潜在类的模型要大。我们的发现与之前关于SP对孕产妇健康积极影响的研究结果一致（Sosa-Rubí, Galárraga, Harris 2009）。

abstract.text: We document the impact of the AIDS crisis on non-AIDS related health services in fourteen sub-Saharan African countries. Using multiple waves of Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS) for each country, we examine antenatal care, birth deliveries, and rates of immunization for children born between 1988 and 2005. We find deterioration in nearly all of these dimensions of health care over this period. The most recent DHS survey for each country collected data on HIV prevalence, which allows us to examine the association between HIV burden and health care. We find that erosion of health services is highly correlated with increases in AIDS prevalence. Regions of countries that have light AIDS burdens have witnessed small or no declines in health care, using the measures noted above, while those regions currently shouldering the heaviest burdens have seen the largest erosion in treatment for pregnant women and children. Using semi-parametric techniques, we can date the beginning of the divergence in health services between high and low HIV regions to the mid-1990s.

10.3386/w15000.abstractZh: 我们记录了艾滋病危机对14个撒哈拉以南非洲国家非艾滋病相关健康服务的影响。通过每个国家多次进行的人口与健康调查，我们研究了1988年至2005年间出生的儿童的产前护理、分娩情况以及免疫接种率。我们发现，在这段时间内，几乎所有这些健康领域的指标都出现了恶化。每个国家最近一次的人口与健康调查收集了HIV感染率的数据，这使我们能够研究HIV负担与健康服务之间的关系。我们发现，健康服务的衰退与艾滋病感染率的上升高度相关。那些艾滋病负担较轻的国家，上述指标几乎没有下降，而那些目前面临最严重艾滋病负担的国家，孕妇和儿童的治疗服务则出现了最大的衰退。利用半参数技术，我们可以将高HIV感染地区与低HIV感染地区之间健康服务差异的开始时间追溯到20世纪90年代中期。

abstract.text: Currently, there is insufficient evidence regarding which policies will improve nutrition, reduce BMI, the probability of obesity and the probability of overweight nationwide. This preliminary study investigates the impact of a nutrition-education policy relative to price policy as a means to improve nutrition and reduce BMI. Model estimations are created with pooled cross-sectional data from the Centers for Disease Control's (CDC), Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS), American Chamber of Commerce Research Association (ACCRA) state-level food prices and the United States Department of Agriculture's (USDA) funding of state-specific nutrition-education programs from 1992 - 2006. During this period, federal funding for state-specific nutrition-education programs rose from approximately $600 thousand for a few states to nearly $248 million for all states. After controlling for state fixed effects, year effects and a state specific linear time trend, I find that nutrition education spending has the intended effect for individuals from certain, but not all, income and education-levels. Also, the results indicate that increasing the price of food purchased for consumption away from home is consistent with decreasing BMI, obesity and overweight for the lowest income groups. However, the overall effect is minimal.

10.3386/w15001.abstractZh: 目前，关于哪些政策能够改善营养状况、降低身体质量指数（BMI）、肥胖概率以及超重概率的证据尚不充分。本初步研究探讨了以营养教育政策替代价格政策在改善营养状况、降低BMI方面的作用。模型估算基于疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）、行为风险因素监测系统（BRFSS）、美国商会研究协会（ACCRA）提供的州级食品价格数据，以及美国农业部（USDA）在1992年至2006年间对各州特定营养教育项目的资金支持数据。在此期间，联邦政府对各州特定营养教育项目的资金支持从少数几个州约60万美元增加到了所有州近2.48亿美元。在控制了州固定效应、年份效应以及各州特定的线性时间趋势后，我发现营养教育支出对特定收入和教育水平的人群具有预期效果，但并非对所有人群都如此。此外，研究结果表明，提高非家庭消费食品的价格有助于降低最低收入群体的BMI、肥胖率和超重率。然而，整体效果较为有限。

abstract.text: There are several ways to measure fatness and obesity, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. The primary measure for tracking the prevalence of obesity has historically been body mass index (BMI). This paper compares long-run trends in the prevalence of obesity when obesity is defined using skinfold thickness instead of body mass index (BMI), using data from the full series of U.S. National Health Examination Surveys. The results indicate that when one uses skinfold thicknesses rather than BMI to define obesity, the rise in the prevalence of obesity is detectable ten to twenty years earlier. This underscores the importance of examining multiple measures of fatness when monitoring or otherwise studying obesity.

10.3386/w15005.abstractZh: 有几种方法可以衡量肥胖程度，每种方法都有其优缺点。历史上，用于追踪肥胖流行率的主要指标是体质指数（BMI）。本文通过比较使用皮褶厚度而非BMI来定义肥胖时，肥胖流行率的长期趋势，使用的是美国全国健康调查的完整数据。研究结果表明，当使用皮褶厚度而非BMI来定义肥胖时，肥胖流行率的上升可以在十年到二十年前被检测到。这强调了在监测或研究肥胖问题时，考察多种肥胖衡量指标的重要性。

abstract.text: Child care subsidies play a critical role in facilitating the transition of disadvantaged mothers from welfare to work. However, little is known about the influence of these policies on children's health and well-being. In this paper, we study the impact of subsidy receipt on low-income children's weight outcomes in the fall and spring of kindergarten. The goals of our empirical analysis are twofold. We first utilize standard OLS and fixed effects methods to explore body mass index as well as measures of overweight and obesity. We then turn to quantile regression to address the possibility that subsidy receipt has heterogeneous effects on children's weight at different points in the BMI distribution. Results suggest that subsidy receipt is associated with increases in BMI and a greater likelihood of being overweight and obese. We also find substantial variation in subsidy effects across the BMI distribution. In particular, child care subsidies have no effect on BMI at the lower end of the distribution, inconsistent effects in the middle of the distribution, and large effects at the top of the distribution. Our results point to the use of non-parental child care, particularly centerbased services, as the key mechanism through which subsidies influence children's weight outcomes.

10.3386/w15007.abstractZh: 儿童保育补贴在帮助弱势母亲从福利制度过渡到工作方面发挥着关键作用。然而，关于这些政策对儿童健康和福祉的影响，我们知之甚少。本文研究了补贴领取对低收入儿童在幼儿园秋季和春季体重状况的影响。我们的实证分析有两个目标：首先，我们利用标准OLS方法和固定效应模型来探讨体重指数以及超重和肥胖的相关指标；然后，通过分位数回归来分析补贴领取对儿童体重的不同影响程度。结果表明，补贴领取与体重指数的上升以及超重和肥胖的风险增加有关。我们还发现，补贴对体重指数的影响在BMI分布的不同区间存在显著差异。具体而言，儿童保育补贴对BMI分布较低区间没有影响，在分布中间区间的影响也不一致，而在分布较高区间则具有显著的影响。我们的研究结果指出，非父母提供的儿童保育服务，尤其是以机构为基础的保育服务，是补贴影响儿童体重状况的关键机制。

abstract.text: Previous estimates on the association between body weight and wages in the literature have been contingent on education and occupation. This paper examines the direct effect of BMI on wages and the indirect effects operating through education and occupation choice, particularly for late-teen BMI and adult wages. Using the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 data, we show that education is the main pathway for the indirect BMI wage penalty. The total BMI wage penalty is underestimated by 18% for women without including those indirect effects. Whereas for men there is no statistically significant direct BMI wage penalty, we do observe a small indirect wage penalty through education.

10.3386/w15027.abstractZh: 以往关于体重与工资之间关系的研究都依赖于教育和职业因素。本文探讨了体质指数对工资的直接影响，以及通过教育和职业选择产生的间接影响，特别是针对青少年晚期体质指数和成年后的工资情况。利用1979年青年纵向调查数据，我们发现教育是导致体质指数对工资产生间接负面影响的主要途径。如果不考虑这些间接影响，女性的总体体质指数对工资的负面影响会被低估18%。而对于男性来说，虽然体质指数对工资的直接负面影响并不显著，但我们确实观察到通过教育产生的较小规模的间接工资负面影响。

abstract.text: Increased health care spending has been argued to be largely due to technological change. Cost-effectiveness analysis is the main tool used by private and public third-party payers to prioritize adoption of the new technologies responsible for this growth. However, such analysis by payers invariably reflects prices set by producers rather than resources used to produce treatments. This implies that the "costs" in cost-effectiveness assessments depend on endogenous markups which are, in turn, influenced by demand factors of patients, doctors, and payers. Reimbursement policy based on endogenous cost-effectiveness levels may therefore bear little relationship to efficient use of scarce medical resources. Using data on technology appraisals in the United Kingdom, we test for conditions under which adoption based on endogenous cost-effectiveness may lead to adoption of more inefficient treatments in terms of resource use.

10.3386/w15032.abstractZh: 有人认为，医疗支出的增加主要归因于技术变革。成本效益分析是私营和公共第三方支付方用于优先采用推动这一增长的新技术的主要工具。然而，支付方的此类分析总是反映生产者设定的价格，而非用于生产治疗的资源。这意味着成本效益评估中的“成本”取决于内生性加价，而内生性加价又受到患者、医生和支付方需求因素的影响。因此，基于内生性成本效益水平的报销政策可能与稀缺医疗资源的有效利用关系不大。通过利用英国的技术评估数据，我们测试了在何种情况下，基于内生性成本效益的采用可能会导致资源利用效率较低的治疗方法的采用。

abstract.text: While much research has focused on the costs of obesity and economic factors that drive obesity growth, little economic research has examined the factors that contribute to obesity -- physical inactivity and poor nutrition. This paper will examine correlates and predictors of physical activity over time with emphasis on economic factors. We use data for adults from the 2000-2005 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) survey that includes state and county codes for each individual that allows us to add supplementary data on state beer and cigarette taxes, local transportation costs, availability of gyms and recreational facilities, county unemployment, crime rates, and prices of related goods. We find that income and education has a strong and consistently positive effect on physical activity across specifications. Sin taxes have no effect on the likelihood of any exercise but generally have negative effects on vigorous exercise or moderate and vigorous exercise. Physical activity is more likely when there are more parks per capita in a county. Our results above are robust to the inclusion of weight status and use of flu shots (a measure of an individual's tendency towards prevention).

10.3386/w15039.abstractZh: 虽然许多研究关注肥胖的成本以及推动肥胖增长的经济因素，但很少有经济研究探讨导致肥胖的因素——如缺乏运动和不良营养。本文将研究随时间变化的身体活动相关因素和预测因素，重点分析经济因素的作用。我们使用了2000-2005年行为风险因素监测系统的数据，这些数据包含了每个个体的州和县代码，使我们能够获取有关州级啤酒和香烟税、当地交通成本、健身房和娱乐设施的可用性、县失业率、犯罪率以及相关商品价格等补充数据。研究发现，收入和教育水平对身体活动有强烈且持续积极的影响。含糖饮料税对运动的可能性没有影响，但通常会对剧烈运动或中等强度运动产生负面影响。当某个县的人均公园数量较多时，人们进行身体活动的可能性也会增加。上述结果在纳入体重状况和使用流感疫苗（衡量个人预防倾向的指标）后仍然保持稳定。

abstract.text: Medical research indicates that breastfeeding suppresses post-natal fertility. We model the implications for breastfeeding decisions and test the model's predictions using survey data from India. First, we find that breastfeeding increases with birth order, since mothers near or beyond their desired total fertility are more likely to make use of the contraceptive properties of nursing. Second, given a preference for having sons, mothers with no or few sons want to conceive again and thus limit their breastfeeding. We indeed find that daughters are weaned sooner than sons, and, moreover, for both sons and daughters, having few or no older brothers results in earlier weaning. Third, these gender effects peak as mothers approach their target family size, when their decision about future childbearing (and therefore breastfeeding) is highly marginal and most sensitive to considerations such as ideal sex composition. Because breastfeeding protects against water- and food-borne disease, our model also makes predictions regarding health outcomes. We find that child-mortality patterns mirror those of breastfeeding with respect to gender and its interactions with birth order and ideal family size. Our results suggest that the gender gap in breastfeeding explains 14 percent of excess female child mortality in India, or about 22,000 "missing girls" each year.

10.3386/w15041.abstractZh: 医学研究表明，母乳喂养能够抑制产后生育能力。我们对该现象对母乳喂养决策的影响进行了建模，并使用印度的调查数据来验证模型的预测结果。首先，我们发现母乳喂养随着出生顺序的增加而增多，因为那些生育数量接近或达到理想水平以上的母亲更有可能利用母乳喂养带来的避孕效果。其次，考虑到对拥有男孩的偏好，没有或只有少数儿子的母亲更希望再次怀孕，因此会减少母乳喂养的时间。事实上，我们发现女儿比儿子更早断奶，而且对于儿子和女儿来说，没有或只有少数年长的兄弟会导致更早断奶。第三，当母亲们接近理想的家庭规模时，这些性别效应达到顶峰，她们关于未来生育（以及母乳喂养）的决策变得非常敏感，容易受到理想性别构成等因素的影响。由于母乳喂养可以预防水传播和食物传播疾病，我们的模型还预测了健康结果。我们发现，儿童死亡率的模式与母乳喂养的情况相似，尤其是在性别以及出生顺序和理想家庭规模之间的相互作用方面。我们的研究结果表明，性别差异在母乳喂养方面的差异可以解释印度女性儿童死亡率的14%，即每年大约有22,000名“失踪女孩”。

abstract.text: This study examines the relationship between child weight and fast food and fruit and vegetable prices and the availability of fast food restaurants, full-service restaurants, supermarkets, grocery stores and convenience stores. We estimate cross-sectional and individual-level fixed effects (FE) models to account for unobserved individual-level heterogeneity. Data are drawn from the Child Development Supplement of the Panel Study of Income Dynamics combined with external food price and outlet density data at the zip code level. FE results show that higher fruit and vegetable prices are statistically significantly related to a higher body mass index (BMI) percentile ranking among children with greater effects among low-income children: fruit and vegetable price elasticity for BMI is estimated to be 0.25 for the full sample and 0.60 among low-income children. Fast food prices are statistically significantly related to child weight only in cross-sectional models among low-income children with a price elasticity of -0.77. Increased supermarket availability and fewer available convenience stores are related with lower weight outcomes among low-income children. These results provide evidence on the potential effectiveness of using fiscal pricing interventions such as taxes and subsidies and other interventions to improve supermarket access as policy instruments to address childhood obesity.

10.3386/w15046.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了儿童体重与快餐、水果和蔬菜价格之间的关系，以及快餐店、全服务餐厅、超市、杂货店和便利店的分布情况。我们通过估计横截面模型和个体固定效应模型来捕捉未观察到的个体异质性。数据来源于收入动态面板研究中的儿童发展补充数据，并结合了邮政编码级别的外部食品价格和店铺密度数据。固定效应模型的结果表明，较高的水果和蔬菜价格与儿童较高的体重指数百分位数显著相关，这一效应在低收入儿童中更为明显：全样本水果和蔬菜价格对体重指数的弹性为0.25，而在低收入儿童中这一数值为0.60。在横截面模型中，快餐价格与低收入儿童体重显著相关，其价格弹性为-0.77。超市的增多和便利店数量的减少与低收入儿童较低的体重水平相关。这些结果提供了关于使用财政定价干预措施（如税收和补贴）以及其他干预手段作为政策工具，以改善儿童肥胖问题的有效性方面的证据。

abstract.text: In this paper we consider how the dental industry responded to the addition of fluoride to public drinking water. We take advantage of the staggered introduction of fluoridation throughout the country to analyze the changes in numbers of within-county dentists relative to physicians in the years surrounding the change in fluoridation status. We find a significant decrease in the number of dental establishments and an even larger reduction in the number of employees per firm following fluoridation. We also find that fluoridation in neighboring markets was associated with an increase in own-market dental supply, suggesting that dentists responded to the demand shock by moving from fluoridated areas to close-by markets. Further analysis suggests that some dentists may have retrained as specialists rather than moving geographically. Our estimates imply that the 8 percentage point change in exposure to water fluoridation from 1974 to 1992 may have led to the loss of as many as 0.6 percent of dental establishments and 2.1 percent of dental employees, suggesting a substantial net impact of this public good on the dental profession since its inception.

10.3386/w15056.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了牙科行业对公共饮用水中添加氟化物这一变化的反应。我们利用全国范围内氟化物添加的逐步实施情况，分析了氟化物添加政策变更前后，各县域内牙医数量与医生数量的变化。研究发现，氟化物添加后，牙科机构的数量显著减少，而每家牙科机构员工数量则进一步减少。此外，我们还发现，邻近地区的氟化物添加政策与当地牙科机构数量的增加有关，这表明牙医们为了应对需求变化，从氟化物添加地区迁移到了邻近市场。进一步分析表明，一些牙医可能通过专业培训来适应这一变化，而非地理上的迁移。我们的估计表明，从1974年到1992年，饮用水氟化物添加带来的8个百分点的变化可能导致了多达0.6%的牙科机构数量和2.1%的牙科员工流失，这表明这一公共政策对牙科行业产生了显著的积极影响。

abstract.text: The rate of increase of longevity has varied considerably across U.S. states since 1991. This paper examines the effect of the quality of medical care, behavioral risk factors (obesity, smoking, and AIDS incidence), and other variables (education, income, and health insurance coverage) on life expectancy and medical expenditure using longitudinal state-level data. We examine the effects of three different measures of the quality of medical care. The first is the average quality of diagnostic imaging procedures, defined as the fraction of procedures that are advanced procedures. The second is the average quality of practicing physicians, defined as the fraction of physicians that were trained at top-ranked medical schools. The third is the mean vintage (FDA approval year) of outpatient and inpatient prescription drugs. Life expectancy increased more rapidly in states where (1) the fraction of Medicare diagnostic imaging procedures that were advanced procedures increased more rapidly; (2) the vintage of self- and provider-administered drugs increased more rapidly; and (3) the quality of medical schools previously attended by physicians increased more rapidly. States with larger increases in the quality of diagnostic procedures, drugs, and physicians did not have larger increases in per capita medical expenditure.

10.3386/w15068.abstractZh: 自1991年以来，美国各州的寿命增长速度存在显著差异。本文利用纵向的州级数据，研究了医疗质量、行为风险因素（肥胖、吸烟和艾滋病发病率）以及其他变量（教育、收入和健康保险覆盖）对预期寿命和医疗支出的影响。我们考察了三种不同的医疗质量衡量标准的影响。第一种是诊断成像程序的平均质量，定义为高级程序的占比。第二种是执业医生的平均质量，定义为在顶尖医学院接受培训的医生的占比。第三种是门诊和住院处方药物的平均批准年份。在以下情况下，预期寿命增长更快：（1）使用高级程序的Medicare诊断成像程序的比例增长更快；（2）自我用药和由医生开具的药物的平均批准年份增长更快；（3）医生之前就读的医学院的平均质量增长更快。在诊断程序、药物和医生质量有所提升的州，人均医疗支出并没有相应增加。

abstract.text: One literature documents a significant, black-white gap in average test scores, while another finds a substantial narrowing of the gap during the 1980's, and stagnation in convergence after. We use two data sources -- the Long Term Trends NAEP and AFQT scores for the universe of applicants to the U.S. military between 1976 and 1991 -- to show: 1) the 1980's convergence is due to relative improvements across successive cohorts of blacks born between 1963 and the early 1970's and not a secular narrowing in the gap over time; and 2) the across-cohort gains were concentrated among blacks in the South. We then demonstrate that the timing and variation across states in the AFQT convergence closely tracks racial convergence in measures of health and hospital access in the years immediately following birth. We show that the AFQT convergence is highly correlated with post-neonatal mortality rates and not with neonatal mortality and low birth weight rates, and that this result cannot be explained by schooling desegregation and changes in family background. We conclude that investments in health through increased access at very early ages have large, long-term effects on achievement, and that the integration of hospitals during the 1960's affected the test performance of black teenagers in the 1980's.

10.3386/w15078.abstractZh: 一项文献记载了黑人与白人在平均测试成绩上存在显著差距，而另一项研究则发现这一差距在1980年代有所缩小，之后则趋于停滞。我们利用两个数据来源——1976年至1991年间申请美国军事职位的人员的NAEP和长期趋势数据以及AFQT成绩——来证明：1) 1980年代的趋同是由于1963年至1970年代初出生的黑人各批次的相对进步所致，而非随着时间推移差距的缩小；2) 各批次黑人的进步主要集中在南方地区。我们进一步证明，各州在AFQT成绩趋同的时间和变化与出生后几年内健康指标和医院获取情况的种族趋同密切相关。我们发现，AFQT成绩的趋同与产后死亡率高度相关，而与新生儿死亡率和低出生体重率无关，这一结果无法用教育融合和家庭背景的变化来解释。我们得出结论，通过在早期阶段增加健康服务的投入，对成就具有长期且显著的影响，而1960年代医院的整合也影响了1980年代黑人青少年的测试表现。

abstract.text: The extent to which consumers respond to marginal prices for medical care is important for policy. Using recent data and a new censored quantile instrumental variable (CQIV) estimator, I estimate the price elasticity of expenditure on medical care. The CQIV estimator allows the estimates to vary across the skewed expenditure distribution, it allows for censoring at zero expenditure nonparametrically, and it allows for the insurance-induced endogenous relationship between price and expenditure. For identification, I rely on cost sharing provisions that generate marginal price differences between individuals who have injured family members and individuals who do not. I estimate the price elasticity of expenditure on medical care to be stable at -2.3 across the .65 to .95 conditional quantiles of the expenditure distribution. These quantile estimates are an order of magnitude larger than previous mean estimates. I consider several explanations for why price responsiveness is larger than previous estimates would suggest.

10.3386/w15085.abstractZh: 消费者对医疗服务的边际价格反应程度对政策制定具有重要意义。利用最新数据及一种新的删失分位数工具变量估计方法，我测算了医疗支出的价格弹性。该工具变量估计方法允许估计值随着支出分布的偏斜而变化，允许以零支出进行非参数删失处理，并允许考虑保险因素对价格与支出之间关系的影响。在识别过程中，我基于成本分担政策，这些政策能够产生有家庭成员受伤的个体与未受伤的个体之间的边际价格差异。我估计医疗支出的价格弹性在支出分布的0.65至0.95条件分位数上稳定在-2.3。这些分位数估计值比之前的均值估计值高出一个数量级。我考虑了多种解释，说明为何价格反应程度比之前的估计值更为显著。

abstract.text: This paper studies the contribution of sulfa drugs, a groundbreaking medical innovation in the 1930s, to declines in U.S. mortality. For several often-fatal infectious diseases, sulfa drugs represented the first effective treatment. Using time-series and difference-in-differences methods (with diseases unaffected by sulfa drugs as a comparison group), we find that sulfa drugs led to a 25 to 40 percent decline in maternal mortality, 17 to 36 percent decline in pneumonia mortality, and 52 to 67 percent decline in scarlet-fever mortality between 1937 and 1943. Altogether, they reduced mortality by 2 to 4 percent and increased life expectancy by 0.4 to 0.8 years. We also find that sulfa drugs benefited whites more than blacks.

10.3386/w15089.abstractZh: 本文研究了磺胺类药物对美国死亡率下降的贡献。作为20世纪30年代的一项突破性医学创新，磺胺类药物为多种常常致命的传染病提供了有效的治疗方法。通过时间序列分析和差异比较方法（以未受磺胺类药物影响的疾病作为对照组），我们发现，在1937年至1943年间，磺胺类药物使孕产妇死亡率下降了25%至40%，肺炎死亡率下降了17%至36%，猩红热死亡率下降了52%至67%。总体而言，磺胺类药物使死亡率降低了2%至4%，并使预期寿命增加了0.4至0.8年。我们还发现，磺胺类药物对白人的益处大于对黑人的益处。

abstract.text: According to the Gallup-Healthways Well-Being Index daily poll of the US population, taller people live better lives, at least on average. They evaluate their lives more favorably, and they are more likely to report a range of positive emotions such as enjoyment and happiness. They are also less likely to report a range of negative experiences, like sadness, and physical pain, though they are more likely to experience stress and anger, and if they are women, to worry. These findings cannot be attributed to different demographic or ethnic characteristics of taller people, but are almost entirely explained by the positive association between height and both income and education, both of which are positively linked to better lives.

10.3386/w15090.abstractZh: 根据盖洛普-健康之路幸福感指数的每日调查，美国民众普遍认为，身高较高的人生活得更好。他们对自己的生活评价更为积极，也更有可能表达出诸如愉悦和幸福等积极情绪。他们不太可能描述负面经历，如悲伤和身体疼痛，但他们更可能感受到压力和愤怒，如果是女性，则更可能感到担忧。这些发现并非由于身高较高的人具有不同的 demographic 或 ethnic 特征所致，而几乎完全可以由身高与收入和教育水平之间的正相关关系来解释，而这两者都与更好的生活状况密切相关。

abstract.text: A popular policy option for addressing the growth in weight has has been the imposition of a "fat tax" on selected foods that are deemed to promote obesity. Understanding the public economics of "fat taxes" requires an understanding of how or even whether individuals respond to changes in food prices over the long-term. We study the short- and long-run body weight consequences of changing food prices, in the Health and Retirement Study (HRS). We found very modest short-term effects of price per calorie on body weight, and the magnitudes align with the previous literature. The long-term effect is much bigger, but it takes a long time for the effect to reach the full scale. Within 30 years, a 10% permanent reduction in price per calorie would lead to a BMI increase of 1.5 units (or 3.6%). The long term effect is an increase of 1.9 units of BMI (or 4.2%). From a policy perspective, these results suggest that policies raising the price of calories will have little effect on weight in the short term, but might curb the rate of weight growth and achieve weight reduction over a very long period of time.

10.3386/w15096.abstractZh: 解决体重增长问题的一个常见政策选择是对被认为会导致肥胖的某些食品征收“脂肪税”。理解“脂肪税”的公共经济学效应需要了解个人在长期内对食品价格变化的反应情况。我们在“健康与退休研究”中研究了食品价格变化对体重的短期和长期影响。研究发现，每卡路里价格的变化对体重的短期影响非常微小，其程度与先前的研究结果一致。长期影响则更为显著，但需要很长时间才能完全显现出来。在30年内，每卡路里价格下降10%会导致BMI增加1.5个单位（或3.6%）。从政策角度来看，这些结果表明，提高卡路里价格的政策在短期内对体重的影响较小，但可能会减缓体重增长的速度，并在很长一段时间内实现体重的减少。

abstract.text: Ten years have passed since John Donohue and Steven Levitt initially proposed that legalized abortion played a major role in the dramatic decline in crime during the 1990s. Criminologists largely dismiss the association because simple plots of age-specific crime rates are inconsistent with a large cohort affect following the legalization of abortion. Economists, on the other hand, have corrected mistakes in the original analyses, added new data, offered alternative tests and tried to replicate the association in other countries. Donohue and Levitt have responded to each challenge with more data and additional regressions. Making sense of the dueling econometrics has proven difficult for even the most seasoned empiricists. In this paper I review the evidence. I argue that the most straightforward test given available data involves age-specific arrest and homicide rates regressed on lagged abortion rates in the 1970s or indicators of abortion legalization in 1970 and 1973. Such models provide little support for the Donohue and Levitt hypothesis in either the US or the United Kingdom.

10.3386/w15098.abstractZh: 自约翰·多诺霍和史蒂文·莱维特最初提出合法化堕胎在20世纪90年代犯罪率大幅下降中起到了重要作用以来，已经过去了十年。犯罪学家大多否认这种关联，因为简单的按年龄划分的犯罪率数据与合法化堕胎后出现的群体效应不符。而经济学家则纠正了原始分析中的错误，增加了新的数据，提出了替代性的检验方法，并试图在其他国家复制这一关联。多诺霍和莱维特通过更多的数据和额外的回归分析来应对这些挑战。即使是经验最丰富的实证学家，要理解这些相互对立的计量经济学结论也相当困难。在本文中，我回顾了相关证据。我认为，根据现有数据，最直接的方法是将1970年代的按年龄划分的逮捕率和杀人率与滞后后的堕胎率进行回归分析，或者将1970年和1973年堕胎合法化的指标纳入模型中。这样的模型在美国和英国都未能为多诺霍和莱维特的假设提供有力的支持。

abstract.text: Obesity is associated with serious health problems, and it can generate adverse economic outcomes. We analyze a nationally-representative sample of young American adults to investigate the interplay between obesity, wages and self-esteem. Wages can be impacted directly by obesity, and they can be influenced by obesity indirectly through the channel of obesity to self-esteem to wages. We find that female wages are directly influenced by body weight, and self-esteem has an impact on wages in case of whites. Being overweight or obese has a negative impact on the self-esteem of females and of black males. The results suggest that obesity has the most significant impact on white women's wages.

10.3386/w15101.abstractZh: 肥胖与严重的健康问题相关，并且可能导致不良的经济后果。我们分析了美国年轻成年人的全国代表性样本，以研究肥胖、工资和自尊心之间的相互作用。肥胖可以直接影响工资，也可以通过肥胖→自尊心→工资的途径间接影响工资。我们发现，女性的工资直接受到体重的影响，而自尊心对白人的工资也有影响。超重或肥胖对女性和黑人男性的自尊心有负面影响。结果表明，肥胖对白人女性的工资影响最为显著。

abstract.text: Research on the effects of Vietnam military service suggests that Vietnam veterans experienced significantly higher mortality than both non-Vietnam veterans and the civilian population at large. These results, however, may be biased by non-random selection into the military if unobserved background differences between veterans and non-veterans affect mortality directly. The present study generates unbiased estimates of the causal impact of Vietnam era draft eligibility on male mortality. Using records from the Vietnam draft lottery to assign decedents born 1950-1952 draft lottery numbers, the study estimates excess mortality among observed draft eligible male decedents as compared to the (1) expected proportion of draft eligible decedents given Vietnam draft eligibility cutoffs and (2) observed proportion of draft eligible female decedents. The results demonstrate that there appears to be no effect of draft exposure on mortality (even cause-specific death rates). When we examine population subgroups--including splits by race, educational attainment, nativity and marital status--we find weak evidence for an interaction between education and draft eligibility. On the whole, these results suggest that previous research, which has shown that Vietnam-era veterans experienced significantly higher mortality than non-veterans, may be biased by non-random selection into the military and may thus overstate the need for compensatory government pensions.

10.3386/w15105.abstractZh: 关于越南兵役影响的研究表明，越南退伍军人的死亡率显著高于非越南退伍军人以及普通平民。然而，这些结果可能受到非随机军事选拔的影响，因为退伍军人与非退伍军人之间的背景差异可能直接影响死亡率。本研究旨在得出关于越南时期征兵资格对男性死亡率因果影响的无偏估计。通过利用越南征兵抽签记录，将1950-1952年间出生的人按照抽签号码分组，研究发现在征兵资格范围内的男性死亡人数高于以下两种情况下的预期比例：（1）根据越南征兵资格标准确定的征兵资格范围内死亡人数；（2）实际观察到的征兵资格范围内的女性死亡人数。研究结果表明，征兵经历似乎对死亡率没有影响（甚至对特定死因的死亡率也没有影响）。当我们考察不同人口亚群体时——包括按种族、教育水平、出生地及婚姻状况划分的群体——我们发现教育水平与征兵资格之间几乎没有交互作用。总体而言，这些结果表明，之前的研究表明越南时期退伍军人的死亡率显著高于非退伍军人，这种结论可能受到非随机军事选拔的影响，因此可能高估了政府需要提供的补偿性养老金的必要性。

abstract.text: We use unique data from an insurer that exclusively offers high-deductible, "consumer-directed" health plans to identify the effect of plan features, notably the spending account, on health care spending. Our results show that the marginal dollar in the spending account is entirely spent on outpatient and pharmacy services. In contrast, inpatient and out-of-pocket spending were not responsive to the amount in the spending account. Our results represent the first plausibly causal estimates of the components of consumer-driven health plans on health spending. The magnitudes of the effects suggest important moral hazard consequences to higher spending account levels.

10.3386/w15106.abstractZh: 我们利用了一家仅提供高免赔额、“消费者主导”健康计划的保险公司的独特数据，来研究计划特性，尤其是消费账户对医疗支出的影响。研究结果表明，消费账户中的每一美元都完全用于门诊和药房服务。相比之下，住院费和自付费用并未受到消费账户金额的影响。我们的研究结果首次提供了关于消费者主导健康计划各组成部分对医疗支出影响的合理因果估计。这些影响的幅度表明，较高的消费账户水平会带来重要的道德风险后果。

abstract.text: This paper assesses the impact of two recent policies designed to increase insurance coverage for older teens and young adults. The introduction of SCHIP in 1997 enabled low and moderate income teens up to age 19 to gain access to public health insurance. More recent policies adopted by a number of states have enabled young adults between the ages of 19 and (typically) 24 to remain covered under their parents' health insurance. We take advantage of the discrete break in coverage at age 19 to evaluate the impact of SCHIP. We also use quasi-experimental variation across states and years along with the targeted nature of eligibility to evaluate the impact of these "extended parental coverage" laws. Our results suggest that both types of policies were effective at increasing health insurance coverage, especially among their respective target populations. Overall, SCHIP increases insurance coverage by 3 percentage points; those with incomes under 150 percent of poverty are found to experience a 7 percentage point increase. We find little evidence of crowd-out associated with the introduction of SCHIP. Extended parental coverage laws have minimal aggregate effects on coverage, but they increase coverage by up to 5 percentage points for select groups. These laws may generate reverse crowd-out, as individuals leave public insurance coverage to take advantage of the private coverage now available to them.

10.3386/w15114.abstractZh: 本文评估了两项旨在增加老年青少年和年轻成年人保险覆盖率的近期政策的影响。1997年实施的SCHIP政策使收入较低和适中的19岁及以下青少年能够获得公共健康保险。一些州最近采取的政策使19岁至24岁之间的年轻成年人能够继续享受父母提供的健康保险。我们利用19岁这一明确的保险覆盖中断点来评估SCHIP政策的效果。我们还利用各州和年份之间的准实验差异，以及资格认定的针对性，来评估这些“扩展父母保险”政策的影响。我们的研究结果表明，这两种政策在增加健康保险覆盖方面都取得了成效，尤其是在各自的目标人群中。总体而言，SCHIP政策使保险覆盖率增加了3个百分点；而收入低于贫困线的群体则增加了7个百分点。我们发现，SCHIP政策的实施并未导致人群流失。扩展父母保险政策对整体保险覆盖率的综合影响较小，但为特定群体增加了高达5个百分点的覆盖率。这些政策可能会产生相反的效果，即个体为了利用现在可获得的私人保险而放弃公共保险。

abstract.text: We examine whether the job characteristics of physical demands and environmental conditions affect individual's health. Five-year cumulative measures of these job characteristics are used to reflect findings in the biologic and physiologic literature that indicate that cumulative exposure to hazards and stresses harms health. To create our analytic sample, we merge job characteristics from the Dictionary of Occupational Titles with the Panel Study of Income Dynamics dataset. We control for early and lagged health measures and a set of pre-determined characteristics to address concerns that individuals self-select into jobs. Our results indicate that individuals who work in jobs with the 'worst' conditions experience declines in their health, though this effect varies by demographic group. For example, for non-white men, a one standard deviation increase in cumulative physical demands decreases health by an amount that offsets an increase of two years of schooling or four years of aging. We also find evidence that job characteristics are more detrimental to the health of females and older workers. Finally, we report suggestive evidence that earned income, another job characteristic, partially cushions the health impact of physical demands and harsh environmental conditions for workers. These results are robust to inclusion of occupation fixed effects.

10.3386/w15121.abstractZh: 我们研究物理需求和环境条件等工作特征是否会影响个人的健康。我们使用这些工作特征的五年累积指标，以反映生物学和生理学文献中的研究结果，这些研究指出，长期暴露于危险和压力下会对健康造成危害。为了构建我们的分析样本，我们将《职业名称词典》中的工作特征与收入动态面板研究数据集进行了合并。我们通过控制早期和滞后期的健康指标以及一组预先确定的特征来消除个体自我选择进入某些工作的担忧。我们的结果表明，从事“最恶劣”工作条件的个体健康状况会下降，不过这种影响因人口群体而异。例如，对于非白人男性来说，累积物理需求增加一个标准差，其健康下降的幅度可以抵消两年教育或四年的年龄增长所带来的健康改善。我们还发现，工作特征对女性和老年工人的健康影响更为严重。最后，我们提供了一些提示性证据，表明收入这一工作特征能够部分缓解物理需求和环境条件恶劣对工作人员的健康影响。这些结果在纳入职业固定效应后依然保持稳定。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of job loss from business closings on body mass index (BMI) and alcohol consumption. We improve upon extant literature by using: exogenously determined business closings, a sophisticated estimation approach (finite mixture models) to deal with complex heterogeneity, and national, longitudinal data (Health and Retirement Study). For both alcohol consumption and BMI, we find evidence that individuals who are more likely to respond to job loss by increasing unhealthy behaviors are already in the problematic range for these behaviors before losing their jobs. Thus health effects of job loss could be concentrated among "at risk" individuals.

10.3386/w15122.abstractZh: 本文探讨了企业倒闭导致失业对体重指数（BMI）和酒精消费的影响。我们通过以下方法改进了现有研究：使用外部确定的企业倒闭事件、采用复杂的估计方法（有限混合模型）来处理复杂的异质性问题，以及利用全国性的纵向数据（健康与退休研究）。我们发现，无论是酒精消费还是BMI，那些更可能通过增加不健康行为来应对失业的个体，在失业之前就已经处于这些行为的问题范围内。因此，失业对健康的负面影响可能主要集中在“高风险”个体身上。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the price elasticity of demand for alcohol using Health and Retirement Survey data. To account for unobserved heterogeneity in price responsiveness, we use finite mixture models. We recover two latent groups, one is significantly responsive to price but the other is unresponsive. Differences between these two groups can be explained in part by the behavioral factors of risk aversion, financial planning horizon, forward looking and locus of control. These results have policy implications. Only a subgroup responds significantly to price. Importantly, the unresponsive group drinks more heavily, suggesting that a higher price could fail to curb drinking by those most likely to cause negative externalities. In contrast, those least likely to impose costs on others are more responsive, thus suffering greater deadweight loss yet with less prevention of negative externalities.

10.3386/w15124.abstractZh: 本文利用《健康与退休调查》数据，估算了酒精需求的价格弹性。为了考虑价格反应的非观测异质性，我们采用了有限混合模型。研究发现存在两个潜在群体：一个对价格反应显著，另一个则无反应。这两个群体之间的差异部分可以由行为因素解释，如风险规避、财务规划期限、前瞻性思维以及控制点等。这些结果具有政策意义。只有一部分群体对价格有显著反应。值得注意的是，无反应群体饮酒量更大，这表明较高的价格可能无法抑制那些最有可能造成负面外部性的人群的饮酒行为。相反，那些最不可能对他人造成负担的人群则对价格反应更敏感，因此虽然减少了负面外部性的预防，但造成了更大的无谓损失。

abstract.text: Recent literature has suggested that higher taxes on addictive goods could increase welfare by assisting individuals with self control problems and trouble resisting 'temptation'. In contrast, if individuals continue to use despite increased prices, taxation may serve to reduce the welfare of these individuals while providing no benefits in managing self control nor mitigating externalities. We use data on adolescents from the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health (Add Health) to examine the impact of tobacco taxes on smoking. To account for unobserved heterogeneity in response to taxes we estimate finite mixture models, positing two types of individuals with differential responses to taxes. We find evidence of differential price elasticity for tobacco use across the adolescents groups, and show that individuals with low self control or high discount rates are largely unresponsive to cigarette price. Those who have the least willpower may need the most help in quitting but are unresponsive to taxes, suggesting that policies other than taxation may be needed to reduce adolescent tobacco use.

10.3386/w15130.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明，对成瘾商品征收更高的税收可以通过帮助有自我控制问题的人以及帮助他们抵抗“诱惑”来增加福利。相反，如果个人在价格上升的情况下仍然继续使用这些商品，税收可能会降低这些人的福利，同时无法帮助他们改善自我控制能力或减轻外部影响。我们利用《全国青少年健康纵向研究》中关于青少年的数据来研究烟草税对吸烟行为的影响。为了考虑税收对个体反应的不同性，我们采用了有限混合模型，假设存在两种对税收反应不同的个体类型。我们发现不同青少年群体对烟草使用的价格弹性存在差异，并且发现那些自我控制能力低或折扣率高的个体对香烟价格变化反应不大。那些意志力最弱的人可能需要更多的帮助来戒烟，但他们对税收的反应并不敏感，这表明除了税收之外，可能还需要其他政策来减少青少年的烟草使用行为。

abstract.text: We use data from California to document and offer possible explanations for the sharp increase in hospital prices charged to private payers after 1999. We find a downward trend in price for private pay patients in the 1990s and a rapid upward trend beginning in 1999, amounting to an annual average increase of 10.6% per year over 1999-2005. Prices in 2006 were almost double prices in 1999. By contrast, there was little discernable trend in prices for Medicare and Medicaid patients, although these prices varied from year-to-year. Surprisingly, the increase in prices is not correlated, geographically, with the change in hospital market concentration. For example, the greatest price rises came from hospitals in monopoly and highly concentrated counties which experienced little or no change over our sample period. Two recent California state hospital regulations, the seismic retrofit mandate and the mandatory nurse staffing ratio affected hospital costs. However, the cost increases due to the nursing staffing regulations are not large enough to account for the price increase, and the price increase is not substantially correlated with the costs of compliance with the seismic retrofit mandate. Therefore, the source of the near-doubling of California hospital prices remains something of a mystery.

10.3386/w15134.abstractZh: 我们利用加利福尼亚州的数据来记录并解释1999年之后私人支付者所支付的医院费用急剧上涨的原因。我们发现，在1990年代，私人支付者的费用呈现下降趋势，而从1999年开始，费用迅速上升，1999至2005年间年均增长10.6%。2006年的费用几乎是1999年的两倍。相比之下，Medicare和Medicaid患者的费用几乎没有明显的趋势变化，尽管这些费用每年都有所不同。令人惊讶的是，费用的增加与医院市场集中度的变化在地理上没有相关性。例如，费用上升最明显的是那些处于垄断或高度集中地区的医院，而这些地区的费用在我们样本期间几乎没有变化。最近加州的两项医院法规——地震加固要求和护士人员配置比例要求——对医院成本产生了影响。然而，由于护士人员配置要求导致的成本增加不足以解释费用的上涨，而且费用的增加与遵守地震加固要求的成本也没有显著的相关性。因此，加州医院费用几乎翻倍的来源仍然是一个谜。

abstract.text: In a recent paper, Acemoglu and Johnson (2007) argue that the large increases in population health witnessed in the 20th century may have lowered income levels. We argue that this result depends crucially on their assumption that initial health and income do not affect subsequent economic growth. Using their data we reject this assumption in favor of a model of conditional convergence, with income adjusting to its steady state over time. We show that, allowing for conditional convergence, exogenous improvements in health due to technical advances associated with the epidemiological transition appear to have increased income levels.

10.3386/w15137.abstractZh: 在最近的一篇论文中，Acemoglu和Johnson（2007）认为，20世纪人口健康水平的显著提升可能降低了收入水平。我们认为，这一结论在很大程度上依赖于他们的假设，即初始的健康状况与收入水平不会影响后续的经济增长。利用他们的数据，我们否定了这一假设，转而支持一种条件性收敛模型，即收入水平会随时间调整至稳定状态。我们表明，在考虑条件性收敛的情况下，由于流行病学转变带来的技术进步所导致的健康改善似乎提升了收入水平。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the relationship between the characteristics of medical licensing boards and the frequency with which boards discipline physicians. Specifically, we take advantage of variation in the structure of medical licensing boards between 1993 and 2003 to determine the effect of organizational and budgetary independence, public oversight, and resource constraints on rates of physician discipline. We find that larger licensing boards, boards with more staff, and boards that are organizationally independent from state government discipline doctors more frequently. Public oversight and political control over board budgets do not appear to influence the extent to which medical licensing boards discipline doctors. These findings are broadly consistent with theories of regulatory behavior that emphasize the importance of bureaucratic autonomy for effective regulatory enforcement.

10.3386/w15140.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医学执照委员会的特征与其对医生进行惩戒的频率之间的关系。具体而言，我们利用1993年至2003年间医学执照委员会结构的变化，来研究组织与预算独立性、公共监督以及资源限制对医生惩戒频率的影响。研究发现，规模较大的执照委员会、拥有更多工作人员的委员会，以及在组织上独立于州政府管理的委员会，其医生惩戒的频率更高。而公共监督和对委员会预算的政治控制似乎并未显著影响医学执照委员会对医生的惩戒程度。这些发现与强调官僚自主性对有效监管执行重要性的监管行为理论大体一致。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the impact of federal extramural research funding on total expenditures for life sciences research and development (R&D) at U.S. universities, to determine whether federal R&D funding spurs funding from non-federal (private and state/local government) sources. We use a fixed effects instrumental variable approach to estimate the causal effect of federal funding on non-federal funding. Our results indicate that a dollar increase in federal funding leads to a $0.33 increase in non-federal funding at U.S. universities. Our evidence also suggests that successful applications for federal funding may be interpreted by non-federal funders as a signal of recipient quality: for example, non-PhD-granting universities, lower ranked universities and those that have historically received less funding experience greater increases in non-federal funding per federal dollar received.

10.3386/w15146.abstractZh: 本文研究了联邦外部研究资金对美国大学生命科学研究与开发总支出的影响，旨在确定联邦研发资金是否能够促进非联邦（私营和州/地方政府）资金来源的投入。我们采用固定效应工具变量方法，来估计联邦资金对非联邦资金的影响。研究结果表明，联邦资金每增加一美元，美国大学的非联邦资金就会相应增加0.33美元。我们的研究还表明，成功的联邦资金申请可能被非联邦资助者视为受助者质量的信号：例如，不提供博士学位的大学、排名较低的大学以及历史上获得资金较少的大学，在每联邦资金投入中获得的非联邦资金增加幅度更大。

abstract.text: While there is a well-established, large positive correlation between mental and physical health and education outcomes, establishing a causal link remains a substantial challenge. Building on findings from the biomedical literature, we exploit specific differences in the genetic code between siblings within the same family to estimate the causal impact of several poor health conditions on academic outcomes. We present evidence of large impacts of poor mental health on academic achievement. Further, our estimates suggest that family fixed effects estimators by themselves cannot fully account for the endogeneity of poor health. Finally, our sensitivity analysis suggests that these differences in specific portions of the genetic code have good statistical properties and that our results are robust to reasonable violations of the exclusion restriction assumption.

10.3386/w15148.abstractZh: 虽然心理健康与身体健康以及教育成果之间存在明确且显著的正相关关系，但建立因果关系仍然是一个重大挑战。基于生物医学研究的发现，我们利用同一家庭中兄弟姐妹之间基因代码的特定差异，来估算几种不良健康状况对学业成果的影响。我们发现，不良心理健康对学业成就有显著负面影响。此外，我们的估计结果表明，仅使用家庭固定效应估计方法无法完全解释健康状况不良的内生性。最后，我们的敏感性分析表明，这些基因代码特定部分的差异具有良好的统计特性，且我们的研究结果在合理违反排除限制假设的情况下仍然具有稳健性。

abstract.text: This paper constructs a rich model of saving for retired single people. Our framework allows for bequest motives and heterogeneity in medical expenses and life expectancies. We estimate the model using AHEAD data and the method of simulated moments. The data show that out-of-pocket medical expenses rise quickly with both age and permanent income. For many elderly people the risk of living long and requiring expensive medical care is a more important driver of old age saving than the desire to leave bequests. Social insurance programs such as Medicaid rationalize the low asset holdings of the poorest. These government programs, however, also benefit the rich because they insure them against their worst nightmares about their very old age: either not being able to afford the medical care that they need, or being left destitute by huge medical bills.

10.3386/w15149.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个关于退休单身人士储蓄的详细模型。我们的框架考虑了遗产动机以及医疗费用和预期寿命的异质性。我们使用AHEAD数据和模拟矩估计方法对模型进行了估计。数据显示，自付医疗费用随年龄和永久收入的增加而迅速上升。对于许多老年人来说，长寿并需要昂贵医疗护理的风险，比留下遗产的愿望更为重要，是老年人储蓄的重要驱动因素。像Medicaid这样的社会保障计划有助于解释最贫困人群资产持有量较低的原因。然而，这些政府计划也对富人有利，因为它们为富人提供了应对晚年最糟糕情况的保障：要么无法负担所需的医疗护理，要么因巨额医疗费用而陷入贫困。

abstract.text: The prevalence of obesity has been rising dramatically in the U.S., leading to poor health and rising health care expenditures. The role of policy in addressing rising rates of obesity, however, is controversial. Policy recommendations for interventions intended to influence body weight decisions often assume the obesity creates negative externalities for the non-obese. We build on earlier work demonstrating that this argument depends on two important assumptions: 1) that the obese do not pay for their higher medical expenditures through differential payments for health care and health insurance, and 2) that body weight decisions are responsive to the incidence of medical care costs associated with obesity. In this paper, we test the latter proposition - that body weight is influenced by insurance coverage - using two approaches. First, we use data from the Rand Health Insurance Experiment, in which people were randomly assigned to varying levels of health insurance, to examine the effect of generosity of insurance coverage on body weight along the intensive coverage margin. Second, we use instrumental variables methods to estimate the effect of type of insurance coverage (private, public and none) on body weight along the extensive margin. We explicitly address the discrete nature of the endogenous indicator of health insurance coverage by estimating a nonlinear instrumental variables model. We find weak evidence that more generous insurance coverage increases body mass index. We find stronger evidence that being insured increases body mass index and obesity.

10.3386/w15163.abstractZh: 美国的肥胖率持续急剧上升，导致健康状况恶化以及医疗支出的增加。然而，政策在应对肥胖率上升方面的作用存在争议。针对影响体重决策的干预措施的政策建议通常假设肥胖对非肥胖人群产生负面影响。我们基于先前的研究表明，这一论点依赖于两个重要假设：1）肥胖者不会通过不同的医疗支付和医疗保险来承担更高的医疗支出；2）体重决策会受到与肥胖相关的医疗成本的影响。在本文中，我们通过两种方法检验后一个假设——即保险覆盖程度会影响体重。首先，我们利用了Rand健康保险实验的数据，参与者被随机分配到不同级别的医疗保险，以研究保险覆盖程度的 generosity 对体重的影响。其次，我们使用工具变量方法估计了保险类型（私人、公共和无保险）对体重的影响。我们通过估计非线性工具变量模型，明确处理了保险覆盖程度这一内生指标的离散性质。我们发现，更慷慨的保险覆盖程度对体重指数的影响较弱。而保险覆盖程度对体重指数和肥胖的影响则更为显著。

abstract.text: This study assesses the factors influencing the movement of people across health plans. We distinguish three types of cost-related transitions: adverse selection, the movement of the less healthy to more generous plans; adverse retention, the tendency for people to stay where they are when they get sick; and aging in place, where lack of all movement makes plans with initially older enrollees increase in cost over time. Using data from the Group Insurance Commission in Massachusetts, we show that aging in place and adverse selection are both quantitatively important. Each can materially impact equilibrium enrollments, especially when premiums to enrollees reflect these costs.

10.3386/w15164.abstractZh: 本研究评估了影响人们在不同健康保险计划间转移的因素。我们将这些转移分为三类与成本相关的现象：逆向选择，即健康状况较差的人转向更优厚的保险计划；逆向保留，即人们在生病时倾向于留在当前的保险计划中；以及就地养老，由于缺乏流动性，最初年龄较大的参保者随着时间推移，其保险计划的成本会不断增加。通过马萨诸塞州团体保险委员会的数据分析，我们发现就地养老和逆向选择这两种因素都具有重要的定量影响。当参保者的保费能够反映这些成本时，这些因素都会对保险计划的均衡参保人数产生实质性影响。

abstract.text: Past research on the health workforce can be structured into three perspectives - "health workforce planning" (1960 through 1970s); "the health worker as economic actor" (1980s through 1990s); and "the health worker as necessary resource" (1990s through 2000s). During the first phase, shortages of health workers in developed countries triggered the development of four approaches to project future health worker requirements. We discuss each approach and show that modified versions are experiencing a resurgence in current studies estimating health worker requirements to meet population health goals, such as the United Nations' health-related Millennium Development Goals. A perceived "cost explosion" in many health systems shifted the focus to the study of the effect of health workers' behavior on health system efficiency during the second phase. We review the literature on one example topic, health worker licensure. In the last phase, regional health worker shortages in developing countries and local shortages in developed countries led to research on international health worker migration and programs to increase the supply of health workers in underserved areas. Based on our review of existing studies, we suggest areas for future research on the health workforce, including the transfer of existing approaches from developed to developing countries.

10.3386/w15168.abstractZh: 关于卫生工作者的研究可以分为三个视角：“卫生工作者规划”（1960年至1970年代）、“卫生工作者作为经济主体”（1980年至1990年代）以及“卫生工作者作为必要资源”（1990年至2000年代）。在第一阶段，发达国家卫生工作者短缺问题促使人们提出了四种方法来预测未来卫生工作者的需求。我们讨论了每种方法，并发现经过修改的方法在当前的卫生工作者需求估算研究中重新受到重视，这些研究旨在实现诸如联合国千年发展目标等公共卫生目标。许多卫生系统对“成本爆炸”的担忧使得研究重点转向了卫生工作者行为对卫生系统效率的影响。我们回顾了关于卫生工作者执照制度的相关文献。在最后一个阶段，发展中国家地区的卫生工作者短缺以及发达国家内部的局部短缺问题促使人们研究国际卫生工作者迁移问题，并制定计划以增加服务不足地区的卫生工作者供应。基于我们对现有研究的回顾，我们提出了未来关于卫生工作者研究的方向，包括将现有方法从发达国家推广到发展中国家。

abstract.text: The average price of treating a colorectal cancer patient with chemotherapy increased from about $100 in 1993 to $36,000 in 2005, due largely to the approval and widespread use of five new drugs between 1996 and 2004. We examine whether the substantial increase in spending has been worth it. Using discrete choice methods to estimate demand, we construct a price index for colorectal cancer drugs for each quarter between 1993 and 2005 that takes into consideration the quality (i.e., the efficacy and side effects in randomized clinical trials) of each drug on the market and the value that oncologists place on drug quality. A naive price index, which makes no adjustments for the changing attributes of drugs on the market, greatly overstates the true price increase. By contrast, a hedonic price index and two quality-adjusted price indices show that prices have actually remained fairly constant over this 13-year period, with slight increases or decreases depending on a model's assumptions.

10.3386/w15174.abstractZh: 使用化疗治疗结直肠癌患者的平均费用从1993年的约100美元增加到2005年的36,000美元，这主要得益于1996年至2004年间五种新药的批准和广泛使用。我们探讨这种费用的大幅增加是否值得。通过离散选择方法估算需求，我们为1993年至2005年每个季度的结直肠癌药物构建了一个价格指数，该指数考虑了市场上每种药物的质量（即随机临床试验中的疗效和副作用）以及肿瘤学家对药物质量的重视程度。一个未经调整的简单价格指数会严重高估实际价格的增长幅度。相比之下，一个享乐主义价格指数和两个质量调整价格指数显示，在这13年期间，价格实际上保持相对稳定，仅根据模型假设会有轻微的变化。

abstract.text: This paper presents a new multivariate copula-based modeling approach for analyzing cost-offsets between drug and nondrug expenditures. Estimates are based on panel data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS) with quarterly measures of medical expenditures. The approach allows for nonlinear dynamic dependence between drug and nondrug expenditures as well as asymmetric contemporaneous dependence. The specification uses the standard hurdle model with two significant extensions. First, it is adapted to the bivariate case. Second, because the cost-offset hypothesis is inherently dynamic, the bivariate hurdle framework is extended to accommodate dynamic relationships between drug and nondrug spending. The econometric analysis is implemented for six different groups defined by specific health conditions. There is evidence of modest cost-offsets of expenditures on prescribed drugs.

10.3386/w15191.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的基于多变量copula的建模方法，用于分析药物与非药物支出之间的成本抵消关系。研究基于《医疗支出面板调查》中的面板数据，这些数据包含季度医疗支出指标。该方法允许药物与非药物支出之间存在非线性动态依赖性，以及同时期的非对称性依赖性。模型采用标准障碍模型，并进行了两项重要扩展：首先，该方法适用于双变量情况；其次，由于成本抵消假设本质上是动态的，双变量障碍框架被扩展以容纳药物与非药物支出之间的动态关系。经济计量分析针对由特定健康状况定义的六组人群进行了实施。研究结果表明，处方药支出的成本抵消程度较为适中。

abstract.text: This study estimates the effect of deployment location and length on the risk of developing PTSD, relative to what it would be from the normal military operations. We use a random sample of activity-duty enlisted personnel serving between 2001 and 2006. We identify PTSD cases from TRICARE medical records and link deployment information from Contingent Tracking System. Comparing to those in other duties around the world, deployment to Iraq/Afghanistan increases the odds of developing PTSD substantially, with the largest effect observed for the Navy (OR=9.06, p<0.01) and the smallest effect for the Air Force (OR=1.25, p<0.01). A deployment longer than 180 days increases the odds of PTSD by 1.11 times to 2.84 times, depending on the service, compared to a tour under 120 days. For Army and Navy, a deployment to Iraq/Afghanistan further exacerbates the adverse effect of tour length. Our research identifies the extent of PTSD across services and quantifies the risks associated with OEF/OIF deployment intensity. Further research is needed for effective monitoring and preventive measures of PTSD on the active duty population.

10.3386/w15203.abstractZh: 本研究评估了部署地点和持续时间对患创伤后应激障碍风险的影响，与正常军事行动相比。我们选取了2001至2006年间服役的现役军人作为样本。通过TRICARE医疗记录识别创伤后应激障碍病例，并将部署信息从部队跟踪系统中获取。与其他国家的现役军人相比，在伊拉克/阿富汗的部署显著增加了患创伤后应激障碍的风险，其中海军的影响最大（比值比为9.06，p<0.01），空军的影响最小（比值比为1.25，p<0.01）。根据服务类型的不同，超过180天的部署会使患创伤后应激障碍的风险增加1.11倍至2.84倍，而120天以下的部署则不会如此。对于陆军和海军来说，在伊拉克/阿富汗的部署进一步加剧了部署时间长度带来的不利影响。我们的研究揭示了不同服务部门中创伤后应激障碍的普遍程度，并量化了与伊拉克战争/阿富汗战争相关部署强度带来的风险。为了有效监测和预防现役军人中的创伤后应激障碍，还需要进一步的研究。

abstract.text: Life expectancy in the United States fares poorly in international comparisons, primarily because of high mortality rates above age 50. Its low ranking is often blamed on a poor performance by the health care system rather than on behavioral or social factors. This paper presents evidence on the relative performance of the US health care system using death avoidance as the sole criterion. We find that, by standards of OECD countries, the US does well in terms of screening for cancer, survival rates from cancer, survival rates after heart attacks and strokes, and medication of individuals with high levels of blood pressure or cholesterol. We consider in greater depth mortality from prostate cancer and breast cancer, diseases for which effective methods of identification and treatment have been developed and where behavioral factors do not play a dominant role. We show that the US has had significantly faster declines in mortality from these two diseases than comparison countries. We conclude that the low longevity ranking of the United States is not likely to be a result of a poorly functioning health care system.

10.3386/w15213.abstractZh: 在美国，预期寿命在国际上的排名并不理想，主要原因在于50岁以上人群的死亡率较高。这一低排名通常被认为是由于医疗保健系统的表现不佳，而非行为或社会因素所致。本文通过仅以死亡预防为唯一标准，对美国医疗保健系统的相对表现进行了分析。我们发现，按照经合组织国家的标准，美国在癌症筛查、癌症生存率、心脏病发作和中风后的生存率以及高血压或高胆固醇患者的药物治疗方面表现良好。我们进一步深入探讨了前列腺癌和乳腺癌的死亡率问题，这两种疾病已经开发出有效的识别和治疗方法，且行为因素在其中并不起主导作用。结果显示，美国在这两种疾病的死亡率下降速度明显快于其他国家。因此，美国低寿命排名的原因不太可能是医疗保健系统功能不佳所致。

abstract.text: Prior studies suggest that, with elastically supplied inputs, free entry may lead to an inefficiently high number of firms in equilibrium. Under input scarcity, however, the welfare loss from free entry is reduced. Further, free entry may increase use of high-quality inputs, as oligopolistic firms underuse these inputs when entry is constrained. We assess these predictions by examining how the 1996 repeal of certificate-of-need (CON) legislation in Pennsylvania affected the market for cardiac surgery in the state. We show that entry led to a redistribution of surgeries to higher-quality surgeons and that this entry was approximately welfare neutral.

10.3386/w15214.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，在弹性供应的条件下，自由进入市场可能会导致均衡状态下企业数量过高且效率低下。然而，在投入稀缺的情况下，自由进入带来的福利损失会有所减少。此外，自由进入可能会促进高质量投入的使用，因为在进入受限的情况下，寡头企业通常会使用较少这些高质量投入。我们通过研究1996年宾夕法尼亚州废除需求证明立法对州内心脏手术市场的影响，来评估这些预测。研究表明，自由进入导致手术资源重新分配到了更优秀的外科医生手中，而这种自由进入对福利的影响大致为零。
