One unique aspect of these societies is that the Maasai represent a textbook example of a patriarchal society, whereas the Khasi are matrilineal. Similar to the extant evidence drawn from experiments executed in Western cultures, Maasai men opt to compete at roughly twice the rate as Maasai women. Interestingly, this result is reversed among the Khasi, where women choose the competitive environment more often than Khasi men, and even choose to compete weakly more often than Maasai men. These results provide insights into the underpinnings of the factors hypothesized to be determinants of the observed gender differences in selecting into competitive environments.

10.3982/ecta6690.abstractZh: 我们通过一项对照实验来探讨在两种不同社会中，性别在选择进入竞争环境方面是否存在差异：坦桑尼亚的马赛族和印度的卡西族。这两个社会的独特之处在于，马赛族是一个典型的父权社会，而卡西族则实行母系制度。与西方文化中已有的实验证据类似，马赛族男性选择参与竞争的频率大约是马赛族女性的两倍。有趣的是，在卡西族中，女性选择进入竞争环境的频率高于卡西族男性，甚至在某些情况下，女性选择参与竞争的频率也高于马赛族男性。这些结果为我们理解导致性别在竞争环境选择方面差异的因素提供了重要线索。

abstract.text: Anscombe and Aumann (1963) wrote a classic characterization of subjective expected utility theory. This paper employs the same domain for preference and a closely related (but weaker) set of axioms to characterize preferences that use second-order beliefs (beliefs over probability measures). Such preferences are of interest because they accommodate Ellsberg-type behavior.

10.3982/ecta6727.abstractZh: Anscombe和Aumann在1963年撰写了一篇关于主观期望效用理论的经典描述性文章。本文采用相同的偏好域，并采用一组密切相关但较为宽松的公理来描述基于二阶信念的偏好（即基于概率测度的信念）。这类偏好之所以值得关注，是因为它们能够体现Ellsberg型行为的特点。

abstract.text: We characterize equilibria with endogenous debt constraints for a general equilibrium econ-omy with limited commitment in which the only consequence of default is losing the ability to borrow in future periods. First, we show that equilibrium debt limits must satisfy a simple con-dition that allows agents to exactly roll over existing debt period by period. Second, we provide an equivalence result, whereby the resulting set of equilibrium allocations with self-enforcing private debt is equivalent to the allocations that are sustained with unbacked public debt or rational bubbles. In contrast to the classic result by Bulow and Rogo § (AER, 1989), positive levels of debt are sustainable in our environment because the interest rate is su¢ciently low to provide repayment incentives. We thank for useful comments the editor, Harald Uhlig, three anonymous referees, Marios Angeletos, Andy

10.3982/ecta6754.abstractZh: 我们描述了在有限承诺的一般均衡经济中，具有内生债务约束的均衡状态。违约的唯一后果是失去未来时期的借款能力。首先，我们表明均衡债务限制必须满足一个简单条件，即允许代理人逐期准确结转现有债务。其次，我们提供了一个等价性结果，即具有自我强制的私人债务的均衡分配集合，与依靠无担保公共债务或理性泡沫维持的分配是等价的。与Bulow和Rogo在1989年提出的经典结果不同，在我们的环境中，较高的债务水平是可持续的，因为利率足够低，能够提供足够的还款激励。感谢编辑Harald Uhlig以及三位匿名审稿人Marios Angeletos、Andy提供的有益评论。

abstract.text: We create an analytical structure that reveals the long-run risk-return relationship for nonlinear continuous-time Markov environments. We do so by studying an eigenvalue problem associated with a positive eigenfunction for a conveniently chosen family of valuation operators. The members of this family are indexed by the elapsed time between payoff and valuation dates, and they are necessarily related via a mathematical structure called a semigroup. We represent the semigroup using a positive process with three components: an exponential term constructed from the eigenvalue, a martingale, and a transient eigenfunction term. The eigenvalue encodes the risk adjustment, the martingale alters the probability measure to capture long-run approximation, and the eigenfunction gives the long-run dependence on the Markov state. We discuss sufficient conditions for the existence and uniqueness of the relevant eigenvalue and eigenfunction. By showing how changes in the stochastic growth components of cash flows induce changes in the corresponding eigenvalues and eigenfunctions, we reveal a long-run risk-return trade-off.

10.3982/ecta6761.abstractZh: 我们构建了一种分析结构，用于揭示非线性连续时间马尔可夫环境下的长期风险-回报关系。我们通过研究一个与正特征值函数相关的特征值问题来实现这一目标，该特征值函数来自一组精心选择的估值算子。这些算子的成员按照收益日期与估值日期之间的时间间隔进行索引，并且它们通过一种称为半群的数学结构相互关联。我们用一个包含三个组成部分的正过程来表示半群：一个由特征值构成的指数项、一个鞅项以及一个瞬态特征函数项。特征值负责风险调整，鞅项用于改变概率测度以捕捉长期近似，而特征函数则体现了马尔可夫状态对长期的影响。我们讨论了相关特征值和特征函数存在性和唯一性的充分条件。通过展示现金流的随机增长成分如何引起相应特征值和特征函数的变化，我们揭示了长期的风险-回报权衡。

abstract.text: In dynamic discrete choice analysis, controlling for unobserved heterogeneity is an important issue, and finite mixture models provide flexible ways to account for it. This paper studies nonparametric identifiability of type probabilities and type-specific component distributions in finite mixture models of dynamic discrete choices. We derive sufficient conditions for nonparametric identification for various finite mixture models of dynamic discrete choices used in applied work under different assumptions on the Markov property, stationarity, and type-invariance in the transition process. Three elements emerge as the important determinants of identification: the time-dimension of panel data, the number of values the covariates can take, and the heterogeneity of the response of different types to changes in the covariates. For example, in a simple case where the transition function is type-invariant, a time-dimension of T = 3 is sufficient for identification, provided that the number of values the covariates can take is no smaller than the number of types and that the changes in the covariates induce sufficiently heterogeneous variations in the choice probabilities across types. Identification is achieved even when state dependence is present if a model is stationary first-order Markovian and the panel has a moderate time-dimension (T 6).

10.3982/ecta6763.abstractZh: 在动态离散选择分析中，控制未观察到的异质性是一个重要问题，有限混合模型提供了灵活的方法来应对这一问题。本文研究了动态离散选择的有限混合模型中，类型概率和类型特定成分分布的非参数可识别性。我们为在不同假设下使用的各种动态离散选择的有限混合模型推导出了非参数识别的充分条件，这些假设包括马尔可夫性质、平稳性以及转换过程中的类型不变性。三个要素是识别的重要决定因素：面板数据的时间维度、协变量可以取的值的数量，以及不同类型对协变量变化的响应异质性。例如，在转换函数为类型不变的简单情况下，只要协变量可以取的值的数量不小于类型数量，并且协变量的变化能够引起不同类型选择概率的足够异质性变化，那么T=3的时间维度就足以实现识别。即使存在状态依赖性，只要模型是一阶马尔可夫平稳的，并且面板数据具有中等的时间维度（T≥6），识别也是可以实现的。

abstract.text: We propose a new regression method to evaluate the impact of changes in the distribution of the explanatory variables on quantiles of the unconditional (marginal) distribution of an outcome variable. The proposed method consists of running a regression of the (recentered) influence function (RIF) of the unconditional quantile on the explanatory variables. The influence function, a widely used tool in robust estimation, is easily computed for quantiles, as well as for other distributional statistics. Our approach, thus, can be readily generalized to other distributional statistics.

10.3982/ecta6822.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的回归方法，用于评估解释变量分布变化对结果变量无条件（边际）分布分位数的影响。该方法包括对无条件分位数的影响函数进行回归分析，该影响函数是一种在稳健估计中广泛使用的工具，可以轻松计算分位数以及其他分布统计量。因此，我们的方法可以很容易地推广到其他分布统计量。

abstract.text: This paper applies some general concepts in decision theory to a linear panel data model. A simple version of the model is an autoregression with a separate intercept for each unit in the cross section, with errors that are independent and identically distributed with a normal distribution. There is a parameter of interest Gamma and a nuisance parameter τ, a N×K matrix, where N is the cross-section sample size. The focus is on dealing with the incidental parameters problem created by a potentially high-dimension nuisance parameter. We adopt a "fixed-effects" approach that seeks to protect against any sequence of incidental parameters. We transform tau to (delta, rho, omega), where delta is a J x K matrix of coefficients from the least-squares projection of tau on a N x J matrix x of strictly exogenous variables, rho is a K x K symmetric, positive semidefinite matrix obtained from the residual sums of squares and cross-products in the projection of tau on x, and omega is a (N - J) x K matrix whose columns are orthogonal and have unit length. The model is invariant under the actions of a group on the sample space and the parameter space, and we find a maximal invariant statistic. The distribution of the maximal invariant statistic does not depend upon omega. There is a unique invariant distribution for omega. We use this invariant distribution as a prior distribution to obtain an integrated likelihood function. It depends upon the observation only through the maximal invariant statistic. We use the maximal invariant statistic to construct a marginal likelihood function, so we can eliminate omega by integration with respect to the invariant prior distribution or by working with the marginal likelihood function. The two approaches coincide.

10.3982/ecta6869.abstractZh: 本文将决策理论中的一些基本概念应用于线性面板数据模型。该模型的一个简单版本是自回归模型，其中每个横截面单位都有一个独立的截距项，误差项具有独立同分布的正态分布。模型中有一个感兴趣的参数Gamma和一个干扰参数τ，τ是一个N×K的矩阵，其中N是横截面样本量。本文的重点是处理由高维干扰参数引起的偶然参数问题。我们采用“固定效应”方法，以防范任何偶然参数的序列出现。我们将τ转换为(δ, ρ, ω)，其中δ是一个J×K的系数矩阵，来源于将τ在N×J的严格外生变量矩阵x上进行最小二乘投影得到的系数；ρ是一个K×K的对称正半定矩阵，来源于τ在x上的投影中残差平方和和交叉乘积；ω是一个(N - J)×K的矩阵，其列向量是正交且长度为1。该模型在样本空间和参数空间上不受群作用的改变，我们找到了一个最大的不变统计量。最大不变统计量的分布不依赖于ω，且ω有一个唯一的不变分布。我们使用这个不变分布作为先验分布，得到一个积分似然函数，该函数仅通过最大不变统计量依赖于观测数据。我们使用最大不变统计量构造边际似然函数，从而可以通过对不变先验分布的积分或利用边际似然函数来消除ω的影响。这两种方法是一致的。

abstract.text: Many approaches to estimation of panel models are based on an average or integrated likelihood that assigns weights to different values of the individual effects. Fixed effects, random effects, and Bayesian approaches all fall into this category. We provide a characterization of the class of weights (or priors) that produce estimators that are first-order unbiased. We show that such bias-reducing weights will depend on the data in general unless an orthogonal reparameterization or an essentially equivalent condition is available. Two intuitively appealing weighting schemes are discussed. We argue that asymptotically valid confidence intervals can be read from the posterior distribution of the common parameters when N and T grow at the same rate. Next, we show that random effects estimators are not bias reducing in general and we discuss important exceptions. Moreover, the bias depends on the Kullback–Leibler distance between the population distribution of the effects and its best approximation in the random effects family. Finally, we show that, in general, standard random effects estimation of marginal effects is inconsistent for large T, whereas the posterior mean of the marginal effect is large-T consistent, and we provide conditions for bias reduction. Some examples and Monte Carlo experiments illustrate the results.

10.3982/ecta6895.abstractZh: 许多关于面板模型估计的方法都基于平均或积分似然法，该方法为个体效应的不同值分配权重。固定效应、随机效应和贝叶斯方法都属于这一类别。我们描述了能够产生一阶无偏估计量的权重（或先验）类。我们表明，除非有正交的重新参数化或本质上等效的条件，否则这种减少偏差的权重通常会依赖于数据。我们讨论了两种直观的加权方案。我们认为，当N和T以相同的速率增长时，可以从共同参数的后验分布中读出渐近有效的置信区间。接下来，我们表明随机效应估计量通常不能减少偏差，并讨论了重要的例外情况。此外，偏差取决于效应总体分布与随机效应族中最佳近似之间的Kullback–Leibler距离。最后，我们表明，一般来说，对于较大的T，标准随机效应边际效应的估计是不一致的，而边际效应的后验均值则是大T一致的，并且我们提供了减少偏差的条件。一些例子和蒙特卡洛实验验证了这些结果。

abstract.text: We study the role of observability in bargaining with correlated values. Short-run buyers sequentially submit offers to one seller. When previous offers are observable, bargaining is likely to end up in an impasse. In contrast, when offers are hidden, agreement is always reached, although with delay. 1

10.3982/ecta6917.abstractZh: 我们研究了可观测性在协商相关价值时的作用。短期内的买家会依次向一个卖家提出报价。当之前的报价是可观测的时，协商很可能会陷入僵局。相反，当报价被隐藏时，虽然会有延迟，但总是能够达成协议。

abstract.text: A player's pure strategy is called relevant for an outcome of a game in extensive form with perfect recall if there exists a weakly sequential equilibrium with that outcome for which the strategy is an optimal reply at every information set it does not exclude. The outcome satisfies forward induction if it results from a weakly sequential equilibrium in which players' beliefs assign positive probability only to relevant strategies at each information set reached by a profile of relevant strategies. We prove that if there are two players and payoffs are generic, then an outcome satisfies forward induction if every game with the same reduced normal form after eliminating redundant pure strategies has a sequential equilibrium with an equivalent outcome. Thus in this case forward induction is implied by decision-theoretic criteria.

10.3982/ecta6956.abstractZh: 一个玩家的纯策略对于具有完美回忆的扩展形式中的游戏结果来说，如果存在一个弱序均衡，并且该策略在每个信息集都是最优回应，那么这个策略就被称为相关的。如果结果源自一个弱序均衡，其中玩家的信念只将正概率分配给每个信息集中相关的策略，那么该结果满足前向归纳。我们证明，如果有两个玩家且收益是通用的，那么如果每个游戏在消除冗余纯策略后都存在一个具有等效结果的序均衡，那么该结果满足前向归纳。因此，在这种情况下，前向归纳是由决策理论标准所蕴含的。

abstract.text: In this paper we study high-dimensional time series that have the generalized dynamic factor structure. We develop a test of the null of k0 factors against the alternative that the number of factors is larger than k0 but no larger than k1>k0. Our test statistic equals maxk0<kk1(γk−γk+1)(γk+1−γk+2), where γi is the ith largest eigenvalue of the smoothed periodogram estimate of the spectral density matrix of data at a prespecified frequency. We describe the asymptotic distribution of the statistic, as the dimensionality and the number of observations rise, as a function of the Tracy–Widom distribution and tabulate the critical values of the test. As an application, we test different hypotheses about the number of dynamic factors in macroeconomic time series and about the number of dynamic factors driving excess stock returns.

10.3982/ecta6964.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了具有广义动态因子结构的高维时间序列。我们提出了一种检验零假设的方法，即假设因子数量为k0，但不超过k1>k0。我们的检验统计量等于maxk0<kk1(γk−γk+1)(γk+1−γk+2)，其中γi是数据在指定频率下平滑谱密度矩阵的第i大特征值。我们描述了随着维数和观测数量增加，该统计量的渐近分布，并将其视为Tracy–Widom分布的函数，同时列出了检验的临界值。作为应用，我们检验了关于宏观经济时间序列中动态因子数量以及驱动超额股票回报的动态因子数量的多种假设。

abstract.text: This paper considers inference in a broad class of nonregular models. The models considered are nonregular in the sense that standard test statistics have asymptotic distributions that are discontinuous in some parameters. It is shown in Andrews and Guggenberger (2009a) that standard fixed critical value, subsampling, and m out of n bootstrap methods often have incorrect asymptotic size in such models. This paper introduces general methods of constructing tests and confidence intervals that have correct asymptotic size. In particular, we consider a hybrid subsampling/fixed-critical-value method and size-correction methods. The paper discusses two examples in detail. They are (i) confidence intervals in an autoregressive model with a root that may be close to unity and conditional heteroskedasticity of unknown form and (ii) tests and confidence intervals based on a post-conservative model selection estimator.

10.3982/ecta7015.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在一系列非规则模型中的推断问题。所研究的模型属于非规则模型，即标准检验统计量的渐近分布在某些参数上是不连续的。Andrews和Guggenberger在2009a年的研究中指出，在这种模型中，标准固定临界值法、子抽样法以及m out of n自助法往往会导致错误的渐近检验功效。本文提出了构建具有正确渐近功效的检验和置信区间的一般方法。特别地，我们提出了一种混合子抽样/固定临界值法以及功效修正方法。文章详细讨论了两个例子：(i) 在具有接近单位根的自回归模型中，以及条件异方差性未知情况下的置信区间；(ii) 基于后保守模型选择估计量的检验和置信区间。

abstract.text: This paper studies the nonparametric identification of the first-price auction model with risk averse bidders within the private value paradigm. First, we show that the benchmark model is nonindentified from observed bids. We also derive the restrictions imposed by the model on observables and show that these restrictions are weak. Second, we establish the nonparametric identification of the bidders' utility function under exclusion restrictions. Our primary exclusion restriction takes the form of an exogenous bidders' participation, leading to a latent distribution of private values that is independent of the number of bidders. The key idea is to exploit the property that the bid distribution varies with the number of bidders while the private value distribution does not. We then extend these results to endogenous bidders' participation when the exclusion restriction takes the form of instruments that do not affect the bidders' private value distribution. Though derived for a benchmark model, our results extend to more general cases such as a binding reserve price, affiliated private values, and asymmetric bidders. Last, possible estimation methods are proposed.

10.3982/ecta7028.abstractZh: 本文研究了在私有价值范式下，具有风险厌恶的竞买者首次拍卖模型的非参数识别问题。首先，我们证明了基准模型无法从观测到的竞买数据中识别出竞买者的效用函数。我们还推导了模型对可观测变量的限制条件，并表明这些限制是较弱的。其次，我们建立了在排除限制下竞买者效用函数的非参数识别方法。我们的主要排除限制表现为竞买者的外部参与，这导致了一个与竞买者数量无关的私有价值潜在分布。关键思想是利用竞买者数量变化而私有价值分布不变这一特性。随后，我们将这些结果扩展到排除限制表现为不影响竞买者私有价值分布的工具时的内生竞买者参与情况。尽管这些结果是为基准模型推导出来的，但它们可以扩展到更一般的情况，例如具有约束性保留价格的拍卖、关联的私有价值以及非对称竞买者的情况。最后，本文提出了可能的估计方法。

abstract.text: This paper uses control variables to identify and estimate models with nonseparable, multidimensional disturbances. Triangular simultaneous equations models are considered, with instruments and disturbances that are independent and a reduced form that is strictly monotonic in a scalar disturbance. Here it is shown that the conditional cumulative distribution function of the endogenous variable given the instruments is a control variable. Also, for any control variable, identification results are given for quantile, average, and policy effects. Bounds are given when a common support assumption is not satisfied. Estimators of identified objects and bounds are provided, and a demand analysis empirical example is given.

10.3982/ecta7108.abstractZh: 本文采用控制变量来识别和估计具有不可分离、多维干扰的模型。考虑了三角联立方程模型，其中工具变量和干扰是独立的，且在一个标量干扰上呈严格单调的简化形式。研究表明，给定工具变量时，内生变量的条件累积分布函数是一个控制变量。此外，对于任何控制变量，都给出了分位数效应、平均效应和政策效应的识别结果。当不满足共同支持假设时，文中还给出了界限。文中提供了被识别对象的估计值和界限，并给出了一个需求分析实证示例。

abstract.text: We propose a test of the hypothesis of stochastic monotonicity. This hypothesis is of interest in many applications in economics. Our test is based on the supremum of a rescaled U-statistic. We show that its asymptotic distribution is Gumbel. The proof is difficult because the approximating Gaussian stochastic process contains both a stationary and a nonstationary part, and so we have to extend existing results that only apply to either one or the other case. We also propose a refinement to the asymptotic approximation that we show works much better in finite samples. We apply our test to the study of intergenerational income mobility.

10.3982/ecta7145.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个检验随机单调性的假设的方法。这一假设在经济学中的许多应用中都具有重要意义。我们的检验基于重新缩放的U统计量的上确界。我们证明了其渐近分布服从Gumbel分布。这一证明相当困难，因为近似的高斯随机过程包含了一个平稳部分和一个非平稳部分，因此我们必须扩展现有的结果，使其适用于这两种情况中的任何一种。我们还对渐近近似方法进行了改进，结果表明在有限样本情况下，改进后的方法效果显著更好。我们将这一检验方法应用于代际收入流动性的研究。

abstract.text: Consider a weather forecaster predicting a probability of rain for the next day. We consider tests that, given a finite sequence of forecast predictions and outcomes, will either pass or fail the forecaster. Sandroni showed that any test which passes a forecaster who knows the distribution of nature can also be probabilistically passed by a forecaster with no knowledge of future events. We look at the computational complexity of such forecasters and exhibit a linear-time test and distribution of nature such that any forecaster without knowledge of the future who can fool the test must be able to solve computationally difficult problems. Thus, unlike Sandroni's work, a computationally efficient forecaster cannot always fool this test independently of nature.

10.3982/ecta7163.abstractZh: 假设有一位天气预报员预测第二天有降雨的可能性。我们考虑一些测试，这些测试在给定一系列预报结果的情况下，要么通过天气预报员，要么未能通过。Sandroni证明了，任何能够让了解自然分布情况的天气预报员通过的测试，也可以让不了解未来事件的天气预报员通过。我们研究了这种天气预报员的计算复杂性，并提出了一种线性时间测试以及自然分布的方法，即任何不了解未来情况且能够欺骗该测试的天气预报员，都必须能够解决计算上困难的问题。因此，与Sandroni的工作不同，计算效率高的天气预报员并不总能独立于自然情况地欺骗这种测试。

abstract.text: The property of an allocation rule to be implementable in dominant strategies by a unique payment scheme is called revenue equivalence. We give a characterization of revenue equivalence based on a graph theoretic interpretation of the incentive compatibility constraints. The characterization holds for any (possibly infinite) outcome space and many of the known results are immediate consequences. Moreover, revenue equivalence can be identified in cases where existing theorems are silent.

10.3982/ecta7168.abstractZh: 一种分配规则能够通过独特的支付方案在支配策略中实现，这种现象被称为收入等价性。我们基于激励相容性约束的图论解释，给出了收入等价性的一种表征。该表征适用于任何（可能是无限的）结果空间，许多已知结果都是其直接推论。此外，在现有定理未涉及的情况下，也可以识别出收入等价性。

abstract.text: In this paper, we build a model where the presence of liquidity constraints tends to magnify the economy's response to aggregate shocks. We consider a decentralized model of trade, where agents may use money or credit to buy goods. When agents do not have access to credit and the real value of money balances is low, agents are more likely to be liquidity constrained. This makes them more concerned about their short-term earning prospects when making their consumption decisions and about their short-term spending opportunities when making their production decisions. This generates a coordination element in spending and production which leads to greater aggregate volatility and greater comovement across producers.

10.3982/ecta7231.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们构建了一个模型，其中流动性约束的存在会加剧经济对总体冲击的响应。我们考虑了一个去中心化的贸易模型，其中代理人可以使用货币或信贷来购买商品。当代理人无法获得信贷，且货币余额的实际价值较低时，他们更有可能受到流动性约束。这使他们在进行消费决策时更加关注短期收益前景，在做出生产决策时则更关注短期支出机会。这种在支出和生产中的协调作用，会导致整体波动性的增加以及生产者之间更大的共同波动。

abstract.text: We develop a search-theoretic model of financial intermediation in an over-the-counter market and study how trading frictions affect the distribution of asset holdings and standard measures of liquidity. A distinctive feature of our theory is that it allows for unrestricted asset holdings, so market participants can accommodate trading frictions by adjusting their asset positions. We show that these individual responses of asset demands constitute a fundamental feature of illiquid markets: they are a key determinant of trade volume, bid–ask spreads, and trading delays—the dimensions of market liquidity that search-based theories seek to explain.

10.3982/ecta7250.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个关于场外市场金融中介的搜索理论模型，研究交易摩擦如何影响资产持有量的分配以及流动性标准指标。我们理论的一个独特特点是允许无限制的资产持有，因此市场参与者可以通过调整资产头寸来应对交易摩擦。我们指出，这些个体对资产需求的反应构成了非流动性市场的一个基本特征：它们是交易量、买卖价差和交易延迟的关键因素——这些市场流动性的维度正是基于搜索理论试图解释的内容。

abstract.text: This paper develops a method for inference in dynamic discrete choice models with serially correlated unobserved state variables. Estimation of these models involves computing high-dimensional integrals that are present in the solution to the dynamic program and in the likelihood function. First, the paper proposes a Bayesian Markov chain Monte Carlo estimation procedure that can handle the problem of multidimensional integration in the likelihood function. Second, the paper presents an efficient algorithm for solving the dynamic program suitable for use in conjunction with the proposed estimation procedure.

10.3982/ecta7292.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种用于动态离散选择模型中带有序列相关未观测状态变量的推断方法。对这些模型的估计涉及计算高维积分，这些积分存在于动态程序的求解结果和似然函数中。首先，本文提出了一种贝叶斯马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛估计方法，能够处理似然函数中的多维积分问题。其次，本文提出了一种高效的动态程序求解算法，该算法适用于与所提出的估计方法结合使用。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the general nonlinear optimal income tax for couples, a multidimensional screening problem. Each couple consists of a primary earner who always participates in the labor market, but makes an hours-of-work choice, and a secondary earner who chooses whether or not to work. If second-earner participation is a signal of the couple being better (worse) off, we prove that optimal tax schemes display a positive tax (subsidy) on secondary earnings and that the tax (subsidy) on secondary earnings decreases with primary earnings and converges to zero asymptotically. We present calibrated microsimulations for the United Kingdom showing that decreasing tax rates on secondary earnings is quantitatively significant and consistent with actual income tax and transfer programs.

10.3982/ecta7343.abstractZh: 本文分析了夫妻之间的非线性最优所得税问题，这是一个多维度筛选问题。每对夫妻由一个主要收入者组成，该收入者始终参与劳动力市场，但会做出工作时间的选择；另一个收入者则选择是否工作。如果第二收入者的参与是夫妻经济状况较好（较差）的信号，我们证明了最优税收方案会对第二收入产生正向的税收（补贴），并且这种税收（补贴）随着主要收入的增加而减少，并最终趋于零。我们为英国提供了经过校准的微观模拟结果，表明降低第二收入部分的税率在数量上具有重要意义，并且与实际所得税和转移支付政策一致。

abstract.text: This paper extends Imbens and Manski's (2004) analysis of confidence intervals for interval identified parameters. The extension is motivated by the discovery that for their final result, Imbens and Manski implicitly assumed locally superefficient estimation of a nuisance parameter.

10.3982/ecta7347.abstractZh: 本文对 Imbens 和 Manski（2004）关于区间识别参数置信区间的分析进行了扩展。这一扩展的动机源于发现，在他们的最终结果中，Imbens 和 Manski 隐含地假设了一个干扰参数的局部超效率估计。

abstract.text: A norm of 50–50 division appears to have considerable force in a wide range of economic environments, both in the real world and in the laboratory. Even in settings where one party unilaterally determines the allocation of a prize (the dictator game), many subjects voluntarily cede exactly half to another individual. The hypothesis that people care about fairness does not by itself account for key experimental patterns. We consider an alternative explanation, which adds the hypothesis that people like to be perceived as fair. The properties of equilibria for the resulting signaling game correspond closely to laboratory observations. The theory has additional testable implications, the validity of which we confirm through new experiments.

10.3982/ecta7384.abstractZh: 50-50的分配标准在现实世界和实验室中的多种经济环境中似乎具有相当大的影响力。即使是在一方单方面决定奖励分配的情况（即独裁游戏），许多受试者也会自愿将一半的奖励分给另一个人。人们关心公平这一假设本身并不能解释关键的实验现象。我们考虑了另一种解释，即人们希望被视作公平。由此产生的信号博弈的均衡特性与实验室观察结果非常吻合。该理论还有更多可验证的推论，我们通过新的实验确认了其有效性。

abstract.text: The econometric literature of high frequency data often relies on moment estimators which are derived from assuming local constancy of volatility and related quantities. We here study this local-constancy approximation as a general approach to estimation in such data. We show that the technique yields asymptotic properties (consistency, normality) that are correct subject to an ex post adjustment involving asymptotic likelihood ratios. These adjustments are derived and documented. Several examples of estimation are provided: powers of volatility, leverage effect, and integrated betas. The first order approximations based on local constancy can be over the period of one observation or over blocks of successive observations. It has the advantage of gaining in transparency in defining and analyzing estimators. The theory relies heavily on the interplay between stable convergence and measure change, and on asymptotic expansions for martingales.

10.3982/ecta7417.abstractZh: 关于高频数据的计量经济学文献，通常依赖于基于局部波动性及其相关量恒定假设推导出的矩估计方法。本文研究这种局部恒定近似方法作为此类数据估计的一般方法。我们证明，该技术所得到的渐近性质（一致性、正态性）在通过涉及渐近似然比的事后调整后得到修正时仍然成立。这些调整方法已被推导并记录下来。文中提供了多个估计示例：波动性幂次、杠杆效应以及积分贝塔值。基于局部恒定假设的初步近似可以应用于单个观测期或连续观测块。这种方法在定义和分析估计量时具有更高的透明度。该理论主要依赖于稳定收敛与度量变化之间的相互作用，以及鞅的渐近展开。

abstract.text: We document cash management patterns for households that are at odds with the predictions of deterministic inventory models that abstract from precautionary motives. We extend the Baumol-Tobin cash inventory model to a dynamic environment that allows for the possibility of withdrawing cash at random times at a low cost. This modification introduces a precautionary motive for holding cash and naturally captures developments in withdrawal technology, such as the increasing diffusion of bank branches and ATM terminals. We characterize the solution of the model, which qualitatively reproduces several empirical patterns. We estimate the structural parameters using micro data and show that quantitatively the model captures important economic patterns. The estimates are used to quantify the expenditure and interest rate elasticity of money demand, the impact of financial innovation on money demand, the welfare cost of inflation, and the benefit of ATM ownership.

10.3982/ecta7451.abstractZh: 我们记录了家庭现金管理模式，这些模式与那些忽略预防性动机的确定性库存模型的预测不符。我们将Baumol-Tobin现金库存模型扩展到一个动态环境中，该环境允许在随机时间以低成本提取现金。这一修改引入了持有现金的预防性动机，并自然地捕捉了取款技术的发展，例如银行分支机构和自动取款机终端的日益普及。我们描述了该模型的解决方案，该模型在定性上再现了多个实证模式。我们使用微观数据估计了结构参数，并表明该模型在定量上能够捕捉到重要的经济模式。这些估计值被用来量化货币需求的支出和利率弹性、金融创新对货币需求的影响、通货膨胀的福利成本，以及拥有自动取款机的好处。

abstract.text: Conditions of information independence are impor-tant in information economics and game theory. We present no-tions of partial independence in Bayesian environments, and study their relationships to notions of common knowledge.

10.3982/ecta7469.abstractZh: 在信息经济学和博弈论中，信息独立性的条件非常重要。我们提出了在贝叶斯环境中的部分独立性概念，并研究了这些概念与共同知识概念之间的关系。

abstract.text: I study individuals who use frequentist models to draw uniform inferences from independent and identically distributed data. The main contribution of this paper is to show that distinct models may be consistent with empirical evidence, even in the limit when data increases without bound. Decision makers may then hold different beliefs and interpret their environment differently even though they know each other's model and base their inferences on the same evidence. The behavior modeled here is that of rational individuals confronting an environment in which learning is hard, rather than individuals beset by cognitive limitations or behavioral biases.

10.3982/ecta7501.abstractZh: 我研究的是那些使用频率主义模型从独立且同分布的数据中得出一致结论的个体。本文的主要贡献在于表明，即使数据无限增加，不同的模型仍然可能与实证证据一致。决策者可能会持有不同的信念，并以不同的方式解释环境，尽管他们了解彼此的模型，并且基于相同的证据进行推断。这里所描述的行为是理性个体面对一个学习成本高昂的环境时的行为，而不是那些受到认知限制或行为偏差影响的个体。

abstract.text: The English auction is susceptible to tacit collusion when post-auction interbidder resale is allowed. We show this by constructing equilibria where, with positive probability, one bidder wins the auction without any competition and divides the spoils by optimally reselling the good to the other bidders. These equilibria interim Pareto-dominate (among bidders) the standard value-bidding equilibrium without requiring the bidders to make any commitment on bidding behavior or postbidding spoil division.

10.3982/ecta7504.abstractZh: 在拍卖结束后允许竞买者转售的情况下，英国式拍卖容易受到默契勾结的影响。我们通过构建一种均衡模型来展示这一现象：以较高的概率，某个竞买者无需任何竞争就能赢得拍卖，并最优地将商品转售给其他竞买者，从而瓜分拍卖所得。这些均衡在竞买者之间暂时占据帕累托优势，而无需竞买者做出任何关于出价行为或拍卖后利润分配的承诺。

abstract.text: We develop a model of friendship formation that sheds light on segregation patterns observed in social and economic networks. Individuals have types and see type-dependent benefits from friendships. We examine the properties of a steady-state equilibrium of a matching process of friendship formation. We use the model to understand three empirical patterns of friendship formation: (i) larger groups tend to form more same-type ties and fewer other-type ties than small groups, (ii) larger groups form more ties per capita, and (iii) all groups are biased towards same-type relative to demographics, with the most extreme bias coming from middle-sized groups. We show how these empirical observations can be generated by biases in preferences and biases in meetings. We also illustrate some welfare implications of the model.

10.3982/ecta7528.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个友谊形成的模型，该模型有助于揭示社会和经济网络中观察到的隔离模式。个体具有不同的类型，并从中获得与类型相关的友谊带来的好处。我们研究了友谊形成匹配过程的稳态均衡特性。利用该模型，我们发现了三种友谊形成的实证模式：(i) 较大的群体倾向于形成更多同类型的联系，而与其他类型的关系则较少；(ii) 较大的群体人均形成的联系更多；(iii) 所有群体都倾向于与同类型的人建立联系，其中中等规模的群体这种倾向最为明显。我们展示了这些实证观察结果是如何由偏好偏差和聚会偏差产生的。此外，我们还阐述了该模型的一些福利含义。

abstract.text: This paper studies a class of games, “all-pay contests,” which capture general asymmetries and sunk investments inherent in scenarios such as lobbying, competition for market power, labor-market tournaments, and R&D races. Players compete for one of several identical prizes by choosing a score. Conditional on winning or losing, it is weakly better to do so with a lower score. This formulation allows for differing production technologies, costs of capital, prior investments, attitudes toward risk, and conditional and unconditional investments, among others. I provide a closed-form formula for players' equilibrium payoffs and analyze player participation. A special case of contests is multiprize, complete-information all-pay auctions.

10.3982/ecta7537.abstractZh: 本文研究了一类被称为“全额支付竞赛”的游戏，这类游戏能够捕捉到诸如游说、争夺市场力量、劳动力市场竞赛以及研发竞赛等场景中普遍存在的不对称性和沉没投资问题。玩家通过选择得分来竞争几个相同的奖品之一。在获胜或失败的条件下，选择较低的得分通常能获得更好的收益。这一模型允许存在不同的生产技术、资本成本、前期投资、风险态度以及条件性与非条件性投资等因素的影响。我给出了玩家均衡收益的封闭形式公式，并分析了玩家的参与行为。这类竞赛的一个特例是多奖项、完全信息全额支付拍卖。

abstract.text: I discuss the failure of the canonical search and matching model to match the cyclical volatility in the job finding rate. I show that job creation in the model is influenced by wages in new matches. I summarize microeconometric evidence and find that wages in new matches are volatile and consistent with the model's key predictions. Therefore, explanations of the unemployment volatility puzzle have to preserve the cyclical volatility of wages. I discuss a modification of the model, based on fixed matching costs, that can increase cyclical unemployment volatility and is consistent with wage flexibility in new matches.

10.3982/ecta7562.abstractZh: 我讨论了经典搜索与匹配模型在匹配就业率周期性波动方面的失败。我发现，模型中的就业创造受到新匹配对象工资水平的影响。我总结了微观计量经济学的研究结果，发现新匹配对象的工资水平具有波动性，这与模型的关键预测一致。因此，对失业波动问题的解释必须考虑到工资的周期性波动。我讨论了一种基于固定匹配成本的模型改进方案，该方案可以增加周期性失业的波动性，并且与新匹配对象中的工资灵活性相一致。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a model of decision under ambiguity deemed vector expected utility, or VEU. In this model, an uncertain prospect, or Savage act, is assessed according to (a) a baseline expected-utility evaluation, and (b) an adjustment that reflects the individual's perception of ambiguity and her attitudes toward it. The adjustment is itself a function of the act's exposure to distinct sources of ambiguity, as well as its variability. The key elements of the VEU model are a baseline probability and a collection of random variables, or adjustment factors, which represent acts exposed to distinct ambiguity sources and also reflect complementarities among ambiguous events. The adjustment to the baseline expected-utility evaluation of an act is a function of the covariance of its utility profile with each adjustment factor, which reflects exposure to the corresponding ambiguity source. A behavioral characterization of the VEU model is provided. Furthermore, an updating rule for VEU preferences is proposed and characterized. The suggested updating rule facilitates the analysis of sophisticated dynamic choice with VEU preferences.

10.3982/ecta7564.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个关于模糊情境下决策模型，称为向量期望效用模型，简称VEU模型。在该模型中，不确定的前景或萨维奇行为会根据以下两个因素进行评估：(a) 基准期望效用评估，以及(b) 反映个体对模糊性感知及其态度的调整。这种调整本身取决于该行为所面临的多种模糊性来源及其变异性。VEU模型的关键要素包括一个基准概率以及一组随机变量或调整因子，这些变量代表面临不同模糊性来源的行为，并反映不同模糊事件之间的互补性。对行为前景的期望效用评估的调整，取决于其效用特征与每个调整因子的协方差，这反映了该行为所面临的相应模糊性来源。本文还提供了VEU模型的行为特征描述，并提出了一种更新VEU偏好的规则。该更新规则有助于分析具有VEU偏好的复杂动态选择问题。

abstract.text: We identify a new way to order functions, called the interval dominance order, that generalizes both the single crossing property and a standard condition used in statistical decision theory. This allows us to provide a unified treatment of the major theorems on monotone comparative statics with and without uncertainty, the comparison of signal informativeness, and a non-Bayesian theorem on the completeness of increasing decision rules. We illustrate the concept and results with various applications, including an application to optimal stopping time problems where the single crossing property is typically violated.

10.3982/ecta7583.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的函数排序方法，称为区间优势排序，该方法既推广了单一交叉性质，也适用于统计决策理论中使用的标准条件。这使我们能够统一处理关于单调比较静态理论的主要定理，无论是否存在不确定性、信号信息量的比较，以及关于递增决策规则完备性的非贝叶斯定理。我们通过多种应用来说明这一概念和结果，包括一个最优停止时间问题的应用，其中通常违反单一交叉性质。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of optimal stopping under Knightian uncertainty. A suitable martingale theory for multiple priors is derived that extends the classical dynamic programming or Snell envelope approach to multiple priors. We relate the multiple prior theory to the classical setup via a minimax theorem. In a multiple prior version of the classical model of independent and identically distributed random variables, we discuss several examples from microeconomics, operation research, and finance. For monotone payoffs, the worst-case prior can be identified quite easily with the help of stochastic dominance arguments. For more complex payoff structures like barrier options, model ambiguity leads to stochastic changes in the worst-case beliefs.

10.3982/ecta7594.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种在奈特型不确定性下的最优停止理论。我们推导出了一种适用于多种先验假设的鞅理论，该理论扩展了传统的动态规划或斯内尔包络方法到多种先验假设的情况。我们通过一个极小极大定理将多种先验假设的理论与经典模型联系起来。在经典模型中，独立同分布随机变量的多重先验假设版本下，我们讨论了来自微观经济学、运筹学和金融领域的几个例子。对于单调收益情况，借助随机优势论证，可以很容易地确定最坏情况下的先验假设。对于更复杂的收益结构，如障碍期权，模型的不确定性会导致最坏情况下信念的随机变化。

abstract.text: Comparative advantage, whether driven by technology or factor endowment, is at the core of neoclassical trade theory. Using tools from the mathematics of complementarity, this paper offers a simple yet unifying perspective on the fundamental forces that shape comparative advantage. The main results characterize sufficient conditions on factor productivity and factor supply to predict patterns of international specialization in a multifactor generalization of the Ricardian model which we refer to as an “elementary neoclassical economy.” These conditions, which hold for an arbitrarily large number of countries, goods, and factors, generalize and extend many results from the previous trade literature. They also offer new insights about the joint effects of technology and factor endowments on international specialization.

10.3982/ecta7636.abstractZh: 比较优势，无论是由技术还是要素禀赋所驱动，都是新古典贸易理论的核心概念。本文运用互补性数学工具，提供了一种简单而统一的视角来阐释塑造比较优势的基本力量。主要研究结果指出了要素生产力和要素供给的充分条件，这些条件可以预测在多重因素条件下的国际专业化模式，我们将这种模型称为“基本新古典经济”。这些条件适用于任意多的国家、商品和要素，它们概括了并扩展了以往贸易文献中的许多研究结果。此外，这些结果还提供了关于技术和要素禀赋对国际专业化联合影响的新的见解。

abstract.text: Two key issues in the literature on female labor supply are (i) whether persistence in employment status is due to unobserved heterogeneity or state dependence, and (ii) whether fertility is exogenous to labor supply. Until recently, the consensus was that unobserved heterogeneity is very important and fertility is endogenous. Hyslop (1999) challenged this. Using a dynamic panel probit model of female labor supply including heterogeneity and state dependence, he found that adding autoregressive errors led to a substantial diminution in the importance of heterogeneity. This, in turn, meant he could not reject that fertility is exogenous. Here, we extend Hyslop (1999) to allow classification error in employment status, using an estimation procedure developed by Keane and Wolpin (2001) and Keane and Sauer (2005). We find that a fairly small amount of classification error is enough to overturn Hyslop's conclusions, leading to overwhelming rejection of the hypothesis of exogenous fertility.

10.3982/ecta7642.abstractZh: 在关于女性劳动力供给的文献中，有两个关键问题：(i) 就业状态的持续性是由于未观察到的异质性还是状态依赖性；(ii) 生育率是否对劳动力供给是外生的。直到最近，普遍观点认为未观察到的异质性非常重要，而生育率是内生的。Hyslop（1999年）对此提出了质疑。他使用了一个包含异质性和状态依赖性的动态面板Probit模型，发现加入自回归误差后，异质性的重要性显著降低。这反过来意味着他无法拒绝生育率是外生的这一假设。在这里，我们扩展了Hyslop（1999年）的研究，考虑了就业状态的分类误差，并使用了Keane和Wolpin（2001年）以及Keane和Sauer（2005年）开发的估计方法。我们发现，相当小的分类误差就足以推翻Hyslop的结论，从而彻底否定了生育率是外生的假设。

abstract.text: We show by counterexample that Proposition 2 in Fernández-Villaverde, Rubio-Ramírez, and Santos (Econometrica (2006), 74, 93–119) is false. We also show that even if their Proposition 2 were corrected, it would be irrelevant for parameter estimates. As a more constructive contribution, we consider the effects of approximation error on parameter estimation, and conclude that second order approximation errors in the policy function have at most second order effects on parameter estimates.

10.3982/ecta7669.abstractZh: 我们通过反例证明，Fernández-Villaverde、Rubio-Ramírez和Santos在《Econometrica》（2006年，第74卷，第93-119页）中的命题2是错误的。我们还表明，即使他们的命题2得到修正，其对参数估计的影响也是微不足道的。作为更具建设性的贡献，我们考虑了近似误差对参数估计的影响，并得出结论：在政策函数中，二阶近似误差对参数估计的影响最多是二阶的。

abstract.text: Nonparametric estimation of a structural cointegrating regression model is studied. As in the standard linear cointegrating regression model, the regressor and the dependent variable are jointly dependent and contemporaneously correlated. In nonparametric estimation problems, joint dependence is known to be a major complication that affects identification, induces bias in conventional kernel estimates, and frequently leads to ill-posed inverse problems. In functional cointegrating regressions where the regressor is an integrated time series, it is shown here that inverse and ill-posed inverse problems do not arise. Remarkably, nonparametric kernel estimation of a structural nonparametric cointegrating regression is consistent and the limit distribution theory is mixed normal, giving simple useable asymptotics in practical work. The results provide a convenient basis for inference in structural nonparametric regression with nonstationary time series. The methods may be applied to a wide range of empirical models where functional estimation of cointegrating relations is required.

10.3982/ecta7732.abstractZh: 本文研究了结构协整回归模型的非参数估计方法。与标准的线性协整回归模型一样，回归变量和因变量之间存在联合依赖关系，并且具有同时相关性。在非参数估计问题中，联合依赖关系是一个主要复杂因素，它会影响识别过程，导致传统核估计出现偏差，并经常引发不适定的逆问题。在回归变量为积分时间序列的功能性协整回归中，本文证明了不会出现不适定的逆问题。值得注意的是，结构非参数协整回归的非参数核估计是一致的，其极限分布理论为混合正态分布，这为实际工作中的推断提供了简便的方法。这些方法可以应用于需要功能性估计协整关系的各种实证模型。

abstract.text: I construct a theoretical framework in which firms offer wage–tenure contracts to direct the search by risk-averse workers. All workers can search, on or off the job. I characterize an equilibrium and prove its existence. The equilibrium generates a nondegenerate, continuous distribution of employed workers over the values of contracts, despite that all matches are identical and workers observe all offers. A striking property is that the equilibrium is block recursive; that is, individuals' optimal decisions and optimal contracts are independent of the distribution of workers. This property makes the equilibrium analysis tractable. Consistent with stylized facts, the equilibrium predicts that (i) wages increase with tenure, (ii) job-to-job transitions decrease with tenure and wages, and (iii) wage mobility is limited in the sense that the lower the worker's wage, the lower the future wage a worker will move to in the next job transition. Moreover, block recursivity implies that changes in the unemployment benefit and the minimum wage have no effect on an employed worker's job-to-job transitions and contracts.

10.3982/ecta7870.abstractZh: 我构建了一个理论框架，其中企业提供工资-任期合同来引导风险规避工人的择业行为。所有工人都可以在工作内外进行择业。我描述了该均衡状态，并证明了其存在性。该均衡使得在职工人的分布成为一个非退化的、连续的分布，尽管所有匹配都是相同的，且工人会观察到所有报价。一个显著的特点是，该均衡具有块递归性；也就是说，个体的最优决策和最优合同与工人的分布无关。这一特性使得均衡分析变得可行。与典型事实一致，该均衡预测：(i) 工资随任期增长；(ii) 工作间的转换随任期和工资的增加而减少；(iii) 工资流动性有限，即工人的工资越低，其在下一次工作转换中获得的未来工资也越低。此外，块递归性意味着失业救济金和最低工资的变化不会对在职工人的工作转换和合同产生任何影响。

abstract.text: We solve for the equilibrium dynamics of information sharing in a large population. Each agent is endowed with signals regarding the likely outcome of a random variable of common concern. Individuals choose the effort with which they search for others from whom they can gather additional information. When two agents meet, they share their information. The information gathered is further shared at subsequent meetings, and so on. Equilibria exist in which agents search maximally until they acquire sufficient information precision, and then minimally. A tax whose proceeds are used to subsidize the costs of search improves information sharing and can in some cases increase welfare. On the other hand, endowing agents with public signals reduces information sharing and can in some cases decrease welfare.

10.3982/ecta8160.abstractZh: 我们研究了大量人群中信息共享的均衡动态。每个个体都拥有关于共同关注随机变量可能结果的信号。个体会选择搜索其他个体以获取额外信息的努力程度。当两个个体相遇时，他们会分享自己的信息。收集到的信息会在后续的交会中进一步共享，如此循环。存在这样的均衡状态：个体在获得足够精确的信息之前会进行最大程度的搜索，而在获得足够信息后则进行最小程度的搜索。一种以搜索成本补贴为目的的税收可以改善信息共享，在某些情况下还能提高福利。另一方面，向个体提供公共信号则会减少信息共享，在某些情况下甚至会降低福利。
